
===== .github\workflows\ci.yml =====

name: Architecture and security checks
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6.1.0
        with:
          version: 11.3.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm setup:local
      - run: pnpm db:generate
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - name: Unit, domain, backup and logging tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p .local
          pnpm test | tee .local/e16-unit.log
      - name: PostgreSQL integration, replay, outbox and restore drill
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p .local
          pnpm test:integration | tee .local/e16-integration.log
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: pnpm test:e2e
      - run: pnpm audit --audit-level=high
      - run: pnpm build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: e16-verification-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            test-results/
            .local/e16-integration.log
            .local/e16-unit.log
            .local/e2e-report.json
            .local/commerce-*-operator.png
            .local/catalog-*.png
            .local/ui-*.png
            .local/e02-*.png
            .local/nasj-*.png
          retention-days: 3

-- Immutable audit: application and runtime credentials cannot UPDATE or DELETE events.
-- A schema owner can explicitly remove the trigger during an authorized retention migration.
CREATE FUNCTION hirfacare_audit_append_only() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Audit events are append-only'; END;
$$;
CREATE TRIGGER audit_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "AuditEvent"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hirfacare_audit_append_only();

ALTER TABLE "CapacityDeclaration" ADD CONSTRAINT "capacity_nonnegative" CHECK (quantity >= 0);
ALTER TABLE "CapacityDeclaration" ADD CONSTRAINT "capacity_effective_period" CHECK ("effectiveTo" > "effectiveFrom");
ALTER TABLE "ArtisanProfile" ADD CONSTRAINT "contact_visibility" CHECK ("contactVisibility" IN ('PRIVATE','ASSOCIATION','PUBLIC'));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "invitation_pending_email" ON "Invitation" ("organizationId",email) WHERE status = 'PENDING';

===== apps\api\prisma\migrations\202610170003_capacity_revisions\migration.sql =====

-- Preserve all declaration values; explicitly mark historical revisions.
ALTER TABLE "CapacityDeclaration" ADD COLUMN "supersededAt" TIMESTAMP(3);
-- If an earlier deployment contains overlapping declarations, latest declaration wins.
-- Metadata-only backfill preserves original quantity, effective dates and provenance.
UPDATE "CapacityDeclaration" old SET "supersededAt" = now()
WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM "CapacityDeclaration" newer
 WHERE newer."artisanProfileId" = old."artisanProfileId"
 AND newer."craftSkillId" = old."craftSkillId" AND newer."unitType" = old."unitType"
 AND newer."effectiveFrom" < old."effectiveTo" AND newer."effectiveTo" > old."effectiveFrom"
 AND (newer."createdAt",newer.id) > (old."createdAt",old.id)
);
CREATE INDEX "capacity_current_scope" ON "CapacityDeclaration" ("artisanProfileId","craftSkillId","unitType","effectiveFrom") WHERE "supersededAt" IS NULL;

CREATE FUNCTION sync_coordinator_marker() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='OrganizationMember' THEN
 NEW."isCoordinator" := EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "MembershipRole" WHERE "membershipId"=NEW.id AND role='ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'); RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP!='DELETE' THEN UPDATE "OrganizationMember" SET "isCoordinator"=true WHERE id=NEW."membershipId"; END IF;
 IF TG_OP!='INSERT' THEN UPDATE "OrganizationMember" SET "isCoordinator"=false WHERE id=OLD."membershipId"; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER membership_coordinator_marker BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON "OrganizationMember" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_coordinator_marker();
CREATE TRIGGER role_coordinator_marker AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON "MembershipRole" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_coordinator_marker();

-- Immutable evidence cannot be rewritten by a later application bug or direct UPDATE.
CREATE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Procurement evidence is append-only; create a new version'; END;
$$;
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementRevision_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementRevision" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementActivity_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementActivity" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementMessage_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementMessage" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementSample_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementSample" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementSampleDecision_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementSampleDecision" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementQuote_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementQuote" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementAcceptance_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementAcceptance" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
CREATE TRIGGER "ProcurementDocument_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "ProcurementDocument" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION procurement_immutable_evidence();
ALTER TABLE "ProcurementSampleDecision" ADD CONSTRAINT "sample_decision_valid" CHECK (decision IN ('APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED','REJECTED'));
ALTER TABLE "ApprovedProductVersion" ADD CONSTRAINT "product_status_valid" CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED','DISCONTINUED'));
ALTER TABLE "ProcurementDocument" ADD CONSTRAINT "document_kind_valid" CHECK (kind IN ('QUOTE','CONTRACT','INVOICE','DELIVERY'));
ALTER TABLE "ProcurementDocument" ADD CONSTRAINT "document_status_valid" CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','FINAL','VOID'));
ALTER TABLE "ProcurementAttachment" ADD CONSTRAINT "attachment_safe_image" CHECK (mime='image/webp' AND octet_length(bytes)<=262144);
COMMIT;

enum OutboxStatus {
  PENDING
  RETRY
  DELIVERED
  FAILED
}

// Metadata only: never copy user-entered text, audit snapshots or wearable data.
model OutboxEvent {
  id             String           @id
  auditEventId   String           @unique
  eventType      String
  version        Int              @default(1)
  actorId        String
  organizationId String?
  targetType     String
  targetId       String
  correlationId  String
  createdAt      DateTime         @default(now())
  status         OutboxStatus     @default(PENDING)
  attempts       Int              @default(0)
  availableAt    DateTime         @default(now())
  deliveredAt    DateTime?
  lastErrorCode  String?
  durationMs     Int?
  notices        CommerceNotice[]
  receipt        EventReceipt?

  @@index([status, availableAt])
}

// Internal durable consumer; not evidence of external publication or commerce ETL.
model EventReceipt {
  eventId    String      @id
  event      OutboxEvent @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  receivedAt DateTime    @default(now())
}

  snapshot  Json

}

===== apps\api\src\common\csrf.ts =====

import { SignJWT, jwtVerify } from 'jose';
export async function csrfToken(secret: string, sessionId: string) {
  return new SignJWT({ sid: sessionId, purpose: 'csrf' })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: 'HS256' })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime('1h')
    .sign(new TextEncoder().encode(secret));
}
export async function verifyCsrf(secret: string, token: string, sessionId: string) {
  try {
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, new TextEncoder().encode(secret), {
      algorithms: ['HS256'],
    });
    return payload.sid === sessionId && payload.purpose === 'csrf';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

===== apps\api\src\common\http-exception.filter.ts =====

import { CommerceRuleError } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { Catch, HttpException, type ArgumentsHost, type ExceptionFilter } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { AppRequest } from './identity.js';
import { logger } from './logging.js';
export function errorResponse(error: unknown, requestId: string) {
  let status = 500;
  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
    message: 'Unable to complete this request.',
  };
  const kind = error && typeof error === 'object' && 'type' in error ? error.type : undefined;
  if (error instanceof CommerceRuleError) {
    status =
      error.code === 'FORBIDDEN' || error.code === 'CONSENT_REQUIRED'
        ? 403
        : error.code === 'NOT_FOUND'
          ? 404
          : error.code === 'INVALID_TRANSITION'
            ? 409
            : error.code.startsWith('INVALID_')
              ? 400
              : 409;
    body = {
      code: error.code,
      message: error.message,
      ...(['INVALID_DEADLINE', 'INVALID_CRAFT'].includes(error.code)
        ? {
            fieldErrors: {
              [error.code === 'INVALID_DEADLINE' ? 'deliveryAt' : 'craftSkillId']: [error.message],
            },
          }
        : {}),
    };
  } else if (kind === 'entity.parse.failed') {
    status = 400;
    body = { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Request body must contain valid JSON.' };
  } else if (kind === 'entity.too.large') {
    status = 413;
    body = { code: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE', message: 'Request body is too large.' };
  } else if (error instanceof HttpException) {
    status = error.getStatus();
    const data = error.getResponse();
    body =
      typeof data === 'object' && 'code' in data
        ? (data as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {
            code: status === 404 ? 'NOT_FOUND' : 'REQUEST_FAILED',
            message: status === 404 ? 'Resource not found.' : 'Unable to complete this request.',
          };
  } else if (error instanceof ZodError) {
    status = 400;
    body = {
      code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
      message: 'Check the submitted fields.',
      fieldErrors: error.flatten().fieldErrors,
    };
  } else if (
    error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
    ['P2002', 'P2003', 'P2025', 'P2034'].includes(error.code)
  ) {
    status = 409;
    body = {
      code: 'STATE_CONFLICT',
      message: 'This record changed or conflicts with existing data.',
    };
  }
  if (status >= 500)
    logger.error(
      { requestId, errorType: error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Unknown' },
      'Request failed',
    );
  return { status, body: { ...body, requestId } };
}
@Catch()
export class HttpExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  catch(error: unknown, host: ArgumentsHost) {
    const req = host.switchToHttp().getRequest<AppRequest>();
    const res = host.switchToHttp().getResponse<Response>();
    const result = errorResponse(error, req.requestId ?? randomUUID());
    res.status(result.status).json(result.body);
  }
}

import pino from 'pino';
import type { LoggerService } from '@nestjs/common';
export function createLogger(destination?: pino.DestinationStream) {
  const options: pino.LoggerOptions = {
    level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL ?? 'info',
    redact: {
      paths: [
        'password',
        'token',
        'secret',
        'cookie',
        'authorization',
        'body',
        'payload',
        '*.password',
        '*.token',
        '*.secret',
        '*.authorization',
        '*.cookie',
        '*.body',
        '*.payload',
        'req.headers.authorization',
        'req.headers.cookie',
        'wearableSummary',
        'sensorData',
      ],
      remove: true,
    },
  };
  return destination ? pino(options, destination) : pino(options);
}
export const logger = createLogger();
export class NestLogger implements LoggerService {
  log() {
    /* Lifecycle noise is omitted; application events use the safe structured sink. */
  }
  debug() {}
  verbose() {}
  warn() {
    logger.warn('Application warning');
  }
  error() {
    logger.error('Application operation failed');
  }
  fatal() {
    logger.fatal('Application failure');
  }
}

export function routeLabel(path: string) {
  if (/^\/api\/v1\/procurement(?:\/|$)/.test(path)) {
    const words = new Set([
      'api',
      'v1',
      'procurement',
      'rfqs',
      'documents',
      'products',
      'activity',
      'revisions',
      'submit',
      'review',
      'attachments',
      'remove',
      'token',
      'content',
      'questions',
      'answer',
      'thread',
      'samples',
      'sample-decisions',
      'quotes',
      'accept',
      'download',
      'status',
      'reorder',
    ]);
    return path
      .split('/')
      .map((s) => (s && !words.has(s) ? ':id' : s))
      .join('/');
  }
  if (exact.has(path)) return path;
  if (/^\/api\/v1\/me\/sessions\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return '/api/v1/me/sessions/:id';
  if (/^\/api\/v1\/admin\/users\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return '/api/v1/admin/users/:id';
  if (/^\/api\/v1\/users\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return '/api/v1/users/:id';
  const templates = [
    /^\/api\/v1\/associations\/me\/artisans\/[^/]+(?:\/(?:skills|capacity|authorization|assignments)(?:\/[^/]+\/withdraw)?)?$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/admin\/(?:coordinators|artisans|authorization-policies|participant-concerns)\/[^/]+(?:\/(?:status|transfer|assignment|link-account))?$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/operator\/organizations\/[^/]+\/(?:participants|duplicate-reviews)$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/organizations\/[^/]+\/members\/[^/]+\/permissions$/,

    /^\/api\/v1\/organizations\/[^/]+(?:\/(?:submit-approval|members|invitations|audit-events))?$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/organizations\/[^/]+\/(?:members|invitations)\/[^/]+(?:\/(?:roles|resend))?$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/admin\/organizations\/[^/]+(?:\/(?:approve|reject|suspend))?$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/admin\/privacy-requests\/[^/]+$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/support\/cases\/[^/]+(?:\/notify)?$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/consents\/[^/]+$/,
    /^\/api\/v1\/artisans\/(?:me|[^/]+)(?:\/(?:skills|capacity|associations|delegations))?(?:\/[^/]+(?:\/coordinators)?)?$/,
  ];
  if (templates.some((pattern) => pattern.test(path))) {
    const literals = new Set([
      'authorization-policies',
      'participant-concerns',
      'status',
      'transfer',
      'assignment',
      'assignments',
      'link-account',
      'operator',
      'participants',
      'duplicate-reviews',
      'permissions',
      'capacity',
      'authorization',
      'withdraw',
      'api',
      'v1',
      'organizations',
      'members',
      'invitations',
      'roles',
      'resend',
      'submit-approval',
      'audit-events',
      'admin',
      'approve',
      'reject',
      'suspend',
      'privacy-requests',
      'support',
      'cases',
      'notify',
      'consents',
      'artisans',
      'me',
      'skills',
      'capacity',
      'associations',
      'delegations',
      'coordinators',
    ]);
    return path
      .split('/')
      .map((segment) => (segment && !literals.has(segment) ? ':id' : segment))
      .join('/');
  }
  return '/api/[unknown]';
}

import type { z } from 'zod';
@Injectable()
export class ZodValidationPipe<T extends z.ZodType> implements PipeTransform {
  constructor(private readonly schema: T) {}
  transform(value: unknown): z.output<T> {
    return this.schema.parse(value);
  }
}

===== apps\api\src\config\env.ts =====

import { isIP } from 'node:net';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { config as dotenv } from 'dotenv';
import { z } from 'zod';

const bool = z.enum(['true', 'false']).transform((value) => value === 'true');
const positive = z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000000);
const optional = (value: unknown) => (value === '' ? undefined : value);
export function trustedNetwork(value: string) {
  const [address, mask, extra] = value.split('/');
  const family = isIP(address);
  return Boolean(
    family &&
      extra === undefined &&
      (mask === undefined ||
        (/^\d+$/.test(mask) && Number(mask) >= 1 && Number(mask) <= (family === 4 ? 32 : 128))),
  );
}
export const envSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development'),
  PUBLIC_APP_URL: z
    .url()
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        new URL(value).origin === value && !new URL(value).username && !new URL(value).password,
      'Use one HTTP(S) origin without a path or trailing slash.',
    )
    .refine((value) => /^https?:\/\//.test(value)),
  API_PORT: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(65535).default(3001),
  API_HOST: z.string().default('127.0.0.1'),
  DATABASE_URL: z
    .url()
    .refine((value) => /^postgres(?:ql)?:\/\//.test(value), 'Use a PostgreSQL URL.'),
  BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: z
    .string()
    .min(48)
    .refine(
      (value) => !/generate|replace|example/i.test(value),
      'Generate a random authentication secret.',
    ),
  TRUST_PROXY: z
    .string()
    .default('')
    .transform((value) =>
      value
        .split(',')
        .map((v) => v.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    )
    .refine(
      (values) => values.every(trustedNetwork),
      'Use explicit proxy IPs/CIDRs; never true, hop counts or wildcards.',
    ),
  DEMO_MODE: bool.default(false),
  REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA: bool.default(false),
  ARCJET_ENABLED: bool.default(false),
  ARCJET_KEY: z.preprocess(optional, z.string().optional()),
  ARCJET_MODE: z.enum(['DRY_RUN', 'LIVE']).default('DRY_RUN'),
  ARCJET_FAILURE_MODE: z.enum(['closed', 'open']).default('closed'),
  RATE_LOGIN_MAX: positive.default(10),
  RATE_LOGIN_WINDOW: positive.default(60),
  RATE_REGISTRATION_MAX: positive.default(5),
  RATE_REGISTRATION_WINDOW: positive.default(3600),
  RATE_RESET_MAX: positive.default(5),
  RATE_RESET_WINDOW: positive.default(3600),
  RATE_VERIFICATION_MAX: positive.default(10),
  RATE_VERIFICATION_WINDOW: positive.default(3600),
  RATE_API_MAX: positive.default(120),
  RATE_API_WINDOW: positive.default(60),
  RATE_ADMIN_MAX: positive.default(30),
  RATE_ADMIN_WINDOW: positive.default(60),
  SMTP_HOST: z.string().min(1).default('127.0.0.1'),
  SMTP_PORT: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(65535).default(1026),
  SMTP_SECURE: bool.default(false),
  SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS: bool.default(false),
  SMTP_USER: z.preprocess(optional, z.string().optional()),
  SMTP_PASSWORD: z.preprocess(optional, z.string().optional()),
  EMAIL_FROM: z.string().min(3).default('NASJ <noreply@nasj.local>'),
  LOG_LEVEL: z.enum(['silent', 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug']).default('info'),
});
export function validateEnvironment(values: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const parsed = envSchema.safeParse(values);
  if (!parsed.success)
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid environment fields: ${parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => issue.path.join('.')).join(', ')}`,
    );
  const config = parsed.data;
  if (config.ARCJET_ENABLED && !config.ARCJET_KEY)
    throw new Error('ARCJET_KEY is required when ARCJET_ENABLED=true.');
  if (
    config.DEMO_MODE &&
    (new URL(config.DATABASE_URL).pathname !== '/nasj_demo' ||
      config.NODE_ENV === 'production')
  )
    throw new Error(
      'Demo mode requires the isolated nasj_demo database and nonproduction environment.',
    );
  if (config.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    if (!config.REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA)
      throw new Error('Production requires REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA=true.');
    if (!config.PUBLIC_APP_URL.startsWith('https://'))
      throw new Error('Production PUBLIC_APP_URL requires HTTPS.');
    if (!config.ARCJET_ENABLED || !config.ARCJET_KEY)
      throw new Error('Production requires configured Arcjet protection.');
    if (
      (!config.SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS && !config.SMTP_SECURE) ||
      !config.SMTP_USER ||
      !config.SMTP_PASSWORD
    )
      throw new Error('Production requires authenticated TLS SMTP.');
  }
  return config;
}
export function loadConfig() {
  dotenv({ path: fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../../.env', import.meta.url)), quiet: true });
  return validateEnvironment(process.env);
}
export type AppConfig = ReturnType<typeof validateEnvironment>;
export const APP_CONFIG = Symbol('APP_CONFIG');

===== apps\api\src\jobs\alerts.ts =====

// Fixed codes are suitable for supervisor alerts; never include provider exception text.
export function operationalAlerts(input: {
  ready: boolean;
  oldestPendingAgeMs: number;
  failedCount: number;
  backupAgeMs?: number | null;
}) {
  const alerts: string[] = [];
  if (!input.ready) alerts.push('API_NOT_READY');
  if (input.failedCount > 0) alerts.push('OUTBOX_FAILED');
  if (input.oldestPendingAgeMs > 300000) alerts.push('OUTBOX_LAG');
  if (input.backupAgeMs === null) alerts.push('BACKUP_MISSING');
  else if (input.backupAgeMs !== undefined && input.backupAgeMs > 86400000)
    alerts.push('BACKUP_STALE');
  return alerts;
}


===== apps\api\src\jobs\commerce-consumer.ts =====

import type { Prisma, OutboxEvent } from '@prisma/client';
import { deriveCommerceMetrics } from '@nasj/contracts';
import type { LocalConsumer } from './outbox.js';

const sourceInclude = { rfq: true, offers: true, batches: true, payments: true } as const;
export async function rebuildOrder(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, orderId: string) {
  const order = await tx.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({
    where: { id: orderId },
    include: sourceInclude,
  });
  const milestones = await tx.auditEvent.findMany({
    where: {
      targetType: 'CommercialOrder',
      targetId: orderId,
      action: { in: ['commerce.order.in_transit', 'commerce.order.buyer_accepted'] },
    },
    select: { action: true },
  });
  const metrics = deriveCommerceMetrics({
    ...order,
    milestones: {
      shipped: milestones.some((m) => m.action === 'commerce.order.in_transit'),
      accepted: milestones.some((m) => m.action === 'commerce.order.buyer_accepted'),
    },
  });
  await tx.commerceProjection.upsert({
    where: { orderId },
    create: { orderId, metrics, definitionVersion: 1 },
    update: { metrics, asOf: new Date(), definitionVersion: 1 },
  });
}
async function resolve(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, event: OutboxEvent) {
  let rfqId: string | undefined;
  let orderId: string | undefined;
  let artisanId: string | undefined;
  let buyerVisible = false;
  switch (event.targetType) {
    case 'CommercialRfq':
      rfqId = event.targetId;
      buyerVisible = true;
      break;
    case 'CommercialOrder':
      orderId = event.targetId;
      buyerVisible = true;
      break;
    case 'CommercialOffer': {
      const row = await tx.commercialOffer.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: event.targetId },
        include: { artisanProfile: true },
      });
      orderId = row.orderId;
      artisanId = row.artisanProfile.userId ?? undefined;
      break;
    }
    case 'CommercialBatch': {
      const row = await tx.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: event.targetId },
        include: { artisanProfile: true },
      });
      orderId = row.orderId;
      artisanId = row.artisanProfile.userId ?? undefined;
      break;
    }
    case 'SyntheticPayment': {
      const row = await tx.syntheticPayment.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: event.targetId },
        include: { batch: { include: { artisanProfile: true } } },
      });
      orderId = row.orderId;
      artisanId = row.batch?.artisanProfile.userId ?? undefined;
      buyerVisible = row.kind === 'BUYER_RECEIPT';
      break;
    }
    default:
      throw Error('Unsupported commerce target.');
  }
  const order = orderId
    ? await tx.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } })
    : undefined;
  const rfq = await tx.commercialRfq.findUniqueOrThrow({
    where: { id: rfqId ?? order!.rfqId },
    include: { order: true },
  });
  if (rfq.provenance !== 'SYNTHETIC' || rfq.buyerOrganizationId !== event.organizationId)
    throw Error('Invalid commerce source.');
  return { rfq, orderId: orderId ?? rfq.order?.id, artisanId, buyerVisible };
}
/** One justified queue: the existing durable outbox also runs the read-only-ledger ETL.
 * Projection, inbox effects and receipt commit together; retry rolls them all back. */
export const consumeLocalEvent: LocalConsumer = async (tx, event) => {
  if (event.version !== 1) throw Error('Unsupported event version.');
  if (await tx.eventReceipt.findUnique({ where: { eventId: event.id } })) return;
  if (event.eventType.startsWith('commerce.')) {
    const { rfq, orderId, artisanId, buyerVisible } = await resolve(tx, event);
    if (orderId) await rebuildOrder(tx, orderId);
    const scopes = [
      ...(buyerVisible ? [{ audience: 'BUYER', scopeId: rfq.buyerOrganizationId }] : []),
      ...(rfq.status !== 'DRAFT'
        ? [{ audience: 'OPERATOR', scopeId: rfq.operatorOrganizationId }]
        : []),
      ...(artisanId ? [{ audience: 'ARTISAN', scopeId: artisanId }] : []),
    ];
    for (const scope of scopes)
      await tx.commerceNotice.upsert({
        where: { eventId_audience_scopeId: { eventId: event.id, ...scope } },
        create: { eventId: event.id, ...scope, code: event.eventType },
        update: {},
      });
  }
  await tx.eventReceipt.create({ data: { eventId: event.id } });
};

/** Trusted operator CLI backfill. The cursor and batch cap bound every transaction.
 * No notifications are regenerated and no commercial source table is written. */
export async function rebuildAnalyticsBatch(
  db: import('../database/prisma.service.js').PrismaService,
  after?: string,
  limit = 50,
) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 100)
    throw RangeError('Batch limit must be 1..100.');
  return db.$transaction(
    async (tx) => {
      await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631902)`;
      await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631903)`;
      const rows = await tx.commercialOrder.findMany({
        where: after ? { id: { gt: after } } : {},
        orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
        take: limit,
        select: { id: true },
      });
      for (const row of rows) await rebuildOrder(tx, row.id);
      return { count: rows.length, cursor: rows.at(-1)?.id };
    },
    { timeout: 15000 },
  );
}


===== apps\api\src\jobs\main.ts =====

import 'reflect-metadata';
import { PrismaService } from '../database/prisma.service.js';
import { loadConfig } from '../config/env.js';
import { dispatchBatch, outboxStatus } from './outbox.js';
import { rebuildAnalyticsBatch } from './commerce-consumer.js';
import { logger } from '../common/logging.js';
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const mode = args[0] ?? '--once';
if (
  !['--once', '--watch', '--status', '--retry-failed', '--rebuild-analytics'].includes(mode) ||
  (mode === '--retry-failed' ? args.length !== 2 : args.length > 1)
)
  throw new Error('Use --once, --watch, --status or --retry-failed EVENT_ID, --rebuild-analytics.');
const db = new PrismaService(loadConfig());
let stopping = false;
process.once('SIGTERM', () => {
  stopping = true;
});
process.once('SIGINT', () => {
  stopping = true;
});
try {
  await db.$connect();
  if (mode === '--rebuild-analytics') {
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    let batch: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof rebuildAnalyticsBatch>>;
    do {
      const started = performance.now();
      batch = await rebuildAnalyticsBatch(db, cursor);
      cursor = batch.cursor;
      logger.info(
        { count: batch.count, durationMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started) },
        'Commerce analytics batch rebuilt',
      );
    } while (batch.count && !stopping);
  } else if (mode === '--status') console.log(JSON.stringify(await outboxStatus(db)));
  else if (mode === '--retry-failed') {
    const result = await db.outboxEvent.updateMany({
      where: { id: args[1], status: 'FAILED' },
      data: { status: 'RETRY', attempts: 0, availableAt: new Date(), lastErrorCode: null },
    });
    logger.info({ count: result.count }, 'Failed outbox event requeued by operator');
  } else {
    do {
      await dispatchBatch(db);
      if (mode === '--watch' && !stopping)
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
    } while (mode === '--watch' && !stopping);
  }
} finally {
  await db.$disconnect();
}


===== apps\api\src\jobs\outbox.ts =====

import type { Prisma, OutboxEvent } from '@prisma/client';
import type { PrismaService } from '../database/prisma.service.js';
import { consumeLocalEvent } from './commerce-consumer.js';
import { logger } from '../common/logging.js';

export const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
export type LocalConsumer = (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, event: OutboxEvent) => Promise<void>;
export const recordReceipt: LocalConsumer = async (tx, event) => {
  if (event.version !== 1) throw new Error('Unsupported event version.');
  await tx.eventReceipt.upsert({
    where: { eventId: event.id },
    create: { eventId: event.id },
    update: {},
  });
};
// Only database-local consumers may run here. No external side effects within a transaction.
// Row locks are the in-flight state; a terminated process rolls back and releases its claim.
export async function dispatchBatch(
  db: PrismaService,
  limit = 50,
  consume: LocalConsumer = consumeLocalEvent,
) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 100)
    throw new RangeError('Batch limit must be 1..100.');
  let processed = 0;
  for (; processed < limit; processed++) {
    const found = await db.$transaction(
      async (tx) => {
        await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631902)`;
        await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631903)`;
        const [event] = await tx.$queryRaw<OutboxEvent[]>`
        SELECT * FROM "OutboxEvent" WHERE "status" IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY')
        AND "availableAt" <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        ORDER BY "availableAt", "id" FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1`;
        if (!event) return false;
        const startedAt = performance.now();
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe('SAVEPOINT local_consumer');
        let failed = false;
        try {
          await consume(tx, event);
          await tx.$executeRawUnsafe('RELEASE SAVEPOINT local_consumer');
        } catch {
          failed = true;
          await tx.$executeRawUnsafe('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT local_consumer');
        }
        const attempts = event.attempts + 1;
        const durationMs = Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt);
        const status = failed ? (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'FAILED' : 'RETRY') : 'DELIVERED';
        await tx.outboxEvent.update({
          where: { id: event.id },
          data: {
            attempts,
            status,
            durationMs,
            availableAt: failed
              ? new Date(Date.now() + Math.min(3600, 2 ** attempts) * 1000)
              : event.availableAt,
            deliveredAt: failed ? null : new Date(),
            lastErrorCode: failed ? 'LOCAL_CONSUMER_FAILED' : null,
          },
        });
        return {
          eventId: event.id,
          correlationId: event.correlationId,
          status,
          attempts,
          durationMs,
        };
      },
      { timeout: 15000 },
    );
    if (!found) break;
    // Emit success/failure only after the delivery transaction has committed.
    logger[found.status === 'DELIVERED' ? 'info' : 'warn'](found, 'Outbox delivery');
  }
  return processed;
}
export async function outboxStatus(db: PrismaService) {
  const [counts, oldest, failed] = await Promise.all([
    db.outboxEvent.groupBy({ by: ['status'], _count: true }),
    db.outboxEvent.findFirst({
      where: { status: { in: ['PENDING', 'RETRY'] } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
      select: { createdAt: true },
    }),
    db.outboxEvent.findMany({
      where: { status: 'FAILED' },
      take: 20,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
      select: { id: true, attempts: true, lastErrorCode: true },
    }),
  ]);
  return {
    counts,
    oldestPendingAgeMs: oldest ? Date.now() - oldest.createdAt.getTime() : 0,
    failed,
  };
}


===== apps\api\src\modules\artisans\artisan.projection.ts =====

import type { Prisma, DelegationScope as DbDelegationScope } from '@prisma/client';
import type {
  ArtisanProfileView,
  CapacityDeclarationView,
  DelegationGrantView,
  DelegationScope,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
export const profileSelect = {
  id: true,
  createdById: true,
  userId: true,
  displayName: true,
  region: true,
  preferredLanguage: true,
  contactPhone: true,
  contactVisibility: true,
  availabilityStatus: true,
  experienceDescription: true,
  equipment: true,
  createdAt: true,
  updatedAt: true,
} satisfies Prisma.ArtisanProfileSelect;
export type ProfileRecord = Prisma.ArtisanProfileGetPayload<{ select: typeof profileSelect }>;
export function profileView(p: ProfileRecord, owner: boolean): ArtisanProfileView {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    userId: p.userId,
    displayName: p.displayName,
    region: p.region,
    preferredLanguage: p.preferredLanguage as ArtisanProfileView['preferredLanguage'],
    contactPhone: owner || p.contactVisibility !== 'PRIVATE' ? (p.contactPhone ?? '') : '',
    contactVisibility: p.contactVisibility as ArtisanProfileView['contactVisibility'],
    availabilityStatus: p.availabilityStatus,
    experienceDescription: p.experienceDescription,
    equipment: p.equipment,
    createdAt: p.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: p.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
export const scopeMap = {
  'artisan.profile.read': 'PROFILE_READ',
  'artisan.profile.update': 'PROFILE_UPDATE',
  'artisan.skills.manage': 'SKILLS_MANAGE',
  'artisan.capacity.read': 'CAPACITY_READ',
  'artisan.capacity.update': 'CAPACITY_UPDATE',
} as const;
const scopeActions: Record<DbDelegationScope, DelegationScope> = {
  PROFILE_READ: 'artisan.profile.read',
  PROFILE_UPDATE: 'artisan.profile.update',
  SKILLS_MANAGE: 'artisan.skills.manage',
  CAPACITY_READ: 'artisan.capacity.read',
  CAPACITY_UPDATE: 'artisan.capacity.update',
};
export function scopeView(scope: DbDelegationScope): DelegationScope {
  return scopeActions[scope];
}
export function capacityView(
  p: Prisma.CapacityDeclarationGetPayload<object>,
): CapacityDeclarationView {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    artisanProfileId: p.artisanProfileId,
    craftSkillId: p.craftSkillId,
    unitType: p.unitType,
    quantity: p.quantity.toString(),
    supersededAt: p.supersededAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    effectiveFrom: p.effectiveFrom.toISOString(),
    effectiveTo: p.effectiveTo.toISOString(),
    declaredByUserId: p.declaredByUserId,
    createdAt: p.createdAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
export function delegationView(
  p: Prisma.DelegationGrantGetPayload<object> & { delegate?: { name: string } },
): DelegationGrantView {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    organizationId: p.organizationId,
    delegateUserId: p.delegateUserId,
    ...(p.delegate ? { delegateName: p.delegate.name } : {}),
    scopes: p.scopes.map(scopeView),
    status: p.status,
    grantedAt: p.grantedAt.toISOString(),
    expiresAt: p.expiresAt.toISOString(),
    revokedAt: p.revokedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  };
}

===== apps\api\src\modules\artisans\artisans.service.ts =====

import { exactCapacityQuantity, isCapacityRevision } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { replaySafe, validateIdempotencyKey } from '../foundation/idempotency.js';
import { HttpException, Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type {
  ArtisanProfileInput,
  AssistedProfileInput,
  ArtisanSkillsInput,
  CapacityDeclarationInput,
  AssociationLinkInput,
  DelegationGrantInput,
  DelegationScope,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service.js';
import type { Actor } from '../../common/identity.js';
import { fail } from '../../common/errors.js';
import { iamTransaction, type Db } from '../foundation/transaction.js';
import { audit } from '../foundation/audit.js';
import {
  profileSelect,
  profileView,
  scopeMap,
  scopeView,
  capacityView,
  delegationView,
} from './artisan.projection.js';

@Injectable()
export class ArtisansService {
  constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly db: PrismaService) {}
  private async owner(actor: Actor, db: Db = this.db) {
    const profile = await db.artisanProfile.findUnique({
      where: { userId: actor.id },
      select: profileSelect,
    });
    if (!profile) fail(404, 'ARTISAN_PROFILE_REQUIRED', 'Create your artisan profile first.');
    return profile;
  }
  private async access(
    actor: Actor,
    id: string,
    scope: DelegationScope,
    db: Db = this.db,
    grantId?: string,
  ) {
    const profile = await db.artisanProfile.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: profileSelect });
    if (!profile) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Artisan profile not found.');
    if (!profile.userId)
      fail(
        403,
        'ASSISTED_REGISTRY_REQUIRED',
        'Use the assigned association registry for this participant.',
      );
    const owner = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: profile.userId },
      select: { status: true, emailVerified: true },
    });
    if (owner?.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !owner.emailVerified)
      fail(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'This artisan profile is unavailable.');
    if (profile.userId === actor.id) return { profile, delegation: null };
    if (profile.createdById && profile.createdById !== profile.userId)
      fail(
        403,
        'ASSISTED_REGISTRY_REQUIRED',
        'Use the assigned registry and current worker authorization for assisted participants.',
      );
    await this.requireProfileConsent(profile.userId, db);
    const grants = await db.delegationGrant.findMany({
      where: {
        id: grantId,
        artisanProfileId: id,
        delegateUserId: actor.id,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: { gt: new Date() },
        scopes: { has: scopeMap[scope] },
      },
    });
    for (const grant of grants) {
      const relationship = await db.associationMembership.findFirst({
        where: {
          artisanProfileId: id,
          organizationId: grant.organizationId,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          endedAt: null,
          consentRecord: { decision: true, withdrawnAt: null },
          organization: { type: 'ASSOCIATION', approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
        },
      });
      const membership = await db.organizationMember.findFirst({
        where: {
          organizationId: grant.organizationId,
          userId: actor.id,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          roles: { some: { role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' } },
        },
      });
      const consent = await db.consentRecord.findFirst({
        where: {
          userId: profile.userId,
          purpose: `delegation:${grant.id}`,
          decision: true,
          withdrawnAt: null,
        },
      });
      if (relationship && membership && consent) return { profile, delegation: grant };
    }
    fail(
      403,
      'FORBIDDEN',
      'An active association relationship and delegation for this action are required.',
    );
  }
  private async requireProfileConsent(userId: string | null, db: Db) {
    if (!userId)
      fail(
        403,
        'AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED',
        'Use participant authorization in the association registry.',
      );
    const consent = await db.consentRecord.findFirst({
      where: {
        userId,
        purpose: 'artisan.profile',
        decision: true,
        withdrawnAt: null,
      },
    });
    if (!consent) fail(403, 'CONSENT_REQUIRED', 'Artisan profile processing consent is required.');
  }
  private async target(
    actor: Actor,
    id: string | undefined,
    scope: DelegationScope,
    db: Db = this.db,
  ) {
    return id
      ? this.access(actor, id, scope, db)
      : { profile: await this.owner(actor, db), delegation: null };
  }
  async me(actor: Actor) {
    return profileView(await this.owner(actor), true);
  }
  async detail(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    const { profile } = await this.access(actor, id, 'artisan.profile.read');
    return profileView(profile, actor.id === profile.userId);
  }
  async update(actor: Actor, input: ArtisanProfileInput | AssistedProfileInput, id?: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      let existing = await tx.artisanProfile.findUnique({
        where: { userId: actor.id },
        select: profileSelect,
      });
      let delegation: Prisma.DelegationGrantGetPayload<object> | null = null;
      if (id)
        ({ profile: existing, delegation } = await this.access(
          actor,
          id,
          'artisan.profile.update',
          tx,
        ));
      if (
        !existing &&
        (!('processingConsent' in input) || !input.processingConsent || !input.policyVersion)
      )
        fail(
          400,
          'CONSENT_REQUIRED',
          'Agree to artisan profile processing before creating a profile.',
        );
      if ('processingConsent' in input && input.processingConsent) {
        if (!input.policyVersion || delegation)
          fail(400, 'INVALID_CONSENT', 'The artisan must provide a consent policy version.');
        const current = await tx.consentRecord.findFirst({
          where: {
            userId: actor.id,
            purpose: 'artisan.profile',
            decision: true,
            withdrawnAt: null,
          },
        });
        if (!current)
          await tx.consentRecord.create({
            data: {
              userId: actor.id,
              purpose: 'artisan.profile',
              policyVersion: input.policyVersion,
              decision: true,
              collectionContext: 'artisan_self_service',
            },
          });
      }
      const data = {
        displayName: input.displayName,
        region: input.region,
        preferredLanguage: input.preferredLanguage,
        ...(!delegation || existing?.contactVisibility !== 'PRIVATE'
          ? { contactPhone: input.contactPhone || null }
          : {}),
        availabilityStatus: input.availabilityStatus,
        experienceDescription: input.experienceDescription,
        equipment: input.equipment,
        ...('contactVisibility' in input && !delegation
          ? { contactVisibility: input.contactVisibility }
          : {}),
      };
      const result = existing
        ? await tx.artisanProfile.update({
            where: { id: existing.id },
            data,
            select: profileSelect,
          })
        : await tx.artisanProfile.create({
            data: { userId: actor.id, ...data },
            select: profileSelect,
          });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'artisan.profile.update',
        targetType: 'ArtisanProfile',
        targetId: result.id,
        organizationId: delegation?.organizationId,
        after: {
          fields: Object.keys(data),
          assistedUserId: result.userId,
          delegationId: delegation?.id ?? null,
          availabilityStatus: result.availabilityStatus,
        },
      });
      return profileView(result, actor.id === result.userId);
    });
  }
  async catalog() {
    return {
      items: await this.db.craftSkill.findMany({
        where: { isActive: true },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          category: true,
          description: true,
        },
        orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
        take: 100,
      }),
    };
  }
  async skills(actor: Actor, id?: string) {
    const { profile } = await this.target(actor, id, 'artisan.skills.manage');
    return {
      items: await this.db.artisanSkill.findMany({
        where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id },
        select: {
          craftSkillId: true,
          proficiency: true,
          evidence: true,
          craftSkill: { select: { id: true, name: true, category: true, description: true } },
        },
        orderBy: { craftSkillId: 'asc' },
      }),
    };
  }
  async replaceSkills(actor: Actor, input: ArtisanSkillsInput, id?: string) {
    await iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const { profile, delegation } = await this.target(actor, id, 'artisan.skills.manage', tx);
      const found = await tx.craftSkill.count({
        where: { id: { in: input.items.map((i) => i.craftSkillId) }, isActive: true },
      });
      if (found !== input.items.length) fail(400, 'INVALID_SKILL', 'Select active craft skills.');
      await tx.artisanSkill.deleteMany({ where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id } });
      if (input.items.length)
        await tx.artisanSkill.createMany({
          data: input.items.map((i) => ({
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            craftSkillId: i.craftSkillId,
            proficiency: i.proficiency,
            evidence: i.evidence,
          })),
        });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'artisan.skills.manage',
        targetType: 'ArtisanProfile',
        targetId: profile.id,
        organizationId: delegation?.organizationId,
        after: {
          craftSkillIds: input.items.map((i) => i.craftSkillId),
          delegationId: delegation?.id ?? null,
        },
      });
    });
    return this.skills(actor, id);
  }
  async capacity(actor: Actor, id?: string) {
    const { profile } = await this.target(actor, id, 'artisan.capacity.read');
    return {
      items: (
        await this.db.capacityDeclaration.findMany({
          where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id },
          orderBy: [{ effectiveFrom: 'desc' }, { createdAt: 'desc' }],
          take: 100,
        })
      ).map(capacityView),
    };
  }
  async declare(actor: Actor, input: CapacityDeclarationInput, id?: string, key?: string) {
    validateIdempotencyKey(key);
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const { profile, delegation } = await this.target(actor, id, 'artisan.capacity.update', tx);
      await this.requireProfileConsent(profile.userId, tx);
      const skill = await tx.artisanSkill.findUnique({
        where: {
          artisanProfileId_craftSkillId: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            craftSkillId: input.craftSkillId,
          },
        },
        include: { craftSkill: true },
      });
      if (!skill?.craftSkill.isActive)
        fail(400, 'INVALID_SKILL', 'Declare capacity for one of your active craft skills.');
      return replaySafe(
        tx,
        { actorId: actor.id, resourceId: profile.id, operation: 'capacity.declare', key },
        input,
        async () => {
          const quantity = exactCapacityQuantity(input.quantity);
          const effectiveFrom = new Date(input.effectiveFrom),
            effectiveTo = new Date(input.effectiveTo);
          const overlaps = await tx.capacityDeclaration.findMany({
            where: {
              artisanProfileId: profile.id,
              craftSkillId: input.craftSkillId,
              unitType: input.unitType,
              supersededAt: null,
              effectiveFrom: { lt: effectiveTo },
              effectiveTo: { gt: effectiveFrom },
            },
            select: { id: true, effectiveFrom: true, effectiveTo: true },
          });
          if (!isCapacityRevision({ effectiveFrom, effectiveTo }, overlaps))
            fail(
              409,
              'CAPACITY_OVERLAP',
              'This period overlaps an existing declaration. Revise the same exact period or choose a non-overlapping period.',
            );
          if (overlaps.length)
            await tx.capacityDeclaration.updateMany({
              where: { id: { in: overlaps.map((row) => row.id) } },
              data: { supersededAt: new Date() },
            });
          const row = await tx.capacityDeclaration.create({
            data: {
              artisanProfileId: profile.id,
              craftSkillId: input.craftSkillId,
              unitType: input.unitType,
              quantity,
              effectiveFrom: new Date(input.effectiveFrom),
              effectiveTo: new Date(input.effectiveTo),
              declaredByUserId: actor.id,
            },
          });
          await audit(tx, actor, {
            action: 'artisan.capacity.update',
            targetType: 'CapacityDeclaration',
            targetId: row.id,
            organizationId: delegation?.organizationId,
            after: {
              artisanProfileId: profile.id,
              declaredByUserId: actor.id,
              delegationId: delegation?.id ?? null,
              source: 'VOLUNTARY_DECLARATION',
            },
          });
          return capacityView(row);
        },
      );
    });
  }
  async associationCatalog() {
    return {
      items: await this.db.organization.findMany({
        where: { type: 'ASSOCIATION', approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
        select: { id: true, name: true },
        orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
        take: 100,
      }),
    };
  }
  async associations(actor: Actor) {
    const profile = await this.owner(actor);
    const rows = await this.db.associationMembership.findMany({
      where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id },
      include: { organization: { select: { name: true } } },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
    });
    return {
      items: rows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        organizationId: r.organizationId,
        organizationName: r.organization.name,
        status: r.status,
        startedAt: r.startedAt.toISOString(),
        endedAt: r.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        consentRecordId: r.consentRecordId,
      })),
    };
  }
  async link(actor: Actor, input: AssociationLinkInput) {
    await iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const profile = await this.owner(actor, tx);
      const org = await tx.organization.findFirst({
        where: { id: input.organizationId, type: 'ASSOCIATION', approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
      });
      if (!org) fail(400, 'INVALID_ASSOCIATION', 'Select an approved association.');
      const management = await tx.artisanManagement.findFirst({
        where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id, endedAt: null },
      });
      if (management && management.organizationId !== org.id)
        fail(
          409,
          'CONTROLLED_TRANSFER_REQUIRED',
          'Ask for a reviewed managing association transfer.',
        );
      if (
        await tx.associationMembership.findFirst({
          where: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            status: 'ACTIVE',
            endedAt: null,
            organizationId: { not: org.id },
          },
        })
      )
        fail(
          409,
          'CONTROLLED_TRANSFER_REQUIRED',
          'Only one active managing association is permitted.',
        );
      const old = await tx.associationMembership.findUnique({
        where: {
          artisanProfileId_organizationId: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            organizationId: org.id,
          },
        },
      });
      if (old?.status === 'ACTIVE')
        fail(409, 'RELATIONSHIP_EXISTS', 'This association is already linked.');
      const consent = await tx.consentRecord.create({
        data: {
          userId: actor.id,
          purpose: `association:${org.id}`,
          policyVersion: input.policyVersion,
          decision: true,
          collectionContext: 'artisan_self_service',
        },
      });
      const row = await tx.associationMembership.upsert({
        where: {
          artisanProfileId_organizationId: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            organizationId: org.id,
          },
        },
        create: {
          artisanProfileId: profile.id,
          organizationId: org.id,
          consentRecordId: consent.id,
        },
        update: {
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          startedAt: new Date(),
          endedAt: null,
          consentRecordId: consent.id,
        },
      });
      if (!management)
        await tx.artisanManagement.create({
          data: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            organizationId: org.id,
            recordedById: actor.id,
            reason: 'Existing authenticated participant voluntary association link',
          },
        });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'artisan.associations.manage',
        targetType: 'AssociationMembership',
        targetId: row.id,
        organizationId: org.id,
        after: { status: 'ACTIVE', consentRecordId: consent.id },
      });
    });
    return this.associations(actor);
  }
  async unlink(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const profile = await this.owner(actor, tx);
      const row = await tx.associationMembership.findFirst({
        where: { id, artisanProfileId: profile.id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
      });
      if (!row) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Active association relationship not found.');
      const now = new Date();
      await tx.artisanManagement.updateMany({
        where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id, organizationId: row.organizationId, endedAt: null },
        data: { endedAt: now },
      });
      await tx.artisanAssignment.updateMany({
        where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id, organizationId: row.organizationId, endedAt: null },
        data: { endedAt: now },
      });
      await tx.associationMembership.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { status: 'REVOKED', endedAt: now },
      });
      await tx.consentRecord.update({
        where: { id: row.consentRecordId },
        data: { withdrawnAt: now },
      });
      const grants = await tx.delegationGrant.findMany({
        where: {
          artisanProfileId: profile.id,
          organizationId: row.organizationId,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      });
      await tx.delegationGrant.updateMany({
        where: { id: { in: grants.map((g) => g.id) } },
        data: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: now },
      });
      await tx.consentRecord.updateMany({
        where: {
          userId: actor.id,
          purpose: { in: grants.map((g) => `delegation:${g.id}`) },
          withdrawnAt: null,
        },
        data: { withdrawnAt: now },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'artisan.association.withdraw',
        targetType: 'AssociationMembership',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId,
        after: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedDelegations: grants.length },
      });
      return { ok: true };
    });
  }
  async coordinators(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    const profile = await this.owner(actor);
    const relation = await this.db.associationMembership.findFirst({
      where: {
        id,
        artisanProfileId: profile.id,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        organization: { approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
        consentRecord: { withdrawnAt: null, decision: true },
      },
    });
    if (!relation) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Active association relationship not found.');
    const rows = await this.db.organizationMember.findMany({
      where: {
        organizationId: relation.organizationId,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        roles: { some: { role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' } },
        user: { status: 'ACTIVE', emailVerified: true },
      },
      select: { user: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
      take: 100,
    });
    return { items: rows.map((r) => r.user) };
  }
  async delegations(actor: Actor) {
    const profile = await this.owner(actor);
    return {
      items: (
        await this.db.delegationGrant.findMany({
          where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id },
          include: { delegate: { select: { name: true } } },
          orderBy: { grantedAt: 'desc' },
          take: 100,
        })
      ).map(delegationView),
    };
  }
  async grant(actor: Actor, input: DelegationGrantInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const profile = await this.owner(actor, tx);
      const now = new Date();
      if (
        new Date(input.expiresAt) <= now ||
        new Date(input.expiresAt).getTime() - now.getTime() > 366 * 86400000
      )
        fail(400, 'INVALID_EXPIRY', 'Choose a future expiry within one year.');
      if (actor.id === input.delegateUserId)
        fail(400, 'INVALID_DELEGATE', 'Choose a different association coordinator.');
      const relation = await tx.associationMembership.findFirst({
        where: {
          artisanProfileId: profile.id,
          organizationId: input.organizationId,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          endedAt: null,
          consentRecord: { decision: true, withdrawnAt: null },
          organization: { type: 'ASSOCIATION', approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
        },
      });
      const member = await tx.organizationMember.findFirst({
        where: {
          organizationId: input.organizationId,
          userId: input.delegateUserId,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          roles: { some: { role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' } },
          user: { status: 'ACTIVE', emailVerified: true },
        },
      });
      if (!relation || !member)
        fail(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Choose an active coordinator from a linked approved association.');
      const row = await tx.delegationGrant.create({
        data: {
          artisanProfileId: profile.id,
          organizationId: input.organizationId,
          delegateUserId: input.delegateUserId,
          scopes: input.scopes.map((s) => scopeMap[s]),
          expiresAt: new Date(input.expiresAt),
        },
      });
      await tx.consentRecord.create({
        data: {
          userId: actor.id,
          purpose: `delegation:${row.id}`,
          policyVersion: input.policyVersion,
          decision: true,
          collectionContext: 'artisan_self_service',
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'delegation.create',
        targetType: 'DelegationGrant',
        targetId: row.id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId,
        after: {
          delegateUserId: row.delegateUserId,
          scopes: row.scopes,
          expiresAt: row.expiresAt.toISOString(),
        },
      });
      return delegationView(row);
    });
  }
  async revoke(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const profile = await this.owner(actor, tx);
      const row = await tx.delegationGrant.findFirst({
        where: { id, artisanProfileId: profile.id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
      });
      if (!row) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Active delegation not found.');
      const now = new Date();
      await tx.delegationGrant.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: now },
      });
      await tx.consentRecord.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id, purpose: `delegation:${id}`, withdrawnAt: null },
        data: { withdrawnAt: now },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'delegation.revoke',
        targetType: 'DelegationGrant',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId,
        after: { status: 'REVOKED' },
      });
      return { ok: true };
    });
  }
  async assisted(actor: Actor) {
    const rows = await this.db.delegationGrant.findMany({
      where: {
        delegateUserId: actor.id,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: { gt: new Date() },
      },
      include: { artisanProfile: { select: { id: true, displayName: true } } },
      take: 100,
    });
    const items = [];
    for (const row of rows) {
      const scopes: DelegationScope[] = [];
      for (const scope of row.scopes) {
        try {
          await this.access(actor, row.artisanProfileId, scopeView(scope), this.db, row.id);
          scopes.push(scopeView(scope));
        } catch (error) {
          if (!(error instanceof HttpException) || ![403, 404].includes(error.getStatus()))
            throw error;
        }
      }
      if (scopes.length)
        items.push({
          id: row.artisanProfile.id,
          displayName: row.artisanProfile.displayName,
          organizationId: row.organizationId,
          scopes,
          expiresAt: row.expiresAt.toISOString(),
        });
    }
    return { items };
  }
}


===== apps\api\src\modules\auth\auth.gateway.ts =====

import { fromNodeHeaders } from 'better-auth/node';
import type { RequestHandler } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  changePasswordSchema,
  emailRequestSchema,
  emptySchema,
  loginSchema,
  registerSchema,
  resetPasswordSchema,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import type { AppConfig } from '../../config/env.js';
import { fail } from '../../common/errors.js';
import { publicUser } from '../users/user.projection.js';
import type { AuthService } from './auth.service.js';
import { hasPrivilegedAccess } from '../foundation/mfa.js';
import { audit } from '../foundation/audit.js';

const bodies = new Map<string, z.ZodType>([
  ['/sign-up/email', registerSchema],
  ['/sign-in/email', loginSchema],
  ['/sign-out', emptySchema],
  ['/request-password-reset', emailRequestSchema],
  ['/reset-password', resetPasswordSchema],
  ['/send-verification-email', emailRequestSchema],
  ['/change-password', changePasswordSchema],
  [
    '/change-email',
    z.object({ newEmail: z.string().trim().toLowerCase().email().max(254) }).strict(),
  ],
  ['/two-factor/enable', z.object({ password: z.string().min(1).max(128) }).strict()],
  ['/two-factor/disable', z.object({ password: z.string().min(1).max(128) }).strict()],
  ['/two-factor/verify-totp', z.object({ code: z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/) }).strict()],
  ['/two-factor/verify-backup-code', z.object({ code: z.string().min(5).max(32) }).strict()],
]);
export function authGateway(auth: AuthService, config: AppConfig): RequestHandler {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      const path = req.path.slice('/api/auth'.length);
      if (path === '/get-session' && req.method === 'GET') {
        z.object({}).strict().parse(req.query);
        const session = await auth.session(req.headers);
        const user = session
          ? await auth.db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.user.id } })
          : null;
        res.json(
          user && user.status === 'ACTIVE' && user.emailVerified
            ? {
                user: publicUser(user),
                session: { expiresAt: session!.session.expiresAt.toISOString() },
              }
            : null,
        );
        return;
      }
      let body: unknown;
      if (req.method === 'POST' && bodies.has(path)) body = bodies.get(path)!.parse(req.body);
      else if (path === '/verify-email' && req.method === 'GET')
        z.object({ token: z.string().min(1).max(2048) })
          .strict()
          .parse(req.query);
      else fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Authentication endpoint not found.');
      const sensitive = [
        '/change-password',
        '/change-email',
        '/two-factor/enable',
        '/two-factor/disable',
      ].includes(path);
      const beforeSession =
        sensitive || path.startsWith('/two-factor/') ? await auth.session(req.headers) : null;
      const beforeUser = beforeSession
        ? await auth.db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: beforeSession.user.id } })
        : null;
      if (
        sensitive &&
        (!beforeSession || !beforeUser?.emailVerified || beforeUser.status !== 'ACTIVE')
      )
        fail(403, 'ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE', 'Sign in with an active verified account.');
      if (sensitive && Date.now() - beforeSession!.session.createdAt.getTime() > 900000)
        fail(403, 'REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED', 'Sign in again before changing account security.');
      if (
        path === '/two-factor/disable' &&
        config.REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA &&
        (await hasPrivilegedAccess(auth.db, beforeUser!.id))
      )
        fail(
          409,
          'MFA_REQUIRED',
          'Remove privileged responsibilities before disabling multi-factor authentication.',
        );
      const url = new URL(req.originalUrl, config.PUBLIC_APP_URL);
      const response = await auth.auth.handler(
        new Request(url, {
          method: req.method,
          headers: fromNodeHeaders(req.headers),
          ...(body === undefined ? {} : { body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
        }),
      );
      for (const cookie of response.headers.getSetCookie()) res.append('Set-Cookie', cookie);
      const data = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        code?: string;
        twoFactorRedirect?: boolean;
        totpURI?: string;
        backupCodes?: string[];
      };
      if (path === '/sign-in/email' && !response.ok)
        fail(
          401,
          'SIGN_IN_FAILED',
          'Sign-in unsuccessful. Check your credentials and verification email.',
        );
      if (
        path === '/sign-up/email' &&
        (response.ok || data.code?.includes('USER_ALREADY_EXISTS'))
      ) {
        res.status(202).json({
          ok: true,
          message: 'If this address can be registered, check your inbox to verify it.',
        });
        return;
      }
      if (
        ['/request-password-reset', '/send-verification-email'].includes(path) &&
        (response.ok || response.status < 500)
      ) {
        res.status(202).json({ ok: true, message: 'If an account matches, check your inbox.' });
        return;
      }
      if (!response.ok)
        fail(
          response.status >= 500 ? 503 : 400,
          'AUTH_REQUEST_FAILED',
          'Unable to complete this authentication request. Try again or request a new link.',
        );
      if (path === '/sign-in/email' && data.twoFactorRedirect) {
        res.status(200).json({ twoFactorRedirect: true });
        return;
      }
      if (
        path.startsWith('/two-factor/') ||
        path === '/change-email' ||
        path === '/change-password'
      ) {
        // Re-read the provider's resulting session, including any rotated HttpOnly cookie.
        const jar = new Map<string, string>();
        for (const pair of (req.headers.cookie ?? '').split(';')) {
          const at = pair.indexOf('=');
          if (at > 0) jar.set(pair.slice(0, at).trim(), pair.slice(at + 1));
        }
        for (const cookie of response.headers.getSetCookie()) {
          const pair = cookie.split(';')[0];
          const at = pair.indexOf('=');
          if (at > 0) jar.set(pair.slice(0, at), pair.slice(at + 1));
        }
        const resulting = await auth.session({
          ...req.headers,
          cookie: [...jar].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join('; '),
        });
        if (resulting) {
          const user = await auth.db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: resulting.user.id } });
          if (user.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !user.emailVerified) {
            await auth.db.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: user.id } });
            fail(403, 'ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE', 'This account is unavailable.');
          }
          await auth.db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
            if (['/two-factor/verify-totp', '/two-factor/verify-backup-code'].includes(path)) {
              await tx.session.update({
                where: { id: resulting.session.id },
                data: { mfaVerifiedAt: new Date() },
              });
              if (beforeUser && !beforeUser.twoFactorEnabled && user.twoFactorEnabled)
                await tx.session.deleteMany({
                  where: { userId: user.id, id: { not: resulting.session.id } },
                });
            }
            if (path === '/two-factor/disable')
              await tx.session.updateMany({
                where: { userId: user.id },
                data: { mfaVerifiedAt: null },
              });
            await audit(
              tx,
              {
                id: user.id,
                role: user.role,
                sessionId: resulting.session.id,
                sessionCreatedAt: resulting.session.createdAt,
                sessionExpiresAt: resulting.session.expiresAt,
                requestId: (req as { requestId?: string }).requestId,
              },
              {
                action: (
                  {
                    '/change-password': 'PASSWORD_CHANGED',
                    '/change-email': 'EMAIL_CHANGE_REQUESTED',
                    '/two-factor/verify-totp': 'MFA_VERIFIED',
                    '/two-factor/verify-backup-code': 'MFA_VERIFIED',
                    '/two-factor/disable': 'MFA_DISABLED',
                    '/two-factor/enable': 'MFA_ENROLLMENT_STARTED',
                  } as Record<string, string>
                )[path],
                targetType: 'User',
                targetId: user.id,
              },
            );
          });
        }
        if (path === '/two-factor/enable') {
          res.status(200).json({ totpURI: data.totpURI, backupCodes: data.backupCodes });
          return;
        }
      }
      // Provider session tokens and credential metadata never enter browser JSON.
      res.status(200).json({ ok: true });
    } catch (error) {
      next(error);
    }
  };
}


===== apps\api\src\modules\auth\auth.guard.ts =====

import { requireMfa } from '../foundation/mfa.js';
import { Inject, Injectable, type CanActivate, type ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { APP_CONFIG, type AppConfig } from '../../config/env.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service.js';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service.js';
import { ADMIN_ONLY, IS_PUBLIC, type AppRequest } from '../../common/identity.js';
import { fail } from '../../common/errors.js';
import { verifyCsrf } from '../../common/csrf.js';
@Injectable()
export class AuthGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    @Inject(AuthService) private readonly auth: AuthService,
    @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly db: PrismaService,
    @Inject(Reflector) private readonly reflector: Reflector,
    @Inject(APP_CONFIG) private readonly config: AppConfig,
  ) {}
  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext) {
    if (
      this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>(IS_PUBLIC, [
        context.getHandler(),
        context.getClass(),
      ])
    )
      return true;
    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<AppRequest>();
    const session = await this.auth.session(req.headers);
    if (!session) fail(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in to continue.');
    const user = await this.db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.user.id } });
    if (user?.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !user.emailVerified)
      fail(403, 'ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE', 'This account is unavailable.');
    req.actor = {
      id: user.id,
      requestId: req.requestId,
      role: user.role,
      sessionId: session.session.id,
      sessionCreatedAt: session.session.createdAt,
      sessionExpiresAt: session.session.expiresAt,
    };
    if (
      ![
        '/api/v1/me',
        '/api/v1/me/context',
        '/api/v1/settings/security',
        '/api/v1/settings/preferences',
        '/api/v1/me/deactivate',
      ].includes(req.path) &&
      !req.path.startsWith('/api/v1/me/sessions')
    )
      await requireMfa(this.db, req.actor, this.config.REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA);
    if (
      this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>(ADMIN_ONLY, [
        context.getHandler(),
        context.getClass(),
      ]) &&
      user.role !== 'ADMIN'
    )
      fail(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'You do not have permission for this action.');
    if (
      !['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(req.method) &&
      !(await verifyCsrf(
        this.config.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET,
        String(req.headers['x-csrf-token'] ?? ''),
        session.session.id,
      ))
    )
      fail(403, 'CSRF_REJECTED', 'Refresh the page and try again.');
    return true;
  }
}

===== apps\api\src\modules\auth\auth.service.ts =====

import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { betterAuth } from 'better-auth';
import { twoFactor } from 'better-auth/plugins';
import { prismaAdapter } from 'better-auth/adapters/prisma';
import { APIError } from 'better-auth/api';
import { fromNodeHeaders } from 'better-auth/node';
import type { IncomingHttpHeaders } from 'node:http';
import { APP_CONFIG, type AppConfig } from '../../config/env.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service.js';
import { MailService } from '../mail/mail.service.js';
import { logger } from '../../common/logging.js';
@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  readonly auth;
  constructor(
    @Inject(PrismaService) readonly db: PrismaService,
    @Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig,
    @Inject(MailService) mail: MailService,
  ) {
    this.auth = betterAuth({
      appName: 'NASJ',
      baseURL: config.PUBLIC_APP_URL,
      basePath: '/api/auth',
      secret: config.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET,
      database: prismaAdapter(db, { provider: 'postgresql' }),
      trustedOrigins: [config.PUBLIC_APP_URL],
      telemetry: { enabled: false },
      plugins: [
        twoFactor({
          issuer: 'NASJ',
          skipVerificationOnEnable: false,
          accountLockout: { enabled: true, maxFailedAttempts: 5, durationSeconds: 900 },
        }),
      ],
      logger: {
        level: 'warn',
        log: (level) => {
          if (level === 'error') logger.error('Authentication operation failed');
          else if (level === 'warn') logger.warn('Authentication request rejected');
        },
      },
      advanced: {
        cookiePrefix: config.DEMO_MODE ? 'nasj_demo' : 'nasj',
        useSecureCookies: config.PUBLIC_APP_URL.startsWith('https://'),
        defaultCookieAttributes: {
          httpOnly: true,
          sameSite: 'lax',
          secure: config.PUBLIC_APP_URL.startsWith('https://'),
        },
        ipAddress: { ipAddressHeaders: ['x-nasj-client-ip'] },
      },
      session: {
        cookieCache: { enabled: false },
        expiresIn: 7 * 86400,
        disableSessionRefresh: true,
        freshAge: 900,
      },
      user: {
        additionalFields: {
          role: { type: 'string', defaultValue: 'USER', input: false },
          status: { type: 'string', defaultValue: 'ACTIVE', input: false },
        },
        changeEmail: {
          enabled: true,
          updateEmailWithoutVerification: false,
          sendChangeEmailConfirmation: async ({ user, token }) => {
            await mail.send(
              user.email,
              'Confirm your NASJ email change',
              `Confirm the email change, then verify the new address: ${config.PUBLIC_APP_URL}/auth/verify-email#token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`,
            );
          },
        },
        deleteUser: { enabled: false },
      },
      verification: { storeIdentifier: 'hashed' },
      emailAndPassword: {
        enabled: true,
        requireEmailVerification: true,
        minPasswordLength: 12,
        maxPasswordLength: 128,
        revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true,
        onPasswordReset: async ({ user }) => {
          await db.auditEvent.create({
            data: {
              actorId: user.id,
              action: 'PASSWORD_RESET',
              targetType: 'User',
              targetId: user.id,
              correlationId: crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
          });
        },
        resetPasswordTokenExpiresIn: 3600,
        sendResetPassword: async ({ user, token }) => {
          await mail.send(
            user.email,
            'Reset your NASJ password',
            `Reset your password within one hour: ${config.PUBLIC_APP_URL}/auth/reset-password#token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}\nIf you did not request this, ignore this email.`,
          );
        },
      },
      emailVerification: {
        afterEmailVerification: async (user) => {
          // A verified change of login identity invalidates sessions as well as initial verification.
          await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
            await tx.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: user.id } });
            await tx.auditEvent.create({
              data: {
                actorId: user.id,
                action: 'EMAIL_VERIFIED',
                targetType: 'User',
                targetId: user.id,
                correlationId: crypto.randomUUID(),
              },
            });
          });
        },
        sendOnSignUp: true,
        autoSignInAfterVerification: false,
        expiresIn: 86400,
        sendVerificationEmail: async ({ user, token }) => {
          await mail.send(
            user.email,
            'Verify your NASJ email',
            `Verify your email within 24 hours: ${config.PUBLIC_APP_URL}/auth/verify-email#token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`,
          );
        },
      },
      // The Nest security boundary owns rate limiting for every external auth/API request.
      rateLimit: { enabled: false },
      databaseHooks: {
        session: {
          create: {
            before: async (session) => {
              const user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.userId } });
              if (user?.status !== 'ACTIVE')
                throw new APIError('FORBIDDEN', { message: 'Sign-in unsuccessful.' });
              return { data: session };
            },
            after: async (session) => {
              const user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.userId } });
              if (user?.status !== 'ACTIVE')
                await db.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: session.userId } });
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }
  session(headers: IncomingHttpHeaders) {
    return this.auth.api.getSession({
      headers: fromNodeHeaders(headers),
      query: { disableCookieCache: true },
    });
  }
}

export function projectBuyerCatalog(
  crafts: readonly { id: string; name: string; description: string }[],
): BuyerCatalog {
  return {
    version: 1,
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
    categories: crafts.map((craft) => ({
      id: craft.id,
      name: craft.name,
      specificationSummary: craft.description,
      examples: examples.filter((example) => example.craftSkillId === craft.id),
    })),
  };
