===== apps\api\src\modules\governance\governance.service.ts =====

import { APP_CONFIG, type AppConfig } from '../../config/env.js';
import { hasPrivilegedAccess } from '../foundation/mfa.js';
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Prisma, PrivacyRequest, SupportCase } from '@prisma/client';
import { notificationCategorySchema, permissionsForMembership } from '@nasj/contracts';
import type {
  PageInput,
  SettingsInput,
  NotificationPreferencesInput,
  PrivacyCreateInput,
  PrivacyReviewInput,
  SupportCreateInput,
  SupportUpdateInput,
  ConsentCreateInput,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service.js';
import type { Actor } from '../../common/identity.js';
import { fail } from '../../common/errors.js';
import { PolicyService } from '../foundation/policy.service.js';
import { iamTransaction, type Db } from '../foundation/transaction.js';
import { audit } from '../foundation/audit.js';
import { MailService } from '../mail/mail.service.js';
const pageArgs = (p: PageInput) => ({ skip: (p.page - 1) * p.pageSize, take: p.pageSize });
const privacyView = (r: PrivacyRequest) => ({
  id: r.id,
  userId: r.userId,
  type: r.type,
  status: r.status,
  details: r.details,
  submittedAt: r.submittedAt.toISOString(),
  assignedReviewerId: r.assignedReviewerId,
  resolvedAt: r.resolvedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  resolutionNotes: r.resolutionNotes,
  retentionExceptions: r.retentionExceptions,
});
const caseView = (r: SupportCase, canManage = false) => ({
  id: r.id,
  userId: r.userId,
  organizationId: r.organizationId,
  subject: r.subject,
  description: r.description,
  status: r.status,
  assignedToUserId: r.assignedToUserId,
  resolution: r.resolution,
  dueAt: r.dueAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
  updatedAt: r.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  canManage,
});
@Injectable()
export class GovernanceService {
  constructor(
    @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly db: PrismaService,
    @Inject(PolicyService) private readonly policy: PolicyService,
    @Inject(MailService) private readonly mail: MailService,
    @Inject(APP_CONFIG) private readonly config: AppConfig,
  ) {}
  async security(actor: Actor) {
    const user = await this.policy.requireActive(actor);
    return {
      sessionVerified: Boolean(
        (
          await this.db.session.findUnique({
            where: { id: actor.sessionId },
            select: { mfaVerifiedAt: true },
          })
        )?.mfaVerifiedAt,
      ),
      twoFactorEnabled: user.twoFactorEnabled,
      privilegedMfaRequired: this.config.REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA,
      hasPrivilegedAccess: await hasPrivilegedAccess(this.db, actor.id),
    };
  }
  async settings(actor: Actor) {
    const u = await this.policy.requireActive(actor);
    return { preferredLanguage: u.preferredLanguage };
  }
  updateSettings(actor: Actor, input: SettingsInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      await tx.user.update({
        where: { id: actor.id },
        data: { preferredLanguage: input.preferredLanguage },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'ACCOUNT_PREFERENCES_UPDATED',
        targetType: 'User',
        targetId: actor.id,
        after: { preferredLanguage: input.preferredLanguage },
      });
      return input;
    });
  }
  async preferences(actor: Actor) {
    const rows = await this.db.notificationPreference.findMany({ where: { userId: actor.id } });
    return {
      items: notificationCategorySchema.options.map((category) => {
        const row = rows.find((r) => r.category === category);
        return {
          category,
          language: row?.language ?? 'en',
          channel: 'EMAIL' as const,
          optedIn: row?.optedIn ?? false,
        };
      }),
    };
  }
  updatePreferences(actor: Actor, input: NotificationPreferencesInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      for (const item of input.items)
        await tx.notificationPreference.upsert({
          where: {
            userId_channel_category: {
              userId: actor.id,
              channel: item.channel,
              category: item.category,
            },
          },
          create: { userId: actor.id, ...item },
          update: item,
        });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES_UPDATED',
        targetType: 'User',
        targetId: actor.id,
        after: { categories: input.items.map((i) => i.category) },
      });
      return input;
    });
  }
  async consents(actor: Actor) {
    const rows = await this.db.consentRecord.findMany({
      where: { userId: actor.id },
      orderBy: { collectedAt: 'desc' },
      take: 200,
    });
    return {
      items: rows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        purpose: r.purpose,
        policyVersion: r.policyVersion,
        decision: r.decision,
        collectedAt: r.collectedAt.toISOString(),
        withdrawnAt: r.withdrawnAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        collectionContext: r.collectionContext,
      })),
    };
  }
  createConsent(actor: Actor, input: ConsentCreateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const row = await tx.consentRecord.create({
        data: { userId: actor.id, ...input, collectionContext: 'account-settings' },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'CONSENT_RECORDED',
        targetType: 'ConsentRecord',
        targetId: row.id,
        after: {
          purpose: input.purpose,
          policyVersion: input.policyVersion,
          decision: input.decision,
        },
      });
      return { id: row.id };
    });
  }
  withdrawConsent(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const row = await tx.consentRecord.findFirst({ where: { id, userId: actor.id } });
      if (!row) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Consent record not found.');
      if (!row.withdrawnAt) {
        await tx.consentRecord.update({ where: { id }, data: { withdrawnAt: new Date() } });
        if (row.purpose.startsWith('delegation:'))
          await tx.delegationGrant.updateMany({
            where: {
              id: row.purpose.slice('delegation:'.length),
              artisanProfile: { userId: actor.id },
            },
            data: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date() },
          });
        if (row.purpose === 'artisan.profile') {
          await tx.artisanProfile.updateMany({
            where: { userId: actor.id },
            data: { availabilityStatus: 'PAUSED' },
          });
          await tx.delegationGrant.updateMany({
            where: { artisanProfile: { userId: actor.id }, status: 'ACTIVE' },
            data: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date() },
          });
        }
        const associations = await tx.associationMembership.findMany({
          where: { consentRecordId: id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
        });
        for (const association of associations) {
          await tx.associationMembership.update({
            where: { id: association.id },
            data: { status: 'REVOKED', endedAt: new Date() },
          });
          await tx.delegationGrant.updateMany({
            where: {
              artisanProfileId: association.artisanProfileId,
              organizationId: association.organizationId,
              status: 'ACTIVE',
            },
            data: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date() },
          });
        }
        await audit(tx, actor, {
          action: 'CONSENT_WITHDRAWN',
          targetType: 'ConsentRecord',
          targetId: id,
          after: { purpose: row.purpose },
        });
      }
      return { ok: true };
    });
  }
  createPrivacy(actor: Actor, input: PrivacyCreateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const row = await tx.privacyRequest.create({ data: { userId: actor.id, ...input } });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'PRIVACY_REQUEST_CREATED',
        targetType: 'PrivacyRequest',
        targetId: row.id,
        after: { type: row.type },
      });
      return privacyView(row);
    });
  }
  async listPrivacy(actor: Actor, p: PageInput, admin = false) {
    if (admin) await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor);
    const where: Prisma.PrivacyRequestWhereInput = admin ? {} : { userId: actor.id };
    const [rows, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.privacyRequest.findMany({
        where,
        ...pageArgs(p),
        orderBy: [{ submittedAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.privacyRequest.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return { items: rows.map(privacyView), total, page: p.page, pageSize: p.pageSize };
  }
  reviewPrivacy(actor: Actor, id: string, input: PrivacyReviewInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
      const old = await tx.privacyRequest.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!old) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Privacy request not found.');
      if (['RESOLVED', 'REJECTED'].includes(old.status))
        fail(409, 'REQUEST_CLOSED', 'This request has already been resolved.');
      if (input.status === 'RESOLVED' && old.type === 'DELETION' && !input.retentionExceptions)
        fail(
          400,
          'RETENTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
          'Record the retention review and any remaining deletion actions.',
        );
      const row = await tx.privacyRequest.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...input,
          assignedReviewerId: actor.id,
          resolvedAt: input.status === 'IN_REVIEW' ? null : new Date(),
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'PRIVACY_REQUEST_REVIEWED',
        targetType: 'PrivacyRequest',
        targetId: id,
        before: { status: old.status },
        after: { status: row.status, type: row.type },
      });
      return privacyView(row);
    });
  }
  exportOwn(actor: Actor) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const user = await tx.user.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: actor.id },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          email: true,
          emailVerified: true,
          role: true,
          status: true,
          preferredLanguage: true,
          createdAt: true,
          updatedAt: true,
        },
      });
      const profile = await tx.artisanProfile.findUnique({
        where: { userId: actor.id },
        include: {
          skills: { include: { craftSkill: { select: { id: true, name: true, category: true } } } },
          capacityDeclarations: true,
          associations: true,
          delegations: true,
        },
      });
      const [memberships, consents, privacyRequests, notificationPreferences, cases] =
        await Promise.all([
          tx.organizationMember.findMany({
            where: { userId: actor.id },
            select: {
              id: true,
              organizationId: true,
              status: true,
              isManager: true,
              joinedAt: true,
              roles: { select: { role: true } },
            },
          }),
          tx.consentRecord.findMany({
            where: { userId: actor.id },
            select: {
              id: true,
              purpose: true,
              policyVersion: true,
              decision: true,
              collectedAt: true,
              withdrawnAt: true,
              collectionContext: true,
            },
          }),
          tx.privacyRequest.findMany({ where: { userId: actor.id } }),
          tx.notificationPreference.findMany({
            where: { userId: actor.id },
            select: { category: true, channel: true, language: true, optedIn: true },
          }),
          tx.supportCase.findMany({ where: { userId: actor.id } }),
        ]);
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'PERSONAL_DATA_EXPORTED',
        targetType: 'User',
        targetId: actor.id,
      });
      return {
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        user,
        artisanProfile: profile
          ? {
              id: profile.id,
              displayName: profile.displayName,
              region: profile.region,
              preferredLanguage: profile.preferredLanguage,
              contactPhone: profile.contactPhone,
              contactVisibility: profile.contactVisibility,
              equipment: profile.equipment,
              availabilityStatus: profile.availabilityStatus,
              experienceDescription: profile.experienceDescription,
              skills: profile.skills.map((s) => ({
                craftSkill: s.craftSkill,
                proficiency: s.proficiency,
                evidence: s.evidence,
              })),
              capacityDeclarations: profile.capacityDeclarations.map((c) => ({
                id: c.id,
                craftSkillId: c.craftSkillId,
                unitType: c.unitType,
                quantity: c.quantity.toString(),
                supersededAt: c.supersededAt,
                effectiveFrom: c.effectiveFrom,
                effectiveTo: c.effectiveTo,
                createdAt: c.createdAt,
              })),
              associations: profile.associations.map((a) => ({
                id: a.id,
                organizationId: a.organizationId,
                status: a.status,
                startedAt: a.startedAt,
                endedAt: a.endedAt,
              })),
              delegations: profile.delegations.map((d) => ({
                id: d.id,
                delegateUserId: d.delegateUserId,
                organizationId: d.organizationId,
                scopes: d.scopes,
                status: d.status,
                expiresAt: d.expiresAt,
                revokedAt: d.revokedAt,
              })),
            }
          : null,
        memberships,
        consents,
        privacyRequests: privacyRequests.map(privacyView),
        notificationPreferences,
        supportCases: cases.map((c) => caseView(c)),
      };
    });
  }
  async auditEvents(actor: Actor, p: PageInput, organizationId?: string) {
    if (organizationId) await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, organizationId, 'audit.read');
    else await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor);
    const where: Prisma.AuditEventWhereInput = organizationId ? { organizationId } : {};
    const [rows, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.auditEvent.findMany({
        where,
        ...pageArgs(p),
        orderBy: [{ timestamp: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
        select: {
          id: true,
          actorId: true,
          targetType: true,
          targetId: true,
          organizationId: true,
          action: true,
          timestamp: true,
          correlationId: true,
          reason: true,
          before: true,
          after: true,
        },
      }),
      this.db.auditEvent.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return {
      items: rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, timestamp: r.timestamp.toISOString() })),
      total,
      page: p.page,
      pageSize: p.pageSize,
    };
  }
  async platformCases(actor: Actor, p: PageInput) {
    await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor);
    const where = { organizationId: null };
    const [rows, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.supportCase.findMany({
        where,
        ...pageArgs(p),
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.supportCase.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return { items: rows.map((r) => caseView(r, true)), total, page: p.page, pageSize: p.pageSize };
  }
  async cases(actor: Actor, p: PageInput, organizationId?: string) {
    if (organizationId)
      await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, organizationId, 'support.case.read');
    const where: Prisma.SupportCaseWhereInput = organizationId
      ? { organizationId }
      : { userId: actor.id };
    const [rows, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.supportCase.findMany({
        where,
        ...pageArgs(p),
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.supportCase.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return {
      items: rows.map((r) =>
        caseView(r, Boolean(organizationId) || (!r.organizationId && actor.role === 'ADMIN')),
      ),
      total,
      page: p.page,
      pageSize: p.pageSize,
    };
  }
  createCase(actor: Actor, input: SupportCreateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      if (input.organizationId)
        await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, input.organizationId, 'organization.read', tx);
      const row = await tx.supportCase.create({ data: { ...input, userId: actor.id } });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'SUPPORT_CASE_CREATED',
        targetType: 'SupportCase',
        targetId: row.id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId ?? undefined,
      });
      return caseView(row);
    });
  }
  async requireCaseManager(actor: Actor, row: SupportCase, tx: Db) {
    if (row.organizationId)
      await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, row.organizationId, 'support.case.manage', tx);
    else await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
  }
  updateCase(actor: Actor, id: string, input: SupportUpdateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const row = await tx.supportCase.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!row) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Support case not found.');
      await this.requireCaseManager(actor, row, tx);
      if (input.assignedToUserId) {
        const target = await tx.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.assignedToUserId } });
        if (!target?.emailVerified || target.status !== 'ACTIVE')
          fail(400, 'INVALID_ASSIGNEE', 'Choose an active authorized support user.');
        if (row.organizationId) {
          const membership = await tx.organizationMember.findUnique({
            where: {
              organizationId_userId: {
                organizationId: row.organizationId,
                userId: input.assignedToUserId,
              },
            },
            include: { organization: true, roles: true },
          });
          if (!membership || !permissionsForMembership(membership).includes('support.case.manage'))
            fail(
              400,
              'INVALID_ASSIGNEE',
              'Choose an authorized support member of this organization.',
            );
        } else if (target.role !== 'ADMIN')
          fail(400, 'INVALID_ASSIGNEE', 'Choose an authorized reviewer.');
      }
      const updated = await tx.supportCase.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { ...input, dueAt: input.dueAt ? new Date(input.dueAt) : input.dueAt },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'SUPPORT_CASE_UPDATED',
        targetType: 'SupportCase',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId ?? undefined,
        before: { status: row.status },
        after: { status: updated.status, assignedToUserId: updated.assignedToUserId },
      });
      return caseView(updated, true);
    });
  }
  async notifyCase(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    const delivery = await iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const row = await tx.supportCase.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!row) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Support case not found.');
      await this.requireCaseManager(actor, row, tx);
      const pref = await tx.notificationPreference.findUnique({
        where: {
          userId_channel_category: {
            userId: row.userId,
            channel: 'EMAIL',
            category: 'SUPPORT_UPDATES',
          },
        },
      });
      if (!pref?.optedIn)
        fail(409, 'NOT_OPTED_IN', 'This user has not opted in to support email updates.');
      const user = await tx.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.userId } });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'SUPPORT_NOTIFICATION_REQUESTED',
        targetType: 'SupportCase',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId ?? undefined,
      });
      return { email: user.email, language: pref.language };
    });
    const templates: Record<string, { subject: string; text: string }> = {
      en: {
        subject: 'NASJ support update',
        text: 'Your support case has been updated. Sign in to NASJ to review it.',
      },
      fr: {
        subject: 'Mise à jour du support NASJ',
        text: 'Votre demande a été mise à jour. Connectez-vous à NASJ pour la consulter.',
      },
      ar: {
        subject: 'تحديث دعم حرفاكير',
        text: 'تم تحديث طلب الدعم الخاص بك. سجل الدخول إلى حرفاكير للاطلاع عليه.',
      },
    };
    const template = templates[delivery.language] ?? templates.en;
    const accepted = await this.mail.sendConfirmed(delivery.email, template.subject, template.text);
    await iamTransaction(this.db, actor, (tx) =>
      audit(tx, actor, {
        action: accepted ? 'SUPPORT_NOTIFICATION_SMTP_ACCEPTED' : 'SUPPORT_NOTIFICATION_FAILED',
        targetType: 'SupportCase',
        targetId: id,
      }),
    );
    return { status: accepted ? 'ACCEPTED_BY_SMTP' : 'FAILED', delivered: false };
  }
}

===== apps\api\src\modules\mail\mail.service.ts =====

import { Inject, Injectable, type OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import { APP_CONFIG, type AppConfig } from '../../config/env.js';
import { logger } from '../../common/logging.js';
@Injectable()
export class MailService implements OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly transport;
  constructor(@Inject(APP_CONFIG) private readonly config: AppConfig) {
    this.transport = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: config.SMTP_HOST,
      port: config.SMTP_PORT,
      secure: config.SMTP_SECURE,
      requireTLS: config.SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS,
      auth: config.SMTP_USER ? { user: config.SMTP_USER, pass: config.SMTP_PASSWORD } : undefined,
      connectionTimeout: 5000,
      socketTimeout: 10000,
    });
  }
  private readonly pending = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();
  send(to: string, subject: string, text: string) {
    const delivery = this.transport
      .sendMail({ from: this.config.EMAIL_FROM, to, subject, text })
      .catch(() => {
        logger.error(
          { category: 'AUTH_MAIL_DELIVERY' },
          'Authentication email delivery failed; check SMTP configuration.',
        );
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.pending.delete(delivery);
      });
    this.pending.add(delivery);
  }
  async sendConfirmed(to: string, subject: string, text: string) {
    try {
      const result = await this.transport.sendMail({
        from: this.config.EMAIL_FROM,
        to,
        subject,
        text,
      });
      return result.accepted.some((address) => String(address).toLowerCase() === to.toLowerCase());
    } catch {
      logger.error({ category: 'NOTIFICATION_SMTP_FAILURE' }, 'Notification submission failed.');
      return false;
    }
  }
  async onModuleDestroy() {
    await Promise.allSettled(this.pending);
    this.transport.close();
  }
}

===== apps\api\src\modules\organizations\organizations.service.ts =====

import { canEditOrganization, canReviewOrganization } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { createHash, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  Prisma,
  type Organization,
  type OrganizationMember,
  type MembershipRole,
  type Invitation,
} from '@prisma/client';
import {
  rolesForOrganization,
  permissionsForMembership,
  type OrganizationCreateInput,
  type OrganizationUpdateInput,
  type InvitationCreateInput,
  type MembershipUpdateInput,
  type MembershipRolesInput,
  type PageInput,
  type OrganizationView,
  type MembershipView,
  type InvitationView,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service.js';
import { APP_CONFIG, type AppConfig } from '../../config/env.js';
import type { Actor } from '../../common/identity.js';
import { fail } from '../../common/errors.js';
import { MailService } from '../mail/mail.service.js';
import { PolicyService } from '../foundation/policy.service.js';
import { iamTransaction, type Db } from '../foundation/transaction.js';
import { audit } from '../foundation/audit.js';

const hashToken = (token: string) => createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
const tokenValue = () => randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
const invitationExpiry = () => new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
type MemberWithRoles = OrganizationMember & {
  roles: MembershipRole[];
  permissionGrants?: { permission: string; enabled?: boolean }[];
};
function organizationView(org: Organization): OrganizationView {
  return {
    id: org.id,
    name: org.name,
    slug: org.slug,
    type: org.type,
    approvalStatus: org.approvalStatus,
    country: org.country,
    region: org.region,
    description: org.description,
    contactEmail: org.contactEmail,
    contactPhone: org.contactPhone,
    representativeName: org.representativeName,
    createdByUserId: org.createdByUserId,
    approvedByUserId: org.approvedByUserId,
    approvedAt: org.approvedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    approvalReason: org.approvalReason,
    createdAt: org.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: org.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
function membershipView(member: MemberWithRoles): MembershipView {
  return {
    id: member.id,
    userId: member.userId,
    organizationId: member.organizationId,
    status: member.status,
    isManager: member.isManager,
    roles: member.roles.map((role) => role.role),
    explicitPermissions:
      member.permissionGrants?.filter((g) => g.enabled !== false).map((g) => g.permission) ?? [],
    joinedAt: member.joinedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
function invitationView(invitation: Invitation): InvitationView {
  return {
    id: invitation.id,
    organizationId: invitation.organizationId,
    email: invitation.email,
    roles: invitation.roles,
    isManager: invitation.isManager,
    status:
      invitation.status === 'PENDING' && invitation.expiresAt <= new Date()
        ? 'EXPIRED'
        : invitation.status,
    expiresAt: invitation.expiresAt.toISOString(),
    acceptedAt: invitation.acceptedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    createdAt: invitation.createdAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
const pagination = (input: PageInput) => ({
  skip: (input.page - 1) * input.pageSize,
  take: input.pageSize,
});

@Injectable()
export class OrganizationsService {
  constructor(
    @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly db: PrismaService,
    @Inject(PolicyService) private readonly policy: PolicyService,
    @Inject(MailService) private readonly mail: MailService,
    @Inject(APP_CONFIG) private readonly config: AppConfig,
  ) {}

  async create(actor: Actor, input: OrganizationCreateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      if (input.type === 'INTERNAL') await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
      const initialRoles =
        input.type === 'BUYER_BUSINESS'
          ? ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE' as const]
          : ['ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE'].includes(input.type)
            ? ['ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' as const]
            : [];
      const baseSlug =
        input.name
          .toLowerCase()
          .normalize('NFKD')
          .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
          .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
          .slice(0, 70) || 'organization';
      const organization = await tx.organization.create({
        data: {
          name: input.name,
          type: input.type,
          country: input.country,
          region: input.region,
          description: input.description,
          contactEmail: input.contactEmail,
          contactPhone: input.contactPhone || null,
          representativeName: input.representativeName,
          slug: `${baseSlug}-${randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`,
          createdByUserId: actor.id,
        },
      });
      if (initialRoles.some((role) => role === 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'))
        await this.policy.assertSingleCoordinator(actor.id, organization.id, tx);
      const member = await tx.organizationMember.create({
        data: {
          organizationId: organization.id,
          userId: actor.id,
          isManager: true,
          roles: { create: initialRoles.map((role) => ({ role, assignedByUserId: actor.id })) },
        },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'organization.create',
        targetType: 'Organization',
        targetId: organization.id,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        after: { type: organization.type },
      });
      return { ...organizationView(organization), myMembership: membershipView(member) };
    });
  }

  async list(actor: Actor, input: PageInput) {
    const where: Prisma.OrganizationMemberWhereInput = {
      userId: actor.id,
      ...(input.q ? { organization: { name: { contains: input.q, mode: 'insensitive' } } } : {}),
    };
    const [members, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.organizationMember.findMany({
        where,
        ...pagination(input),
        include: { roles: true, organization: true, permissionGrants: true },
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.organizationMember.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return {
      items: members.map((member) => ({
        id: member.organization.id,
        name: member.organization.name,
        slug: member.organization.slug,
        type: member.organization.type,
        approvalStatus: member.organization.approvalStatus,
        myMembership: membershipView(member),
      })),
      total,
      page: input.page,
      pageSize: input.pageSize,
    };
  }

  async detail(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    const member = await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, id, 'organization.read');
    return {
      ...organizationView(member.organization),
      myMembership: membershipView(member),
      permissions: permissionsForMembership(member),
      assignableRoles: member.isManager ? rolesForOrganization(member.organization.type) : [],
    };
  }

  async update(actor: Actor, id: string, input: OrganizationUpdateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const member = await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, id, 'organization.update', tx);
      if (!canEditOrganization(member.organization.approvalStatus))
        fail(
          409,
          'ORGANIZATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
          'Only draft or rejected organization profiles may be edited.',
        );
      const organization = await tx.organization.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...(input.name !== undefined ? { name: input.name } : {}),
          ...(input.country !== undefined ? { country: input.country } : {}),
          ...(input.region !== undefined ? { region: input.region } : {}),
          ...(input.description !== undefined ? { description: input.description } : {}),
          ...(input.contactEmail !== undefined ? { contactEmail: input.contactEmail } : {}),
          ...(input.contactPhone !== undefined ? { contactPhone: input.contactPhone || null } : {}),
          ...(input.representativeName !== undefined
            ? { representativeName: input.representativeName }
            : {}),
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'organization.update',
        targetType: 'Organization',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: id,
        after: { fields: Object.keys(input) },
      });
      return organizationView(organization);
    });
  }

  async submitApproval(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const member = await this.policy.requireOrganization(
        actor,
        id,
        'organization.approval.request',
        tx,
      );
      if (!canEditOrganization(member.organization.approvalStatus))
        fail(
          409,
          'INVALID_TRANSITION',
          'Only draft or rejected organizations can request approval.',
        );
      const org = await tx.organization.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          approvalStatus: 'PENDING_REVIEW',
          approvedByUserId: null,
          approvedAt: null,
          approvalReason: null,
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'organization.approval.request',
        targetType: 'Organization',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: id,
      });
      return organizationView(org);
    });
  }

  async adminList(
    actor: Actor,
    input: PageInput & { type?: Organization['type'] },
    pendingOnly = false,
  ) {
    await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor);
    const where: Prisma.OrganizationWhereInput = {
      ...(pendingOnly ? { approvalStatus: 'PENDING_REVIEW' } : {}),
      ...(input.type ? { type: input.type } : {}),
      ...(input.q ? { name: { contains: input.q, mode: 'insensitive' } } : {}),
    };
    const [items, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.organization.findMany({
        where,
        ...pagination(input),
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.organization.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return {
      items: items.map(organizationView),
      total,
      page: input.page,
      pageSize: input.pageSize,
    };
  }

  async adminDetail(actor: Actor, id: string) {
    await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor);
    const org = await this.db.organization.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!org) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Organization not found.');
    return organizationView(org);
  }

  async review(
    actor: Actor,
    id: string,
    status: 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED' | 'SUSPENDED',
    reason: string,
  ) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
      const org = await tx.organization.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!org) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Organization not found.');
      if (!canReviewOrganization(org.approvalStatus, status))
        fail(
          409,
          'INVALID_TRANSITION',
          'This organization cannot receive that approval decision in its current state.',
        );
      const result = await tx.organization.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          approvalStatus: status,
          approvedByUserId: actor.id,
          approvedAt: new Date(),
          approvalReason: reason,
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: `organization.${status.toLowerCase()}`,
        targetType: 'Organization',
        targetId: id,
        organizationId: id,
        reason,
        before: { approvalStatus: org.approvalStatus },
        after: { approvalStatus: status },
      });
      return organizationView(result);
    });
  }

  async members(actor: Actor, id: string, input: PageInput) {
    await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, id, 'organization.members.read');
    const where: Prisma.OrganizationMemberWhereInput = {
      organizationId: id,
      ...(input.q ? { user: { name: { contains: input.q, mode: 'insensitive' } } } : {}),
    };
    const [items, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.organizationMember.findMany({
        where,
        ...pagination(input),
        include: {
          roles: true,
          permissionGrants: true,
          user: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, status: true } },
        },
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.organizationMember.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return {
      items: items.map((member) => ({ ...membershipView(member), user: member.user })),
      total,
      page: input.page,
      pageSize: input.pageSize,
    };
  }

  private validateRoles(type: Organization['type'], roles: InvitationCreateInput['roles']) {
    const allowed = rolesForOrganization(type);
    if (roles.some((role) => !allowed.includes(role)))
      fail(
        403,
        'ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED',
        'The requested roles are not allowed in this organization type.',
      );
  }

  private sendInvitation(invitation: Invitation, token: string, organizationName: string) {
    const url = new URL('/invitations/accept', this.config.PUBLIC_APP_URL);
    url.hash = `token=${token}`;
    this.mail.send(
      invitation.email,
      'NASJ organization invitation',
      `You have been invited to join ${organizationName} on NASJ. Sign in with this email address and accept the invitation:\n${url.toString()}\nThis invitation expires on ${invitation.expiresAt.toISOString()}.`,
    );
    return { invitation: invitationView(invitation), delivery: 'QUEUED' as const };
  }

  private async invitationAuthority(actor: Actor, id: string, tx: Db = this.db) {
    const organization = await tx.organization.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!organization) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Organization not found.');
    if (organization.type === 'BUYER_BUSINESS')
      return this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, id, 'organization.members.invite', tx);
    await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
    if (organization.approvalStatus !== 'APPROVED')
      fail(
        409,
        'ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE',
        'Approve the organization before inviting privileged personnel.',
      );
    return { organization, isManager: true };
  }
  async invite(actor: Actor, id: string, input: InvitationCreateInput, reason?: string) {
    const token = tokenValue();
    const result = await iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const member = await this.invitationAuthority(actor, id, tx);
      this.validateRoles(member.organization.type, input.roles);
      if (input.isManager && !member.isManager)
        fail(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Only organization managers may delegate manager access.');
      const existingMember = await tx.organizationMember.findFirst({
        where: { organizationId: id, user: { email: input.email } },
      });
      if (existingMember)
        fail(
          409,
          'MEMBERSHIP_EXISTS',
          'This person already has a membership; manage the existing membership.',
        );
      if (
        await tx.invitation.findFirst({
          where: {
            organizationId: id,
            email: input.email,
            status: 'PENDING',
            expiresAt: { gt: new Date() },
          },
        })
      )
        fail(409, 'INVITATION_EXISTS', 'A pending invitation already exists for this address.');
      const invitation = await tx.invitation.create({
        data: {
          organizationId: id,
          email: input.email,
          roles: input.roles,
          isManager: input.isManager,
          tokenHash: hashToken(token),
          expiresAt: invitationExpiry(),
          createdByUserId: actor.id,
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'organization.members.invite',
        reason,
        targetType: 'Invitation',
        targetId: invitation.id,
        organizationId: id,
        after: { roles: input.roles, isManager: input.isManager },
      });
      return { invitation, organizationName: member.organization.name };
    });
    return this.sendInvitation(result.invitation, token, result.organizationName);
  }

  async invitations(actor: Actor, id: string, input: PageInput) {
    await this.invitationAuthority(actor, id);
    const where: Prisma.InvitationWhereInput = {
      organizationId: id,
      ...(input.q ? { email: { contains: input.q, mode: 'insensitive' } } : {}),
    };
    const [items, total] = await this.db.$transaction([
      this.db.invitation.findMany({
        where,
        ...pagination(input),
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      }),
      this.db.invitation.count({ where }),
    ]);
    return { items: items.map(invitationView), total, page: input.page, pageSize: input.pageSize };
  }

  async cancelInvitation(actor: Actor, id: string, invitationId: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      await this.invitationAuthority(actor, id, tx);
      const invitation = await tx.invitation.findFirst({
        where: { id: invitationId, organizationId: id },
      });
      if (!invitation) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Invitation not found.');
      if (invitation.status !== 'PENDING')
        fail(409, 'INVALID_TRANSITION', 'Only pending invitations can be cancelled.');
      const updated = await tx.invitation.update({
        where: { id: invitationId },
        data: { status: 'CANCELLED' },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'invitation.cancel',
        targetType: 'Invitation',
        targetId: invitationId,
        organizationId: id,
      });
      return invitationView(updated);
    });
  }

  async resendInvitation(actor: Actor, id: string, invitationId: string) {
    const token = tokenValue();
    const result = await iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const member = await this.invitationAuthority(actor, id, tx);
      const invitation = await tx.invitation.findFirst({
        where: { id: invitationId, organizationId: id },
      });
      if (!invitation) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Invitation not found.');
      if (invitation.status !== 'PENDING')
        fail(409, 'INVALID_TRANSITION', 'Only pending invitations can be resent.');
      this.validateRoles(member.organization.type, invitation.roles);
      const updated = await tx.invitation.update({
        where: { id: invitationId },
        data: {
          tokenHash: hashToken(token),
          expiresAt: invitationExpiry(),
          createdByUserId: actor.id,
        },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'invitation.resend',
        targetType: 'Invitation',
        targetId: invitationId,
        organizationId: id,
      });
      return { invitation: updated, organizationName: member.organization.name };
    });
    return this.sendInvitation(result.invitation, token, result.organizationName);
  }

  async acceptInvitation(actor: Actor, token: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const invitation = await tx.invitation.findUnique({
        where: { tokenHash: hashToken(token) },
        include: { organization: true, createdBy: true },
      });
      if (invitation?.status !== 'PENDING' || invitation.expiresAt <= new Date())
        fail(400, 'INVALID_INVITATION', 'This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.');
      const recipient = await tx.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: actor.id } });
      if (recipient.email.toLowerCase() !== invitation.email.toLowerCase())
        fail(403, 'INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH', 'Sign in with the invited email address.');
      if (invitation.createdBy.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !invitation.createdBy.emailVerified)
        fail(403, 'INVITER_UNAVAILABLE', 'The inviter no longer has permission to add members.');
      const inviter = await tx.organizationMember.findUnique({
        where: {
          organizationId_userId: {
            organizationId: invitation.organizationId,
            userId: invitation.createdByUserId,
          },
        },
        include: { roles: true, organization: true, permissionGrants: true },
      });
      const inviterAuthorized =
        invitation.organization.type === 'BUYER_BUSINESS'
          ? inviter?.status === 'ACTIVE' && inviter.isManager
          : invitation.createdBy.role === 'ADMIN';
      if (!inviterAuthorized || invitation.organization.approvalStatus !== 'APPROVED')
        fail(
          403,
          'INVITER_UNAVAILABLE',
          'The inviter or organization no longer permits invitation acceptance.',
        );
      this.validateRoles(invitation.organization.type, invitation.roles);
      if (
        await tx.organizationMember.findUnique({
          where: {
            organizationId_userId: { organizationId: invitation.organizationId, userId: actor.id },
          },
        })
      )
        fail(
          409,
          'MEMBERSHIP_EXISTS',
          'Your membership already exists; contact an organization manager.',
        );
      const claimed = await tx.invitation.updateMany({
        where: { id: invitation.id, status: 'PENDING', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
        data: { status: 'ACCEPTED', acceptedAt: new Date() },
      });
      if (claimed.count !== 1)
        fail(409, 'INVITATION_USED', 'This invitation has already been used.');
      if (invitation.roles.includes('ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'))
        await this.policy.assertSingleCoordinator(actor.id, invitation.organizationId, tx);
      const member = await tx.organizationMember.create({
        data: {
          organizationId: invitation.organizationId,
          userId: actor.id,
          isManager: invitation.isManager,
          roles: {
            create: invitation.roles.map((role) => ({
              role,
              assignedByUserId: invitation.createdByUserId,
            })),
          },
        },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'invitation.accept',
        targetType: 'OrganizationMember',
        targetId: member.id,
        organizationId: invitation.organizationId,
        after: { roles: invitation.roles, isManager: invitation.isManager },
      });
      return { ...organizationView(invitation.organization), myMembership: membershipView(member) };
    });
  }

  private async protectManager(
    tx: Db,
    member: MemberWithRoles,
    next: { status?: string; isManager?: boolean },
  ) {
    if (
      !member.isManager ||
      member.status !== 'ACTIVE' ||
      ((next.status ?? member.status) === 'ACTIVE' && (next.isManager ?? member.isManager))
    )
      return;
    const remaining = await tx.organizationMember.count({
      where: {
        organizationId: member.organizationId,
        id: { not: member.id },
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        isManager: true,
        user: { status: 'ACTIVE', emailVerified: true },
      },
    });
    if (!remaining)
      fail(
        409,
        'LAST_ORGANIZATION_MANAGER',
        'Keep at least one active verified organization manager.',
      );
  }

  async updateMember(actor: Actor, id: string, memberId: string, input: MembershipUpdateInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const governedOrg = await tx.organization.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (governedOrg?.type !== 'BUYER_BUSINESS') await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
      else await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, id, 'organization.members.update', tx);
      const member = await tx.organizationMember.findFirst({
        where: { id: memberId, organizationId: id },
        include: { roles: true, user: true },
      });
      if (!member) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Membership not found.');
      if (member.userId === actor.id && input.isManager !== undefined)
        fail(
          403,
          'SELF_PROMOTION_DENIED',
          'Ask another organization manager to change your manager access.',
        );
      if (
        (input.status ?? member.status) === 'ACTIVE' &&
        (member.user.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !member.user.emailVerified)
      )
        fail(
          409,
          'ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE',
          'Only active verified accounts may have active memberships.',
        );
      if (
        (input.status ?? member.status) === 'ACTIVE' &&
        member.roles.some((r) => r.role === 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR')
      )
        await this.policy.assertSingleCoordinator(member.userId, id, tx);
      await this.protectManager(tx, member, input);
      const next = await tx.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: member.id },
        data: {
          ...(input.status !== undefined
            ? {
                status: input.status,
                suspendedAt: input.status === 'SUSPENDED' ? new Date() : null,
                revokedAt: ['REVOKED', 'LEFT'].includes(input.status) ? new Date() : null,
              }
            : {}),
          ...(input.isManager !== undefined ? { isManager: input.isManager } : {}),
        },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'organization.members.update',
        targetType: 'OrganizationMember',
        targetId: member.id,
        organizationId: id,
        reason: input.reason,
        before: { status: member.status, isManager: member.isManager },
        after: { status: next.status, isManager: next.isManager },
      });
      return membershipView(next);
    });
  }

  async setRoles(actor: Actor, id: string, memberId: string, input: MembershipRolesInput) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const manager = await this.invitationAuthority(actor, id, tx);
      const member = await tx.organizationMember.findFirst({
        where: { id: memberId, organizationId: id },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      if (!member) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Membership not found.');
      if (member.userId === actor.id)
        fail(403, 'SELF_PROMOTION_DENIED', 'Another organization manager must change your roles.');
      this.validateRoles(manager.organization.type, input.roles);
      if (member.status === 'ACTIVE' && input.roles.includes('ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'))
        await this.policy.assertSingleCoordinator(member.userId, id, tx);
      await tx.membershipRole.deleteMany({ where: { membershipId: member.id } });
      await tx.membershipRole.createMany({
        data: input.roles.map((role) => ({
          membershipId: member.id,
          role,
          assignedByUserId: actor.id,
        })),
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: 'organization.roles.assign',
        targetType: 'OrganizationMember',
        targetId: member.id,
        organizationId: id,
        reason: input.reason,
        before: { roles: member.roles.map((role) => role.role) },
        after: { roles: input.roles },
      });
      return membershipView(
        await tx.organizationMember.findUniqueOrThrow({
          where: { id: member.id },
          include: { roles: true },
        }),
      );
    });
  }

  async removeMember(actor: Actor, id: string, memberId: string, reason: string) {
    return iamTransaction(this.db, actor, async (tx) => {
      const member = await tx.organizationMember.findFirst({
        where: { id: memberId, organizationId: id },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      if (!member) fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Membership not found.');
      const self = member.userId === actor.id;
      if (self) {
        if (member.status !== 'ACTIVE')
          fail(403, 'MEMBERSHIP_UNAVAILABLE', 'This membership is no longer active.');
      } else {
        const governedOrg = await tx.organization.findUnique({ where: { id } });
        if (governedOrg?.type !== 'BUYER_BUSINESS') await this.policy.requireAdmin(actor, tx);
        else await this.policy.requireOrganization(actor, id, 'organization.members.remove', tx);
      }
      await this.protectManager(tx, member, { status: self ? 'LEFT' : 'REVOKED' });
      const next = await tx.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: member.id },
        data: { status: self ? 'LEFT' : 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date() },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      await audit(tx, actor, {
        action: self ? 'organization.members.leave' : 'organization.members.remove',
        targetType: 'OrganizationMember',
        targetId: member.id,
        organizationId: id,
        reason,
        before: { status: member.status },
        after: { status: next.status },
      });
      return membershipView(next);
    });
  }
}

  @Post('rfqs/:id/accept') accept(
    @CurrentUser() a: Actor,
    @Param('id', rid) id: string,
