===== apps\api\src\app.ts =====

import 'reflect-metadata';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { ExpressAdapter } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import type { ArcjetNest } from '@arcjet/nest';
import express, { type NextFunction, type Request, type Response } from 'express';
import { AppModule } from './app.module.js';
import { loadConfig, type AppConfig } from './config/env.js';
import { SecurityService } from './security/security.service.js';
import { AuthService } from './modules/auth/auth.service.js';
import { authGateway } from './modules/auth/auth.gateway.js';
import { NestLogger, logger } from './common/logging.js';
import { errorResponse, HttpExceptionFilter } from './common/http-exception.filter.js';
import { fail } from './common/errors.js';
import type { AppRequest } from './common/identity.js';
import { routeLabel } from './common/routes.js';
export async function createApp(options: { config?: AppConfig; arcjet?: ArcjetNest } = {}) {
  const config = options.config ?? loadConfig();
  const server = express();
  server.disable('x-powered-by');
  // Configure routing before the Nest adapter installs its first middleware/router.
  server.set('case sensitive routing', true);
  server.set('strict routing', true);
  server.set('trust proxy', config.TRUST_PROXY.length ? config.TRUST_PROXY : false);
  const app = await NestFactory.create(
    AppModule.register(config, options.arcjet),
    new ExpressAdapter(server),
    {
      bodyParser: false,
      logger: new NestLogger(),
      abortOnError: false,
    },
  );
  app.enableCors({
    origin: config.PUBLIC_APP_URL,
    credentials: true,
    methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS'],
    allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'X-CSRF-Token', 'Idempotency-Key'],
    exposedHeaders: ['X-Request-ID', 'Retry-After'],
  });
  app.use((req: AppRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const startedAt = performance.now();
    req.requestId = randomUUID();
    res.setHeader('X-Request-ID', req.requestId);
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
    res.setHeader('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer');
    res.setHeader('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
    if (config.PUBLIC_APP_URL.startsWith('https://'))
      res.setHeader('Strict-Transport-Security', 'max-age=31536000');
    // Always overwrite the only IP header consumed by Better Auth.
    req.headers['x-nasj-client-ip'] = req.ip ?? req.socket.remoteAddress ?? '';
    res.once('finish', () =>
      logger.info(
        {
          requestId: req.requestId,
          method: req.method,
          endpoint: routeLabel(req.path),
          status: res.statusCode,
          durationMs: Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt),
        },
        'Request completed',
      ),
    );
    next();
  });
  const ordinaryJson = express.json({ limit: '32kb' });
  const attachmentJson = express.json({ limit: '384kb' });
  app.use((req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =>
    (/^\/api\/v1\/procurement\/rfqs\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}\/attachments$/.test(req.path) &&
      req.method === 'POST'
      ? attachmentJson
      : ordinaryJson)(req, res, next),
  );
  app.use((req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    try {
      if (
        !['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(req.method) &&
        (req.headers.origin !== config.PUBLIC_APP_URL || !req.is('application/json'))
      )
        fail(
          403,
          'ORIGIN_REJECTED',
          'Use the approved application origin and JSON request format.',
        );
      next();
    } catch (error) {
      next(error);
    }
  });
  const security = app.get(SecurityService);
  app.use((req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    void security
      .protect(req, res)
      .then(() => next())
      .catch(next);
  });
  server.all('/api/auth/{*path}', authGateway(app.get(AuthService), config));
  server.use((error: unknown, req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction) => {
    const result = errorResponse(error, (req as AppRequest).requestId ?? randomUUID());
    res.status(result.status).json(result.body);
  });
  app.useGlobalFilters(new HttpExceptionFilter());
  app.enableShutdownHooks();
  if (!config.ARCJET_ENABLED)
    logger.warn('Remote Arcjet is disabled; only the local database rate limiter is active.');
  await app.init();
  return app;
}


===== apps\api\src\bootstrap-admin.ts =====

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg';
import { emailSchema } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { loadConfig } from './config/env.js';
const args = process.argv.slice(2).filter((value) => value !== '--');
const email = emailSchema.safeParse(args[0]);
if (args.length !== 1 || !email.success) {
  console.error('Usage: pnpm db:bootstrap-admin -- verified-account@example.com');
  process.exit(1);
}
const config = loadConfig();
const db = new PrismaClient({ adapter: new PrismaPg({ connectionString: config.DATABASE_URL }) });
try {
  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631902)`;
    const user = await tx.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.data } });
    if (!user?.emailVerified || user.status !== 'ACTIVE')
      throw new Error('An existing active verified account is required.');
    await tx.user.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
    await tx.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: user.id } });
  });
  console.log('Administrator access granted. Sign in again.');
} catch {
  console.error(
    'Administrator bootstrap failed. Check database readiness and use an existing active verified account.',
  );
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  await db.$disconnect();
}


===== apps\api\src\main.ts =====

import { createApp } from './app.js';
import { loadConfig } from './config/env.js';
import { logger } from './common/logging.js';
try {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const app = await createApp({ config });
  await app.listen(config.API_PORT, config.API_HOST);
  logger.info({ port: config.API_PORT }, 'NASJ API ready');
} catch (error) {
  logger.error(
    { errorType: error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Unknown' },
    'API startup failed; check environment and database readiness.',
  );
  process.exitCode = 1;
}


===== apps\api\test\unit\backup-logging.test.ts =====

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtemp, writeFile, chmod, readFile, stat, utimes, symlink, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  encryptBackup,
  packDatabaseBackup,
  unpackDatabaseBackup,
  decryptBackup,
  readBackupKey,
  pruneExpiredBackups,
  backupStatus,
  writePrivateBackup,
} from '../../src/operations/backup.js';
import { createLogger } from '../../src/common/logging.js';
test('authenticated backup encryption rejects corruption, wrong keys and invalid archive bounds', () => {
  const key = randomBytes(32),
    raw = Buffer.from('PGDMP synthetic source');
  const encrypted = encryptBackup(raw, key);
  assert.deepEqual(decryptBackup(encrypted, key), raw);
  assert.ok(!encrypted.includes(raw));
  assert.notDeepEqual(encryptBackup(raw, key), encrypted);
  const damaged = Buffer.from(encrypted);
  damaged[damaged.length - 1] ^= 1;
  assert.throws(() => decryptBackup(damaged, key));
  assert.throws(() => decryptBackup(encrypted, randomBytes(32)));
  assert.throws(() => encryptBackup(Buffer.alloc(0), key));
  assert.throws(() => encryptBackup(raw, Buffer.alloc(31)));
});
test('backup files and keys require owner privacy, reject symlinks and never overwrite archives', async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'nasj-key-test-'));
  try {
    const keyPath = join(directory, 'key'),
      output = join(directory, 'archive.hcab');
    const key = randomBytes(32),
      encrypted = encryptBackup(Buffer.from('synthetic'), key);
    await writeFile(keyPath, key, { mode: 0o600 });
    assert.deepEqual(await readBackupKey(keyPath), key);
    await chmod(keyPath, 0o644);
    await assert.rejects(readBackupKey(keyPath));
    await chmod(keyPath, 0o600);
    const link = join(directory, 'key-link');
    await symlink(keyPath, link);
    await assert.rejects(readBackupKey(link));
    await writePrivateBackup(output, encrypted);
    assert.equal((await stat(output)).mode & 0o777, 0o600);
    await assert.rejects(writePrivateBackup(output, Buffer.from('replacement')));
    assert.deepEqual(await readFile(output), encrypted);
    await chmod(directory, 0o755);
    await assert.rejects(writePrivateBackup(join(directory, 'unsafe'), encrypted));
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
test('real Pino redaction removes secrets, request bodies and signal fields from structured output', () => {
  let output = '';
  const logger = createLogger({
    write: (line: string) => {
      output += line;
    },
  });
  logger.info(
    {
      correlationId: 'correlation-safe',
      durationMs: 5,
      password: 'sentinel-password',
      token: 'sentinel-token',
      secret: 'sentinel-secret',
      authorization: 'sentinel-authorization',
      cookie: 'sentinel-cookie',
      body: { email: 'sentinel-email' },
      payload: { raw: 'sentinel-payload' },
      sensorData: 'sentinel-sensor',
      wearableSummary: 'sentinel-wearable',
      req: {
        headers: { authorization: 'sentinel-nested-auth', cookie: 'sentinel-nested-cookie' },
        body: 'sentinel-nested-body',
      },
    },
    'Operation',
  );
  assert.ok(!output.includes('sentinel-'));
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(output).correlationId, 'correlation-safe');
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(output).durationMs, 5);
});

test('seven-day retention removes only expired private tool archives', async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'nasj-retention-test-'));
  try {
    const name = 'backup-2026-10-01T00-00-00.000Z-12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc.hcab';
    const archive = join(directory, name);
    await writeFile(archive, Buffer.from('encrypted test fixture'), { mode: 0o600 });
    await writeFile(join(directory, 'unrelated.hcab'), Buffer.from('keep'), { mode: 0o600 });
    const now = Date.now();
    assert.equal((await backupStatus(directory, now)).count, 0); // Too short to be an encrypted archive.
    await utimes(archive, new Date(now - 8 * 86400000), new Date(now - 8 * 86400000));
    assert.equal(await pruneExpiredBackups(directory, now), 1);
    assert.equal(await pruneExpiredBackups(directory, now), 0);
    assert.equal((await readFile(join(directory, 'unrelated.hcab'))).toString(), 'keep');
    await writeFile(archive, encryptBackup(Buffer.from('fresh fixture'), randomBytes(32)), {
      mode: 0o600,
    });
    assert.equal((await backupStatus(directory, now)).count, 1);
    assert.equal(await pruneExpiredBackups(directory, now), 0);
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test('database/configuration backup payload roundtrips private configuration and accepts legacy archives', () => {
  const database = Buffer.from('PGDMP synthetic database archive');
  const config = Buffer.from('BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=private-test-configuration');
  const key = randomBytes(32);
  const encrypted = encryptBackup(packDatabaseBackup(database, config), key);
  assert.ok(!encrypted.includes(config));
  const restored = unpackDatabaseBackup(decryptBackup(encrypted, key));
  assert.equal(restored.version, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(restored.database, database);
  assert.deepEqual(restored.configuration, config);
  assert.equal(unpackDatabaseBackup(database).configuration, null);
  assert.throws(() => packDatabaseBackup(database, Buffer.alloc(0)));
  assert.throws(() => packDatabaseBackup(database, Buffer.alloc(1024 * 1024 + 1)));
  const truncated = packDatabaseBackup(database, config).subarray(0, 15);
  assert.throws(() => unpackDatabaseBackup(truncated));
  assert.throws(() => unpackDatabaseBackup(Buffer.from('HCABCFG1 invalid payload')));
});


===== apps\api\test\unit\commerce-domain.test.ts =====

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  rfqStates,
  offerStates,
  batchStates,
  orderStates,
  paymentStates,
  rfqEdges,
  offerEdges,
  batchEdges,
  orderEdges,
  paymentEdges,
  transitionRfq,
  transitionOffer,
  transitionBatch,
  transitionOrder,
  transitionPayment,
  reconcileFulfillment,
  reconcileInspection,
  validateProgress,
  reconcileSettlement,
  payableForUnits,
  MAX_TND_MILLIMES,
  type CommerceRole,
  type Fulfillment,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
const roles: CommerceRole[] = [
  'BUYER',
  'ARTISAN',
  'PRODUCTION_MANAGER',
  'QUALITY_INSPECTOR',
  'FINANCE_MANAGER',
  'INVENTORY_LOGISTICS_COORDINATOR',
];
const full: Fulfillment = {
  requested: 10,
  reserved: 0,
  allocated: 10,
  produced: 10,
  submitted: 10,
  approved: 10,
  rejected: 0,
  pending: 0,
  delivered: 10,
};
test('all specified RFQ, offer, batch, order and payment transitions reject missing edges and roles', () => {
  const check = <S extends string>(
    states: readonly S[],
    edges: readonly (readonly [S, S, readonly CommerceRole[]])[],
    run: (from: S, to: S, roles: CommerceRole[]) => unknown,
  ) => {
    for (const from of states)
      for (const to of states) {
        const edge = edges.find((e) => e[0] === from && e[1] === to);
        if (!edge) assert.throws(() => run(from, to, roles), `${from} -> ${to}`);
        else {
          // Conditional cancellation is checked with a zero-obligation context below.
          if (
            to !== 'CANCELLED' ||
            from !== 'APPROVED' ||
            !states.includes('FUNDING_CONFIRMED' as S)
          )
            assert.doesNotThrow(() => run(from, to, [...edge[2]]));
          for (const role of roles.filter((r) => !edge[2].includes(r)))
            assert.throws(() => run(from, to, [role]));
        }
      }
  };
  check(rfqStates, rfqEdges, (a, b, r) =>
    transitionRfq(a, b, r, { quoteValid: true, quoteExpired: true }),
  );
  check(offerStates, offerEdges, (a, b, r) =>
    transitionOffer(a, b, r, { now: b === 'EXPIRED' ? 11 : 1, expiresAt: 10 }),
  );
  check(batchStates, batchEdges, (a, b, r) =>
    transitionBatch(a, b, r, {
      assigned: 10,
      produced: 10,
      approved: 10,
      pending: 0,
      reworkAccepted: true,
    }),
  );
  check(paymentStates, paymentEdges, (a, b, r) =>
    transitionPayment(a, b, r, { provenance: 'SYNTHETIC', evidenceType: 'SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT' }),
  );
  check(orderStates, orderEdges, (a, b, r) =>
    transitionOrder(a, b, r, {
      ...full,
      buyerDue: 1000n,
      buyerSettled: 1000n,
      artisanDue: 800n,
      artisanSettled: 800n,
      openDisputes: 0,
      pendingPayments: 0,
      materialsResolved: true,
    }),
  );
});
test('quantity reconciliation rejects excess allocation, production, QA, delivery and invalid numbers', () => {
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => reconcileFulfillment(full));
  for (const patch of [
    { allocated: 11 },
    { reserved: 1 },
    { produced: 11 },
    { submitted: 11 },
    { approved: 9 },
    { rejected: 1 },
    { delivered: 11 },
    { requested: 0 },
    { pending: -1 },
    { allocated: 1.5 },
    { produced: NaN },
  ])
    assert.throws(() => reconcileFulfillment({ ...full, ...patch }));
  assert.throws(() => validateProgress(250, 200, 260));
  assert.throws(() => validateProgress(250, 200, 199));
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateProgress(250, 200, 200));
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => reconcileInspection(250, 230, 15, 5));
  assert.throws(() => reconcileInspection(250, 230, 15, 6));
  assert.throws(() => reconcileInspection(250, 220, 20, 10, 230));
});
test('settlements are exact, bounded and cannot overpay approved quantities', () => {
  assert.equal(payableForUnits(1001n, 250), 250250n);
  assert.equal(payableForUnits(MAX_TND_MILLIMES, 1), MAX_TND_MILLIMES);
  assert.throws(() => payableForUnits(MAX_TND_MILLIMES, 2));
  assert.throws(() => payableForUnits(1000n, -1));
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => reconcileSettlement(1000n, 500n, 400n, 100n));
  for (const values of [
    [1000n, 1001n, 0n, 0n],
    [1000n, 500n, 400n, 101n],
    [1000n, -1n, 0n, 0n],
  ])
    assert.throws(() => reconcileSettlement(...(values as [bigint, bigint, bigint, bigint])));
});
test('deterministic quantity/settlement properties hold across partitions and boundary mutations', () => {
  for (let n = 1; n <= 500; n++) {
    const approved = Math.floor(n / 3),
      rejected = Math.floor(n / 4),
      pending = n - approved - rejected;
    reconcileFulfillment({
      requested: n,
      reserved: 0,
      allocated: n,
      produced: n,
      submitted: n,
      approved,
      rejected,
      pending,
      delivered: approved,
    });
    assert.throws(() => reconcileInspection(n, approved, rejected, pending + 1));
    const due = payableForUnits(1001n, n);
    reconcileSettlement(due, due / 2n, due - due / 2n);
    assert.throws(() => reconcileSettlement(due, due / 2n, due - due / 2n, 1n));
  }
});
test('expiry, explicit rework consent, evidence, funding and closure gates cannot be bypassed', () => {
  assert.throws(() =>
    transitionOffer('OFFERED', 'ACCEPTED', ['ARTISAN'], { now: 10, expiresAt: 10 }),
  );
  assert.throws(() => transitionRfq('QUOTED', 'ACCEPTED', ['BUYER'], { quoteValid: false }));
  assert.throws(() =>
    transitionBatch('REWORK_REQUESTED', 'IN_PROGRESS', ['ARTISAN'], {
      assigned: 10,
      produced: 10,
      approved: 5,
      pending: 0,
    }),
  );
  assert.throws(() =>
    transitionPayment('INITIATED', 'SETTLED', ['FINANCE_MANAGER'], { provenance: 'SYNTHETIC' }),
  );
  const context = {
    ...full,
    buyerDue: 1000n,
    buyerSettled: 1000n,
    artisanDue: 800n,
    artisanSettled: 800n,
    openDisputes: 0,
    pendingPayments: 0,
    materialsResolved: true,
  };
  for (const patch of [
    { artisanSettled: 799n },
    { buyerSettled: 999n },
    { openDisputes: 1 },
    { pendingPayments: 1 },
    { materialsResolved: false },
    { delivered: 9 },
  ])
    assert.throws(() =>
      transitionOrder('SETTLED', 'CLOSED', ['FINANCE_MANAGER'], { ...context, ...patch }),
    );
  assert.throws(() =>
    transitionOrder('APPROVED', 'FUNDING_CONFIRMED', ['FINANCE_MANAGER'], {
      ...context,
      buyerSettled: 0n,
    }),
  );
  assert.throws(() => transitionOrder('APPROVED', 'CANCELLED', ['BUYER'], context));
  assert.doesNotThrow(() =>
    transitionOrder('APPROVED', 'CANCELLED', ['BUYER'], {
      requested: 10,
      reserved: 0,
      allocated: 0,
      produced: 0,
      submitted: 0,
      approved: 0,
      rejected: 0,
      pending: 0,
      delivered: 0,
      buyerDue: 1000n,
      buyerSettled: 0n,
      artisanDue: 0n,
      artisanSettled: 0n,
      openDisputes: 0,
      pendingPayments: 0,
      materialsResolved: false,
    }),
  );
});


===== apps\api\test\unit\commerce-metrics.test.ts =====

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { deriveCommerceMetrics, type MetricSource } from '@nasj/contracts';
const source = (): MetricSource => ({
  provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
  status: 'IN_PRODUCTION',
  delivered: 0,
  rfq: { provenance: 'SYNTHETIC', quantity: 10 },
  batches: [{ provenance: 'SYNTHETIC', produced: 7, submitted: 6, approved: 5, offerId: 'offer' }],
  offers: [{ id: 'offer', provenance: 'SYNTHETIC', unitPayMillimes: 2345n }],
  payments: [
    {
      provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
      kind: 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT',
      status: 'SETTLED',
      amountMillimes: 2000n,
      evidenceType: 'SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT',
    },
  ],
});
test('synthetic partial fulfillment carries denominators and exact earned/outstanding millimes', () => {
  const input = source();
  input.payments.push({
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
    kind: 'BUYER_RECEIPT',
    status: 'SCHEDULED',
    amountMillimes: 100001n,
    evidenceType: null,
  });
  input.payments.push({
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
    kind: 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT',
    status: 'SCHEDULED',
    amountMillimes: 9725n,
    evidenceType: null,
  });
  const metrics = deriveCommerceMetrics(input);
  assert.equal(metrics.finance.scheduledBuyerReceipt, '100001');
  assert.equal(metrics.finance.scheduledArtisanPayout, '9725');
  assert.deepEqual(metrics.fulfillment.produced, { numerator: 7, denominator: 10, ratio: 0.7 });
  assert.equal(metrics.fulfillment.shipped.numerator, 0);
  assert.equal(metrics.finance.artisanEarned, '11725');
  assert.equal(metrics.finance.artisanOutstanding, '9725');
  assert.equal(metrics.finance.verifiedSettlement, null);
  assert.equal(metrics.finance.actualCost, null);
});
test('empty sources do not invent rates or verified evidence; incompatible provenance is rejected', () => {
  const empty = {
    ...source(),
    rfq: { provenance: 'SYNTHETIC', quantity: 0 },
    batches: [],
    offers: [],
    payments: [],
  };
  assert.equal(deriveCommerceMetrics(empty).fulfillment.produced.ratio, null);
  assert.throws(() => deriveCommerceMetrics({ ...empty, provenance: 'OBSERVED' }));
  const forged = source();
  forged.payments[0].evidenceType = 'BANK_TRANSFER';
  assert.throws(() => deriveCommerceMetrics(forged));
});
test('persisted audit milestones preserve shipped and accepted history during disputes', () => {
  const metrics = deriveCommerceMetrics({
    ...source(),
    status: 'DISPUTED',
    delivered: 5,
    milestones: { shipped: true, accepted: true },
  });
  assert.equal(metrics.fulfillment.shipped.numerator, 5);
  assert.equal(metrics.fulfillment.received.numerator, 5);
  assert.equal(metrics.fulfillment.accepted.numerator, 5);
});


===== apps\api\test\unit\domain.test.ts =====

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  parseTnd,
  formatTnd,
  addTnd,
  prorateTnd,
  MAX_TND_MILLIMES,
  exactCapacityQuantity,
  isCapacityRevision,
  canEditOrganization,
  canReviewOrganization,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import { validateIdempotencyKey } from '../../src/modules/foundation/idempotency.js';

test('TND has exact scale, bounded addition and canonical serialization', () => {
  assert.equal(addTnd(parseTnd('0.1'), parseTnd('0.2')), 300n);
  assert.equal(formatTnd(parseTnd('1.001')), '1.001');
  assert.equal(parseTnd(formatTnd(MAX_TND_MILLIMES)), MAX_TND_MILLIMES);
  assert.equal(formatTnd(0n), '0.000');
  for (const invalid of ['-1', '01', '1.0001', '1e3', ' 1', 'NaN', '1.', '9223372036854775.808'])
    assert.throws(() => parseTnd(invalid));
  assert.throws(() => addTnd(MAX_TND_MILLIMES, 1n));
  assert.throws(() => addTnd(-1n, 1n));
  assert.throws(() => formatTnd(-1n));
});
test('HALF_UP rational rounding and round-trip properties', () => {
  assert.equal(prorateTnd(1n, 1n, 2n), 1n);
  assert.equal(prorateTnd(1n, 1n, 3n), 0n);
  assert.equal(prorateTnd(5n, 1n, 2n), 3n);
  assert.throws(() => prorateTnd(1n, 1n, 0n));
  assert.throws(() => prorateTnd(1n, -1n, 1n));
  assert.throws(() => prorateTnd(MAX_TND_MILLIMES, 2n, 1n));
  for (let amount = 0n; amount < 10000n; amount += 7n)
    assert.equal(parseTnd(formatTnd(amount)), amount);
});
test('capacity permits zero and exact cents; rejects loss and impossible quantities', () => {
  assert.equal(exactCapacityQuantity(0), '0.00');
  assert.equal(exactCapacityQuantity(12.5), '12.50');
  assert.equal(exactCapacityQuantity(100000), '100000.00');
  for (const invalid of [-1, NaN, Infinity, 100000.01, 0.001, 0.1 + 0.2])
    assert.throws(() => exactCapacityQuantity(invalid));
});
test('capacity revisions require identical positive periods; adjacent periods are allowed by query', () => {
  const period = { effectiveFrom: new Date('2027-01-01'), effectiveTo: new Date('2027-01-08') };
  assert.equal(isCapacityRevision(period, []), true);
  assert.equal(isCapacityRevision(period, [period]), true);
  assert.equal(
    isCapacityRevision(period, [{ ...period, effectiveTo: new Date('2027-01-09') }]),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(isCapacityRevision({ ...period, effectiveTo: period.effectiveFrom }, []), false);
  assert.equal(isCapacityRevision({ ...period, effectiveFrom: new Date('invalid') }, []), false);
});
test('all implemented organization approval transitions are explicit', () => {
  const states = ['DRAFT', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED'] as const;
  for (const state of states) {
    assert.equal(canEditOrganization(state), state === 'DRAFT' || state === 'REJECTED');
    for (const decision of ['APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED'] as const) {
      assert.equal(
        canReviewOrganization(state, decision),
        decision === 'SUSPENDED'
          ? state === 'APPROVED'
          : state === 'PENDING_REVIEW' || state === 'SUSPENDED',
      );
    }
  }
});
test('idempotency key is optional but bounded and cannot contain sensitive arbitrary text', () => {
  assert.equal(validateIdempotencyKey(undefined), undefined);
  assert.equal(validateIdempotencyKey('valid_key_12345678'), 'valid_key_12345678');
  for (const key of ['', 'short', 'x'.repeat(129), 'secret/key/1234567'])
    assert.throws(() => validateIdempotencyKey(key));
});


===== apps\api\test\unit\foundation.test.ts =====

import 'reflect-metadata';
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { profileSchema, registerSchema, accountUpdateSchema, pageSchema } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { validateEnvironment, trustedNetwork } from '../../src/config/env.js';
import { csrfToken, verifyCsrf } from '../../src/common/csrf.js';
import { errorResponse } from '../../src/common/http-exception.filter.js';
import { routeLabel } from '../../src/common/routes.js';
import { publicUser } from '../../src/modules/users/user.projection.js';
import { policyName, botProtected, healthProbe } from '../../src/security/policies.js';
const secret = 'a'.repeat(64);
const values = {
  NODE_ENV: 'test',
  PUBLIC_APP_URL: 'http://localhost:3000',
  DATABASE_URL: 'postgresql://test:test@localhost:5442/test',
  BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: secret,
};
test('configuration rejects unsafe production defaults and unrestricted proxy trust', () => {
  assert.equal(validateEnvironment(values).ARCJET_ENABLED, false);
  assert.throws(() => validateEnvironment({ ...values, NODE_ENV: 'production' }));
  assert.throws(() => validateEnvironment({ ...values, ARCJET_ENABLED: 'true' }));
  for (const proxy of ['true', '*', '1', '0.0.0.0/0', 'caller-controlled'])
    assert.throws(() => validateEnvironment({ ...values, TRUST_PROXY: proxy }));
  assert.deepEqual(
    validateEnvironment({ ...values, TRUST_PROXY: '127.0.0.1,10.0.0.0/24' }).TRUST_PROXY,
    ['127.0.0.1', '10.0.0.0/24'],
  );
  assert.equal(trustedNetwork('::1'), true);
  assert.throws(() =>
    validateEnvironment({ ...values, PUBLIC_APP_URL: 'http://localhost:3000/path' }),
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => validateEnvironment({ ...values, DATABASE_URL: 'mysql://private:secret@host/database' }),
    (error) => !(error as Error).message.includes('private:secret'),
  );
});
test('strict contracts prevent public role/status mass assignment and bound pagination', () => {
  assert.equal(
    registerSchema.parse({
      name: 'Maker One',
      email: ' Maker+Demo@Example.com ',
      password: 'a'.repeat(12),
    }).email,
    'maker+demo@example.com',
  );
  assert.equal(
    registerSchema.safeParse({
      name: 'Maker',
      email: 'maker@example.com',
      password: 'a'.repeat(12),
      role: 'ADMIN',
    }).success,
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(profileSchema.safeParse({ name: 'Maker', emailVerified: true }).success, false);
  assert.equal(accountUpdateSchema.safeParse({ role: 'ADMIN', password: 'secret' }).success, false);
  assert.equal(pageSchema.safeParse({ page: -1 }).success, false);
  assert.equal(pageSchema.safeParse({ pageSize: 1000 }).success, false);
});
test('CSRF proofs are session-bound and cannot be replayed for another session', async () => {
  const token = await csrfToken(secret, 'session-one');
  assert.equal(await verifyCsrf(secret, token, 'session-one'), true);
  assert.equal(await verifyCsrf(secret, token, 'session-two'), false);
  assert.equal(await verifyCsrf('b'.repeat(64), token, 'session-one'), false);
  assert.equal(await verifyCsrf(secret, `${token}tampered`, 'session-one'), false);
});
test('public user projections exclude future fields and credentials', () => {
  const now = new Date();
  const result = publicUser({
    id: 'one',
    name: 'Maker',
    email: 'maker@example.com',
    emailVerified: true,
    role: 'USER',
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    password: 'must-never-leak',
    sessions: ['secret'],
  } as Parameters<typeof publicUser>[0]);
  assert.equal('password' in result, false);
  assert.equal('sessions' in result, false);
  assert.equal(result.createdAt, now.toISOString());
});
test('errors never echo malformed input, database messages or internal exception details', () => {
  const parser = Object.assign(new Error('password=super-private'), {
    type: 'entity.parse.failed',
  });
  assert.equal(errorResponse(parser, 'request-one').status, 400);
  assert.equal(
    JSON.stringify(errorResponse(parser, 'request-one')).includes('super-private'),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    JSON.stringify(errorResponse(new HttpException('raw-token', 400), 'request-one')).includes(
      'raw-token',
    ),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(errorResponse(new Error('database credentials'), 'request-one').status, 500);
});
test('rate policies distinguish abuse flows and narrowly exempt health probes', () => {
  assert.equal(policyName('/api/auth/sign-in/email'), 'login');
  assert.equal(policyName('/api/auth/sign-up/email'), 'registration');
  assert.equal(policyName('/api/auth/request-password-reset'), 'reset');
  assert.equal(policyName('/api/auth/send-verification-email'), 'verification');
  assert.equal(policyName('/api/v1/admin/users/one'), 'admin');
  assert.equal(botProtected('/api/v1/me'), false);
  assert.equal(botProtected('/api/auth/sign-in/email'), true);
  assert.equal(healthProbe('/api/health/live', 'GET'), true);
  assert.equal(healthProbe('/api/health/live/anything', 'GET'), false);
  assert.equal(healthProbe('/api/health/live', 'POST'), false);
  assert.equal(routeLabel('/api/auth/reset-password/private-token'), '/api/[unknown]');
});

===== apps\api\test\unit\local-operations.test.ts =====

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtemp, readFile, stat, rm, chmod, symlink } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import {
  operationResult,
  userUnits,
  writeOperationStatus,
} from '../../src/operations/local-runner.js';
test('local operation summaries allow only fixed codes and never forward child output/secrets', () => {
  assert.equal(operationResult('backup', 0, '{"code":"BACKUP_CREATED"}').code, 'OPERATION_OK');
  assert.deepEqual(operationResult('health', 0, '{"alerts":[]}').alerts, []);
  const failed = operationResult(
    'health',
    1,
    '{"alerts":["API_NOT_READY","private-password"],"secret":"private-value"}',
  );
  assert.deepEqual(failed.alerts, ['API_NOT_READY']);
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(failed).includes('private-'));
  for (const output of ['null', '[]', 'not JSON', '"private-password"'])
    assert.deepEqual(operationResult('health', 1, output).alerts, ['OPERATION_FAILED']);
  assert.deepEqual(operationResult('backup', 1, '{"code":"BACKUP_CREATED"}').alerts, [
    'BACKUP_FAILED',
  ]);
});
test('user timers are local, persistent daily backup and bounded five-minute health checks', () => {
  const units = userUnits(
    '/project/website',
    '/usr/bin/node',
    '/project/website/.local/schedule.env',
  );
  assert.match(units['nasj-local-backup.timer'], /OnCalendar=daily\nPersistent=true/);
  assert.match(units['nasj-local-health.timer'], /OnCalendar=\*:0\/5/);
  assert.match(units['nasj-local-backup.service'], /UMask=0077/);
  assert.match(
    units['nasj-local-health.service'],
    /ConditionPathExists=\/project\/website\/.local\/dev.lock/,
  );
  assert.match(units['nasj-local-backup.service'], /TimeoutStartSec=150/);
  assert.match(units['nasj-local-health.service'], /run-local-operation.ts health/);
  for (const path of ['/project/%n', '/project/$HOME', '/project/with space', '/project/\ninject'])
    assert.throws(() => userUnits(path, '/usr/bin/node', '/tmp/config'));
});
test('local status and alerts are private, safe and reject nonprivate directories/symlink logs', async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'nasj-local-ops-'));
  try {
    const healthy = operationResult('health', 0, '{"alerts":[]}');
    await writeOperationStatus(directory, healthy);
    assert.equal((await stat(join(directory, 'health.json'))).mode & 0o777, 0o600);
    const failed = operationResult('health', 1, '{"alerts":["API_NOT_READY"]}');
    await writeOperationStatus(directory, failed);
    assert.equal(
      JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, 'health.json'), 'utf8')).code,
      'OPERATION_FAILED',
    );
    assert.equal((await stat(join(directory, 'alerts.ndjson'))).mode & 0o777, 0o600);
    await chmod(directory, 0o755);
    await assert.rejects(writeOperationStatus(directory, failed));
    await chmod(directory, 0o700);
    await rm(join(directory, 'alerts.ndjson'));
    await symlink(join(directory, 'health.json'), join(directory, 'alerts.ndjson'));
    await assert.rejects(writeOperationStatus(directory, failed));
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});


===== apps\api\test\unit\operations.test.ts =====

import 'reflect-metadata';
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { operationalAlerts } from '../../src/jobs/alerts.js';
import { HealthController } from '../../src/modules/health/health.controller.js';
import type { PrismaService } from '../../src/database/prisma.service.js';

test('operational alert threshold reports failures and lag without payloads', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    operationalAlerts({ ready: true, oldestPendingAgeMs: 300000, failedCount: 0 }),
    [],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    operationalAlerts({ ready: false, oldestPendingAgeMs: 300001, failedCount: 1 }),
    ['API_NOT_READY', 'OUTBOX_FAILED', 'OUTBOX_LAG'],
  );
});
test('database outage fails readiness with safe 503 while liveness remains healthy', async () => {
  const controller = new HealthController({
    $queryRaw: async () => {
      throw new Error('private database URI');
    },
  } as unknown as PrismaService);
  assert.equal(controller.live().status, 'ok');
  await assert.rejects(controller.ready(), (error) => {
    const failure = error as { getStatus(): number; message: string };
    return failure.getStatus() === 503 && !failure.message.includes('private');
  });
});

test('backup age alerts follow the approved 24-hour recovery point without exposing paths', () => {
  const healthy = { ready: true, oldestPendingAgeMs: 0, failedCount: 0 };
  assert.deepEqual(operationalAlerts({ ...healthy, backupAgeMs: 86400000 }), []);
  assert.deepEqual(operationalAlerts({ ...healthy, backupAgeMs: 86400001 }), ['BACKUP_STALE']);
  assert.deepEqual(operationalAlerts({ ...healthy, backupAgeMs: null }), ['BACKUP_MISSING']);
});

import { test } from 'node:test';

test('membership permissions deny revoked access and separate management from financial authority', () => {

    status: 'ACTIVE',
    isManager: true,
    roles: [],
    organization: { approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
  };
  assert.ok(permissionsForMembership(member).includes('organization.members.invite'));

  assert.deepEqual(permissionsForMembership({ ...member, status: 'REVOKED' }), []);
  assert.equal(
    permissionsForMembership({
      ...member,
      organization: { approvalStatus: 'PENDING_REVIEW' },

    false,
  );

===== apps\api\test\unit\revised-roles.test.ts =====

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  permissionsForMembership,
  rolesForOrganization,
  grantAllowed,
  operationalPersonas,
  registryCreateSchema,
  assistedCapacitySchema,
  artisanDecisionEvidenceSchema,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
test('four personas separate platform governance, buyer authority and internal financial permissions', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(operationalPersonas, [
    'PLATFORM_ADMIN',
    'NASJ_OPERATOR',
    'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE',
    'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR',
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(rolesForOrganization('BUYER_BUSINESS'), ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE']);
  assert.deepEqual(rolesForOrganization('INTERNAL'), ['NASJ_OPERATOR']);
  assert.equal(grantAllowed('BUYER_BUSINESS', 'operator.payout.approve'), false);
  const buyer = {
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    isManager: true,
    organization: { type: 'BUYER_BUSINESS', approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
    roles: [{ role: 'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE' as const }],
  };
  const p = permissionsForMembership(buyer);
  assert.ok(p.includes('buyer.rfq.create'));
  assert.ok(
    !permissionsForMembership({
      ...buyer,
      permissionGrants: [{ permission: 'buyer.rfq.create', enabled: false }],
    }).includes('buyer.rfq.create'),
  );
  assert.ok(!p.includes('buyer.quotation.approve'));
  assert.ok(!p.some((v) => v.startsWith('operator.')));
  assert.ok(
    permissionsForMembership({
      ...buyer,
      permissionGrants: [{ permission: 'buyer.quotation.approve' }],
    }).includes('buyer.quotation.approve'),
  );
  assert.ok(
    !permissionsForMembership({
      ...buyer,
      roles: [],
      permissionGrants: [{ permission: 'buyer.quotation.approve' }],
    }).includes('buyer.quotation.approve'),
  );
  assert.ok(
    !permissionsForMembership({ ...buyer, roles: [{ role: 'FINANCE_MANAGER' }] }).includes(
      'finance.payout.read',
    ),
  );
  assert.deepEqual(permissionsForMembership({ ...buyer, status: 'REVOKED' }), []);
});
test('association coordination does not implicitly delegate coordinator management or any financial scope', () => {
  const p = permissionsForMembership({
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    isManager: true,
    organization: { type: 'ASSOCIATION', approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
    roles: [{ role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' }],
  });
  assert.ok(p.includes('association.artisan.create'));
  assert.ok(!p.includes('organization.members.invite'));
  assert.ok(!p.includes('organization.roles.assign'));
  assert.ok(!p.some((v) => v.startsWith('finance.') || v.startsWith('operator.')));
});
test('assisted contracts reject unchecked scope, missing witness and wearable capacity inputs', () => {
  const evidence = {
    policyId: 'reviewed-policy',
    purpose: 'PARTICIPATION',
    method: 'WITNESSED_VERBAL',
    occurredAt: '2026-10-20T00:00:00Z',
    language: 'fr',
    evidenceReference: 'synthetic-reference',
  };
  const profile = {
    displayName: 'Synthetic Participant',
    region: 'Tunis',
    preferredLanguage: 'fr',
    equipment: [],
    availabilityStatus: 'AVAILABLE',
    skills: ['weaving'],
    authorization: evidence,
  };
  assert.equal(registryCreateSchema.safeParse(profile).success, false);
  const valid = {
    ...profile,

  assert.equal(registryCreateSchema.safeParse(valid).success, true);
  for (const field of ['userId', 'organizationId', 'role'])
    assert.equal(registryCreateSchema.safeParse({ ...valid, [field]: 'forged' }).success, false);
  assert.equal(
    assistedCapacitySchema.safeParse({
      craftSkillId: 'weaving',
      quantity: '10',
      unitType: 'PIECES',
      effectiveFrom: '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z',
      effectiveTo: '2027-01-08T00:00:00Z',
      authorizationId: 'reference',
      wearable: 1,
    }).success,
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    artisanDecisionEvidenceSchema.safeParse({
      artisanId: 'participant',

      termsVersion: 1,
      decision: 'ACCEPTED',
      method: 'SIGNED',
      occurredAt: '2026-10-20T00:00:00Z',
      recordedByCoordinatorId: 'recorder',
      confirmationReference: 'documented exact terms',
      authorizationId: 'evidence',
      reviewStatus: 'PENDING_REVIEW',
    }).success,
    true,
  );

===== apps\api\test\unit\security.test.ts =====

import 'reflect-metadata';
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ArcjetNest } from '@arcjet/nest';
import { SecurityService } from '../../src/security/security.service.js';
import { validateEnvironment } from '../../src/config/env.js';
import type { PrismaService } from '../../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import { logger } from '../../src/common/logging.js';
logger.level = 'silent';
function fixture(
  mode: 'LIVE' | 'DRY_RUN',
  kind: 'allow' | 'rate' | 'bot' | 'error',
  failure: 'closed' | 'open' = 'closed',
) {
  const calls: unknown[][] = [],
    rules: unknown[] = [];
  const reason = {
    type: kind,
    reset: 20,
    isRateLimit: () => kind === 'rate',
    isBot: () => kind === 'bot',
    isShield: () => false,
    isEmail: () => false,
  };
  const client = {
    withRule: (rule: unknown) => {
      rules.push(rule);
      return client;
    },
    protect: async (...args: unknown[]) => {
      calls.push(args);
      return {
        id: 'test-decision',
        reason,
        results: [],
        isDenied: () => ['rate', 'bot'].includes(kind),
        isErrored: () => kind === 'error',
      };
    },
  } as unknown as ArcjetNest;
  let localCalls = 0;
  const db = {
    $queryRaw: async () => {
      localCalls++;
      return [{ count: 1, resetAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60000) }];
    },
  } as unknown as PrismaService;
  const config = validateEnvironment({
    NODE_ENV: 'test',
    PUBLIC_APP_URL: 'http://localhost:3000',
    DATABASE_URL: 'postgresql://test:test@localhost/test',
    BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: 'a'.repeat(64),
    ARCJET_ENABLED: 'true',
    ARCJET_KEY: 'test-only-never-sent',
    ARCJET_MODE: mode,
    ARCJET_FAILURE_MODE: failure,
  });
  const service = new SecurityService(config, db, client);
  const req = {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/auth/sign-up/email',
    ip: '127.0.0.1',
    protocol: 'http',
    body: { email: 'maker+tag@example.com', password: 'credential' },
    headers: {
      cookie: 'private-cookie',
      authorization: 'private-token',
      'x-forwarded-for': '203.0.113.50',
      'user-agent': 'browser',
    },
    socket: { remoteAddress: '127.0.0.1' },
  } as unknown as Request;
  const headers = new Map<string, unknown>();
  const res = {
    setHeader: (key: string, value: unknown) => headers.set(key, value),
    once: () => {},
    statusCode: 200,
  } as unknown as Response;
  return { service, req, res, calls, rules, localCalls: () => localCalls, headers };
}
test('legitimate Arcjet decisions pass without a second rate counter or credential forwarding', async () => {
  const f = fixture('LIVE', 'allow');
  await f.service.protect(f.req, f.res);
  assert.equal(f.calls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(f.localCalls(), 0);
  const [request, props] = f.calls[0] as [
    { headers: Record<string, string>; body?: unknown },
    { ipSrc: string; email: string },
  ];
  assert.equal(request.headers.cookie, undefined);
  assert.equal(request.headers.authorization, undefined);
  assert.equal(request.body, undefined);
  assert.equal(props.ipSrc, '127.0.0.1');
  assert.equal(props.email, 'maker+tag@example.com');
  assert.equal(f.rules.length, 3);
});
test('live rate decisions return 429 and bot decisions return 403', async () => {
  for (const [kind, status] of [
    ['rate', 429],
    ['bot', 403],
  ] as const) {
    const f = fixture('LIVE', kind);
    await assert.rejects(
      f.service.protect(f.req, f.res),
      (error) => (error as { getStatus(): number }).getStatus() === status,
    );
  }
});
test('dry-run deny remains observable without blocking normal authentication', async () => {
  const f = fixture('DRY_RUN', 'bot');
  await f.service.protect(f.req, f.res);
  assert.equal(f.calls.length, 1);
});
test('operational failure is closed by default; explicit open mode uses only the local fallback counter', async () => {
  const closed = fixture('LIVE', 'error');
  await assert.rejects(
    closed.service.protect(closed.req, closed.res),
    (error) => (error as { getStatus(): number }).getStatus() === 503,
  );
  assert.equal(closed.localCalls(), 0);
  const open = fixture('LIVE', 'error', 'open');
  await open.service.protect(open.req, open.res);
  assert.equal(open.localCalls(), 1);
});
test('health probes never invoke bot/provider rules', async () => {
  const f = fixture('LIVE', 'bot');
  f.req.method = 'GET';
  Object.defineProperty(f.req, 'path', { value: '/api/health/live' });
  await f.service.protect(f.req, f.res);
  assert.equal(f.calls.length, 0);
});


===== apps\api\test\artisans.integration.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';

type Result = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Result>;
};
type Member = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Member>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Result>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
};
const value = <T>(result: Result) => result.body as T;
export async function runArtisanScenarios({ db, register, mutate, check }: Harness) {
  const artisan = await register('artisan-foundation@example.com', 'Independent Artisan');
  const coordinator = await register(
    'coordinator-foundation@example.com',
    'Association Coordinator',
  );
  const outsider = await register('outsider-artisan@example.com', 'Unrelated Artisan');
  const profile = {
    processingConsent: true,
    policyVersion: 'artisan-profile-v1',
    displayName: 'Synthetic Artisan',
    region: 'Tunis',
    preferredLanguage: 'fr',
    contactPhone: '+21600000000',
    contactVisibility: 'PRIVATE',
    availabilityStatus: 'AVAILABLE',
    experienceDescription: 'Synthetic craft experience',
    equipment: ['Loom'],
  };
  let artisanId = '';
  const craftSkillId = 'weaving';
  await check(
    'independent artisan profile, safe projection and strict mass assignment',
    async () => {
      assert.equal((await artisan.client.request('/api/v1/artisans/me')).status, 404);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me', 'PATCH', {
            ...profile,
            userId: outsider.me.user.id,
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      const { processingConsent: _consent, policyVersion: _policy, ...withoutConsent } = profile;
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me', 'PATCH', withoutConsent)).status,
        400,
      );
      const created = await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me', 'PATCH', profile);
      assert.equal(created.status, 200);
      const body = value<{ id: string; userId: string }>(created);
      artisanId = body.id;
      assert.equal(body.userId, artisan.me.user.id);
      assert.equal(
        await db.associationMembership.count({ where: { artisanProfileId: artisanId } }),
        0,
      );
      assert.equal('email' in value<object>(created), false);
      assert.equal((await outsider.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
      const catalog = await artisan.client.request('/api/v1/craft-skills');
      assert.equal(catalog.status, 200);
      assert.ok(
        value<{ items: { id: string }[] }>(catalog).items.some((s) => s.id === craftSkillId),
      );
    },
  );
  await check('artisan skill replacement validates catalog, duplicates and ownership', async () => {
    assert.equal(
      (
        await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/skills', 'PUT', {
          items: [{ craftSkillId: 'missing' }],
        })
      ).status,
      400,
    );
    assert.equal(
      (
        await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/skills', 'PUT', {
          items: [{ craftSkillId }, { craftSkillId }],
        })
      ).status,
      400,
    );
    const result = await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/skills', 'PUT', {
      items: [{ craftSkillId, proficiency: 'ADVANCED', evidence: 'Synthetic training' }],
    });
    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    assert.equal(value<{ items: unknown[] }>(result).items.length, 1);
    assert.equal(
      (await mutate(outsider.client, `/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}/skills`, 'PUT', { items: [] }))
        .status,
      403,
    );
  });
  const capacity = {
    craftSkillId,
    unitType: 'HOURS',
    quantity: 12.5,
    effectiveFrom: '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z',
    effectiveTo: '2027-01-08T00:00:00Z',
  };
  await check(
    'voluntary capacity preserves history and rejects wearable or health fields',
    async () => {
      for (const forbidden of ['sensorData', 'strainReason', 'healthStatus', 'wearableSummary']) {
        assert.equal(
          (
            await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity', 'POST', {
              ...capacity,
              [forbidden]: 'forbidden',
            })
          ).status,
          400,
        );
      }
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity', 'POST', {
            ...capacity,
            quantity: -1,
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity', 'POST', {
            ...capacity,
            effectiveTo: capacity.effectiveFrom,
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      const first = await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity', 'POST', capacity);
      assert.equal(first.status, 201);
      assert.equal(value<{ quantity: string }>(first).quantity, '12.5');
      const second = await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity', 'POST', {
        ...capacity,
        quantity: 8,
      });
      assert.equal(second.status, 201);
      const history = await artisan.client.request('/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity');
      assert.equal(value<{ items: unknown[] }>(history).items.length, 2);
      const versions = await db.capacityDeclaration.findMany({
        where: { artisanProfileId: artisanId },
      });
      assert.equal(versions.filter((row) => row.supersededAt === null).length, 1);
      assert.equal(
        versions.find((row) => row.id === value<{ id: string }>(first).id)?.supersededAt instanceof
          Date,
        true,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity', 'POST', {
            ...capacity,
            effectiveFrom: new Date(
              new Date(capacity.effectiveFrom).getTime() + 86400000,
            ).toISOString(),
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        await db.capacityDeclaration.count({ where: { artisanProfileId: artisanId } }),
        2,
      );

      assert.equal(
        (
          await db.capacityDeclaration.findUniqueOrThrow({
            where: { id: value<{ id: string }>(first).id },
          })
        ).quantity.toString(),
        '12.5',
      );
      await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me', 'PATCH', {
        ...profile,
        availabilityStatus: 'PAUSED',
      });
      assert.equal(
        await db.capacityDeclaration.count({ where: { artisanProfileId: artisanId } }),
        2,
      );
    },
  );
  const association = await db.organization.create({
    data: {
      name: 'Synthetic Artisan Association',
      slug: 'artisan-test-association',
      type: 'ASSOCIATION',
      approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
      country: 'TN',
      region: 'Tunis',
      description: 'Synthetic test association',
      representativeName: 'Test Representative',
      contactEmail: 'association@example.com',
      createdByUserId: coordinator.me.user.id,
    },
  });
  const otherAssociation = await db.organization.create({
    data: {
      name: 'Unrelated Synthetic Association',
      slug: 'artisan-test-other-association',
      type: 'ASSOCIATION',
      approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
      country: 'TN',
      region: 'Tunis',
      description: 'Synthetic test association',
      representativeName: 'Test Representative',
      contactEmail: 'other-association@example.com',
      createdByUserId: outsider.me.user.id,
    },
  });
  const membership = await db.organizationMember.create({
    data: {
      organizationId: association.id,
      userId: coordinator.me.user.id,
      roles: {
        create: { role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR', assignedByUserId: coordinator.me.user.id },
      },
    },
  });
  await db.organizationMember.create({
    data: {
      organizationId: otherAssociation.id,
      userId: outsider.me.user.id,
      roles: { create: { role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR', assignedByUserId: outsider.me.user.id } },
    },
  });
  let relationshipId = '';
  await check(
    'association participation requires explicit consent and an approved association',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/associations', 'POST', {
            organizationId: association.id,
            policyVersion: 'association-v1',
            consent: false,
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      const linked = await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/associations', 'POST', {
        organizationId: association.id,
        policyVersion: 'association-v1',
        consent: true,
      });
      assert.equal(linked.status, 201);
      relationshipId = value<{ items: { id: string }[] }>(linked).items[0].id;
      assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
      const choices = await artisan.client.request(
        `/api/v1/artisans/me/associations/${relationshipId}/coordinators`,
      );
      assert.equal(value<{ items: { id: string }[] }>(choices).items[0].id, coordinator.me.user.id);
    },
  );
  const grantInput = {
    organizationId: association.id,
    delegateUserId: coordinator.me.user.id,
    scopes: ['artisan.profile.read', 'artisan.profile.update', 'artisan.capacity.update'],
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString(),
    policyVersion: 'delegation-v1',
    consent: true,
  };
  let grantId = '';
  await check(
    'delegation is precise, audited, email-private and restricted to linked association',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations', 'POST', {
            ...grantInput,
            organizationId: otherAssociation.id,
            delegateUserId: outsider.me.user.id,
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      const grant = await mutate(
        artisan.client,
        '/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations',
        'POST',
        grantInput,
      );
      assert.equal(grant.status, 201);
      grantId = value<{ id: string }>(grant).id;
      const read = await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`);
      assert.equal(read.status, 200);
      assert.equal(value<{ contactPhone: string }>(read).contactPhone, '');
      const {
        contactVisibility: _visibility,
        processingConsent: _consent,
        policyVersion: _policy,
        ...assistedInput
      } = profile;
      const assistedUpdate = await mutate(
        coordinator.client,
        `/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`,
        'PATCH',
        {
          ...assistedInput,
          contactPhone: '',
          displayName: 'Assisted Synthetic Artisan',
        },
      );
      assert.equal(assistedUpdate.status, 200);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.artisanProfile.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: artisanId } })).contactPhone,
        profile.contactPhone,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(coordinator.client, `/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`, 'PATCH', profile))
          .status,
        400,
      );

      assert.equal(
        (await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}/capacity`)).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(coordinator.client, `/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}/skills`, 'PUT', {
            items: [],
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      const update = await mutate(
        coordinator.client,
        `/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}/capacity`,
        'POST',
        { ...capacity, quantity: 9 },
      );
      assert.equal(update.status, 201);
      assert.equal(
        value<{ declaredByUserId: string }>(update).declaredByUserId,
        coordinator.me.user.id,
      );
      const event = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: value<{ id: string }>(update).id },
      });
      assert.equal(event.actorId, coordinator.me.user.id);
      assert.equal(event.organizationId, association.id);
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event.after).includes(grantId), true);
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event.after).includes(profile.contactPhone), false);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'delegate membership suspension removes access immediately and leaves owner access',
    async () => {
      await db.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: membership.id },
        data: { status: 'SUSPENDED' },
      });
      assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
      assert.equal((await artisan.client.request('/api/v1/artisans/me')).status, 200);
      await db.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: membership.id },
        data: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
      });
      assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 200);
      await db.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: membership.id },
        data: { status: 'REVOKED' },
      });
      assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
      await db.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: membership.id },
        data: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
      });
      await db.organization.update({
        where: { id: association.id },
        data: { approvalStatus: 'SUSPENDED' },
      });
      assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
      await db.organization.update({
        where: { id: association.id },
        data: { approvalStatus: 'APPROVED' },
      });
    },
  );
  await check('revoked delegation and expired delegation lose access immediately', async () => {
    assert.equal(
      (await mutate(artisan.client, `/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations/${grantId}`, 'DELETE', {}))
        .status,
      200,
    );
    assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
    const next = await mutate(
      artisan.client,
      '/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations',
      'POST',
      grantInput,
    );
    grantId = value<{ id: string }>(next).id;
    await db.delegationGrant.update({ where: { id: grantId }, data: { expiresAt: new Date(0) } });
    assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
    assert.equal(
      (
        await mutate(artisan.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations', 'POST', {
          ...grantInput,
          expiresAt: '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        })
      ).status,
      400,
    );
  });
  await check('consent withdrawal and relationship withdrawal revoke assisted access', async () => {
    const next = await mutate(
      artisan.client,
      '/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations',
      'POST',
      grantInput,
    );
    grantId = value<{ id: string }>(next).id;
    await db.consentRecord.updateMany({
      where: { userId: artisan.me.user.id, purpose: `delegation:${grantId}` },
      data: { withdrawnAt: new Date() },
    });
    assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
    const last = await mutate(
      artisan.client,
      '/api/v1/artisans/me/delegations',
      'POST',
      grantInput,
    );
    grantId = value<{ id: string }>(last).id;
    assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 200);
    assert.equal(
      (
        await mutate(
          artisan.client,
          `/api/v1/artisans/me/associations/${relationshipId}`,
          'DELETE',
          {},
        )
      ).status,
      200,
    );
    assert.equal((await coordinator.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
    assert.equal(
      (await db.delegationGrant.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: grantId } })).status,
      'REVOKED',
    );
    assert.equal((await artisan.client.request('/api/v1/artisans/me')).status, 200);
  });
  await check('platform administrator has no implicit artisan or delegation access', async () => {
    await db.user.update({ where: { id: outsider.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
    assert.equal((await outsider.client.request(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status, 403);
    assert.equal(
      (await mutate(outsider.client, `/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}/capacity`, 'POST', capacity))
        .status,
      403,
    );
    await db.user.update({ where: { id: outsider.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'USER' } });
  });
}


===== apps\api\test\catalog.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { BuyerCatalog } from '@nasj/contracts';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import { seedCommerceFixture } from './commerce.fixture.js';
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    headers?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown }>;
};
type Identity = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
export async function runCatalogScenarios({
  db,
  register,
  check,
}: {
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Identity>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [buyer, operator, artisan, quality, outsider] = await Promise.all(
    ['buyer', 'operator', 'artisan', 'quality', 'outsider'].map((role) =>
      register(`catalog-${role}@example.com`, `Synthetic catalog ${role}`),
    ),
  );
  const fixture = await seedCommerceFixture(
    db,
    {
      buyerId: buyer.me.user.id,
      operatorId: operator.me.user.id,
      artisanId: artisan.me.user.id,
      qualityId: quality.me.user.id,
      outsiderId: outsider.me.user.id,
    },
    'catalog',
  );
  const input = {
    buyerOrganizationId: fixture.buyerOrganizationId,
    operatorOrganizationId: fixture.operatorOrganizationId,
    catalogExampleId: 'woven-table-runner-v1',
    craftSkillId: 'weaving',
    title: 'Synthetic catalog request',
    specification: 'Buyer-confirmed fictional cotton runner, revised dimensions 130 × 30 cm.',
    designRequirements: 'Buyer will agree colors before quoting.',
    quantity: 10,
    deliveryAt: fixture.deliveryAt,
    deliveryLocation: 'Synthetic Tunis collection point',
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
  };
  async function create(who: Identity, body: unknown, key = randomUUID()) {
    const me = await who.client.request('/api/v1/me');
    return who.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/rfqs', 'POST', body, {
      'X-CSRF-Token': (me.body as { csrfToken: string }).csrfToken,
      'Idempotency-Key': key,
    });
  }
  async function catalog() {
    const result = await buyer.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/catalog');
    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    return result.body as BuyerCatalog;
  }
  await check(
    'buyer-safe catalog exposes bounded synthetic examples, assumptions and empty categories',
    async () => {
      const result = await catalog();
      assert.equal(result.version, 1);
      assert.equal(result.provenance, 'SYNTHETIC');
      assert.ok(result.categories.length <= 100);
      assert.deepEqual(result.categories.find((c) => c.id === 'other')?.examples, []);
      for (const example of result.categories.flatMap((c) => c.examples)) {
        assert.equal(example.provenance, 'SYNTHETIC');
        assert.equal(example.unit, 'PIECE');
        assert.ok(example.specification.length > 10);
        assert.ok(example.leadTime.minDays <= example.leadTime.maxDays);
        assert.match(example.leadTime.assumption, /no stock or supply is confirmed/);
        assert.ok(
          !('price' in example) && !('capacity' in example) && !('artisanProfileId' in example),
        );
      }
      assert.equal(
        result.categories.find((c) => c.id === 'pottery')?.examples[0].availability,
        'UNAVAILABLE',
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await outsider.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/catalog')).status,
        200,
        'Catalog contains shared examples, not private procurement data.',
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'catalog RFQ selection rejects forged and unavailable examples atomically; valid prefill stays replay-safe',
    async () => {
      const before = await db.commercialRfq.count();
      const events = await db.outboxEvent.count();
      for (const body of [
        { ...input, catalogExampleId: 'forged-example' },
        { ...input, catalogExampleId: 'decorative-vase-v1', craftSkillId: 'pottery' },
        { ...input, craftSkillId: 'embroidery' },
        { ...input, catalogExampleId: 'https://evil.invalid/example' },
        { ...input, quantity: 0 },
        { ...input, deliveryAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
      ])
        assert.equal((await create(buyer, body)).status, 400);
      assert.equal((await create(outsider, input)).status, 403);
      assert.equal(await db.commercialRfq.count(), before);
      assert.equal(await db.outboxEvent.count(), events);
      const key = randomUUID();
      const first = await create(buyer, input, key);
      assert.equal(first.status, 201, JSON.stringify(first.body));
      assert.deepEqual((await create(buyer, input, key)).body, first.body);
      assert.equal(
        (await create(buyer, { ...input, specification: 'Different confirmed specification' }, key))
          .status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(await db.commercialRfq.count(), before + 1);
      const saved = await db.commercialRfq.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: (first.body as { id: string }).id },
      });
      assert.equal(saved.status, 'DRAFT');
      assert.equal(
        saved.specification,
        input.specification,
        'Catalog suggestions remain buyer-editable requirements.',
      );
      assert.equal(saved.quantity, 10);
      assert.equal(
        await db.commercialOrder.count({ where: { rfqId: saved.id } }),
        0,
        'Selecting an example is not an order, reservation or supply commitment.',
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'inactive crafts invalidate catalog links and API selection; no active crafts yields a safe empty catalog',
    async () => {
      const active = await db.craftSkill.findMany({
        where: { isActive: true },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      try {
        await db.craftSkill.update({ where: { id: 'weaving' }, data: { isActive: false } });
        assert.equal(
          (await catalog()).categories.some((c) => c.id === 'weaving'),
          false,
        );
        assert.equal((await create(buyer, input)).status, 400);
        await db.craftSkill.updateMany({
          where: { id: { in: active.map((c) => c.id) } },
          data: { isActive: false },
        });
        assert.deepEqual((await catalog()).categories, []);
      } finally {
        await db.craftSkill.updateMany({
          where: { id: { in: active.map((c) => c.id) } },
          data: { isActive: true },
        });
      }
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\commerce.fixture.ts =====

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';

// Called only by disposable integration/browser harnesses, never imported into application code.
export async function seedCommerceFixture(
  db: Pick<
    PrismaService,
    | 'organization'
    | 'organizationMember'
    | 'artisanProfile'
    | 'consentRecord'
    | 'capacityDeclaration'
  >,
  users: {
    buyerId: string;
    operatorId: string;
    artisanId: string;
    qualityId: string;
    outsiderId: string;
  },
  suffix: string,
) {
  const createOrg = async (
    type: 'BUYER_BUSINESS' | 'INTERNAL',
    userId: string,
    name: string,
    roles: (
      | 'BUYER'
      | 'PRODUCTION_MANAGER'
      | 'FINANCE_MANAGER'
      | 'QUALITY_INSPECTOR'
      | 'INVENTORY_LOGISTICS_COORDINATOR'
    )[],
  ) =>
    db.organization.create({
      data: {
        name,
        slug: `commerce-${suffix}-${type.toLowerCase()}-${userId}`,
        type,
        approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
        country: 'TN',
        region: 'Tunis',
        description: 'Synthetic commerce regression fixture',
        contactEmail: 'fictional-commerce@example.com',
        representativeName: 'Synthetic representative',
        createdByUserId: userId,
        members: {
          create: {
            userId,
            isManager: true,
            roles: { create: roles.map((role) => ({ role, assignedByUserId: userId })) },
            ...(roles.includes('BUYER')
              ? {
                  permissionGrants: {
                    create: {
                      permission: 'buyer.quotation.approve',
                      grantedById: userId,
                      reason: 'Synthetic explicit approval authority fixture',
                    },
                  },
                }
              : {}),
          },
        },
      },
    });
  const buyer = await createOrg('BUYER_BUSINESS', users.buyerId, `Synthetic Buyer ${suffix}`, [
    'BUYER',
  ]);
  const operator = await createOrg('INTERNAL', users.operatorId, `Synthetic Operator ${suffix}`, [
    'PRODUCTION_MANAGER',
    'FINANCE_MANAGER',
    'QUALITY_INSPECTOR',
    'INVENTORY_LOGISTICS_COORDINATOR',
  ]);
  const outsider = await createOrg('BUYER_BUSINESS', users.outsiderId, `Other Buyer ${suffix}`, [
    'BUYER',
  ]);
  await db.organizationMember.create({
    data: {
      organizationId: operator.id,
      userId: users.qualityId,
      roles: { create: { role: 'QUALITY_INSPECTOR', assignedByUserId: users.operatorId } },
    },
  });
  const profile = await db.artisanProfile.create({
    data: {
      userId: users.artisanId,
      displayName: `Synthetic Artisan ${suffix}`,
      region: 'Tunis',
      equipment: [],
      skills: { create: { craftSkillId: 'weaving' } },
    },
  });
  await db.consentRecord.create({
    data: {
      userId: users.artisanId,
      purpose: 'artisan.profile',
      decision: true,
      policyVersion: 'artisan-profile-v1',
      collectionContext: 'synthetic_test_fixture',
    },
  });
  const now = Date.now();
  const capacity = await db.capacityDeclaration.create({
    data: {
      artisanProfileId: profile.id,
      craftSkillId: 'weaving',
      unitType: 'PIECES',
      quantity: '10',
      effectiveFrom: new Date(now - 86400000),
      effectiveTo: new Date(now + 8 * 86400000),
      declaredByUserId: users.artisanId,
    },
  });
  return {
    buyerOrganizationId: buyer.id,
    operatorOrganizationId: operator.id,
    otherBuyerOrganizationId: outsider.id,
    artisanProfileId: profile.id,
    capacityDeclarationId: capacity.id,
    deliveryAt: new Date(now + 6 * 86400000).toISOString(),
    quoteExpiresAt: new Date(now + 2 * 86400000).toISOString(),
    offerExpiresAt: new Date(now + 3 * 86400000).toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function seedBrowserCommerceFixture(url: string, suffix: string) {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$/.test(suffix)) throw new Error('Invalid fixture suffix.');
  const db = new PrismaClient({ adapter: new PrismaPg({ connectionString: url }) });
  try {
    const get = async (role: string) =>
      (
        await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({
          where: { email: `commerce-${role}-${suffix}@example.com` },
        })
      ).id;
    return await seedCommerceFixture(
      db,
      {
        buyerId: await get('buyer'),
        operatorId: await get('operator'),
        artisanId: await get('artisan'),
        qualityId: await get('quality'),
        outsiderId: await get('outsider'),
      },
      suffix,
    );
  } finally {
    await db.$disconnect();
  }
}


===== apps\api\test\commerce.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { AppConfig } from '../src/config/env.js';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import type { CommerceWorkspaceView } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { dispatchBatch } from '../src/jobs/outbox.js';
import { consumeLocalEvent, rebuildAnalyticsBatch } from '../src/jobs/commerce-consumer.js';
import { seedCommerceFixture } from './commerce.fixture.js';
type Result = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Result>;
};
type Identity = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  config: AppConfig;
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Identity>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
};
export async function runCommerceScenarios({ db, register, check, config }: Harness) {
  const buyer = await register('commerce-buyer@example.com', 'Synthetic Commerce Buyer');
  const operator = await register('commerce-operator@example.com', 'Synthetic Commerce Operator');
  const artisan = await register('commerce-artisan@example.com', 'Synthetic Commerce Artisan');
  const quality = await register('commerce-quality@example.com', 'Synthetic Quality Inspector');
  const outsider = await register('commerce-outsider@example.com', 'Unrelated Commerce Buyer');
  const fixture = await seedCommerceFixture(
    db,
    {
      buyerId: buyer.me.user.id,
      operatorId: operator.me.user.id,
      artisanId: artisan.me.user.id,
      qualityId: quality.me.user.id,
      outsiderId: outsider.me.user.id,
    },
    'integration',
  );
  async function command(
    who: Identity,
    path: string,
    body: unknown,
    key: string = randomUUID(),
    method = 'POST',
  ) {
    const me = await who.client.request('/api/v1/me');
    assert.equal(me.status, 200);
    return who.client.request(`/api/v1/commerce/${path}`, method, body, {
      'X-CSRF-Token': (me.body as { csrfToken: string }).csrfToken,
      'Idempotency-Key': key,
    });
  }
  async function ok(who: Identity, path: string, body: unknown, key?: string) {
    const result = await command(who, path, body, key);
    assert.equal(result.status, 201, JSON.stringify(result.body));
    return result.body as { id: string; version: number };
  }
  async function workspace(who: Identity) {
    const result = await who.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/workspace');
    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    return result.body as CommerceWorkspaceView;
  }
  const input = {
    buyerOrganizationId: fixture.buyerOrganizationId,
    operatorOrganizationId: fixture.operatorOrganizationId,
    craftSkillId: 'weaving',
    title: 'Synthetic reconciled craft request',
    specification: 'Ten synthetic woven samples, agreed size and color.',
    designRequirements: 'Fictional blue sample design',
    quantity: 10,
    deliveryAt: fixture.deliveryAt,
    deliveryLocation: 'Synthetic Tunis collection point',
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
  };
  let rfqId = '',
    orderId = '',
    offerId = '',
    batchId = '';
  async function rfqAction(who: Identity, next: string, extra: object = {}) {
    const row = await db.commercialRfq.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: rfqId } });
    return ok(who, `rfqs/${rfqId}/actions`, { version: row.version, next, ...extra });
  }
  async function orderAction(who: Identity, next: string, extra: object = {}) {
    const row = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
    return ok(who, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, { version: row.version, next, ...extra });
  }
  async function batchAction(who: Identity, next: string, extra: object = {}) {
    const row = await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: batchId } });
    return ok(who, `batches/${batchId}/actions`, { version: row.version, next, ...extra });
  }
  async function settle(id: string) {
    for (const next of ['APPROVED', 'INITIATED', 'SETTLED']) {
      const row = await db.syntheticPayment.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
      await ok(operator, `payments/${id}/actions`, {
        version: row.version,
        next,
        ...(next === 'SETTLED' ? { evidenceType: 'SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT' } : {}),
      });
    }
  }
  await check(
    'commerce draft persistence, tenant privacy, strict validation and concurrent keyed creation',
    async () => {
      const key = randomUUID();
      const results = await Promise.all([
        command(buyer, 'rfqs', input, key),
        command(buyer, 'rfqs', input, key),
      ]);
      for (const r of results) assert.equal(r.status, 201, JSON.stringify(r.body));
      assert.deepEqual(results[0].body, results[1].body);
      rfqId = (results[0].body as { id: string }).id;
      assert.equal(
        await db.commercialRfq.count({
          where: { buyerOrganizationId: fixture.buyerOrganizationId },
        }),
        1,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await workspace(operator)).rfqs.length,
        0,
        'Unsubmitted buyer drafts are private.',
      );
      assert.equal((await workspace(outsider)).rfqs.length, 0);
      assert.equal((await command(buyer, 'rfqs', { ...input, quantity: 11 }, key)).status, 409);
      for (const body of [
        { ...input, provenance: 'OBSERVED' },
        { ...input, wearableSummary: { strain: 3 } },
        { ...input, quantity: 0 },
        { ...input, quantity: 1.5 },
        { ...input, deliveryAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
      ])
        assert.equal((await command(buyer, 'rfqs', body)).status, 400);
      assert.equal((await command(outsider, 'rfqs', input)).status, 403);
      const row = await db.commercialRfq.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: rfqId } });
      const {
        buyerOrganizationId: _b,
        operatorOrganizationId: _o,
        provenance: _p,
        ...edit
      } = input;
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(
            outsider,
            `rfqs/${rfqId}`,
            { ...edit, version: row.version },
            undefined,
            'PATCH',
          )
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      const changed = await command(
        buyer,
        `rfqs/${rfqId}`,
        { ...edit, title: 'Reopened synthetic craft request', version: row.version },
        undefined,
        'PATCH',
      );
      assert.equal(changed.status, 200, JSON.stringify(changed.body));
      assert.equal((await workspace(buyer)).rfqs[0].title, 'Reopened synthetic craft request');
      await rfqAction(buyer, 'SUBMITTED');
      assert.equal(
        (await command(buyer, `rfqs/${rfqId}`, { ...edit, version: 3 }, undefined, 'PATCH')).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await command(buyer, `rfqs/${rfqId}/actions`, { next: 'UNDER_REVIEW', version: 3 }))
          .status,
