        403,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'commerce exact quote acceptance creates one order and requires reconciled simulated funding',
    async () => {
      await rfqAction(operator, 'UNDER_REVIEW');
      await rfqAction(operator, 'QUOTED', {
        quoteTnd: '100.001',
        quoteExpiresAt: fixture.quoteExpiresAt,
      });
      const row = await db.commercialRfq.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: rfqId } });
      const key = randomUUID();
      const payload = { next: 'ACCEPTED', version: row.version };
      const results = await Promise.all([
        command(buyer, `rfqs/${rfqId}/actions`, payload, key),
        command(buyer, `rfqs/${rfqId}/actions`, payload, key),
      ]);
      assert.equal(results[0].status, 201);
      assert.deepEqual(results[0].body, results[1].body);
      const order = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { rfqId } });
      orderId = order.id;
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, {
            next: 'FUNDING_CONFIRMED',
            version: 1,
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      const payment = await ok(operator, 'payments', {
        orderId,
        kind: 'BUYER_RECEIPT',
        amountTnd: '100.001',
        provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
      });
      const scheduledOrder = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(buyer, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, {
            version: scheduledOrder.version,
            next: 'CANCELLED',
          })
        ).status,
        409,
        'Pending payments must not be hidden by cancellation.',
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, 'payments', {
            orderId,
            kind: 'BUYER_RECEIPT',
            amountTnd: '0.001',
            provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(quality, 'payments', {
            orderId,
            kind: 'BUYER_RECEIPT',
            amountTnd: '1.000',
            provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      await settle(payment.id);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.syntheticPayment.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: payment.id } })).amountMillimes,
        100001n,
      );
      await orderAction(operator, 'FUNDING_CONFIRMED');
      await orderAction(operator, 'PLANNING');
    },
  );
  const offerInput = () => ({
    orderId,
    capacityDeclarationId: fixture.capacityDeclarationId,
    quantity: 10,
    unitPayTnd: '2.345',
    estimatedHours: '2 to 3',
    expiresAt: fixture.offerExpiresAt,
    materials: 'Synthetic operator supplies yarn',
    reworkTerms: 'Rework only with explicit artisan acceptance; no decline penalty',
    paymentConditions: 'Synthetic payable at QA-approved units, independent of buyer delays',
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
  });
  await check(
    'commerce offer reservations reconcile concurrent allocation, decline, expiry and explicit owner acceptance',
    async () => {
      const concurrent = await Promise.all([
        command(operator, 'offers', { ...offerInput(), quantity: 6 }),
        command(operator, 'offers', { ...offerInput(), quantity: 6 }),
      ]);
      assert.deepEqual(concurrent.map((r) => r.status).sort(), [201, 409]);
      const reserved = concurrent.find((r) => r.status === 201)!.body as {
        id: string;
        version: number;
      };
      assert.equal(
        (await command(operator, `offers/${reserved.id}/actions`, { next: 'ACCEPTED', version: 1 }))
          .status,
        403,
      );
      await ok(artisan, `offers/${reserved.id}/actions`, { next: 'DECLINED', version: 1 });
      const expiring = await ok(operator, 'offers', offerInput());
      await db.commercialOffer.update({
        where: { id: expiring.id },
        data: { expiresAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      assert.equal(
        (await command(artisan, `offers/${expiring.id}/actions`, { next: 'ACCEPTED', version: 1 }))
          .status,
        409,
      );
      await ok(operator, `offers/${expiring.id}/actions`, { next: 'EXPIRED', version: 1 });
      const offer = await ok(operator, 'offers', offerInput());
      offerId = offer.id;
      assert.equal(
        (await command(outsider, `offers/${offerId}/actions`, { next: 'ACCEPTED', version: 1 }))
          .status,
        403,
      );
      const key = randomUUID();
      const decision = { next: 'ACCEPTED', version: 1 };
      const accepted = await Promise.all([
        command(artisan, `offers/${offerId}/actions`, decision, key),
        command(artisan, `offers/${offerId}/actions`, decision, key),
      ]);
      assert.equal(accepted[0].status, 201);
      assert.deepEqual(accepted[0].body, accepted[1].body);
      assert.equal(await db.commercialBatch.count({ where: { offerId } }), 1);
      batchId = (await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { offerId } })).id;
      assert.equal((await workspace(buyer)).offers.length, 0);
      assert.equal(
        (await workspace(quality)).offers.find((o) => o.id === offerId)!.unitPayTnd,
        null,
      );
      assert.equal((await workspace(artisan)).rfqs.length, 0);
      assert.equal((await workspace(outsider)).orders.length, 0);
      await orderAction(operator, 'IN_PRODUCTION');
      await batchAction(operator, 'MATERIAL_READY');
      await batchAction(artisan, 'IN_PROGRESS');
    },
  );
  await check(
    'commerce cumulative progress, inspection attempts and rework reject excess and preserve quantities',
    async () => {
      const first = await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: batchId } });
      const key = randomUUID();
      const payload = { version: first.version, produced: 7 };
      const results = await Promise.all([
        command(artisan, `batches/${batchId}/progress`, payload, key),
        command(artisan, `batches/${batchId}/progress`, payload, key),
      ]);
      assert.equal(results[0].status, 201);
      assert.deepEqual(results[0].body, results[1].body);
      let batch = await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: batchId } });
      assert.equal(batch.produced, 7);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(artisan, `batches/${batchId}/progress`, {
            version: batch.version,
            produced: 11,
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(artisan, `batches/${batchId}/progress`, {
            version: batch.version,
            produced: 6,
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(outsider, `batches/${batchId}/progress`, {
            version: batch.version,
            produced: 8,
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      await ok(artisan, `batches/${batchId}/progress`, { version: batch.version, produced: 10 });
      await batchAction(artisan, 'SUBMITTED');
      await orderAction(operator, 'QUALITY_REVIEW');
      const order = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, {
            next: 'READY_TO_SHIP',
            version: order.version,
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      await batchAction(quality, 'INSPECTION');
      batch = await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: batchId } });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(quality, `batches/${batchId}/inspections`, {
            version: batch.version,
            approved: 9,
            rejected: 0,
            pending: 0,
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      const inspectKey = randomUUID();
      const inspection = {
        version: batch.version,
        approved: 8,
        rejected: 1,
        pending: 1,
        defectReason: 'Synthetic loose edge',
      };
      await ok(quality, `batches/${batchId}/inspections`, inspection, inspectKey);
      await ok(quality, `batches/${batchId}/inspections`, inspection, inspectKey);
      assert.equal(await db.commercialInspection.count({ where: { batchId } }), 1);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, 'payments', {
            orderId,
            batchId,
            kind: 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT',
            amountTnd: '18.761',
            provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      await batchAction(quality, 'REWORK_REQUESTED');
      batch = await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: batchId } });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(artisan, `batches/${batchId}/actions`, {
            version: batch.version,
            next: 'IN_PROGRESS',
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      await batchAction(artisan, 'IN_PROGRESS', { reworkAccepted: true });
      await batchAction(artisan, 'SUBMITTED');
      await batchAction(quality, 'INSPECTION');
      batch = await db.commercialBatch.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: batchId } });
      await ok(quality, `batches/${batchId}/inspections`, {
        version: batch.version,
        approved: 10,
        rejected: 0,
        pending: 0,
      });
      await batchAction(quality, 'APPROVED');
      await batchAction(operator, 'COMPLETED');
      assert.equal(await db.commercialInspection.count({ where: { batchId } }), 2);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'commerce fulfillment and separate exact synthetic ledgers block unpaid closure and duplicate settlement',
    async () => {
      await orderAction(operator, 'READY_TO_SHIP');
      await orderAction(operator, 'IN_TRANSIT');
      await orderAction(operator, 'DELIVERED');
      await orderAction(buyer, 'BUYER_ACCEPTED');
      let row = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, {
            version: row.version,
            next: 'SETTLED',
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      const payment = await ok(operator, 'payments', {
        orderId,
        batchId,
        kind: 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT',
        amountTnd: '23.450',
        provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
      });
      await settle(payment.id);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.syntheticPayment.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: payment.id } })).amountMillimes,
        23450n,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await workspace(buyer)).payments.every((p) => p.kind === 'BUYER_RECEIPT'),
        true,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await workspace(artisan)).payments.every((p) => p.kind === 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT'),
        true,
      );
      assert.equal((await workspace(quality)).payments.length, 0);
      row = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
      await orderAction(operator, 'SETTLED');
      row = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, {
            version: row.version,
            next: 'CLOSED',
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      await orderAction(operator, 'CLOSED', {
        materialsResolved: true,
        dispositionNote:
          'Synthetic materials and returns fully reconciled; no outstanding dispositions.',
      });
      const closed = await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: orderId } });
      assert.equal(closed.status, 'CLOSED');
      assert.equal(closed.delivered, 10);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await command(operator, `orders/${orderId}/actions`, {
            version: closed.version,
            next: 'PLANNING',
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(await db.syntheticPayment.count({ where: { orderId, status: 'SETTLED' } }), 2);
      const audits = await db.auditEvent.findMany({
        where: { organizationId: fixture.buyerOrganizationId, action: { startsWith: 'commerce.' } },
      });
      assert.ok(audits.length > 20);
      assert.equal(
        await db.outboxEvent.count({ where: { auditEventId: { in: audits.map((a) => a.id) } } }),
        audits.length,
      );
    },
  );
  const ledger = async () =>
    JSON.stringify(
      await db.commercialOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: orderId },
        include: {
          rfq: true,
          offers: true,
          batches: { include: { inspections: true } },
          payments: true,
        },
      }),
      (_, value) => (typeof value === 'bigint' ? value.toString() : value),
    );
  await check(
    'E16 useful outbox consumer rebuilds metrics and inbox atomically without changing ledgers',
    async () => {
      const before = await ledger();
      while (await dispatchBatch(db, 100)) {
        /* Drain bounded batches of actual committed events. */
      }
      assert.equal(await ledger(), before);
      const projected = await db.commerceProjection.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { orderId } });
      const metrics = projected.metrics as {
        finance: { artisanEarned: string; artisanPaid: string; buyerReceived: string };
        fulfillment: { accepted: { numerator: number } };
      };
      assert.equal(metrics.finance.artisanEarned, '23450');
      assert.equal(metrics.finance.artisanPaid, '23450');
      assert.equal(metrics.finance.buyerReceived, '100001');
      assert.equal(metrics.fulfillment.accepted.numerator, 10);
      const count = await db.commerceNotice.count();
      const event = await db.outboxEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: orderId, status: 'DELIVERED' },
      });
      await db.outboxEvent.update({
        where: { id: event.id },
        data: { status: 'RETRY', availableAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      await Promise.all([dispatchBatch(db), dispatchBatch(db)]);
      assert.equal(await db.commerceNotice.count(), count);
      const rebuilt = await rebuildAnalyticsBatch(db, undefined, 1);
      assert.equal(rebuilt.count, 1);
      assert.deepEqual(
        (await db.commerceProjection.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { orderId } })).metrics,
        projected.metrics,
      );
      assert.equal(await ledger(), before);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'E16 analytics transient failure rolls back projection/inbox/receipt and replay recovers once',
    async () => {
      const before = await ledger();
      const event = await db.outboxEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: orderId, status: 'DELIVERED' },
      });
      await db.commerceNotice.deleteMany({ where: { eventId: event.id } });
      await db.eventReceipt.delete({ where: { eventId: event.id } });
      await db.commerceProjection.delete({ where: { orderId } });
      await db.outboxEvent.update({
        where: { id: event.id },
        data: { status: 'PENDING', attempts: 0, availableAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      await dispatchBatch(db, 1, async (tx, row) => {
        await consumeLocalEvent(tx, row);
        throw Error('simulated crash after effects');
      });
      assert.equal(await db.commerceProjection.count({ where: { orderId } }), 0);
      assert.equal(await db.commerceNotice.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 0);
      assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 0);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.outboxEvent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: event.id } })).status,
        'RETRY',
      );
      await db.outboxEvent.update({ where: { id: event.id }, data: { availableAt: new Date(0) } });
      await dispatchBatch(db, 1);
      assert.equal(await db.commerceProjection.count({ where: { orderId } }), 1);
      assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 1);
      assert.equal(await ledger(), before);
    },
  );

  await check(
    'E16 killed worker rolls back its claim and effects; restarted worker recovers',
    async () => {
      const event = await db.outboxEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: orderId, status: 'DELIVERED' },
      });
      await db.commerceNotice.deleteMany({ where: { eventId: event.id } });
      await db.eventReceipt.delete({ where: { eventId: event.id } });
      await db.commerceProjection.delete({ where: { orderId } });
      await db.outboxEvent.update({
        where: { id: event.id },
        data: { status: 'PENDING', attempts: 0, availableAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      const environment = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(config).map(([key, value]) => [
          key,
          Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(',') : String(value ?? ''),
        ]),
      );
      const child = spawn(process.execPath, ['--import', 'tsx', 'test/outbox-crash-child.ts'], {
        cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)),
        env: { ...process.env, ...environment },
        stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      });
      const exited = new Promise<void>((resolve) => child.once('close', () => resolve()));
      try {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
          const timeout = setTimeout(
            () => reject(Error('Crash fixture did not reach uncommitted effects.')),
            10000,
          );
          child.once('error', (error) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(error);
          });
          child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => {
            if (chunk.toString().includes('CONSUMER_EFFECTS_UNCOMMITTED')) {
              clearTimeout(timeout);
              resolve();
            }
          });
          child.once('exit', () => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(Error('Crash fixture exited prematurely.'));
          });
        });
      } finally {
        child.kill('SIGKILL');
        await exited;
      }
      assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 0);
      assert.equal(await db.commerceProjection.count({ where: { orderId } }), 0);
      assert.equal(await db.commerceNotice.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 0);
      await dispatchBatch(db, 1);
      assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 1);
      assert.equal(await db.commerceProjection.count({ where: { orderId } }), 1);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'E16 reports, downloadable CSV and inbox enforce tenant, role and current membership',
    async () => {
      const report = `/api/v1/commerce/orders/${orderId}/report`;
      const read = await buyer.client.request(report);
      assert.equal(read.status, 200);
      const visible = JSON.stringify(read.body);
      assert.ok(visible.includes('100001'));
      assert.ok(!visible.includes('artisanPaid'));
      assert.equal((await outsider.client.request(report)).status, 403);
      assert.equal((await artisan.client.request(report)).status, 403);
      const qa = await quality.client.request(report);
      assert.equal((qa.body as { metrics: { finance: unknown } }).metrics.finance, null);
      const csv = await buyer.client.request(`${report}.csv`);
      assert.equal(csv.status, 200);
      assert.ok(String(csv.body).includes('accepted,10,10,PIECES,SYNTHETIC'));
      assert.ok(!String(csv.body).includes('artisanPaid'));
      assert.equal((await outsider.client.request(`${report}.csv`)).status, 403);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await outsider.client.request(
            `/api/v1/commerce/orders/${orderId}/batches/${batchId}/report`,
          )
        ).status,
        404,
      );
      const inbox = await buyer.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/inbox');
      assert.ok((inbox.body as unknown[]).length > 0);
      const foreign = await outsider.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/inbox');
      assert.deepEqual(foreign.body, []);
      await db.organizationMember.update({
        where: {
          organizationId_userId: {
            organizationId: fixture.buyerOrganizationId,
            userId: buyer.me.user.id,
          },
        },
        data: { status: 'REVOKED' },
      });
      assert.equal((await buyer.client.request(report)).status, 403);
      assert.equal((await buyer.client.request(`${report}.csv`)).status, 403);
      assert.deepEqual((await buyer.client.request('/api/v1/commerce/inbox')).body, []);
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\e16.scenarios.ts =====

import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { AppConfig } from '../src/config/env.js';
import { operationalAlerts } from '../src/jobs/alerts.js';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import { iamTransaction } from '../src/modules/foundation/transaction.js';
import { replaySafe } from '../src/modules/foundation/idempotency.js';
import { audit } from '../src/modules/foundation/audit.js';
import { dispatchBatch, recordReceipt, MAX_ATTEMPTS, outboxStatus } from '../src/jobs/outbox.js';
import type { Actor } from '../src/common/identity.js';
type Result = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Result>;
};
type Member = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  config: AppConfig;
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Member>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Result>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
};
export async function runE16Scenarios({ db, register, mutate, check, config }: Harness) {
  const maker = await register('e16-maker@example.com', 'Synthetic E16 Maker');
  const stranger = await register('e16-stranger@example.com', 'Synthetic E16 Stranger');
  const path = '/api/v1/artisans/me/capacity';
  await mutate(maker.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me', 'PATCH', {
    displayName: 'Synthetic E16 Maker',
    region: 'Tunis',
    processingConsent: true,
    policyVersion: 'artisan-profile-v1',
  });
  await mutate(maker.client, '/api/v1/artisans/me/skills', 'PUT', {
    items: [{ craftSkillId: 'weaving' }],
  });
  const profile = await db.artisanProfile.findUniqueOrThrow({
    where: { userId: maker.me.user.id },
  });
  const me = await maker.client.request('/api/v1/me');
  let csrf = (me.body as { csrfToken: string }).csrfToken;
  const session = await db.session.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { userId: maker.me.user.id } });
  const actor: Actor = {
    id: maker.me.user.id,
    sessionId: session.id,
    role: 'USER',
    sessionCreatedAt: session.createdAt,
    sessionExpiresAt: session.expiresAt,
  };
  const input = {
    craftSkillId: 'weaving',
    unitType: 'HOURS',
    quantity: 4.25,
    effectiveFrom: '2027-06-01T00:00:00Z',
    effectiveTo: '2027-06-08T00:00:00Z',
  };
  const key = 'e16_capacity_replay_0001';
  const post = (body: unknown = input, token = key) =>
    maker.client.request(path, 'POST', body, { 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf, 'Idempotency-Key': token });
  await check(
    'E16 concurrent capacity replay has one persisted revision, audit, outcome and event',
    async () => {
      const results = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => post()));
      assert.deepEqual(
        results.map((r) => r.status),
        Array(6).fill(201),
      );
      for (const result of results) assert.deepEqual(result.body, results[0].body);
      assert.equal(
        await db.capacityDeclaration.count({ where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id } }),
        1,
      );
      assert.equal(await db.commandOutcome.count({ where: { resourceId: profile.id } }), 1);
      const audits = await db.auditEvent.findMany({
        where: { actorId: actor.id, action: 'artisan.capacity.update' },
      });
      assert.equal(audits.length, 1);
      assert.equal(await db.outboxEvent.count({ where: { auditEventId: audits[0].id } }), 1);
      assert.equal((await post({ ...input, quantity: 5 })).status, 409);
      assert.equal((await post(input, 'bad')).status, 400);
      assert.equal((await post({ ...input, organizationId: 'forged' })).status, 400);
      assert.equal((await post({ ...input, wearableSummary: { strain: 2 } })).status, 400);
      assert.equal(
        await db.capacityDeclaration.count({ where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id } }),
        1,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'E16 replay rechecks privacy consent, resource ownership and session expiry',
    async () => {
      const denied = await mutate(
        stranger.client,
        `/api/v1/artisans/${profile.id}/capacity`,
        'POST',
        input,
      );
      assert.equal(denied.status, 403);
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(denied.body).includes('4.25'), false);
      await db.consentRecord.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id, purpose: 'artisan.profile' },
        data: { withdrawnAt: new Date() },
      });
      assert.equal((await post()).status, 403);
      await db.consentRecord.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id, purpose: 'artisan.profile' },
        data: { withdrawnAt: null },
      });
      await db.session.update({ where: { id: session.id }, data: { expiresAt: new Date(0) } });
      assert.equal((await post()).status, 401);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await maker.client.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'e16-maker@example.com',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      const renewed = await maker.client.request('/api/v1/me');
      const identity = renewed.body as { csrfToken: string; session: { id: string } };
      csrf = identity.csrfToken;
      actor.sessionId = identity.session.id;
      assert.equal((await post()).status, 201);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'E16 transaction failure rolls back mutation, command outcome, audit and outbox then retries safely',
    async () => {
      const before = {
        audit: await db.auditEvent.count(),
        event: await db.outboxEvent.count(),
        command: await db.commandOutcome.count(),
      };
      const run = (fail: boolean) =>
        iamTransaction(db, actor, (tx) =>
          replaySafe(
            tx,
            {
              actorId: actor.id,
              resourceId: profile.id,
              operation: 'e16.rollback',
              key: 'e16_rollback_key_0001',
            },
            { version: 1 },
            async () => {
              await tx.artisanProfile.update({
                where: { id: profile.id },
                data: { displayName: 'Changed transactionally' },
              });
              await audit(tx, actor, {
                action: 'e16.rollback',
                targetType: 'ArtisanProfile',
                targetId: profile.id,
              });
              if (fail) throw new Error('Injected transaction failure');
              return { ok: true };
            },
          ),
        );
      await assert.rejects(run(true), /Injected/);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.artisanProfile.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: profile.id } })).displayName,
        profile.displayName,
      );
      assert.deepEqual(
        {
          audit: await db.auditEvent.count(),
          event: await db.outboxEvent.count(),
          command: await db.commandOutcome.count(),
        },
        before,
      );
      await run(false);
      await run(false);
      assert.equal(await db.auditEvent.count(), before.audit + 1);
      assert.equal(await db.outboxEvent.count(), before.event + 1);
      assert.equal(await db.commandOutcome.count(), before.command + 1);
    },
  );
  await check('E16 operator worker CLI processes and reports the disposable queue', async () => {
    const environment = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(config).map(([name, value]) => [
        name,
        Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(',') : String(value ?? ''),
      ]),
    );
    const options = {
      cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../', import.meta.url)),
      env: { ...process.env, ...environment },
      timeout: 30000,
    };
    await promisify(execFile)('pnpm', ['worker', '--once'], options);
    const result = await promisify(execFile)('pnpm', ['worker', '--status'], options);
    const status = JSON.parse(result.stdout.trim());
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(status.counts));
    assert.equal(typeof status.oldestPendingAgeMs, 'number');
    // Own the unhealthy endpoint: a developer's real API may already be healthy on port 3001.
    const unavailable = createServer((_request, response) => response.writeHead(503).end());
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => unavailable.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
    try {
      await assert.rejects(
        promisify(execFile)(process.execPath, ['--import', 'tsx', 'scripts/check-operations.ts'], {
          ...options,
          env: {
            ...options.env,
            API_PORT: String((unavailable.address() as { port: number }).port),
            TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH: 'apps/api/tsconfig.json',
            BACKUP_DIRECTORY: '',
          },
        }),
        (failure) => {
          const error = failure as { code: number; stdout: string };
          assert.equal(error.code, 1);
          const alerts = JSON.parse(error.stdout).alerts as string[];
          assert.ok(alerts.includes('API_NOT_READY'));
          assert.ok(
            alerts.every((code) => ['API_NOT_READY', 'OUTBOX_LAG'].includes(code)),
            'The isolated API outage may coexist with real queue lag under load.',
          );
          return true;
        },
      );
    } finally {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => unavailable.close(() => resolve()));
    }
  });
  await check(
    'E16 failed local delivery rolls back consumer effects, exhausts bounded retries and recovers',
    async () => {
      await iamTransaction(db, actor, (tx) =>
        audit(tx, actor, {
          action: 'e16.delivery',
          targetType: 'ArtisanProfile',
          targetId: profile.id,
          reason: 'PRIVATE_SENTINEL_TEXT',
          after: { privateText: 'PRIVATE_SENTINEL_TEXT' },
        }),
      );
      const event = await db.outboxEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { actorId: actor.id, eventType: 'e16.delivery' },
      });
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event).includes('PRIVATE_SENTINEL_TEXT'), false);
      const consumer = async (
        tx: Parameters<typeof recordReceipt>[0],
        row: Parameters<typeof recordReceipt>[1],
      ) => {
        await recordReceipt(tx, row);
        if (row.id === event.id) throw new Error('PRIVATE_PROVIDER_ERROR');
      };
      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
        await db.outboxEvent.update({
          where: { id: event.id },
          data: { availableAt: new Date(0) },
        });
        await dispatchBatch(db, 100, consumer);
        assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 0);
        const failed = await db.outboxEvent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: event.id } });
        assert.equal(failed.attempts, attempt);
        assert.equal(failed.status, attempt === MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'FAILED' : 'RETRY');
        assert.equal(failed.lastErrorCode, 'LOCAL_CONSUMER_FAILED');
        assert.ok(failed.durationMs !== null);
      }
      const diagnostics = await outboxStatus(db);
      assert.ok(diagnostics.failed.some((row) => row.id === event.id));
      assert.ok(
        operationalAlerts({
          ready: true,
          oldestPendingAgeMs: diagnostics.oldestPendingAgeMs,
          failedCount: diagnostics.failed.length,
        }).includes('OUTBOX_FAILED'),
      );
      await db.outboxEvent.update({
        where: { id: event.id },
        data: { status: 'RETRY', attempts: 0, availableAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      await Promise.all([dispatchBatch(db, 100), dispatchBatch(db, 100)]);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.outboxEvent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: event.id } })).status,
        'DELIVERED',
      );
      assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 1);
      // Simulate at-least-once redelivery after an acknowledgement loss.
      await db.outboxEvent.update({
        where: { id: event.id },
        data: { status: 'RETRY', availableAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      await dispatchBatch(db, 100);
      assert.equal(await db.eventReceipt.count({ where: { eventId: event.id } }), 1);
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\governance.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
type Reply = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Reply>;
};
type Fixture = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Fixture>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Reply>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
  mail: { messages: { to: string; text: string }[] };
};
const data = <T>(r: Reply) => r.body as T;
export async function runGovernanceScenarios({ db, register, mutate, check, mail }: Harness) {
  const alice = await register('privacy-alice@example.com', 'Privacy Alice');
  const bob = await register('privacy-bob@example.com', 'Privacy Bob');
  const reviewer = await register('privacy-reviewer@example.com', 'Privacy Reviewer');
  await db.user.update({ where: { id: reviewer.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
  await check(
    'personal preferences and privacy requests are owner-bound and reviewed with retention reasons',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/settings/preferences', 'PATCH', {
            preferredLanguage: 'ar',
            role: 'ADMIN',
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/settings/preferences', 'PATCH', {
            preferredLanguage: 'ar',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        data<{ preferredLanguage: string }>(
          await alice.client.request('/api/v1/settings/preferences'),
        ).preferredLanguage,
        'ar',
      );
      const created = await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/privacy/requests', 'POST', {
        type: 'DELETION',
        details: 'Please review retention and delete optional data.',
      });
      assert.equal(created.status, 201);
      const id = data<{ id: string }>(created).id;
      assert.equal(
        data<{ total: number }>(await bob.client.request('/api/v1/privacy/requests/me')).total,
        0,
      );
      assert.equal((await bob.client.request('/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests')).status, 403);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(bob.client, `/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'RESOLVED',
            resolutionNotes: 'Unauthorized review',
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'RESOLVED',
            resolutionNotes: 'Reviewed request',
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'IN_REVIEW',
            resolutionNotes: 'Retention inventory review started.',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'RESOLVED',
            resolutionNotes: 'Synthetic fixture review complete; no real deletion requested.',
            retentionExceptions:
              'Test fixture retains audit and identity records; no automatic erasure is claimed.',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'IN_REVIEW',
            resolutionNotes: 'Cannot reopen closed review.',
          })
        ).status,
        409,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'self data export excludes credentials and other users, with immutable redacted audits',
    async () => {
      const exported = await alice.client.request('/api/v1/privacy/export');
      assert.equal(exported.status, 200);
      const text = JSON.stringify(exported.body);
      assert.ok(text.includes('privacy-alice@example.com'));
      assert.equal(text.includes('privacy-bob@example.com'), false);
      assert.equal(text.includes('tokenHash'), false);
      assert.equal(text.includes('backupCodes'), false);
      assert.equal(text.includes('password'), false);
      assert.equal(text.includes('session_token'), false);
      assert.equal(
        (await bob.client.request(`/api/v1/privacy/export?userId=${alice.me.user.id}`)).status,
        400,
      );
      const audit = await reviewer.client.request('/api/v1/admin/audit-events');
      assert.equal(audit.status, 200);
      const events = await db.auditEvent.findMany({ where: { actorId: alice.me.user.id } });
      assert.ok(events.some((e) => e.action === 'PERSONAL_DATA_EXPORTED'));
      assert.ok(events.every((e) => e.correlationId.length > 10));
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(events).includes('Please review retention'), false);
      await assert.rejects(
        db.auditEvent.update({ where: { id: events[0].id }, data: { reason: 'tamper' } }),
      );
      await assert.rejects(db.auditEvent.delete({ where: { id: events[0].id } }));
    },
  );
  await check(
    'consent withdrawal is ownership-bound and records purpose/version without deleting history',
    async () => {
      const consent = await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/consents', 'POST', {
        purpose: 'MARKETING',
        policyVersion: '2026-10',
        decision: true,
      });
      assert.equal(consent.status, 201);
      const id = data<{ id: string }>(consent).id;
      assert.equal((await mutate(bob.client, `/api/v1/consents/${id}`, 'DELETE', {})).status, 404);
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(alice.client, `/api/v1/consents/${id}`, 'DELETE', {})).status,
        200,
      );
      const stored = await db.consentRecord.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
      assert.equal(stored.decision, true);
      assert.ok(stored.withdrawnAt);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'support cases enforce resource ownership, assignment and opt-in SMTP submission',
    async () => {
      const created = await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/support/cases', 'POST', {
        subject: 'Synthetic support request',
        description: 'Please help me with a synthetic account setting.',
      });
      assert.equal(created.status, 201);
      const id = data<{ id: string }>(created).id;
      assert.equal(
        data<{ items: unknown[] }>(await bob.client.request('/api/v1/support/cases')).items.length,
        0,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(bob.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'RESOLVED',
            resolution: 'Unauthorized response.',
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}/notify`, 'POST', {})).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/notifications/preferences', 'PUT', {
            items: [
              { category: 'SUPPORT_UPDATES', language: 'fr', channel: 'EMAIL', optedIn: true },
            ],
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
            assignedToUserId: bob.me.user.id,
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
            assignedToUserId: reviewer.me.user.id,
            dueAt: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString(),
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      const sent = await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}/notify`, 'POST', {});
      assert.equal(sent.status, 201);
      assert.deepEqual(sent.body, { status: 'ACCEPTED_BY_SMTP', delivered: false });
      assert.ok(
        mail.messages.some(
          (m) => m.to === 'privacy-alice@example.com' && m.text.includes('Votre demande'),
        ),
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(alice.client, '/api/v1/notifications/preferences', 'PUT', {
            items: [
              { category: 'SUPPORT_UPDATES', language: 'fr', channel: 'EMAIL', optedIn: false },
            ],
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}/notify`, 'POST', {})).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(reviewer.client, `/api/v1/support/cases/${id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'RESOLVED',
            resolution: 'Resolved synthetic request.',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\integration.ts =====

import { runProcurementScenarios } from './procurement.scenarios.js';
import { runRoleUpgradeScenario } from './roles-upgrade.scenarios.js';
import { runRoleScenarios } from './roles.scenarios.js';

  function client(base = origin) {
    const jar = new Map<string, string>();
    return {
      jar,
      async request(
        path: string,
        method = 'GET',
        body?: unknown,
        extra: Record<string, string> = {},
      ) {
        const headers: Record<string, string> = { Origin: config.PUBLIC_APP_URL, ...extra };
        if (jar.size) headers.Cookie = [...jar].map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('; ');
        if (method !== 'GET') headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
        const response = await fetch(base + path, {
          method,
          headers,
          body: method === 'GET' ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body ?? {}),
          redirect: 'manual',
        });
        for (const cookie of response.headers.getSetCookie()) {
          const pair = cookie.split(';')[0];
          const at = pair.indexOf('=');
          const name = pair.slice(0, at),
            value = pair.slice(at + 1);
          if (value) jar.set(name, value);
          else jar.delete(name);
        }
        return {
          status: response.status,
          body: response.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('application/json')
            ? await response.json()
            : await response.text(),
          headers: response.headers,
        };
      },
    };
  }
  type TestClient = Pick<ReturnType<typeof client>, 'request'>;

    return { client: user, me: me.body };
  }

===== apps\api\test\lifecycle.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { AppConfig } from '../src/config/env.js';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';

type Result = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Result>;
};
type Registered = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  db: PrismaService;
  config: AppConfig;
  client(): Client;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Registered>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Result>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
};
const value = <T>(result: Result) => result.body as T;
export async function runLifecycleScenarios({
  db,
  config,
  client,
  register,
  mutate,
  check,
}: Harness) {
  const manager = await register('lifecycle-manager@example.com', 'Synthetic Manager');
  const colleague = await register('lifecycle-colleague@example.com', 'Synthetic Colleague');
  const administrator = await register('lifecycle-admin@example.com', 'Synthetic Administrator');
  await db.user.update({ where: { id: administrator.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
  const organization = await db.organization.create({
    data: {
      name: 'Synthetic Lifecycle Organization',
      slug: 'synthetic-lifecycle',
      type: 'BUYER_BUSINESS',
      region: 'Tunis',
      description: 'Synthetic lifecycle fixture',
      contactEmail: 'lifecycle@example.com',
      representativeName: 'Synthetic Manager',
      createdByUserId: manager.me.user.id,
    },
  });
  await db.organizationMember.create({
    data: {
      organizationId: organization.id,
      userId: manager.me.user.id,
      isManager: true,
      roles: { create: { role: 'BUYER', assignedByUserId: manager.me.user.id } },
    },
  });
  await check(
    'organization responsibility summary blocks last-manager self-deactivation',
    async () => {
      const responsibilities = await manager.client.request('/api/v1/me/responsibilities');
      assert.equal(responsibilities.status, 200);
      assert.deepEqual(value<{ items: unknown[] }>(responsibilities).items, [
        {
          organizationId: organization.id,
          name: organization.name,
          reason: 'LAST_ACTIVE_MANAGER',
        },
      ]);
      assert.deepEqual(
        value<{ items: unknown[] }>(await colleague.client.request('/api/v1/me/responsibilities'))
          .items,
        [],
      );
      const blocked = await mutate(manager.client, '/api/v1/me/deactivate', 'POST', {
        confirmation: 'DEACTIVATE',
      });
      assert.equal(blocked.status, 409);
      assert.equal(value<{ code: string }>(blocked).code, 'LAST_ORGANIZATION_MANAGER');
      assert.equal((await manager.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: manager.me.user.id } })).status,
        'ACTIVE',
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'emergency administrator suspension remains possible and audits unmanaged organizations',
    async () => {
      const suspended = await mutate(
        administrator.client,
        `/api/v1/admin/users/${manager.me.user.id}`,
        'PATCH',
        { status: 'SUSPENDED' },
      );
      assert.equal(suspended.status, 200);
      assert.equal('unmanagedOrganizationIds' in value<object>(suspended), false);
      assert.equal((await manager.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 401);
      const event = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: manager.me.user.id, action: 'account.access.update' },
        orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },
      });
      assert.deepEqual(
        (event.after as { unmanagedOrganizationIds: string[] }).unmanagedOrganizationIds,
        [organization.id],
      );
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event.after).includes('password'), false);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(administrator.client, `/api/v1/admin/users/${manager.me.user.id}`, 'PATCH', {
            status: 'ACTIVE',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await manager.client.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'lifecycle-manager@example.com',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'profile updates record field names without recording submitted personal values',

      const name = 'Private Synthetic Name';
      assert.equal((await mutate(colleague.client, '/api/v1/me', 'PATCH', { name })).status, 200);
      const event = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { actorId: colleague.me.user.id, action: 'account.profile.update' },
      });
      assert.deepEqual(event.after, { fields: ['name'] });
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event).includes(name), false);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'revoke-other-sessions preserves current login and writes safe audit atomically',

      assert.equal(
        (
          await second.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'lifecycle-colleague@example.com',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal((await second.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
      const before = await db.session.findMany({ where: { userId: colleague.me.user.id } });
      assert.ok(before.length >= 2);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(colleague.client, '/api/v1/me/sessions/revoke-others', 'POST', {
            userId: manager.me.user.id,
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      const revoked = await mutate(
        colleague.client,
        '/api/v1/me/sessions/revoke-others',
        'POST',
        {},
      );
      assert.equal(revoked.status, 200);
      assert.ok(value<{ revokedCount: number }>(revoked).revokedCount >= 1);
      assert.equal((await second.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 401);
      assert.equal((await colleague.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
      assert.equal((await manager.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
      const event = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { actorId: colleague.me.user.id, action: 'account.sessions.revoke_others' },
      });
      for (const session of before)
        assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event).includes(session.token), false);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'reassigned organization responsibility permits deactivation and retains memberships/audit',

          isManager: true,

        },
      });
      assert.deepEqual(
        value<{ items: unknown[] }>(await manager.client.request('/api/v1/me/responsibilities'))

        [],
      );
      const result = await mutate(manager.client, '/api/v1/me/deactivate', 'POST', {
        confirmation: 'DEACTIVATE',
      });
      assert.equal(result.status, 200);
      assert.equal((await manager.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 401);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: manager.me.user.id } })).status,
        'DISABLED',
      );
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: { organizationId: organization.id, userId: manager.me.user.id },
        }),
        1,
      );
      const audit = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { actorId: manager.me.user.id, action: 'account.deactivate' },
      });
      assert.deepEqual(audit.after, { status: 'DISABLED' });
      assert.equal((await colleague.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'individual session revocation records safe durable history before ending current access',
    async () => {
      const current = await colleague.client.request('/api/v1/me');
      const id = value<{ session: { id: string } }>(current).session.id;
      const token = (await db.session.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } })).token;
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(administrator.client, `/api/v1/me/sessions/${id}`, 'DELETE', {})).status,
        404,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(colleague.client, `/api/v1/me/sessions/${id}`, 'DELETE', {})).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal((await colleague.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 401);
      const event = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: id, action: 'account.session.revoke' },
      });
      assert.deepEqual(event.after, { current: true });
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(event).includes(token), false);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'trusted recovery CLI validates operator and target before scoped audited handover',
    async () => {
      const replacement = await register(
        'lifecycle-replacement@example.com',
        'Synthetic Replacement',
      );
      const environment = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(config).map(([key, item]) => [
          key,
          Array.isArray(item) ? item.join(',') : String(item ?? ''),
        ]),
      );
      const exec = promisify(execFile);
      const command = (args: string[]) =>
        exec(
          'pnpm',
          [
            'exec',
            'tsx',
            '--tsconfig',
            'apps/api/tsconfig.json',
            'scripts/recover-organization-manager.ts',
            ...args,
          ],
          {
            cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../', import.meta.url)),
            env: { ...process.env, ...environment, DATABASE_URL: config.DATABASE_URL },
            maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,
          },
        );
      const argumentsFor = (operator: string, target = 'lifecycle-replacement@example.com') => [
        '--organization',
        organization.id,
        '--email',
        target,
        '--operator',
        operator,
        '--reason',
        'Synthetic incident manager handover',
      ];
      await assert.rejects(command(argumentsFor('lifecycle-colleague@example.com')));
      await assert.rejects(command(['--organization', organization.id]));
      await db.user.update({
        where: { id: replacement.me.user.id },
        data: { status: 'SUSPENDED' },
      });
      await assert.rejects(command(argumentsFor('lifecycle-admin@example.com')));
      await db.user.update({
        where: { id: replacement.me.user.id },
        data: { status: 'ACTIVE', emailVerified: false },
      });
      await assert.rejects(command(argumentsFor('lifecycle-admin@example.com')));
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: { organizationId: organization.id, userId: replacement.me.user.id },
        }),
        0,
      );
      await db.user.update({
        where: { id: replacement.me.user.id },
        data: { emailVerified: true },
      });
      const recovered = await command(argumentsFor('lifecycle-admin@example.com'));
      assert.match(recovered.stdout, /Organization manager recovered/);
      assert.equal(recovered.stdout.includes('lifecycle-replacement@example.com'), false);
      const membership = await db.organizationMember.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: {
          organizationId_userId: {
            organizationId: organization.id,
            userId: replacement.me.user.id,
          },
        },
        include: { roles: true },
      });
      assert.equal(membership.status, 'ACTIVE');
      assert.equal(membership.isManager, true);
      assert.deepEqual(
        membership.roles.map((role) => role.role),
        ['BUYER'],
      );
      const event = await db.auditEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { targetId: membership.id, action: 'organization.manager.recover' },
      });
      assert.equal(event.actorId, administrator.me.user.id);
      assert.equal(event.reason, 'Synthetic incident manager handover');
      await db.organizationMember.update({
        where: { id: membership.id },
        data: { status: 'SUSPENDED', isManager: false },
      });
      await command(argumentsFor('lifecycle-admin@example.com'));
      assert.equal(await db.membershipRole.count({ where: { membershipId: membership.id } }), 1);
      assert.equal(
        await db.auditEvent.count({
          where: { targetId: membership.id, action: 'organization.manager.recover' },
        }),
        2,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: replacement.me.user.id } })).role,
        'USER',
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: manager.me.user.id } })).status,
        'DISABLED',
      );
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\mfa.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import type { AppConfig } from '../src/config/env.js';
import { createApp } from '../src/app.js';
type Reply = { status: number; body: unknown; headers: Headers };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Reply>;
};
type Fixture = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  db: PrismaService;
  config: AppConfig;
  client(base?: string): Client;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Fixture>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Reply>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
  mail: {
    token(email: string, path: string): Promise<string>;
    messages: { to: string; text: string }[];
  };
};
const body = <T>(r: Reply) => r.body as T;
// Test-only RFC 6238 generator. Runtime cryptography remains exclusively Better Auth.
export function totp(uri: string) {
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';
  const secret = new URL(uri).searchParams.get('secret')!;
  let bits = '';
  for (const c of secret.toUpperCase().replace(/=+$/, ''))
    bits += alphabet.indexOf(c).toString(2).padStart(5, '0');
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) bytes.push(parseInt(bits.slice(i, i + 8), 2));
  const counter = Buffer.alloc(8);
  counter.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 30000)));
  const digest = createHmac('sha1', Buffer.from(bytes)).update(counter).digest();
  const offset = digest.at(-1)! & 15;
  return ((digest.readUInt32BE(offset) & 0x7fffffff) % 1000000).toString().padStart(6, '0');
}
export async function runMfaScenarios({
  db,
  config,
  client,
  register,
  mutate,
  check,
  mail,
}: Harness) {
  const account = await register('mfa-foundation@example.com', 'MFA Operator');
  await db.user.update({ where: { id: account.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
  let guardedApp: INestApplication | undefined;
  try {
    guardedApp = await createApp({ config: { ...config, REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA: true } });
    await guardedApp.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
    const operator = client(await guardedApp.getUrl());
    await check(
      'privileged MFA is enforced before approval/admin access and verified enrollment invalidates older sessions',
      async () => {
        assert.equal(
          (
            await operator.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
              email: 'mfa-foundation@example.com',
              password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
            })
          ).status,
          200,
        );
        assert.equal((await operator.request('/api/v1/admin/users')).status, 403);
        assert.equal(
          body<{ code: string }>(await operator.request('/api/v1/admin/users')).code,
          'MFA_REQUIRED',
        );
        assert.equal((await operator.request('/api/v1/settings/security')).status, 200);
        const started = await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/enable', 'POST', {
          password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
        });
        assert.equal(started.status, 200);
        const setup = body<{ totpURI: string; backupCodes: string[] }>(started);
        assert.ok(setup.totpURI.startsWith('otpauth://'));
        assert.equal(setup.backupCodes.length, 10);
        const raw = await db.twoFactor.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { userId: account.me.user.id } });
        assert.equal(
          raw.secret.includes(new URL(setup.totpURI).searchParams.get('secret')!),
          false,
        );
        assert.equal(raw.backupCodes.includes(setup.backupCodes[0]), false);
        const verified = await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp', 'POST', {
          code: totp(setup.totpURI),
        });
        assert.equal(verified.status, 200);
        assert.deepEqual(verified.body, { ok: true });
        assert.equal((await operator.request('/api/v1/admin/users')).status, 200);
        assert.equal((await account.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 401);
        assert.equal(
          (
            await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/disable', 'POST', {
              password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
            })
          ).status,
          409,
        );
        await operator.request('/api/auth/sign-out', 'POST', {});
        const login = await operator.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
          email: 'mfa-foundation@example.com',
          password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
        });
        assert.deepEqual(login.body, { twoFactorRedirect: true });
        assert.equal((await operator.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 401);
        assert.equal(
          (await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp', 'POST', { code: '000000' }))
            .status,
          400,
        );
        const recovery = await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-backup-code', 'POST', {
          code: setup.backupCodes[0],
        });
        assert.equal(recovery.status, 200);
        assert.deepEqual(recovery.body, { ok: true });
        assert.equal((await operator.request('/api/v1/admin/users')).status, 200);
        await operator.request('/api/auth/sign-out', 'POST', {});
        await operator.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
          email: 'mfa-foundation@example.com',
          password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
        });
        assert.equal(
          (
            await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-backup-code', 'POST', {
              code: setup.backupCodes[0],
            })
          ).status,
          400,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (
            await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-backup-code', 'POST', {
              code: setup.backupCodes[1],
            })
          ).status,
          200,
        );
        const me = await operator.request('/api/v1/me');
        const sessionId = body<{ session: { id: string } }>(me).session.id;
        await db.session.update({ where: { id: sessionId }, data: { mfaVerifiedAt: null } });
        assert.equal((await operator.request('/api/v1/admin/users')).status, 403);
        assert.equal(
          (
            await operator.request('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp', 'POST', {
              code: totp(setup.totpURI),
            })
          ).status,
          200,
        );
        const assignee = await register('mfa-support-assignee@example.com', 'Support Assignee');
        const organization = await db.organization.create({
          data: {
            name: 'Synthetic MFA support',
            slug: 'synthetic-mfa-support',
            type: 'INTERNAL',
            approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
            region: 'Tunis',
            description: 'Synthetic scoped support assignment test.',
            contactEmail: 'synthetic@example.com',
            representativeName: 'MFA Operator',
            createdByUserId: account.me.user.id,
          },
        });
        for (const userId of [account.me.user.id, assignee.me.user.id])
          await db.organizationMember.create({
            data: {
              organizationId: organization.id,
              userId,
              roles: { create: { role: 'SUPPORT', assignedByUserId: account.me.user.id } },
            },
          });
        const supportCase = await mutate(operator, '/api/v1/support/cases', 'POST', {
          subject: 'Scoped assignment without session borrowing',
          description: 'Synthetic support member assignment checks independent membership.',
          organizationId: organization.id,
        });
        assert.equal(supportCase.status, 201);
        assert.equal(
          (
            await mutate(
              operator,
              `/api/v1/support/cases/${body<{ id: string }>(supportCase).id}`,
              'PATCH',
              { status: 'IN_PROGRESS', assignedToUserId: assignee.me.user.id },
            )
          ).status,
          200,
        );
      },
    );
  } finally {
    await guardedApp?.close();
  }
  await check(
    'verified email change keeps old identity until confirmations and blocks ordinary email profile editing',
    async () => {
      const user = await register('email-change-old@example.com', 'Email Change');
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(user.client, '/api/v1/me', 'PATCH', {
            name: 'Email Change',
            email: 'email-change-new@example.com',
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await user.client.request('/api/auth/change-email', 'POST', {
            newEmail: 'email-change-new@example.com',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: user.me.user.id } })).email,
        'email-change-old@example.com',
      );
      const confirmation = await mail.token('email-change-old@example.com', '/auth/verify-email');
      // Signup and old-address confirmation share a path; wait for the newer confirmation message.
      let current = confirmation;
      for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        const matches = mail.messages.filter(
          (m) =>
            m.to === 'email-change-old@example.com' && m.text.includes('Confirm the email change'),
        );
        const match = matches.at(-1)?.text.match(/#token=([^\s]+)/);
        if (match) {
          current = decodeURIComponent(match[1]);
          break;
        }
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20));
      }
      assert.equal(
        (await client().request(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(current)}`))
          .status,
        200,
      );
      const verification = await mail.token('email-change-new@example.com', '/auth/verify-email');
      assert.equal(
        (await client().request(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(verification)}`))
          .status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: user.me.user.id } })).email,
        'email-change-new@example.com',
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await client().request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'email-change-old@example.com',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        401,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await client().request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'email-change-new@example.com',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        200,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'unverified accounts cannot sign in and expired recovery records cannot reset credentials',
    async () => {
      const unverified = client();
      assert.equal(
        (
          await unverified.request('/api/auth/sign-up/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'unverified-edge@example.com',
            name: 'Unverified Edge',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        202,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await unverified.request('/api/auth/sign-in/email', 'POST', {
            email: 'unverified-edge@example.com',
            password: 'Foundation-test-password-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        401,
      );
      const existing = await register('expired-recovery@example.com', 'Expired Recovery');
      const before = new Set(
        (await db.verification.findMany({ select: { id: true } })).map((row) => row.id),
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await client().request('/api/auth/request-password-reset', 'POST', {
            email: 'expired-recovery@example.com',
          })
        ).status,
        202,
      );
      const token = await mail.token('expired-recovery@example.com', '/auth/reset-password');
      const rows = await db.verification.findMany({ select: { id: true } });
      const created = rows.filter((row) => !before.has(row.id));
      assert.equal(created.length, 1);
      await db.verification.update({
        where: { id: created[0].id },
        data: { expiresAt: new Date(0) },
      });
      assert.equal(
        (
          await client().request('/api/auth/reset-password', 'POST', {
            token,
            newPassword: 'Invalid-expired-recovery-2026!',
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal((await existing.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\organizations.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import type {
  OrganizationMembershipView,
  InvitationView,
  MembershipView,
  OrganizationView,
  Page,
  OrganizationMemberView,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';

type Reply = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    extra?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Reply>;
};
type Fixture = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type ScenarioContext = {
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Fixture>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Reply>;
  check(name: string, run: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
  mail: { token(email: string, path: string): Promise<string> };
};
export async function runOrganizationScenarios({
  db,
  register,
  mutate,
  check,
  mail,
}: ScenarioContext) {
  const owner = await register('org-owner@example.com', 'Organization Owner');
  const invitee = await register('org-invitee@example.com', 'Organization Invitee');
  const outsider = await register('org-outsider@example.com', 'Organization Outsider');
  const reviewer = await register('org-reviewer@example.com', 'Organization Reviewer');
  await db.user.update({ where: { id: reviewer.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
  const base = {
    name: 'Synthetic Buyer Cooperative',
    type: 'BUYER_BUSINESS',
    region: 'Tunis',
    description: 'Synthetic buyer organization for access regression tests.',
    contactEmail: 'org-owner@example.com',
    representativeName: 'Organization Owner',
    country: 'TN',
    contactPhone: '+216 70000000',
  };
  let organization: OrganizationMembershipView;
  let otherOrganization: OrganizationMembershipView;
  const lastTokens = new Map<string, string>();
  const freshToken = async (email: string) => {
    const previous = lastTokens.get(email);
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++) {
      const token = await mail.token(email, '/invitations/accept');
      if (token !== previous) {
        lastTokens.set(email, token);
        return token;
      }
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
    }
    throw new Error('A newly rotated invitation email was not received.');
  };
  const invite = async (email: string, isManager = false) => {
    const reply = await mutate(
      owner.client,
      `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/invitations`,
      'POST',
      { email, roles: ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'], isManager },
    );
    assert.equal(reply.status, 201);
    const data = reply.body as { invitation: InvitationView; delivery: string };
    assert.equal(data.delivery, 'QUEUED');
    assert.equal('tokenHash' in data.invitation, false);
    return { invitation: data.invitation, token: await freshToken(email) };
  };
  await check(
    'organization onboarding denies public internal-operator creation, mass assignment and cross-tenant access',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        (await mutate(owner.client, '/api/v1/organizations', 'POST', { ...base, type: 'INTERNAL' }))
          .status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(owner.client, '/api/v1/organizations', 'POST', {
            ...base,
            approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      const created = await mutate(owner.client, '/api/v1/organizations', 'POST', base);
      assert.equal(created.status, 201);
      organization = created.body as OrganizationMembershipView;
      assert.equal(organization.approvalStatus, 'DRAFT');
      assert.equal(organization.myMembership.isManager, true);
      assert.deepEqual(organization.myMembership.roles, ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE']);
      assert.equal(
        (await outsider.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`)).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await reviewer.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`)).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(

            owner.client,

            'POST',
            { email: 'org-invitee@example.com', roles: ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'] },
          )
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      const other = await mutate(invitee.client, '/api/v1/organizations', 'POST', {
        ...base,
        name: 'Other Synthetic Buyer',

      });

        403,

            {},

            reviewer.client,

      );
      assert.equal(

            description: 'Corrected synthetic profile for approval.',
          })

        200,
      );
      const corrected = await owner.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`);
      assert.equal((corrected.body as OrganizationView).contactPhone, base.contactPhone);
      assert.equal((corrected.body as OrganizationView).country, base.country);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/submit-approval`,
            'POST',
            {},

        ).status,
        200,

      );
      assert.equal(approved.status, 200);
      assert.equal((approved.body as OrganizationView).approvedByUserId, reviewer.me.user.id);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'invitation email binding, hashed secrets, type-specific roles and concurrent single-use acceptance',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/invitations`,
            'POST',
            { email: 'org-outsider@example.com', roles: ['FINANCE_MANAGER'] },

        ).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            reviewer.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/invitations`,
            'POST',
            { email: 'org-outsider@example.com', roles: ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'] },

        ).status,
        403,
      );
      const invitation = await invite('org-invitee@example.com');
      const stored = await db.invitation.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: invitation.invitation.id },

      assert.notEqual(stored.tokenHash, invitation.token);
      assert.equal(stored.tokenHash, createHash('sha256').update(invitation.token).digest('hex'));
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(outsider.client, '/api/v1/invitations/accept', 'POST', {
            token: invitation.token,
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(invitee.client, '/api/v1/invitations/accept', 'POST', {
            token: '0'.repeat(64),
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      const results = await Promise.all([
        mutate(invitee.client, '/api/v1/invitations/accept', 'POST', { token: invitation.token }),
        mutate(invitee.client, '/api/v1/invitations/accept', 'POST', { token: invitation.token }),
      ]);
      assert.deepEqual(results.map((r) => r.status).sort(), [200, 400]);
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: { organizationId: organization.id, userId: invitee.me.user.id },
        }),
        1,
      );
      const detail = await invitee.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`);
      assert.equal(detail.status, 200);
      assert.deepEqual((detail.body as OrganizationMembershipView).myMembership.roles, [
        'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE',
      ]);
      assert.equal((detail.body as OrganizationMembershipView).myMembership.isManager, false);
      assert.equal(
        (

        ).status,

      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,

            { email: 'org-invitee@example.com', roles: ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'] },

        ).status,
        409,
      );
      const auditText = JSON.stringify(
        await db.auditEvent.findMany({ where: { organizationId: organization.id } }),

      assert.equal(auditText.includes(invitation.token), false);
      assert.equal(auditText.includes(stored.tokenHash), false);
    },
  );
  await check('expired, cancelled and rotated invitations deny stale links', async () => {
    const pending = await invite('org-outsider@example.com');
    await db.invitation.update({
      where: { id: pending.invitation.id },
      data: { expiresAt: new Date(0) },

    assert.equal(
      (

    const fresh = await freshToken('org-outsider@example.com');
    assert.notEqual(fresh, pending.token);
    assert.equal(

  });
  await check(
    'invitation acceptance rechecks suspended organization, inviter status and current manager authority',

        200,
      );
      assert.equal(

          await mutate(outsider.client, '/api/v1/invitations/accept', 'POST', {
            token: pending.token,

        ).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            reviewer.client,
            `/api/v1/admin/organizations/${organization.id}/approve`,
            'POST',
            { reason: 'Synthetic suspension completed' },

        ).status,

      assert.equal(
