        200,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'membership revocation is immediate and isolated while last manager and self role changes are protected',
    async () => {
      const members = await owner.client.request(
        `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members`,
      );
      assert.equal(members.status, 200);
      const target = (members.body as Page<OrganizationMemberView>).items.find(
        (m) => m.userId === invitee.me.user.id,
      );
      assert.ok(target);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${organization.myMembership.id}/roles`,
            'PUT',
            { roles: ['BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'], reason: 'Self role edit prohibited' },
          )
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${organization.myMembership.id}`,
            'DELETE',
            { reason: 'Cannot leave without successor' },
          )
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${target.id}`,
            'PATCH',
            { status: 'SUSPENDED', reason: 'Scoped synthetic suspension' },
          )
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await invitee.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`)).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await invitee.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${otherOrganization.id}`)).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal((await invitee.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
      const summary = await invitee.client.request('/api/v1/organizations');
      assert.equal(summary.status, 200);
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(summary.body).includes('contactEmail'), false);
      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(summary.body).includes('description'), false);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${target.id}`,
            'DELETE',
            { reason: 'Scoped synthetic revocation' },
          )
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      const revoked = await db.organizationMember.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: target.id } });
      assert.equal(revoked.status, 'REVOKED');
      assert.equal(
        (await invitee.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`)).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${otherOrganization.myMembership.id}`,
            'PATCH',
            { status: 'SUSPENDED', reason: 'Cross organization member substitution' },
          )
        ).status,
        404,
      );
      const restored = await mutate(
        owner.client,
        `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${target.id}`,
        'PATCH',
        { status: 'ACTIVE', isManager: true, reason: 'Assign replacement organization manager' },
      );
      assert.equal(restored.status, 200);
      assert.equal((restored.body as MembershipView).isManager, true);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            owner.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${organization.myMembership.id}`,
            'DELETE',
            { reason: 'Leave with replacement manager present' },
          )
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await owner.client.request(`/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}`)).status,
        403,
      );
      assert.equal((await owner.client.request('/api/v1/me')).status, 200);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'concurrent manager departures preserve a verified organization manager',
    async () => {
      const memberships = await db.organizationMember.findMany({
        where: { organizationId: organization.id },
      });
      const inviteeMembership = memberships.find((member) => member.userId === invitee.me.user.id);
      const outsiderMembership = memberships.find(
        (member) => member.userId === outsider.me.user.id,
      );
      assert.ok(inviteeMembership);
      assert.ok(outsiderMembership);
      assert.equal(
        (
          await mutate(
            invitee.client,
            `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${outsiderMembership.id}`,
            'PATCH',
            { isManager: true, reason: 'Assign second manager for safe handover' },
          )
        ).status,
        200,
      );
      const results = await Promise.all([
        mutate(
          invitee.client,
          `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${inviteeMembership.id}`,
          'DELETE',
          { reason: 'Concurrent synthetic manager departure' },
        ),
        mutate(
          outsider.client,
          `/api/v1/organizations/${organization.id}/members/${outsiderMembership.id}`,
          'DELETE',
          { reason: 'Concurrent synthetic manager departure' },
        ),
      ]);
      assert.deepEqual(results.map((result) => result.status).sort(), [200, 409]);
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: {
            organizationId: organization.id,
            status: 'ACTIVE',
            isManager: true,
            user: { status: 'ACTIVE', emailVerified: true },
          },
        }),
        1,
      );
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\outbox-crash-child.ts =====

import 'reflect-metadata';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import { loadConfig } from '../src/config/env.js';
import { dispatchBatch } from '../src/jobs/outbox.js';
import { consumeLocalEvent } from '../src/jobs/commerce-consumer.js';
const db = new PrismaService(loadConfig());
try {
  await dispatchBatch(db, 1, async (tx, event) => {
    await consumeLocalEvent(tx, event);
    process.stdout.write('CONSUMER_EFFECTS_UNCOMMITTED\n');
    await new Promise<void>(() => {
      /* Parent deliberately kills this test process. */
    });
  });
} finally {
  await db.$disconnect();
}


===== apps\api\test\procurement.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { randomUUID, createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import sharp from 'sharp';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
import type { AppConfig } from '../src/config/env.js';
import type { ProcurementDetail, ProcurementList, ProcurementThread } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { seedCommerceFixture } from './commerce.fixture.js';
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    headers?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown }>;
};
type Identity = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
export async function runProcurementScenarios({
  db,
  register,
  check,
  config,
}: {
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Identity>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
  config: AppConfig;
}) {
  const people = await Promise.all(
    [
      'buyer',
      'operator',
      'artisan',
      'quality',
      'outsider',
      'assigned-operator',
      'coordinator',
      'unassigned-coordinator',
      'representative',
    ].map((r) => register(`procurement-${r}@example.com`, `Synthetic procurement ${r}`)),
  );
  const [
    buyer,
    operator,
    artisan,
    quality,
    outsider,
    assigned,
    coordinator,
    otherCoordinator,
    representative,
  ] = people;
  const fixture = await seedCommerceFixture(
    db,
    {
      buyerId: buyer.me.user.id,
      operatorId: operator.me.user.id,
      artisanId: artisan.me.user.id,
      qualityId: quality.me.user.id,
      outsiderId: outsider.me.user.id,
    },
    'procurement',
  );
  const input = {
    buyerOrganizationId: fixture.buyerOrganizationId,
    operatorOrganizationId: fixture.operatorOrganizationId,
    craftSkillId: 'weaving',
    title: 'Synthetic procurement request',
    specification: 'Cotton runner, synthetic reference version one.',
    designRequirements: 'Fictional blue trim and agreed dimensions.',
    quantity: 10,
    deliveryAt: fixture.deliveryAt,
    deliveryLocation: 'Synthetic Tunis collection point',
    provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
  };
  const root = '/api/v1/procurement';
  async function command(who: Identity, path: string, body: unknown, key: string = randomUUID()) {
    const me = await who.client.request('/api/v1/me');
    assert.equal(me.status, 200);
    return who.client.request(root + path, 'POST', body, {
      'X-CSRF-Token': (me.body as { csrfToken: string }).csrfToken,
      'Idempotency-Key': key,
    });
  }
  async function ok<T = { id: string; version: number }>(
    who: Identity,
    path: string,
    body: unknown,
    key?: string,
  ) {
    const r = await command(who, path, body, key);
    assert.equal(r.status, 201, JSON.stringify(r));
    return r.body as T;
  }
  async function get<T>(who: Identity, path: string) {
    const r = await who.client.request(root + path);
    assert.equal(r.status, 200, JSON.stringify(r));
    return r.body as T;
  }
  const detail = () => get<ProcurementDetail>(buyer, `/rfqs/${id}`);
  let id = '',
    fileId = '',
    quoteId = '',
    orderId = '',
    productId = '';
  const png = await sharp({ create: { width: 8, height: 8, channels: 3, background: '#11665f' } })
    .png()
    .toBuffer();
  const image = { filename: 'reference.png', mime: 'image/png', base64: png.toString('base64') };
  await check(
    'E02 draft creation validates fields, persists a revision and replays atomically',
    async () => {
      const key: string = randomUUID(),
        results = await Promise.all([
          command(buyer, '/rfqs', input, key),
          command(buyer, '/rfqs', input, key),
        ]);
      for (const r of results) assert.equal(r.status, 201, JSON.stringify(r));
      assert.deepEqual(results[0].body, results[1].body);
      id = (results[0].body as { id: string }).id;
      const d = await detail();
      assert.equal(d.rfq.procurementManaged, true);
      assert.equal(d.revisions.length, 1);
      assert.equal(d.revisions[0].authorId, buyer.me.user.id);
      assert.equal(d.revisions[0].snapshot.quantity, 10);
      assert.equal((await operator.client.request(`${root}/rfqs/${id}`)).status, 404);
      for (const body of [
        { ...input, quantity: 0 },
        { ...input, quantity: 1.5 },
        { ...input, specification: '' },
        { ...input, deliveryAt: 'not-a-date' },
        { ...input, wearableData: { strain: 1 } },
      ])
        assert.equal((await command(buyer, '/rfqs', body)).status, 400);
      const invalid = await command(buyer, '/rfqs', { ...input, quantity: 0 });
      assert.ok((invalid.body as { fieldErrors: Record<string, unknown> }).fieldErrors.quantity);
      assert.equal((await command(outsider, '/rfqs', input)).status, 403);
      assert.equal((await outsider.client.request(`${root}/rfqs/${id}`)).status, 404);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'E02 references are inspected, re-encoded and session scoped; unsafe input leaves the draft intact',
    async () => {
      const d = await detail();
      const uploaded = await ok(buyer, `/rfqs/${id}/attachments`, {
        ...image,
        version: d.rfq.version,
      });
      fileId = uploaded.id;
      const after = await detail();
      assert.equal(after.attachments[0].mime, 'image/webp');
      assert.equal(after.revisions.length, 2);
      assert.equal(after.revisions[0].predecessorId, d.revisions[0].id);
      const token = await get<{ token: string }>(buyer, `/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/token`);
      const content = await get<{ mime: string; base64: string }>(
        buyer,
        `/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/content?token=${encodeURIComponent(token.token)}`,
      );
      assert.equal(content.mime, 'image/webp');
      assert.equal((await sharp(Buffer.from(content.base64, 'base64')).metadata()).format, 'webp');
      assert.equal(
        (await outsider.client.request(`${root}/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/token`)).status,
        404,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await buyer.client.request(
            `${root}/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/content?token=forged`,
          )
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      const claims = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.token.split('.')[0], 'base64url').toString());
      claims.expires = Date.now() - 1;
      const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(claims)).toString('base64url'),
        signature = createHmac('sha256', config.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET)
          .update(`procurement-download:${payload}`)
          .digest('base64url');
      assert.equal(
        (
          await buyer.client.request(
            `${root}/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/content?token=${payload}.${signature}`,
          )
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      for (const body of [
        { ...image, mime: 'image/jpeg' },
        { ...image, base64: Buffer.from('MZ disguised executable').toString('base64') },
        { ...image, filename: '../unsafe.png' },
        { ...image, base64: Buffer.alloc(262145).toString('base64') },
      ])
        assert.equal(
          (await command(buyer, `/rfqs/${id}/attachments`, { ...body, version: after.rfq.version }))
            .status,
          400,
        );
      assert.equal((await detail()).rfq.version, after.rfq.version);
      await ok(buyer, `/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/remove`, { version: after.rfq.version });
      assert.equal((await detail()).attachments.length, 0);
      assert.equal(
        (await buyer.client.request(`${root}/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${fileId}/token`)).status,
        404,
      );
      fileId = (
        await ok(buyer, `/rfqs/${id}/attachments`, {
          ...image,
          version: (await detail()).rfq.version,
        })
      ).id;
    },
  );
  await check(
    'E02 attachment count and stale-write limits hold under concurrent commands',
    async () => {
      const second = await ok(buyer, '/rfqs', { ...input, title: 'Synthetic image limit request' });
      let d = await get<ProcurementDetail>(buyer, `/rfqs/${second.id}`);
      for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) {
        await ok(buyer, `/rfqs/${second.id}/attachments`, { ...image, version: d.rfq.version });
        d = await get<ProcurementDetail>(buyer, `/rfqs/${second.id}`);
      }
      const r = await Promise.all([
        command(buyer, `/rfqs/${second.id}/attachments`, { ...image, version: d.rfq.version }),

===== apps\api\test\restore.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { mkdtemp, writeFile, readFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { decryptBackup, unpackDatabaseBackup } from '../src/operations/backup.js';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { createHash, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import { disposableDatabase } from './support.js';
const exec = promisify(execFile);
async function snapshot(url: string) {
  const client = new Client({ connectionString: url });
  try {
    await client.connect();
    const tables = await client.query<{ tablename: string }>(
      "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename",
    );
    const result: Record<string, { count: number; sha256: string }> = {};
    for (const { tablename } of tables.rows) {
      const escaped = tablename.replaceAll('"', '""');
      const rows = await client.query<{ row: string }>(
        `SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS row FROM "${escaped}" t`,
      );
      result[tablename] = {
        count: rows.rowCount ?? 0,
        sha256: createHash('sha256')
          .update(
            rows.rows
              .map((row) => row.row)
              .sort()
              .join('\n'),
          )
          .digest('hex'),
      };
    }
    return result;
  } finally {
    await client.end();
  }
}
// Only accepts containers created by the test harness; no production URL or restore target input.
export async function runRestoreScenario(
  source: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof disposableDatabase>>,
  check: (name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>,
) {
  await check(
    'E16 real pg_dump/pg_restore preserves every table in an isolated synthetic database',
    async () => {
      if (!/^nasj-test-[a-f0-9]{16}$/.test(source.containerName))
        throw new Error('Disposable source required.');
      const target = await disposableDatabase();
      const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'nasj-restore-'));
      try {
        const before = await snapshot(source.url);
        const started = performance.now();
        const key = randomBytes(32);
        const keyFile = join(directory, 'backup.key');
        await writeFile(keyFile, key, { mode: 0o600 });
        const configFile = join(directory, 'runtime.env');
        const configuration = Buffer.from(
          `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${randomBytes(48).toString('hex')}\n`,
        );
        await writeFile(configFile, configuration, { mode: 0o600 });
        const command = await exec('node_modules/.bin/tsx', ['scripts/backup-database.ts'], {
          cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../', import.meta.url)),
          env: {
            ...process.env,
            BACKUP_CONTAINER: source.containerName,
            BACKUP_DIRECTORY: directory,
            BACKUP_KEY_FILE: keyFile,
            BACKUP_CONFIG_FILE: configFile,
            BACKUP_DATABASE_USER: 'foundation_test',
            BACKUP_DATABASE_NAME: 'foundation_test',
          },
        });
        const result = JSON.parse(command.stdout) as {
          code: string;
          filename: string;
          encryptedBytes: number;
        };
        assert.equal(result.code, 'BACKUP_CREATED');
        const encrypted = await readFile(join(directory, result.filename));
        const payload = unpackDatabaseBackup(decryptBackup(encrypted, key));
        assert.equal(payload.version, 2);
        assert.deepEqual(payload.configuration, configuration);
        const stdout = payload.database;
        assert.ok(stdout.subarray(0, 5).equals(Buffer.from('PGDMP')));
        assert.ok(!encrypted.includes(Buffer.from('commerce-buyer@example.com')));
        const archive = join(directory, 'synthetic.dump');
        await writeFile(archive, stdout, { mode: 0o600 });
        const backupMs = Math.round(performance.now() - started);
        await exec('docker', [
          '--context',
          'default',
          'cp',
          archive,
          `${target.containerName}:/tmp/synthetic.dump`,
        ]);
        const restoreStarted = performance.now();
        await exec('docker', [
          '--context',
          'default',
          'exec',
          target.containerName,
          'pg_restore',
          '-U',
          'foundation_test',
          '-d',
          'foundation_test',
          '--clean',
          '--if-exists',
          '--no-owner',
          '--no-acl',
          '--exit-on-error',
          '/tmp/synthetic.dump',
        ]);
        const restored = await snapshot(target.url);
        assert.deepEqual(restored, before);
        assert.ok(before.User.count > 0);
        assert.ok(before.AuditEvent.count > 0);
        assert.ok(before.OutboxEvent.count > 0);
        console.log(
          JSON.stringify({
            evidence: 'DISPOSABLE_ENCRYPTED_SYNTHETIC_RESTORE',
            configurationRestored: true,
            encryptedBytes: encrypted.length,
            tables: Object.keys(before).length,
            rows: Object.values(before).reduce((total, table) => total + table.count, 0),
            backupMs,
            restoreAndVerifyMs: Math.round(performance.now() - restoreStarted),
            archiveBytes: stdout.length,
          }),
        );
      } finally {
        await target.stop();
        await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\roles-upgrade.scenarios.ts =====

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import { disposableDatabase } from './support.js';
export async function runRoleUpgradeScenario(
  check: (name: string, run: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>,
) {
  await check(
    'role migration reports conflicting affiliations, preserves old identities and backfills explicit authority without deleting records',
    async () => {
      const database = await disposableDatabase({ foundationOnly: true });
      const db = new Client({ connectionString: database.url });
      try {
        await db.connect();
        const root = new URL('../prisma/migrations/', import.meta.url);
        const folders = (await readdir(root)).filter((n) => n !== 'migration_lock.toml').sort();
        for (const folder of folders) {
          if (folder === '202610150001_foundation' || folder >= '20261021010000_revised_foundation')
            continue;
          await db.query(await readFile(new URL(`${folder}/migration.sql`, root), 'utf8'));
        }
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "User"(id,name,email,"emailVerified","updatedAt") VALUES('role-upgrade-user','Synthetic upgrade','role-upgrade@example.com',true,now());`,
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "Organization"(id,name,slug,type,region,description,"contactEmail","representativeName","createdByUserId","updatedAt") VALUES('role-upgrade-a','Synthetic A','role-upgrade-a','ASSOCIATION','Tunis','Synthetic fixture','fixture@example.com','Fixture','role-upgrade-user',now()),('role-upgrade-b','Synthetic B','role-upgrade-b','ASSOCIATION','Tunis','Synthetic fixture','fixture@example.com','Fixture','role-upgrade-user',now()),('role-upgrade-buyer','Synthetic Buyer','role-upgrade-buyer','BUYER_BUSINESS','Tunis','Synthetic fixture','fixture@example.com','Fixture','role-upgrade-user',now());`,
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "OrganizationMember"(id,"organizationId","userId","updatedAt") VALUES('role-upgrade-ma','role-upgrade-a','role-upgrade-user',now()),('role-upgrade-mb','role-upgrade-b','role-upgrade-user',now()),('role-upgrade-buyerm','role-upgrade-buyer','role-upgrade-user',now());`,
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "MembershipRole"(id,"membershipId",role,"assignedByUserId") VALUES('role-upgrade-ra','role-upgrade-ma','ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR','role-upgrade-user'),('role-upgrade-rb','role-upgrade-mb','ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR','role-upgrade-user'),('role-upgrade-buyerr','role-upgrade-buyerm','BUYER','role-upgrade-user');`,
        );
        const sql = await readFile(
          new URL('20261021010000_revised_foundation/migration.sql', root),
          'utf8',
        );
        await assert.rejects(db.query(sql), /Coordinator conflict report.*role-upgrade-user/);
        await db.query('ROLLBACK');
        assert.equal(
          (await db.query(`SELECT to_regclass('"ArtisanManagement"') AS value`)).rows[0].value,
          null,
        );
        await db.query(
          `UPDATE "OrganizationMember" SET status='REVOKED' WHERE id='role-upgrade-mb'`,
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "ArtisanProfile"(id,"userId","displayName",region,equipment,"updatedAt") VALUES('role-upgrade-artisan','role-upgrade-user','Synthetic existing artisan','Tunis','{}',now())`,
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "ConsentRecord"(id,"userId",purpose,"policyVersion",decision,"collectionContext") VALUES('role-upgrade-consent','role-upgrade-user','artisan.profile','synthetic-v1',true,'synthetic upgrade fixture')`,
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "AssociationMembership"(id,"artisanProfileId","organizationId","consentRecordId","updatedAt") VALUES('role-upgrade-aa','role-upgrade-artisan','role-upgrade-a','role-upgrade-consent',now()),('role-upgrade-ab','role-upgrade-artisan','role-upgrade-b','role-upgrade-consent',now())`,
        );
        await assert.rejects(
          db.query(sql),
          /Artisan management conflict report.*role-upgrade-artisan/,
        );
        await db.query('ROLLBACK');
        await db.query(
          `UPDATE "AssociationMembership" SET status='REVOKED',"endedAt"=now() WHERE id='role-upgrade-ab'`,
        );
        const before = (
          await db.query(
            `SELECT row_to_json(u) AS value FROM "User" u WHERE id='role-upgrade-user'`,
          )
        ).rows[0].value;
        await db.query(sql);
        for (const folder of folders.filter((f) => f > '20261021010000_revised_foundation'))
          await db.query(await readFile(new URL(`${folder}/migration.sql`, root), 'utf8'));
        assert.equal(
          (
            await db.query(
              `SELECT enabled FROM "MembershipPermission" WHERE "membershipId"='role-upgrade-buyerm'`,
            )
          ).rows[0].enabled,
          true,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (
            await db.query(
              `SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "AssociationMembership" WHERE "artisanProfileId"='role-upgrade-artisan'`,
            )
          ).rows[0].n,
          2,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (
            await db.query(
              `SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "ArtisanManagement" WHERE "artisanProfileId"='role-upgrade-artisan' AND "endedAt" IS NULL`,
            )
          ).rows[0].n,
          1,
        );
        assert.deepEqual(
          (
            await db.query(
              `SELECT row_to_json(u) AS value FROM "User" u WHERE id='role-upgrade-user'`,
            )
          ).rows[0].value,
          before,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (
            await db.query(
              `SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "OrganizationMember" WHERE "userId"='role-upgrade-user'`,
            )
          ).rows[0].n,
          3,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (
            await db.query(
              `SELECT permission FROM "MembershipPermission" WHERE "membershipId"='role-upgrade-buyerm'`,
            )
          ).rows[0].permission,
          'buyer.quotation.approve',
        );
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO "ArtisanProfile"(id,"displayName",region,equipment,"createdById","updatedAt") VALUES('role-upgrade-no-login','Synthetic assisted','Tunis','{}','role-upgrade-user',now())`,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (await db.query(`SELECT "userId" FROM "ArtisanProfile" WHERE id='role-upgrade-no-login'`))
            .rows[0].userId,
          null,
        );
      } finally {
        await db.end();
        await database.stop();
      }
    },
  );
}


===== apps\api\test\roles.scenarios.ts =====

import { hasPrivilegedAccess } from '../src/modules/foundation/mfa.js';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import type { PrismaService } from '../src/database/prisma.service.js';
type Reply = { status: number; body: unknown };
type Client = {
  request(
    path: string,
    method?: string,
    body?: unknown,
    headers?: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<Reply>;
};
type Identity = { client: Client; me: { user: { id: string } } };
type Harness = {
  db: PrismaService;
  register(email: string, name: string): Promise<Identity>;
  mutate(client: Client, path: string, method: string, body: unknown): Promise<Reply>;
  check(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
  mail: { token(email: string, path: string): Promise<string> };
};
export async function runRoleScenarios({ db, register, mutate, check, mail }: Harness) {
  const make = (label: string) => register(`revised-${label}@example.com`, `Synthetic ${label}`);
  const [admin, a, b, c, d, buyer, rep, operator, unassigned, linked] = await Promise.all(
    [
      'admin',
      'coordinator-a',
      'coordinator-b',
      'coordinator-c',
      'coordinator-d',
      'buyer',
      'representative',
      'operator',
      'unassigned',
      'linked-account',
    ].map(make),
  );
  await db.user.update({ where: { id: admin.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });
  const createOrg = (
    id: string,
    type: 'ASSOCIATION' | 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE' | 'BUYER_BUSINESS' | 'INTERNAL',
  ) =>
    db.organization.create({
      data: {
        id,
        name: `Synthetic ${id}`,
        slug: id,
        type,
        approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
        region: 'Tunis',
        description: 'Revised foundation synthetic test organization',
        contactEmail: 'synthetic@example.com',
        representativeName: 'Synthetic reviewer',
        createdByUserId: admin.me.user.id,
      },
    });
  const [orgA, orgB, business, internal] = await Promise.all([
    createOrg('revised-association-a', 'ASSOCIATION'),
    createOrg('revised-cooperative-b', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE'),
    createOrg('revised-business', 'BUYER_BUSINESS'),
    createOrg('revised-internal', 'INTERNAL'),
  ]);
  const orgC = await createOrg('revised-association-c', 'ASSOCIATION');
  const member = (
    who: Identity,
    organizationId: string,
    role: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' | 'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE' | 'NASJ_OPERATOR',
    manager = false,
  ) =>
    db.organizationMember.create({
      data: {
        userId: who.me.user.id,
        organizationId,
        isManager: manager,
        roles: { create: { role, assignedByUserId: admin.me.user.id } },
      },
    });
  const [ma, mb, , md, _mp, mo] = await Promise.all([
    member(a, orgA.id, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'),
    member(b, orgA.id, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'),
    member(c, orgA.id, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'),
    member(d, orgB.id, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'),
    member(buyer, business.id, 'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE', true),
    member(operator, internal.id, 'NASJ_OPERATOR'),
  ]);
  const call = (who: Identity, path: string, body: unknown, method = 'POST') =>
    mutate(who.client, `/api/v1/${path}`, method, body);
  async function ok(who: Identity, path: string, body: unknown, method = 'POST') {
    const r = await call(who, path, body, method);
    assert.ok([200, 201].includes(r.status), JSON.stringify(r));
    return r.body as Record<string, unknown>;
  }
  const reason = 'Synthetic independently reviewed authorization decision';
  let policyId = '',
    artisanId = '',
    authorizationId = '',
    participationId = '';
  const evidence = () => ({
    policyId,
    purpose: 'PARTICIPATION',
    method: 'WITNESSED_VERBAL',
    occurredAt: new Date(Date.now() - 60000).toISOString(),
    language: 'fr',
    witnessReference: 'independent-witness-synthetic',
    evidenceReference: 'synthetic-authorization-reference',
  });
  const artisan = () => ({
    displayName: 'Synthetic no-account participant',
    region: 'Tunis',
    preferredLanguage: 'fr',
    contactPhone: '+21600000000',
    experienceDescription: 'Synthetic weaving experience',
    equipment: ['Loom'],
    availabilityStatus: 'AVAILABLE',
    skills: ['weaving'],
    authorization: evidence(),
  });
  await check(
    'revised roles resolve four personas, three coordinators share one association, unassigned access is denied',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: { organizationId: orgA.id, isCoordinator: true, status: 'ACTIVE' },
        }),
        3,
      );
      for (const [who, persona, path] of [
        [admin, 'PLATFORM_ADMIN', '/admin'],
        [a, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR', '/association'],
        [buyer, 'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE', '/buyer'],
        [operator, 'NASJ_OPERATOR', '/operator'],
      ] as const) {
        const r = await who.client.request('/api/v1/me/context');
        assert.equal(r.status, 200);
        assert.ok((r.body as { personas: string[] }).personas.includes(persona));
        assert.equal((r.body as { landingPath: string }).landingPath, path);
      }
      assert.equal((await unassigned.client.request('/api/v1/associations/me')).status, 403);
      assert.equal((await buyer.client.request('/api/v1/operator/dashboard')).status, 403);
      assert.equal((await admin.client.request('/api/v1/operator/dashboard')).status, 403);
    },
  );
  await check(
    'assisted policies require administrator review and independent witness evidence',
    async () => {
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(a, 'admin/authorization-policies', {
            version: 'synthetic-v1',
            methods: ['WITNESSED_VERBAL'],
            reviewReference: reason,
          })
        ).status,
        403,
      );
      policyId = (
        await ok(admin, 'admin/authorization-policies', {
          version: 'synthetic-v1',
          methods: ['WITNESSED_VERBAL', 'SIGNED'],
          reviewReference: reason,
        })
      ).id as string;
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', {
            ...artisan(),
            authorization: { ...evidence(), witnessReference: undefined },
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', {
            ...artisan(),
            authorization: { ...evidence(), witnessReference: a.me.user.id },
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'second active coordinator affiliation is rejected through concurrent database writes and invitation acceptance',
    async () => {
      const races = await Promise.allSettled([
        member(a, orgB.id, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'),
        member(a, orgB.id, 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'),
      ]);
      assert.ok(races.every((r) => r.status === 'rejected'));
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: { userId: a.me.user.id, isCoordinator: true, status: 'ACTIVE' },
        }),
        1,
      );
      const concurrentActor = await register(
        'revised-concurrent-roles@example.com',
        'Synthetic concurrent role recipient',
      );
      const membershipA = await db.organizationMember.create({
        data: { userId: concurrentActor.me.user.id, organizationId: orgA.id },
      });
      const membershipB = await db.organizationMember.create({
        data: { userId: concurrentActor.me.user.id, organizationId: orgB.id },
      });
      const roleChanges = await Promise.all([
        call(
          admin,
          `organizations/${orgA.id}/members/${membershipA.id}/roles`,
          { roles: ['ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'], reason },
          'PUT',
        ),
        call(
          admin,
          `organizations/${orgB.id}/members/${membershipB.id}/roles`,
          { roles: ['ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'], reason },
          'PUT',
        ),
      ]);
      assert.equal(roleChanges.filter((r) => r.status === 200).length, 1);
      assert.equal(roleChanges.filter((r) => r.status === 409).length, 1);
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({
          where: { userId: concurrentActor.me.user.id, isCoordinator: true, status: 'ACTIVE' },
        }),
        1,
      );
      const active = await db.organizationMember.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { userId: concurrentActor.me.user.id, isCoordinator: true, status: 'ACTIVE' },
      });
      const other = active.organizationId === orgA.id ? membershipB : membershipA;
      await ok(
        admin,
        `admin/coordinators/${concurrentActor.me.user.id}/status`,
        { status: 'SUSPENDED', organizationId: active.organizationId, reason },
        'PATCH',
      );
      await ok(
        admin,
        `organizations/${other.organizationId}/members/${other.id}/roles`,
        { roles: ['ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'], reason },
        'PUT',
      );
      await ok(
        admin,
        `admin/coordinators/${concurrentActor.me.user.id}/status`,
        { status: 'SUSPENDED', organizationId: other.organizationId, reason },
        'PATCH',
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(
            admin,
            `admin/coordinators/${concurrentActor.me.user.id}/status`,
            { status: 'ACTIVE', reason },
            'PATCH',
          )
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      await ok(
        admin,
        `admin/coordinators/${concurrentActor.me.user.id}/status`,
        { status: 'ACTIVE', organizationId: active.organizationId, reason },
        'PATCH',
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(
            admin,
            `admin/coordinators/${concurrentActor.me.user.id}/status`,
            { status: 'ACTIVE', organizationId: other.organizationId, reason },
            'PATCH',
          )
        ).status,
        409,
      );
      await ok(admin, 'admin/personnel/invite', {
        organizationId: orgB.id,
        email: 'revised-coordinator-a@example.com',
        persona: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR',
        reason,
      });
      const token = await mail.token('revised-coordinator-a@example.com', '/invitations/accept');
      assert.equal((await call(a, 'invitations/accept', { token })).status, 409);
      assert.equal(
        await db.invitation.count({
          where: { email: 'revised-coordinator-a@example.com', status: 'PENDING' },

      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'privileged invitations recheck administrator authority even when the former administrator remains an organization manager',
    async () => {
      const inviter = await register(

      );
      await db.user.update({ where: { id: inviter.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'ADMIN' } });

        data: { userId: inviter.me.user.id, organizationId: orgB.id, isManager: true },
      });
      await ok(inviter, 'admin/personnel/invite', {
        organizationId: orgB.id,
        email: 'revised-unassigned@example.com',
        persona: 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR',
        reason,
      });
      const token = await mail.token('revised-unassigned@example.com', '/invitations/accept');
      await db.user.update({ where: { id: inviter.me.user.id }, data: { role: 'USER' } });
      assert.equal((await call(unassigned, 'invitations/accept', { token })).status, 403);
      assert.equal(
        await db.organizationMember.count({ where: { userId: unassigned.me.user.id } }),
        0,
      );
    },
  );
  await check(
    'coordinator creates an authorized artisan without an account; scope mass assignment and duplicate creation are rejected',
    async () => {
      const users = await db.user.count();
      assert.equal(
        (await call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', { ...artisan(), organizationId: orgB.id }))
          .status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', {
            ...artisan(),
            authorization: { ...evidence(), checkbox: true },
          })
        ).status,
        400,
      );
      artisanId = (await ok(a, 'associations/me/artisans', artisan())).id as string;
      assert.equal(await db.user.count(), users);
      assert.equal(
        (await db.artisanProfile.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: artisanId } })).userId,
        null,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await db.artisanManagement.findFirstOrThrow({
            where: { artisanProfileId: artisanId, endedAt: null },
          })
        ).organizationId,
        orgA.id,
      );
      participationId = (
        await db.onboardingAuthorization.findFirstOrThrow({
          where: { artisanProfileId: artisanId },
        })
      ).id;
      const concurrentBody = { ...artisan(), displayName: 'Synthetic concurrent participant' };
      const creates = await Promise.all([
        call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', concurrentBody),
        call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', concurrentBody),
      ]);
      assert.equal(creates.filter((r) => r.status === 201).length, 1);
      assert.equal(creates.filter((r) => r.status === 409).length, 1);
      const duplicates = await Promise.all([
        call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', artisan()),
        call(a, 'associations/me/artisans', artisan()),
      ]);
      assert.ok(duplicates.every((r) => r.status === 409));
    },
  );
  await check(
    'unassigned same-association coordinators, other associations, buyers and administrators cannot read private artisan fields',
    async () => {
      for (const who of [b, d, buyer, admin, operator]) {
        const r = await who.client.request(`/api/v1/associations/me/artisans/${artisanId}`);
        assert.ok([403, 404].includes(r.status));
        assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(r.body).includes('+21600000000'));
      }
      assert.equal(
        (await call(d, `associations/me/artisans/${artisanId}`, { ...artisan(), reason }, 'PATCH'))
          .status,
        400,
      );
      assert.equal(
        (
          await call(d, `associations/me/artisans/${artisanId}/capacity`, {
            craftSkillId: 'weaving',
            quantity: '10',
            unitType: 'PIECES',
            effectiveFrom: '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z',
            effectiveTo: '2027-01-08T00:00:00Z',
            authorizationId: participationId,
          })
        ).status,
        404,
      );
    },
  );
  const capacity = () => ({
    craftSkillId: 'weaving',
    quantity: '10',
    unitType: 'PIECES',
    effectiveFrom: '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z',
    effectiveTo: '2027-01-08T00:00:00Z',
    authorizationId,
  });
  let offerId = '';
  await check(

===== apps\api\test\support.ts =====

import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import { SMTPServer } from 'smtp-server';
import { validateEnvironment } from '../src/config/env.js';
const exec = promisify(execFile);
export async function disposableDatabase(options: { foundationOnly?: boolean } = {}) {
  const name = `nasj-test-${randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
  const password = randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
  await exec('docker', [
    '--context',
    'default',
    'run',
    '--rm',
    '-d',
    '--name',
    name,
    '-e',
    'POSTGRES_USER=foundation_test',
    '-e',
    `POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${password}`,
    '-e',
    'POSTGRES_DB=foundation_test',
    '-p',
    '127.0.0.1::5432',
    'postgres:17.7-alpine',
  ]);
  const stop = async () => {
    await exec('docker', ['--context', 'default', 'rm', '-f', '--volumes', name]).catch(() => {});
  };
  try {
    const { stdout } = await exec('docker', ['--context', 'default', 'port', name, '5432']);
    const port = Number(stdout.trim().split(':').at(-1));
    const url = `postgresql://foundation_test:${password}@127.0.0.1:${port}/foundation_test`;
    let ready = false;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 60; attempt++) {
      const client = new Client({ connectionString: url, connectionTimeoutMillis: 1000 });
      try {
        await client.connect();
        await client.query('SELECT 1');
        ready = true;
        break;
      } catch {
      } finally {
        await client.end().catch(() => {});
      }
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
    }
    if (!ready) throw new Error('Disposable database did not become ready.');
    const migrationOptions = {
      cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)),
      env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: url, MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: url },
      maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,
    };
    if (options.foundationOnly) {
      // Only in this newly created disposable container: establish the original migration baseline.
      await exec(
        'pnpm',
        [
          'exec',
          'prisma',
          'db',
          'execute',
          '--file',
          'prisma/migrations/202610150001_foundation/migration.sql',
        ],
        migrationOptions,
      );
      await exec(
        'pnpm',
        ['exec', 'prisma', 'migrate', 'resolve', '--applied', '202610150001_foundation'],
        migrationOptions,
      );
    } else await exec('pnpm', ['exec', 'prisma', 'migrate', 'deploy'], migrationOptions);
    return { url, stop, containerName: name };
  } catch (error) {
    await stop();
    throw error;
  }
}
export async function captureMail() {
  const messages: { to: string; text: string }[] = [];
  const server = new SMTPServer({
    authOptional: true,
    disabledCommands: ['AUTH', 'STARTTLS'],
    logger: false,
    onData(stream, session, callback) {
      let raw = '';
      stream.on('data', (chunk) => {
        raw += chunk.toString();
      });
      stream.on('end', () => {
        const split = raw.indexOf('\r\n\r\n');
        const header = raw.slice(0, split);
        let text = raw.slice(split + 4);
        if (/Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64/i.test(header))
          text = Buffer.from(text, 'base64').toString();
        else
          text = text
            .replace(/=\r?\n/g, '')
            .replace(/=([A-F0-9]{2})/g, (_m, hex: string) =>
              String.fromCharCode(parseInt(hex, 16)),
            );
        messages.push({ to: session.envelope.rcptTo[0].address, text });
        callback();
      });
    },
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const port = (server.server.address() as { port: number }).port;
  return {
    port,
    messages,
    stop: () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(resolve)),
    async token(email: string, path: string) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++) {
        const mail = messages.findLast((m) => m.to === email && m.text.includes(path));
        const match = mail?.text.match(/#token=([^\s]+)/);
        if (match) return decodeURIComponent(match[1]);
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
      }
      throw new Error('Expected authentication email was not received.');
    },
  };
}
export function testConfig(url: string, smtpPort: number, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return validateEnvironment({
    NODE_ENV: 'test',
    PUBLIC_APP_URL: 'http://localhost:3000',
    DATABASE_URL: url,
    BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: randomBytes(48).toString('hex'),
    SMTP_HOST: '127.0.0.1',
    SMTP_PORT: smtpPort,
    RATE_LOGIN_MAX: 1000,
    RATE_REGISTRATION_MAX: 1000,
    RATE_RESET_MAX: 1000,
    RATE_VERIFICATION_MAX: 1000,
    RATE_API_MAX: 1000,
    RATE_ADMIN_MAX: 1000,
    ...overrides,
  });
}

export async function promoteDisposableAdmin(url: string, email: string) {
  const db = new Client({ connectionString: url });
  await db.connect();
  try {
    const result = await db.query(
      'UPDATE "User" SET role=\'ADMIN\' WHERE email=$1 AND "emailVerified"=true RETURNING id',
      [email],
    );
    if (result.rowCount !== 1) throw new Error('A verified disposable account is required.');
    await db.query('DELETE FROM "Session" WHERE "userId"=$1', [result.rows[0].id]);
  } finally {
    await db.end();
  }
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import { hashPassword, verifyPassword } from 'better-auth/crypto';
import { disposableDatabase } from './support.js';
export async function runUpgradeScenario(
  check: (name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>,
) {
  await check(
    'additive migrations preserve preexisting identity, credential and session records',
    async () => {
      const database = await disposableDatabase({ foundationOnly: true });
      const db = new Client({ connectionString: database.url });
      try {
        await db.connect();
        const passwordHash = await hashPassword('Upgrade-synthetic-password-2026!');
        const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000);
        await db.query(
          'INSERT INTO "User" (id,name,email,"emailVerified","updatedAt") VALUES ($1,$2,$3,true,now())',
          ['upgrade-user', 'Upgrade Fixture', 'upgrade@example.com'],
        );
        await db.query(
          'INSERT INTO "Account" (id,"accountId","providerId","userId",password,"updatedAt") VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,now())',
          ['upgrade-account', 'upgrade-user', 'credential', 'upgrade-user', passwordHash],
        );
        await db.query(
          'INSERT INTO "Session" (id,token,"userId","expiresAt","updatedAt") VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,now())',
          ['upgrade-session', 'synthetic-session-token', 'upgrade-user', expiry],
        );
        await promisify(execFile)('pnpm', ['exec', 'prisma', 'migrate', 'deploy'], {
          cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)),
          env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: database.url, MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: database.url },
        });
        const users = await db.query(
          'SELECT id,email,role,status,"preferredLanguage","twoFactorEnabled" FROM "User" WHERE id=$1',
          ['upgrade-user'],
        );
        assert.equal(users.rowCount, 1);
        assert.equal(users.rows[0].email, 'upgrade@example.com');
        assert.equal(users.rows[0].preferredLanguage, 'en');
        assert.equal(users.rows[0].twoFactorEnabled, false);
        assert.equal(
          (await db.query('SELECT password FROM "Account" WHERE id=$1', ['upgrade-account']))
            .rows[0].password,
          passwordHash,
        );
        const session = (
          await db.query('SELECT token,"expiresAt","mfaVerifiedAt" FROM "Session" WHERE id=$1', [
            'upgrade-session',
          ])
        ).rows[0];
        assert.equal(session.token, 'synthetic-session-token');
        assert.equal(session.expiresAt.toISOString(), expiry.toISOString());
        assert.equal(session.mfaVerifiedAt, null);
        assert.equal(
          await verifyPassword({
            hash: passwordHash,
            password: 'Upgrade-synthetic-password-2026!',
          }),
          true,
        );
        assert.equal(
          (await db.query('SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM "CraftSkill"')).rows[0].count,
          5,
        );
      } finally {
        await db.end();
        await database.stop();
      }
    },
  );
}

===== apps\web\src\app\(protected)\admin\users\page.tsx =====

import { DeniedWorkspace } from '@/components/foundation-gate';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Page, UserView } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { getMe, serverApi } from '@/lib/server-api';
import { AdminUsers } from '@/components/admin-users';
export default async function UsersPage() {
  const me = await getMe();
  if (!me) redirect('/auth/login');
  if (me.user.role !== 'ADMIN') return <DeniedWorkspace />;
  const data = await serverApi<Page<UserView>>('/api/v1/admin/users');
  if (!data) return <DeniedWorkspace />;
  return <AdminUsers initial={data} />;
}

import { CommerceWorkspace } from '@/components/commerce-workspace';
export const metadata = { title: 'Buyer synthetic commerce' };
export default async function Page({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ example?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  const { example } = await searchParams;
  const catalogExampleId = Array.isArray(example) ? '' : example;
  return (
    <CommerceGate mode="buyer">
      <CommerceWorkspace
        key={catalogExampleId ?? 'manual'}
        mode="buyer"
        catalogExampleId={catalogExampleId}
      />
    </CommerceGate>
  );
}

===== apps\web\src\app\(protected)\dashboard\page.tsx =====

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getIdentityContext } from '@/lib/server-api';
import { FoundationDashboard } from '@/components/foundation-workspace';
export default async function Page() {
  const context = await getIdentityContext();
  if (!context)
    return (
      <>
        <h1>Access unavailable</h1>
        <a href="/settings/security">Review security settings</a>
      </>
    );
  if (context.landingPath !== '/dashboard') redirect(context.landingPath);
  return <FoundationDashboard context={context} mode="onboarding" />;
}

===== apps\web\src\app\(protected)\layout.tsx =====

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getMe, getIdentityContext } from '@/lib/server-api';
import { AppShell } from '@/components/app-shell';
export default async function ProtectedLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const me = await getMe();
  if (!me) redirect('/auth/login');
  const context = await getIdentityContext();
  return (
    <AppShell
      demo={process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' || process.env.DEMO_MODE === 'true'}
      context={context}
      name={me.user.name}
      email={me.user.email}
      capabilities={{
        buyer: Boolean(context?.personas.includes('BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE')),
        artisan: Boolean(context?.linkedArtisanProfileId),
        operator: Boolean(
          context?.organizations.some(
            (o) =>
              o.type === 'INTERNAL' &&
              o.permissions.some((p) =>
                [
                  'production.manage',
                  'finance.payout.read',
                  'quality.inspection.create',
                  'inventory.manage',
                ].includes(p),
              ),
          ),
        ),
        admin: me.user.role === 'ADMIN',
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AppShell>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\app\auth\[mode]\page.tsx =====

import Image from 'next/image';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AuthForm, type AuthMode } from '@/components/auth-form';
import { Weave, Wordmark } from '@/components/brand';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/navigation';
export default async function AuthPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ mode: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string }>;
}) {
  const { mode } = await params;
  if (!['login', 'register', 'forgot-password', 'reset-password', 'verify-email'].includes(mode))
    notFound();
  const query = await searchParams;
  return (
    <main className="auth-layout" id="main-content">
      <aside className="auth-aside">
        <Wordmark light />
        <div className="auth-aside-body">
          <div className="arch arch-small">
            <Image src="/brand/artisan-weaving.jpg" alt="" width={685} height={753} sizes="420px" />
          </div>
          <h2>
            Every thread
            <br />
            tells a story.
          </h2>
          <p>
            {mode === 'register'
              ? 'Create your account, verify your email, then register a company or association, and accept your team invitation.'
              : 'Sign in to manage your organization, your team and your assigned work.'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Weave />
      </aside>
      <div className="auth-main">
        <Link className="back-link" href="/">
          <span aria-hidden="true">←</span> Back to home
        </Link>
        <AuthForm mode={mode as AuthMode} next={safeNext(query.next)} />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

'use client';
import Link from 'next/link';
export default function ErrorPage({
  retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  retry: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <main className="workspace" id="main-content">
      <h1>A little interruption.</h1>
      <p>The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.</p>
      <button type="button" className="button" onClick={() => retry()}>
        Try again
      </button>{' '}
      <Link href="/auth/login">Back to sign in</Link>
    </main>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { Inter, Manrope, Tajawal } from 'next/font/google';
import './globals.css';
const manrope = Manrope({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-display', display: 'swap' });
const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-body', display: 'swap' });
const tajawal = Tajawal({
  subsets: ['arabic'],
  weight: ['400', '500', '700'],
  variable: '--font-arabic',
  display: 'swap',
});
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: { default: 'NASJ | نسج', template: '%s · NASJ' },
  description:
    'NASJ connects companies with rural women artisans and the associations that support them.',
  robots: { index: false, follow: false },
  icons: { icon: '/brand/nasj-mark.png' },
};
export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    // Browser extensions (custom cursors, translators, password managers) inject attributes
    // into <html>/<body> before hydration; this only silences those two elements, not children.
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${manrope.variable} ${inter.variable} ${tajawal.variable}`}
      suppressHydrationWarning
    >
      <body suppressHydrationWarning>
        <a className="skip-link" href="#main-content">
          Skip to content
        </a>
        {process.env.DEMO_MODE === 'true' && (
          <aside className="demo-banner" aria-label="Demo environment">
            Synthetic demonstration environment · Fictional accounts and organizations ·{' '}
            <a href="/demo">Demo information</a>
          </aside>
        )}
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

===== apps\web\src\components\ui\alert.tsx =====

import * as React from 'react';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from 'cn';

const alertVariants = cva(
  'relative grid w-full grid-cols-[0_1fr] items-start gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] has-[>svg]:gap-x-3 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&>svg]:text-current',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-card text-card-foreground',
        destructive:
          'bg-card text-destructive *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90 [&>svg]:text-current',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
    },
  },
);

function Alert({
  className,
  variant,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert"
      role="alert"
      className={cn(alertVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function AlertTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-title"
      className={cn('col-start-2 line-clamp-1 min-h-4 font-medium tracking-tight', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function AlertDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-description"
      className={cn(
        'col-start-2 grid justify-items-start gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground [&_p]:leading-relaxed',
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription };


===== apps\web\src\components\ui\badge.tsx =====

import * as React from 'react';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from 'cn';
import { Slot } from 'radix-ui';

const badgeVariants = cva(
  'inline-flex w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-[color,box-shadow] focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-primary/90',
        secondary: 'bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-secondary/90',
        destructive:
          'bg-destructive text-white focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/60 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a&]:hover:bg-destructive/90',
        outline:
          'border-border text-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-accent-foreground',
        ghost: '[a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-accent-foreground',
        link: 'text-primary underline-offset-4 [a&]:hover:underline',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
    },
  },
);

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = 'default',
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'span'> & VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : 'span';

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="badge"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants };


===== apps\web\src\components\ui\button.tsx =====

import * as React from 'react';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from 'cn';
import { Slot } from 'radix-ui';

// Keep opacity changes immediate: enabling a hydrated form must not fade through low contrast.
const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring focus-visible:outline-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90',
        destructive:
          'bg-destructive text-white hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/60 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40',
        outline:
          'border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50',
        secondary: 'bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80',
        ghost: 'hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50',
        link: 'text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline',
      },
      size: {
        default: 'h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3',
        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-md px-2 text-xs has-[>svg]:px-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        sm: 'h-8 gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5',
        lg: 'h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4',
        icon: 'size-9',
        'icon-xs': "size-6 rounded-md [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        'icon-sm': 'size-8',
        'icon-lg': 'size-10',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
      size: 'default',
    },
  },
);

function Button({
  className,
  variant = 'default',
  size = 'default',
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'button'> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean;
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : 'button';

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      data-variant={variant}
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Button, buttonVariants };


===== apps\web\src\components\ui\card.tsx =====

import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from 'cn';

function Card({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card"
      className={cn(
        'flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-xl border bg-card py-6 text-card-foreground shadow-sm',
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function CardHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return (
    <div

===== apps\web\src\components\ui\tabs.tsx =====

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from 'cn';
import { Tabs as TabsPrimitive } from 'radix-ui';

function Tabs({
  className,
  orientation = 'horizontal',
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.Root>) {
  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="tabs"
      data-orientation={orientation}
      orientation={orientation}
      className={cn('group/tabs flex gap-2 data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-col', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

const tabsListVariants = cva(
  'group/tabs-list inline-flex w-fit items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-[3px] text-muted-foreground group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/tabs:h-9 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tabs:h-fit group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tabs:flex-col data-[variant=line]:rounded-none',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-muted',
        line: 'gap-1 bg-transparent',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
    },
  },
);

function TabsList({
  className,
  variant = 'default',
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.List> & VariantProps<typeof tabsListVariants>) {

    <TabsPrimitive.List
      data-slot="tabs-list"

  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.Trigger

        'group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:bg-transparent group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:border-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent',
        'data-[state=active]:bg-background data-[state=active]:text-foreground dark:data-[state=active]:border-input dark:data-[state=active]:bg-input/30 dark:data-[state=active]:text-foreground',
        'after:absolute after:bg-foreground after:opacity-0 after:transition-opacity group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/tabs:after:inset-x-0 group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/tabs:after:bottom-[-5px] group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/tabs:after:h-0.5 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tabs:after:inset-y-0 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tabs:after:-right-1 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tabs:after:w-0.5 group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:after:opacity-100',
