===== apps\web\src\components\admin-users.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useHydrated } from '@/lib/use-hydrated';
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import type { AccountUpdate, Page, UserView } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch, ApiError } from '@/lib/api';
export function AdminUsers({ initial }: { initial: Page<UserView> }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const ready = useHydrated();
  const [data, setData] = useState(initial);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  function load(page: number) {
    start(async () => {
      setError('');
      try {
        setData(
          await apiFetch(
            `/api/v1/admin/users?page=${page}&pageSize=20&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`,
          ),
        );
      } catch (failure) {
        setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Unable to load users.');
      }
    });
  }
  function update(user: UserView, input: AccountUpdate) {
    start(async () => {
      setError('');
      setMessage('');
      try {
        const updated = await apiFetch<UserView>(`/api/v1/admin/users/${user.id}`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: input,
        });
        setData((previous) => ({
          ...previous,
          items: previous.items.map((item) => (item.id === user.id ? updated : item)),
        }));
        setMessage('Account access updated. Existing sessions were revoked.');
        router.refresh();
      } catch (failure) {
        if (failure instanceof ApiError && failure.status === 401) router.replace('/auth/login');
        setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Unable to update account.');
      }
    });
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <p className="eyebrow">ADMINISTRATION</p>
          <h1>People.</h1>
          <p className="lead">Manage account access with care.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="badge">{data.total} accounts</span>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="notice" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {message && (
        <p className="notice success" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
      <section className="panel">
        <form
          className="search-form"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            load(1);
          }}
        >
          <label htmlFor="search">Search by name or email</label>
          <div>
            <input
              id="search"
              value={query}
              onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
              maxLength={120}
            />
            <button type="submit" className="button secondary" disabled={pending || !ready}>
              Search
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
        <div className="table-scroll">
          <table>
            <caption className="sr-only">User administration</caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Person</th>
                <th scope="col">Verification</th>
                <th scope="col">Role</th>
                <th scope="col">Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.items.map((user) => (
                <tr key={user.id}>
                  <td>
                    <strong>{user.name}</strong>
                    <span>{user.email}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{user.emailVerified ? 'Verified' : 'Pending'}</td>
                  <td>
                    <select
                      aria-label={`Role for ${user.name}`}
                      value={user.role}
                      disabled={pending || !user.emailVerified}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        update(user, { role: event.target.value as UserView['role'] })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="USER">User</option>
                      <option value="ADMIN">Administrator</option>
                    </select>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <select
                      aria-label={`Status for ${user.name}`}
                      value={user.status}
                      disabled={pending || !ready}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        update(user, { status: event.target.value as UserView['status'] })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="ACTIVE">Active</option>
                      <option value="SUSPENDED">Suspended</option>
                      <option value="DISABLED">Disabled</option>
                    </select>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        {data.items.length === 0 && <p>No matching accounts.</p>}
        <div className="pagination">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="text-button"
            disabled={pending || data.page === 1}
            onClick={() => load(data.page - 1)}
          >
            Previous
          </button>
          <span>
            Page {data.page} · {data.total} accounts
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="text-button"
            disabled={pending || data.page * data.pageSize >= data.total}
            onClick={() => load(data.page + 1)}
          >
            Next
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\app-shell.tsx =====

'use client';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { DropdownMenu } from 'radix-ui';
import type { IdentityContext } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { initials, profileMenuItems } from '@/lib/app-navigation';
import { Wordmark, SiteFooter } from './brand';
import { Icon } from './icons';
import { LogoutButton } from './logout-button';
import { Button } from './ui/button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from './ui/sheet';
import { Badge } from './ui/badge';
type Capabilities = { buyer: boolean; artisan: boolean; operator: boolean; admin: boolean };
export function AppShell({
  name,
  email,
  capabilities,
  children,
  demo = false,
  context,
}: {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  capabilities: Capabilities;
  children: ReactNode;
  demo?: boolean;
  context?: IdentityContext | null;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname(),
    [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const work = [
    {
      href: context?.landingPath ?? '/dashboard',
      label: 'Dashboard',
      icon: 'organization' as const,
    },
    ...(context?.personas.includes('ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR')
      ? [
          { href: '/association/artisans', label: 'Artisan registry', icon: 'artisan' as const },
          {
            href: '/procurement/discussions',
            label: 'Order discussions',
            icon: 'support' as const,
          },
        ]
      : []),
    ...(context?.personas.includes('NASJ_OPERATOR')
      ? [{ href: '/operator', label: 'Internal operations', icon: 'organization' as const }]
      : []),
    ...(context?.personas.includes('BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE')
      ? [{ href: '/buyer/company', label: 'Your company', icon: 'organization' as const }]
      : []),
    ...(context?.personas.includes('BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE') ||
    context?.personas.includes('NASJ_OPERATOR') ||
    capabilities.operator
      ? [{ href: '/procurement', label: 'Procurement', icon: 'organization' as const }]
      : []),
    { href: '/commerce/catalog', label: 'Craft catalog', icon: 'artisan' as const },
    ...(capabilities.buyer
      ? [{ href: '/commerce/buyer', label: 'Buyer requests', icon: 'organization' as const }]
      : []),
    ...(capabilities.artisan
      ? [{ href: '/commerce/artisan', label: 'Offers & production', icon: 'artisan' as const }]
      : []),
    ...(capabilities.operator
      ? [{ href: '/commerce/operator', label: 'Operator review', icon: 'organization' as const }]
      : []),
  ];
  const account = [
    { href: '/settings/organizations', label: 'Organizations', icon: 'organization' as const },
    ...(context?.linkedArtisanProfileId
      ? [{ href: '/artisan/profile', label: 'Your artisan profile', icon: 'artisan' as const }]
      : []),
    { href: '/settings/profile', label: 'Your account', icon: 'users' as const },
    { href: '/settings/security', label: 'Security', icon: 'privacy' as const },
    { href: '/support/cases', label: 'Support', icon: 'support' as const },
    ...(capabilities.admin
      ? [{ href: '/admin', label: 'Administration', icon: 'approval' as const }]
      : []),
  ];
  function navigation(mobile = false) {
    return (
      <>
        <div className="sidebar-brand">
          <Wordmark href={context?.landingPath ?? '/dashboard'} />
        </div>
        <nav aria-label={mobile ? 'Mobile account navigation' : 'Account navigation'}>
          {[
            { label: 'Workspace', items: work },
            { label: 'Manage', items: account },
          ].map((section) => (
            <div className="sidebar-section" key={section.label}>
              <p className="sidebar-label">{section.label}</p>
              <ul>
                {section.items.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.href}>
                    <Link
                      href={item.href}
                      className={pathname === item.href ? 'sidebar-link active' : 'sidebar-link'}
                      aria-current={pathname === item.href ? 'page' : undefined}
                      onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                    >
                      <Icon name={item.icon} />
                      {item.label}
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <div className="shell-user">
          <div className="user-identity">
            <span className="user-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
              {initials(name)}
            </span>
            <div>
              <strong>{name}</strong>
              <span>{email}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <LogoutButton />
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="app-shell">
      <aside className="sidebar">{navigation()}</aside>
      <div className="app-main">
        <header className="topbar shell-header">
          <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
            <SheetTrigger asChild>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                className="sidebar-toggle mobile-menu-button hidden max-[900px]:inline-flex"
                aria-label="Open navigation"
              >
                <Icon name="menu" />
              </Button>
            </SheetTrigger>
            <SheetContent side="left" className="mobile-sidebar w-[min(85vw,300px)] gap-0 p-0">
              <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
                <SheetTitle>NASJ navigation</SheetTitle>
                <SheetDescription>Navigate your workspaces and account settings.</SheetDescription>
              </SheetHeader>
              {navigation(true)}
            </SheetContent>
          </Sheet>
          {demo && <Badge variant="outline">Demo workspace</Badge>}
          <DropdownMenu.Root modal={false}>
            <DropdownMenu.Trigger asChild>
              <button type="button" className="profile-trigger" aria-label="Account menu">
                <span className="avatar" aria-hidden="true">
                  {initials(name)}
                </span>
                <Icon name="chevron" size={16} />
              </button>
            </DropdownMenu.Trigger>
            <DropdownMenu.Portal>
              <DropdownMenu.Content
                className="profile-panel z-50"
                align="end"
                sideOffset={8}
                aria-label="Account settings"
              >
                <div className="profile-identity">
                  <strong>{name}</strong>
                  <span className="profile-email">{email}</span>
                </div>
                <ul role="presentation">
                  {profileMenuItems.map((item) => (
                    <li role="presentation" key={item.href}>
                      <DropdownMenu.Item asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={item.href}
                          aria-current={pathname === item.href ? 'page' : undefined}
                        >
                          {item.label}
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenu.Item>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                <div className="profile-signout">
                  <LogoutButton menuItem />
                </div>
              </DropdownMenu.Content>
            </DropdownMenu.Portal>
          </DropdownMenu.Root>
        </header>
        <main className="workspace" id="main-content">
          {children}
        </main>
        <SiteFooter />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\artisan-workspace.tsx =====

'use client';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type {
  ArtisanProfileView,
  CraftSkillView,
  ArtisanSkillView,
  CapacityDeclarationView,
  AssociationMembershipView,
  DelegationGrantView,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  Workspace,
  ResourceState,
  ActionForm,
  Input,
  Select,
  Checkboxes,
  useResource,
  text,
  humanize,
} from './workspace-ui';
type Items<T> = { items: T[] };
type Assisted = {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  organizationId: string;
  scopes: string[];
  expiresAt: string;
};
const profileFields = ['displayName', 'region', 'contactPhone', 'experienceDescription'] as const;
const profileLabels = {
  displayName: 'Display name',
  region: 'Region',
  contactPhone: 'Contact phone',
  experienceDescription: 'Experience and biography',
};
export function ArtisanWorkspace({ artisanId }: { artisanId?: string }) {
  const [skillsVersion, setSkillsVersion] = useState(0);
  const [associationVersion, setAssociationVersion] = useState(0);
  const path = artisanId
    ? `/api/v1/artisans/${encodeURIComponent(artisanId)}`
    : '/api/v1/artisans/me';
  const resource = useResource<ArtisanProfileView>(path);
  const grants = useResource<Items<Assisted>>('/api/v1/artisans/assisted');
  const scopes =
    grants.data?.items.filter((grant) => grant.id === artisanId).flatMap((grant) => grant.scopes) ??
    [];
  const can = (permission: string) => !artisanId || scopes.includes(permission);
  const profile = resource.data;
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={artisanId ? 'Assisted artisan workspace.' : 'Your artisan workspace.'}
      description="Share your skills and voluntary capacity. Participation through an association is optional."
    >
      <nav className="workspace-tabs" aria-label="Artisan sections">
        {['profile', 'skills', 'capacity', 'associations', 'delegations'].map((section) => (
          <a key={section} href={`#${section}`}>
            {humanize(section)}
          </a>
        ))}
      </nav>
      {resource.loading && <p role="status">Loading artisan profile…</p>}
      {resource.error && (
        <p className="notice" role="status">
          {resource.error}{' '}
          {artisanId
            ? 'Ask the artisan to review your delegation.'
            : 'If you have not created a profile, complete the form below.'}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="settings-grid">
        <section className="panel" id="profile">
          <h2>Artisan profile</h2>
          {can('artisan.profile.update') && !resource.loading && (!artisanId || profile) ? (
            <ActionForm
              key={profile?.updatedAt ?? 'new'}
              label="Save artisan profile"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(data) =>
                apiFetch(path, {
                  method: 'PATCH',
                  body: {
                    ...Object.fromEntries(profileFields.map((name) => [name, text(data, name)])),
                    preferredLanguage: text(data, 'preferredLanguage'),
                    availabilityStatus: text(data, 'availabilityStatus'),
                    equipment: text(data, 'equipment')
                      .split(',')
                      .map((item) => item.trim())
                      .filter(Boolean),
                    ...(!artisanId ? { contactVisibility: text(data, 'contactVisibility') } : {}),
                    ...(!profile && !artisanId
                      ? {
                          processingConsent: data.has('processingConsent'),
                          policyVersion: 'artisan-profile-v1',
                        }
                      : {}),
                  },
                })
              }
            >
              {profileFields.map((name) => (
                <Input
                  key={name}
                  name={name}
                  label={profileLabels[name]}
                  value={profile?.[name]}
                  required={name === 'displayName' || name === 'region'}
                />
              ))}
              <Select
                name="preferredLanguage"
                label="Preferred language"
                value={profile?.preferredLanguage ?? 'fr'}
                options={[
                  { value: 'fr', label: 'Français' },
                  { value: 'ar', label: 'العربية' },
                  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
                ]}
              />
              {!artisanId && (
                <Select
                  name="contactVisibility"
                  label="Contact visibility"
                  value={profile?.contactVisibility ?? 'PRIVATE'}
                  options={['PRIVATE', 'ASSOCIATION', 'PUBLIC']}
                />
              )}
              <Select
                name="availabilityStatus"
                label="Availability for new opportunities"
                value={profile?.availabilityStatus ?? 'AVAILABLE'}
                options={['AVAILABLE', 'PAUSED']}
              />
              <Input
                name="equipment"
                label="Equipment (separate items with commas)"
                value={profile?.equipment.join(', ')}
              />
              {!profile && !artisanId && (
                <label className="check-label">
                  <input name="processingConsent" type="checkbox" required />I consent to processing
                  this artisan profile for participation in NASJ (artisan-profile-v1).
                </label>
              )}
              <p className="hint">
                Language records your preference. This interface currently uses English. Pausing new
                opportunities preserves existing commitments.
              </p>
            </ActionForm>
          ) : (
            profile && (
              <>
                <p>
                  {profile.displayName} · {profile.region}
                </p>
                <p>{profile.experienceDescription}</p>
                <p>{humanize(profile.availabilityStatus)}</p>
              </>
            )
          )}
        </section>
        {!artisanId && (
          <section className="panel">
            <h2>Assistance you can provide</h2>
            <ResourceState {...grants} retry={grants.reload} />
            <p>Only current, explicit delegation grants appear here.</p>
            <ul className="record-list">
              {grants.data?.items.map((grant) => (
                <li key={`${grant.id}-${grant.organizationId}-${grant.expiresAt}`}>
                  <Link href={`/artisan/assisted/${grant.id}`}>{grant.displayName}</Link>
                  <p>{grant.scopes.join(', ')}</p>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            {grants.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No active assisted profiles.</p>}
          </section>
        )}
        {profile && (
          <>
            {can('artisan.skills.manage') && (
              <section className="panel wide" id="skills">
                <Skills path={path} onChanged={() => setSkillsVersion((value) => value + 1)} />
              </section>
            )}
            {can('artisan.capacity.read') && (
              <section className="panel wide" id="capacity">
                <Capacity
                  key={skillsVersion}
                  path={path}
                  canUpdate={can('artisan.capacity.update')}
                />
              </section>
            )}
            {!artisanId && (
              <>
                <section className="panel wide" id="associations">
                  <Associations
                    path={path}
                    onChanged={() => setAssociationVersion((value) => value + 1)}
                  />
                </section>
                <section className="panel wide" id="delegations">
                  <Delegations key={associationVersion} path={path} />
                </section>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </Workspace>
  );
}
function Skills({ path, onChanged }: { path: string; onChanged: () => void }) {
  const catalog = useResource<Items<CraftSkillView>>('/api/v1/craft-skills');
  const selected = useResource<Items<ArtisanSkillView>>(`${path}/skills`);
  return (
    <>
      <h2>Craft skills</h2>
      <ResourceState {...catalog} retry={catalog.reload} />
      <ResourceState {...selected} retry={selected.reload} />
      {catalog.data && selected.data && (
        <ActionForm
          key={JSON.stringify(selected.data)}
          label="Save craft skills"
          onSuccess={async () => {
            await selected.reload();
            onChanged();
          }}
          action={(data) =>
            apiFetch(`${path}/skills`, {
              method: 'PUT',
              body: {
                items: data.getAll('skills').map((value) => ({
                  craftSkillId: String(value),
                  proficiency: text(data, `proficiency-${value}`),
                  evidence: text(data, `evidence-${value}`),
                })),
              },
            })
          }
        >
          <div className="skill-grid">
            {catalog.data.items.map((skill) => {
              const current = selected.data?.items.find((item) => item.craftSkillId === skill.id);
              return (
                <div key={skill.id}>
                  <label className="check-label">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      name="skills"
                      value={skill.id}
                      defaultChecked={Boolean(current)}
                    />
                    {skill.name}
                  </label>
                  <Select
                    name={`proficiency-${skill.id}`}
                    label={`${skill.name} proficiency`}
                    value={current?.proficiency ?? 'INTERMEDIATE'}
                    options={['BEGINNER', 'INTERMEDIATE', 'ADVANCED', 'EXPERT']}
                  />
                  <Input
                    name={`evidence-${skill.id}`}
                    label={`${skill.name} experience or evidence`}
                    value={current?.evidence}
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </ActionForm>
      )}
      {catalog.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No craft skills are available yet.</p>}
    </>
  );
}
function Capacity({ path, canUpdate }: { path: string; canUpdate: boolean }) {
  const pending = useRef<{ payload: string; key: string } | null>(null);
  const history = useResource<Items<CapacityDeclarationView>>(`${path}/capacity`);
  const skills = useResource<Items<ArtisanSkillView>>(`${path}/skills`);
  return (
    <>
      <h2>Voluntary weekly capacity</h2>
      <p>
        Declare capacity for a craft and date period. Revise the same exact period or choose a
        non-overlapping period. Existing commitments remain intact. Wearable data is never used.
      </p>
      <ResourceState {...history} retry={history.reload} />
      {canUpdate &&
        skills.data &&
        (skills.data.items.length ? (
          <ActionForm
            label="Declare capacity"
            onSuccess={history.reload}
            action={async (data) => {
              const body = {
                craftSkillId: text(data, 'craftSkillId'),
                unitType: text(data, 'unitType'),
                quantity: Number(text(data, 'quantity')),
                effectiveFrom: new Date(text(data, 'effectiveFrom')).toISOString(),
                effectiveTo: new Date(text(data, 'effectiveTo')).toISOString(),
              };
              const payload = JSON.stringify({ path, body });
              if (pending.current?.payload !== payload)
                pending.current = { payload, key: crypto.randomUUID() };
              const result = await apiFetch(`${path}/capacity`, {
                method: 'POST',
                body,
                idempotencyKey: pending.current.key,
              });
              pending.current = null;
              return result;
            }}
          >
            <Select
              name="craftSkillId"
              label="Craft"
              options={skills.data.items.map((item) => ({
                value: item.craftSkillId,
                label: item.craftSkill.name,
              }))}
            />
            <Select name="unitType" label="Weekly capacity unit" options={['HOURS', 'PIECES']} />
            <Input
              name="quantity"
              label="Quantity per week"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              max="100000"
              step="0.01"
              required
            />
            <Input name="effectiveFrom" label="Effective from" type="datetime-local" required />
            <Input name="effectiveTo" label="Effective until" type="datetime-local" required />
          </ActionForm>
        ) : (
          <p>Add a craft skill before declaring capacity.</p>
        ))}
      <h3>Declaration history</h3>
      {history.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No capacity declarations yet.</p>}
      <ul className="record-list">
        {history.data?.items.map((item) => (
          <li key={item.id}>
            {item.supersededAt ? 'Superseded declaration · ' : 'Current declaration · '}
            {item.quantity} {item.unitType.toLowerCase()} per week ·{' '}
            {skills.data?.items.find((skill) => skill.craftSkillId === item.craftSkillId)
              ?.craftSkill.name ?? item.craftSkillId}
            <p>
              {new Date(item.effectiveFrom).toLocaleString()} —{' '}
              {new Date(item.effectiveTo).toLocaleString()}
            </p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );
}
function Associations({ path, onChanged }: { path: string; onChanged: () => void }) {
  const links = useResource<Items<AssociationMembershipView>>(`${path}/associations`);
  const catalog = useResource<Items<{ id: string; name: string }>>(
    '/api/v1/artisans/associations/catalog',
  );
  return (
    <>
      <h2>Association relationships</h2>
      <p>
        You can work independently. Linking an association does not grant access to your profile;
        assistance requires a separate delegation.
      </p>
      <ResourceState {...links} retry={links.reload} />
      <ResourceState {...catalog} retry={catalog.reload} />
      {catalog.data?.items.length ? (
        <ActionForm
          label="Link association"
          onSuccess={async () => {
            await links.reload();
            onChanged();
          }}
          action={(data) =>
            apiFetch(`${path}/associations`, {
              method: 'POST',
              body: {
                organizationId: text(data, 'organizationId'),
                policyVersion: 'association-v1',
                consent: data.has('consent'),
              },
            })
          }
        >
          <Select
            name="organizationId"
            label="Approved association"
            options={catalog.data.items.map((item) => ({ value: item.id, label: item.name }))}
          />
          <label className="check-label">
            <input type="checkbox" name="consent" required />I consent to recording this association
            relationship (association-v1).
          </label>
        </ActionForm>
      ) : (
        catalog.data && <p>No approved associations are available yet.</p>
      )}
      <ul className="record-list">
        {links.data?.items.map((link) => (
          <li key={link.id}>
            <strong>{link.organizationName}</strong>
            <p>{humanize(link.status)}</p>
            {link.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
              <ActionForm
                label="End relationship"
                confirm="End this association relationship? Associated delegations will be revoked."
                onSuccess={async () => {
                  await links.reload();
                  onChanged();
                }}
                action={() => apiFetch(`${path}/associations/${link.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })}
              />
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {links.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>You are participating independently.</p>}
    </>
  );
}
function Delegations({ path }: { path: string }) {
  const resource = useResource<Items<DelegationGrantView>>(`${path}/delegations`);
  const associations = useResource<Items<AssociationMembershipView>>(`${path}/associations`);
  const [association, setAssociation] = useState('');
  const active = associations.data?.items.filter((link) => link.status === 'ACTIVE') ?? [];
  return (
    <>
      <h2>Limited assistance permissions</h2>
      <p>
        Grant selected actions to an association coordinator until an expiry date. You can revoke
        access at any time.
      </p>
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      <label className="field">
        <span className="label">Association for delegation</span>
        <select
          aria-label="Association for delegation"
          value={association}
          onChange={(event) => setAssociation(event.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">Choose an association</option>
          {active.map((link) => (
            <option key={link.id} value={link.id}>
              {link.organizationName}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      {association && (
        <GrantDelegation
          key={association}
          path={path}
          association={active.find((link) => link.id === association)!}
          reload={resource.reload}
        />
      )}
      <ul className="record-list">
        {resource.data?.items.map((grant) => (
          <li key={grant.id}>
            <strong>Coordinator {grant.delegateName ?? grant.delegateUserId}</strong>
            <p>
              {grant.scopes.join(', ')} · {humanize(grant.status)}
            </p>
            <p>Expires {new Date(grant.expiresAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
            {grant.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
              <ActionForm
                label="Revoke delegation"
                confirm="Revoke this coordinator’s assistance access immediately?"
                onSuccess={resource.reload}
                action={() => apiFetch(`${path}/delegations/${grant.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })}
              />
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No assistance permissions granted.</p>}
    </>
  );
}
function GrantDelegation({
  path,
  association,
  reload,
}: {
  path: string;
  association: AssociationMembershipView;
  reload: () => unknown;
}) {
  const coordinators = useResource<Items<{ id: string; name: string }>>(
    `${path}/associations/${association.id}/coordinators`,
  );
  return (
    <>
      <ResourceState {...coordinators} retry={coordinators.reload} />
      {coordinators.data?.items.length ? (
        <ActionForm
          label="Grant limited assistance"
          onSuccess={reload}
          action={(data) =>
            apiFetch(`${path}/delegations`, {
              method: 'POST',
              body: {
                organizationId: association.organizationId,
                delegateUserId: text(data, 'delegateUserId'),
                scopes: data.getAll('scopes'),
                expiresAt: new Date(text(data, 'expiresAt')).toISOString(),
                policyVersion: 'delegation-v1',
                consent: data.has('consent'),
              },
            })
          }
        >
          <Select
            name="delegateUserId"
            label="Coordinator"
            options={coordinators.data.items.map((item) => ({ value: item.id, label: item.name }))}
          />
          <Checkboxes
            name="scopes"
            options={[
              'artisan.profile.read',
              'artisan.profile.update',
              'artisan.skills.manage',
              'artisan.capacity.read',
              'artisan.capacity.update',
            ]}
          />
          <Input name="expiresAt" label="Assistance expires" type="datetime-local" required />
          <label className="check-label">
            <input type="checkbox" name="consent" required />I authorize only the selected actions
            until expiry (delegation-v1).
          </label>
        </ActionForm>
      ) : (
        coordinators.data && <p>This association has no eligible coordinators.</p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function AssistedArtisans() {
  const resource = useResource<Items<Assisted>>('/api/v1/artisans/assisted');
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Assisted artisans."
      description="Only artisans with a current, explicit delegation appear in this workspace."
    >
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      <section className="panel">
        <ul className="record-list">
          {resource.data?.items.map((grant) => (
            <li key={`${grant.id}-${grant.organizationId}-${grant.expiresAt}`}>
              <Link href={`/artisan/assisted/${grant.id}`}>{grant.displayName}</Link>
              <p>{grant.scopes.join(', ')}</p>
              <p>Expires {new Date(grant.expiresAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No active assistance delegations.</p>}
      </section>
    </Workspace>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\auth-form.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useHydrated } from '@/lib/use-hydrated';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import {
  emailRequestSchema,
  loginSchema,
  registerSchema,
  resetPasswordSchema,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import type { IdentityContext } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { ApiError, apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import { Field } from './field';
export type AuthMode = 'login' | 'register' | 'forgot-password' | 'reset-password' | 'verify-email';
const titles: Record<AuthMode, string> = {
  login: 'Welcome back.',
  register: 'Make yourself at home.',
  'forgot-password': 'A fresh start.',
  'reset-password': 'Choose a new password.',
  'verify-email': 'Verify your email.',
};
const descriptions: Record<AuthMode, string> = {
  login: 'Sign in to your NASJ account.',
  register: 'Create an account and verify your email to get started.',
  'forgot-password': 'We’ll send a recovery link if an account matches this address.',
  'reset-password': 'Use at least 12 characters. Your other sessions will be signed out.',
  'verify-email': 'Open your verification link, or request another email below.',
};
export function AuthForm({
  mode,
  next,
  embedded = false,
  onAuthenticated,
  onRegistered,
}: {
  mode: AuthMode;
  next: string;
  embedded?: boolean;
  onAuthenticated?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onRegistered?: () => void;
}) {
  const ready = useHydrated();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  const [twoFactorChallenge, setTwoFactorChallenge] = useState(false);
  const [useBackupCode, setUseBackupCode] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'reset-password' && mode !== 'verify-email') return;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    const value = new URLSearchParams(url.hash.slice(1)).get('token') ?? '';
    setToken(value);
    url.hash = '';
    url.searchParams.delete('token');
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.pathname + url.search);
  }, [mode]);
  function handleError(error: unknown) {
    setMessage(
      error instanceof ApiError
        ? error.message
        : 'Unable to complete this request. Please try again.',
    );
    if (error instanceof ApiError) setErrors(error.detail.fieldErrors ?? {});
  }
  function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setMessage('');
    setErrors({});
    const input = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(event.currentTarget));
    const schema =
      mode === 'register'
        ? registerSchema
        : mode === 'login'
          ? loginSchema
          : mode === 'reset-password'
            ? resetPasswordSchema
            : emailRequestSchema;
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(mode === 'reset-password' ? { ...input, token } : input);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      setErrors(parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors as Record<string, string[]>);
      setMessage('Check the highlighted fields.');
      return;
    }
    start(async () => {
      try {
        const endpoints: Record<AuthMode, string> = {
          login: '/sign-in/email',
          register: '/sign-up/email',
          'forgot-password': '/request-password-reset',
          'reset-password': '/reset-password',
          'verify-email': '/send-verification-email',
        };
        const response = await apiFetch<{ twoFactorRedirect?: boolean }>(
          `/api/auth${endpoints[mode]}`,
          { method: 'POST', body: parsed.data },
        );
        if (mode === 'login' && response?.twoFactorRedirect) {
          setTwoFactorChallenge(true);
          return;
        }
        if (mode === 'login') {
          if (onAuthenticated) await onAuthenticated();
          else {
            router.replace(
              next === '/dashboard'
                ? (await apiFetch<IdentityContext>('/api/v1/me/context')).landingPath
                : next,
            );
            router.refresh();
          }
          return;
        }
        if (mode === 'register' && onRegistered) {
          onRegistered();
          return;
        }
        setSuccess(true);
        setToken('');
        setMessage(
          mode === 'reset-password'
            ? 'Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password.'
            : 'If this address is eligible, check your inbox for the next step.',
        );
      } catch (error) {
        handleError(error);
      }
    });
  }
  function verify() {
    setMessage('');
    start(async () => {
      try {
        await apiFetch(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`);
        setToken('');
        setSuccess(true);
        setMessage(
          'Verification confirmed. You can sign in once your email is verified. If you changed your email, open the message sent to the new address.',
        );
      } catch (error) {
        handleError(error);
      }
    });
  }
  return (
    <section className="auth-card">
      <p className="eyebrow">YOUR NASJ ACCOUNT</p>
      {embedded ? <h2>{titles[mode]}</h2> : <h1>{titles[mode]}</h1>}
      <p className="lead">{descriptions[mode]}</p>
      {message && (
        <p className={success ? 'notice success' : 'notice'} role={success ? 'status' : 'alert'}>
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
      {twoFactorChallenge ? (
        <form
          method="post"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
            setMessage('');
            start(async () => {
              try {
                await apiFetch(
                  `/api/auth/two-factor/${useBackupCode ? 'verify-backup-code' : 'verify-totp'}`,
                  { method: 'POST', body: { code: String(data.get('code') ?? '').trim() } },
                );
                if (onAuthenticated) await onAuthenticated();
                else {
                  router.replace(
                    next === '/dashboard'
                      ? (await apiFetch<IdentityContext>('/api/v1/me/context')).landingPath
                      : next,
                  );
                  router.refresh();
                }
              } catch (error) {
                handleError(error);
              }
            });
          }}
        >
          <fieldset disabled={pending || !ready}>
            <Field
              name="code"
              label={useBackupCode ? 'Recovery code' : 'Authenticator code'}
              autoComplete="one-time-code"
            />
            <button className="button" type="submit">
              Verify sign-in
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="text-button"
              onClick={() => setUseBackupCode((value) => !value)}
            >
              {useBackupCode ? 'Use authenticator code' : 'Use recovery code'}
            </button>
          </fieldset>
        </form>
      ) : success ? (
        <Link className="button" href="/auth/login">
          Continue to sign in
        </Link>
      ) : mode === 'verify-email' && token ? (
        <button type="button" className="button" disabled={pending || !ready} onClick={verify}>
          {pending ? 'Verifying…' : 'Verify email address'}
        </button>
      ) : mode === 'reset-password' && !token ? (
        <p className="notice">
          Open the password reset link from your email.{' '}
          <Link href="/auth/forgot-password">Request a new link</Link>.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <form method="post" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
          <fieldset disabled={pending || !ready} aria-busy={pending}>
            {mode === 'register' && (
              <Field name="name" label="Your name" autoComplete="name" error={errors.name} />
            )}
            {mode !== 'reset-password' && (
              <Field
                name="email"
                label="Email address"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                error={errors.email}
              />
            )}
            {(mode === 'login' || mode === 'register') && (
              <Field
                name="password"
                label="Password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete={mode === 'login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'}
                error={errors.password}
                hint={mode === 'register' ? 'At least 12 characters.' : undefined}
              />
            )}
            {mode === 'reset-password' && (
              <Field
                name="newPassword"
                label="New password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                error={errors.newPassword}
              />
            )}
            <button className="button" type="submit">
              {pending
                ? 'Please wait…'
                : mode === 'login'
                  ? 'Sign in'
                  : mode === 'register'
                    ? 'Create account'
                    : mode === 'reset-password'
                      ? 'Update password'
                      : mode === 'verify-email'
                        ? 'Send verification email'
                        : 'Send recovery link'}
            </button>
          </fieldset>
        </form>
      )}
      {!embedded && (
        <nav className="auth-links" aria-label="Account options">
          {mode === 'login' ? (
            <>
              <Link href="/auth/forgot-password">Forgot your password?</Link>
              <span>
                New here? <Link href="/auth/register">Create an account</Link>
              </span>
              <Link href="/auth/verify-email">Resend verification email</Link>
            </>
          ) : (
            <Link href="/auth/login">Back to sign in</Link>
          )}
        </nav>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Query strings carry only a fixture ID. Resolve current server data before showing a form. */
export function CatalogRequestSelection({
  id,
  children,
}: {
  id: string;
  children: (example: CatalogExample) => ReactNode;
}) {
  const resource = useResource<BuyerCatalog>('/api/v1/commerce/catalog');

  return (
    <>

        (example?.availability === 'ILLUSTRATIVE' ? (
          <>
            <p className="notice">

              your quantity, destination and future deadline. This is not a stock reservation or
              supply commitment.
