          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="notice" role="alert">
            This catalog example is unavailable or no longer active.{' '}
            <Link href="/commerce/catalog">Choose another example</Link> or{' '}
            <Link href="/commerce/buyer">start a request without an example</Link>.
          </p>
        ))}
    </>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\commerce-report.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { CommerceMetrics } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import { humanize } from './workspace-ui';
type Report = {
  status: string;
  pendingEvents: number;
  asOf?: string;
  metrics: (Omit<CommerceMetrics, 'finance'> & { finance: Record<string, unknown> | null }) | null;
};
export function CommerceReport({ orderId }: { orderId: string }) {
  const [report, setReport] = useState<Report>();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  async function load() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      setReport(await apiFetch<Report>(`/api/v1/commerce/orders/${orderId}/report`));
    } catch (failure) {
      setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Unable to load report.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <details>
      <summary>Synthetic fulfillment report</summary>
      <button className="btn-secondary" type="button" onClick={load} disabled={busy}>
        {busy ? 'Loading report…' : 'Refresh report'}
      </button>
      {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
      {report && (
        <div>
          <p role="status">
            {humanize(report.status)} · {report.pendingEvents} queued events for this buyer
            organization.
            {report.asOf && ` Calculated ${report.asOf} (UTC).`}
          </p>
          {report.metrics && (
            <>
              <p>
                Order lifetime totals. All results are simulated. Actual costs, hours and verified
                settlement are unavailable.
              </p>
              <dl className="commerce-summary">
                {Object.entries(report.metrics.fulfillment).map(([name, value]) => (
                  <div key={name}>
                    <dt>{humanize(name)}</dt>
                    <dd>
                      {value.numerator} / {value.denominator} pieces
                    </dd>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {Object.entries(report.metrics.finance ?? {})
                  .filter(([, value]) => typeof value === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(value))
                  .map(([name, value]) => (
                    <div key={name}>
                      <dt>{humanize(name)}</dt>
                      <dd>{String(value)} millimes (TND)</dd>
                    </div>
                  ))}
              </dl>
              <a className="btn-secondary" href={`/api/v1/commerce/orders/${orderId}/report.csv`}>
                Download synthetic CSV
              </a>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </details>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\commerce-workspace.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useRef, useId } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { CommerceReport } from './commerce-report';
import { CatalogRequestSelection } from './buyer-catalog';
import { Card } from './ui/card';
import { Textarea } from './ui/textarea';
import { Badge } from './ui/badge';
import { Label } from './ui/label';
import type {
  CommerceWorkspaceView,
  CommercialRfqView,
  CommercialOrderView,
  CommercialBatchView,
  CatalogExample,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  Workspace,
  ResourceState,
  ActionForm,
  Input,
  Select,
  useResource,
  text,
  humanize,
} from './workspace-ui';

type Mode = 'buyer' | 'artisan' | 'operator';
function LongText({ name, label, value }: { name: string; label: string; value?: string }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>{label}</Label>
      <Textarea
        id={id}
        aria-label={label}
        name={name}
        defaultValue={value}
        required
        maxLength={2000}
        rows={3}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
function asDate(data: FormData, name: string) {
  return new Date(text(data, name)).toISOString();
}
function useCommand() {
  const pending = useRef(new Map<string, string>());
  return async (path: string, body: object, method: 'POST' | 'PATCH' = 'POST') => {
    const signature = JSON.stringify({ path, body, method });
    let key = pending.current.get(signature);
    if (!key) {
      key = crypto.randomUUID();
      pending.current.set(signature, key);
    }
    const result = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/commerce/${path}`, {
      method,
      body,
      idempotencyKey: key,
    });
    pending.current.delete(signature);
    return result;
  };
}
export function CommerceWorkspace({
  mode,
  catalogExampleId,
}: {
  mode: Mode;
  catalogExampleId?: string;
}) {
  const resource = useResource<CommerceWorkspaceView>('/api/v1/commerce/workspace');
  const inbox =
    useResource<{ id: string; code: string; createdAt: string }[]>('/api/v1/commerce/inbox');
  const send = useCommand();
  const data = resource.data;
  const titles = {
    buyer: 'Buyer requests',
    artisan: 'Artisan offers and production',
    operator: 'Operator review',
  };
  const roles = (id: string) => data?.operatorOrganizations.find((o) => o.id === id)?.roles ?? [];
  const buyer = (id: string) => Boolean(data?.buyerOrganizations.some((o) => o.id === id));
  const action = (path: string, next: string, version: number, extra: object = {}) =>
    send(`${path}/actions`, { next, version, ...extra });
  function rfqFields(rfq?: Partial<CommercialRfqView>) {
    return (
      <>
        <Input name="title" label="Request title" value={rfq?.title} required />
        <Select
          name="craftSkillId"
          label="Craft"
          value={rfq?.craftSkillId}
          options={data?.crafts.map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name })) ?? []}
          required
        />
        <LongText name="specification" label="Craft specification" value={rfq?.specification} />
        <LongText
          name="designRequirements"
          label="Design requirements"
          value={rfq?.designRequirements}
        />
        <Input
          name="quantity"
          label="Requested pieces"
          type="number"
          min="1"
          max="1000000"
          step="1"
          value={rfq?.quantity}
          required
        />
        <Input
          name="deliveryAt"
          label="Delivery deadline"
          type="datetime-local"
          value={
            rfq?.deliveryAt
              ? new Date(
                  new Date(rfq.deliveryAt).getTime() -
                    new Date(rfq.deliveryAt).getTimezoneOffset() * 60000,
                )
                  .toISOString()
                  .slice(0, 16)
              : undefined
          }
          required
        />
        <Input
          name="deliveryLocation"
          label="Delivery location"
          value={rfq?.deliveryLocation}
          required
        />
      </>
    );
  }
  const rfqBody = (f: FormData) => ({
    title: text(f, 'title'),
    craftSkillId: text(f, 'craftSkillId'),
    specification: text(f, 'specification'),
    designRequirements: text(f, 'designRequirements'),
    quantity: Number(text(f, 'quantity')),
    deliveryAt: asDate(f, 'deliveryAt'),
    deliveryLocation: text(f, 'deliveryLocation'),
  });
  function createRequest(example?: CatalogExample) {
    if (!data?.buyerOrganizations.some((o) => o.permissions?.includes('buyer.rfq.create')))
      return null;
    return (
      <details className="request-composer panel" open={Boolean(example)}>
        <summary>Create a synthetic request</summary>
        <ActionForm
          label="Save RFQ draft"
          onSuccess={resource.reload}
          action={(f) =>
            send('rfqs', {
              ...rfqBody(f),
              buyerOrganizationId: text(f, 'buyerOrganizationId'),
              operatorOrganizationId: text(f, 'operatorOrganizationId'),
              provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
              ...(example ? { catalogExampleId: example.id } : {}),
            })
          }
        >
          <Select
            name="buyerOrganizationId"
            label="Buyer organization"
            options={data.buyerOrganizations
              .filter((o) => o.permissions?.includes('buyer.rfq.create'))
              .map((o) => ({ value: o.id, label: o.name }))}
            required
          />
          <Select
            name="operatorOrganizationId"
            label="Responsible operator organization"
            options={data.operatorCatalog.map((o) => ({ value: o.id, label: o.name }))}
            required
          />
          {rfqFields(
            example
              ? {
                  title: `Synthetic ${example.name}`,
                  craftSkillId: example.craftSkillId,
                  specification: example.specification,
                  designRequirements: example.designRequirements,
                }
              : undefined,
          )}
        </ActionForm>
      </details>
    );
  }
  function orderCard(order: CommercialOrderView) {
    const ownBuyer = buyer(order.buyerOrganizationId),
      permission = roles(order.operatorOrganizationId);
    const production = permission.includes('PRODUCTION_MANAGER'),
      finance = permission.includes('FINANCE_MANAGER'),
      quality = permission.includes('QUALITY_INSPECTOR'),
      logistics = permission.includes('INVENTORY_LOGISTICS_COORDINATOR');
    const rfq = data!.rfqs.find((r) => r.id === order.rfqId);
    const next: Record<string, { state: string; label: string; allow: boolean }> = {
      APPROVED: { state: 'FUNDING_CONFIRMED', label: 'Confirm simulated funding', allow: finance },
      FUNDING_CONFIRMED: {
        state: 'PLANNING',
        label: 'Start allocation planning',
        allow: production,
      },
      PLANNING: { state: 'IN_PRODUCTION', label: 'Release order to production', allow: production },
      IN_PRODUCTION: {
        state: 'QUALITY_REVIEW',
        label: 'Request order quality review',
        allow: production,
      },
      QUALITY_REVIEW: {
        state: 'READY_TO_SHIP',
        label: 'Approve order for shipment',
        allow: quality,
      },
      READY_TO_SHIP: { state: 'IN_TRANSIT', label: 'Record synthetic shipment', allow: logistics },
      IN_TRANSIT: { state: 'DELIVERED', label: 'Record synthetic delivery', allow: logistics },
      DELIVERED: { state: 'BUYER_ACCEPTED', label: 'Accept delivered order', allow: ownBuyer },
      BUYER_ACCEPTED: { state: 'SETTLED', label: 'Reconcile simulated settlement', allow: finance },
    };
    return (
      <Card
        role="article"
        className="panel commerce-card block gap-0 p-5"
        key={order.id}
        aria-label={`Order ${order.title}`}
      >
        <h3>{order.title}</h3>
        <Badge variant="secondary">Order · {humanize(order.status)} · Synthetic</Badge>
        <dl className="commerce-facts">
          <dt>Requested</dt>
          <dd>{order.quantity} pieces</dd>
          <dt>Accepted assignments</dt>
          <dd>{order.allocated}</dd>
          <dt>Produced</dt>
          <dd>{order.produced}</dd>
          <dt>QA-approved</dt>
          <dd>{order.approved}</dd>
          <dt>Delivered</dt>
          <dd>{order.delivered}</dd>
          {order.quoteTnd && (
            <>
              <dt>Buyer quote</dt>
              <dd>{order.quoteTnd} TND</dd>
            </>
          )}
        </dl>
        <CommerceReport orderId={order.id} />
        {next[order.status]?.allow && (
          <ActionForm
            label={next[order.status].label}
            action={() => action(`orders/${order.id}`, next[order.status].state, order.version)}
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
          />
        )}
        {order.status === 'SETTLED' && finance && (
          <ActionForm
            label="Close reconciled synthetic order"
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
            action={(f) =>
              action(`orders/${order.id}`, 'CLOSED', order.version, {
                materialsResolved: f.get('materialsResolved') === 'on',
                dispositionNote: text(f, 'dispositionNote'),
              })
            }
          >
            <label className="check-label">
              <input name="materialsResolved" type="checkbox" required />I confirm synthetic
              materials and returns are resolved
            </label>
            <LongText name="dispositionNote" label="Material disposition note" />
          </ActionForm>
        )}
        {production && order.status === 'PLANNING' && (
          <details>
            <summary>Create a voluntary artisan offer</summary>
            <p>This reserves declared piece capacity until expiry. Only the artisan can accept.</p>
            <ActionForm
              label="Send synthetic offer"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(f) =>
                send('offers', {
                  orderId: order.id,
                  capacityDeclarationId: text(f, 'capacityDeclarationId'),
                  quantity: Number(text(f, 'quantity')),
                  unitPayTnd: text(f, 'unitPayTnd'),
                  estimatedHours: text(f, 'estimatedHours'),
                  expiresAt: asDate(f, 'expiresAt'),
                  materials: text(f, 'materials'),
                  reworkTerms: text(f, 'reworkTerms'),
                  paymentConditions: text(f, 'paymentConditions'),
                  provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
                })
              }
            >
              <Select
                name="capacityDeclarationId"
                label="Artisan declared capacity"
                options={data!.candidates
                  .filter(
                    (c) =>
                      c.craftSkillId === rfq?.craftSkillId &&
                      new Date(c.effectiveTo) >= new Date(rfq!.deliveryAt) &&
                      new Date(c.effectiveFrom) <= new Date(rfq!.deliveryAt),
                  )
                  .map((c) => ({
                    value: c.capacityDeclarationId,
                    label: `${c.displayName} · ${c.quantity} pieces declared`,
                  }))}
                required
              />
              <Input
                name="quantity"
                label="Offered pieces"
                type="number"
                min="1"
                max={String(order.quantity)}
                step="1"
                required
              />
              <Input name="unitPayTnd" label="Agreed artisan pay per piece (TND)" required />
              <Input name="estimatedHours" label="Estimated effort range (hours)" required />
              <Input name="expiresAt" label="Offer expiry" type="datetime-local" required />
              <LongText name="materials" label="Material responsibility" />
              <LongText name="reworkTerms" label="Quality and rework terms" />
              <LongText name="paymentConditions" label="Agreed payment conditions" />
            </ActionForm>
          </details>
        )}
        {finance && !['CLOSED', 'SETTLED', 'CANCELLED', 'DISPUTED'].includes(order.status) && (
          <details>
            <summary>Schedule a simulated payment</summary>
            <p>No bank transfer or real money movement occurs.</p>
            <ActionForm
              label="Schedule simulated payment"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(f) =>
                send('payments', {
                  orderId: order.id,
                  kind: text(f, 'kind'),
                  ...(text(f, 'kind') === 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT' ? { batchId: text(f, 'batchId') } : {}),
                  amountTnd: text(f, 'amountTnd'),
                  provenance: 'SYNTHETIC',
                })
              }
            >
              <Select
                name="kind"
                label="Payment ledger"
                options={['BUYER_RECEIPT', 'ARTISAN_PAYOUT']}
              />
              <Select
                name="batchId"
                label="Artisan batch (payouts only)"
                options={[
                  { value: '', label: 'Not applicable to buyer receipt' },
                  ...data!.batches
                    .filter((b) => b.orderId === order.id)
                    .map((b) => ({
                      value: b.id,
                      label: `Batch ${b.id} · ${b.approved} QA-approved pieces`,
                    })),
                ]}
              />
              <Input name="amountTnd" label="Simulated payment amount (TND)" required />
            </ActionForm>
          </details>
        )}
      </Card>
    );
  }
  function batchCard(batch: CommercialBatchView) {
    const order = data!.orders.find((o) => o.id === batch.orderId);
    const permission = order ? roles(order.operatorOrganizationId) : [];
    const own = batch.artisanProfileId === data!.artisanProfileId;
    return (
      <Card
        role="article"
        className="panel commerce-card block gap-0 p-5"
        key={batch.id}
        aria-label={`Production batch ${batch.id}`}
      >
        <h3>Production batch</h3>
        <p className="hint">{batch.id}</p>
        <p>{humanize(batch.status)} · Synthetic</p>
        <dl className="commerce-facts">
          <dt>Accepted pieces</dt>
          <dd>{batch.quantity}</dd>
          <dt>Produced</dt>
          <dd>{batch.produced}</dd>
          <dt>Submitted</dt>
          <dd>{batch.submitted}</dd>
          <dt>QA-approved</dt>
          <dd>{batch.approved}</dd>
          <dt>Rejected</dt>
          <dd>{batch.rejected}</dd>
          <dt>Pending QA</dt>
          <dd>{batch.pending}</dd>
        </dl>
        {permission.includes('PRODUCTION_MANAGER') && batch.status === 'ACCEPTED' && (
          <ActionForm
            label="Confirm synthetic material readiness"
            action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'MATERIAL_READY', batch.version)}
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
          />
        )}
        {own && batch.status === 'MATERIAL_READY' && (
          <ActionForm
            label="Start accepted production"
            action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'IN_PROGRESS', batch.version)}
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
          />
        )}
        {own && batch.status === 'IN_PROGRESS' && (
          <>
            <ActionForm
              label="Save cumulative progress"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(f) =>
                send(`batches/${batch.id}/progress`, {
                  version: batch.version,
                  produced: Number(text(f, 'produced')),
                })
              }
            >
              <p>Enter the total produced so far, including previously reported pieces.</p>
              <Input
                name="produced"
                label="Total pieces produced so far"
                type="number"
                min={String(batch.produced)}
                max={String(batch.quantity)}
                step="1"
                value={batch.produced}
                required
              />
            </ActionForm>
            <ActionForm
              label="Submit produced pieces for QA"
              action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'SUBMITTED', batch.version)}
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            />
          </>
        )}
        {permission.includes('QUALITY_INSPECTOR') && batch.status === 'SUBMITTED' && (
          <ActionForm
            label="Start quality inspection"
            action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'INSPECTION', batch.version)}
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
          />
        )}
        {permission.includes('QUALITY_INSPECTOR') && batch.status === 'INSPECTION' && (
          <>
            <ActionForm
              label="Save reconciled inspection"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(f) =>
                send(`batches/${batch.id}/inspections`, {
                  version: batch.version,
                  approved: Number(text(f, 'approved')),
                  rejected: Number(text(f, 'rejected')),
                  pending: Number(text(f, 'pending')),
                  defectReason: text(f, 'defectReason'),
                })
              }
            >
              <p>Approved + rejected + pending must equal {batch.submitted} submitted pieces.</p>
              <Input
                name="approved"
                label="Approved pieces"
                type="number"
                min={String(batch.approved)}
                max={String(batch.submitted)}
                value={batch.approved}
                required
              />
              <Input
                name="rejected"
                label="Rejected pieces"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                value={batch.rejected}
                required
              />
              <Input
                name="pending"
                label="Pending pieces"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                value={batch.pending}
                required
              />
              <Input name="defectReason" label="Defect reason (required for rejection)" />
            </ActionForm>
            <ActionForm
              label="Approve inspected batch"
              action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'APPROVED', batch.version)}
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            />
            <ActionForm
              label="Request rework under agreed terms"
              action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'REWORK_REQUESTED', batch.version)}
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            />
          </>
        )}
        {own && batch.status === 'REWORK_REQUESTED' && (
          <>
            <ActionForm
              label="Accept agreed rework"
              action={() =>
                action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'IN_PROGRESS', batch.version, {
                  reworkAccepted: true,
                })
              }
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            />
            <ActionForm
              label="Dispute rework"
              action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'DISPUTED', batch.version)}
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            />
          </>
        )}
        {permission.includes('PRODUCTION_MANAGER') && batch.status === 'APPROVED' && (
          <ActionForm
            label="Complete approved batch"
            action={() => action(`batches/${batch.id}`, 'COMPLETED', batch.version)}
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
          />
        )}
      </Card>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={titles[mode]}
      description={
        mode === 'buyer'
          ? 'Create a request, review quotes and track your orders. Demo records use simulated values.'
          : mode === 'artisan'
            ? 'Review offers and update the work you accepted. This is a simulated demo; participation is always your choice.'
            : 'Manage requests, production and fulfillment. Records and payments in this demo are simulated.'
      }
    >
      <nav className="workspace-tabs" aria-label="Commerce journeys">
        {(mode === 'buyer' || Boolean(data?.buyerOrganizations.length)) && (
          <Link href="/commerce/buyer" aria-current={mode === 'buyer' ? 'page' : undefined}>
            Buyer requests
          </Link>
        )}
        {(mode === 'artisan' || Boolean(data?.artisanProfileId)) && (
          <Link href="/commerce/artisan" aria-current={mode === 'artisan' ? 'page' : undefined}>
            Artisan decisions and progress
          </Link>
        )}
        {(mode === 'operator' || Boolean(data?.operatorOrganizations.length)) && (
          <Link href="/commerce/operator" aria-current={mode === 'operator' ? 'page' : undefined}>
            Operator review
          </Link>
        )}
      </nav>
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {data && (
        <>
          <section className="workspace-stats" aria-label="Records in this workspace">
            {(mode === 'artisan'
              ? [
                  {
                    label: 'Your offers',
                    value: data.offers.filter((o) => o.artisanProfileId === data.artisanProfileId)
                      .length,
                  },
                  {
                    label: 'Production batches',
                    value: data.batches.filter((b) => b.artisanProfileId === data.artisanProfileId)
                      .length,
                  },
                ]
              : [
                  {
                    label: mode === 'buyer' ? 'Your requests' : 'Assigned requests',
                    value: data.rfqs.filter((r) =>
                      mode === 'buyer'
                        ? buyer(r.buyerOrganizationId)
                        : roles(r.operatorOrganizationId).length > 0,
                    ).length,
                  },
                  {
                    label: 'Orders',
                    value: data.orders.filter((o) =>
                      mode === 'buyer'
                        ? buyer(o.buyerOrganizationId)
                        : roles(o.operatorOrganizationId).length > 0,
                    ).length,
                  },
                ]
            ).map((stat) => (
              <Card className="workspace-stat block gap-0 p-4" key={stat.label}>
                <p>{stat.label}</p>
                <strong>{stat.value}</strong>
                <span>In this view</span>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </section>
          {mode === 'buyer' && (
            <section aria-labelledby="buyer-heading">
              <h2 id="buyer-heading">Create and track a buyer RFQ</h2>
              <p>
                <Link href="/commerce/catalog">Browse craft examples</Link> to start with a
                synthetic specification.
              </p>
              {!data.buyerOrganizations.length ? (
                <p>
                  An approved buyer organization membership is required.{' '}
                  <Link href="/settings/organizations">Manage organizations</Link>.
                </p>
              ) : catalogExampleId !== undefined ? (
                <CatalogRequestSelection id={catalogExampleId}>
                  {createRequest}
                </CatalogRequestSelection>
              ) : (
                createRequest()
              )}
            </section>
          )}
          {mode !== 'artisan' && (
            <section aria-labelledby="rfq-heading">
              <h2 id="rfq-heading">{mode === 'buyer' ? 'Your requests' : 'Assigned requests'}</h2>
              <p>
                Submitted content is locked. Accepting the exact unexpired quote creates one
                synthetic order.
              </p>
              {!data.rfqs.filter((r) =>
                mode === 'buyer'
                  ? buyer(r.buyerOrganizationId)
                  : roles(r.operatorOrganizationId).length > 0,
              ).length && <p>No requests in this workspace yet.</p>}
              {data.rfqs
                .filter((r) =>
                  mode === 'buyer'
                    ? buyer(r.buyerOrganizationId)
                    : roles(r.operatorOrganizationId).length > 0,
                )
                .map((r) => (
                  <Card
                    role="article"
                    key={r.id}
                    className="panel commerce-card block gap-0 p-5"
                    aria-label={`RFQ ${r.title}`}
                  >
                    <h3>{r.title}</h3>
                    <p>
                      {humanize(r.status)} · Version {r.version} · Synthetic
                    </p>
                    <dl className="commerce-facts">
                      <dt>Quantity</dt>
                      <dd>{r.quantity} pieces</dd>
                      <dt>Specification</dt>
                      <dd>{r.specification}</dd>
                      <dt>Design requirements</dt>
                      <dd>{r.designRequirements}</dd>
                      <dt>Delivery</dt>
                      <dd>
                        {new Date(r.deliveryAt).toLocaleString()} · {r.deliveryLocation}
                      </dd>
                      {r.quoteTnd && (
                        <>
                          <dt>Exact quote</dt>
                          <dd>{r.quoteTnd} TND</dd>
                          <dt>Quote expires</dt>
                          <dd>{r.quoteExpiresAt && new Date(r.quoteExpiresAt).toLocaleString()}</dd>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </dl>
                    {buyer(r.buyerOrganizationId) && r.status === 'DRAFT' && (
                      <>
                        <details>
                          <summary>Edit saved draft</summary>
                          <ActionForm
                            label="Save draft changes"
                            onSuccess={resource.reload}
                            action={(f) =>
                              send(`rfqs/${r.id}`, { ...rfqBody(f), version: r.version }, 'PATCH')
                            }
                          >
                            {rfqFields(r)}
                          </ActionForm>
                        </details>
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Submit RFQ for review"
                          action={() => action(`rfqs/${r.id}`, 'SUBMITTED', r.version)}
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                      </>
                    )}
                    {roles(r.operatorOrganizationId).includes('PRODUCTION_MANAGER') &&
                      r.status === 'SUBMITTED' && (
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Start RFQ review"
                          action={() => action(`rfqs/${r.id}`, 'UNDER_REVIEW', r.version)}
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                      )}
                    {roles(r.operatorOrganizationId).includes('FINANCE_MANAGER') &&
                      r.status === 'UNDER_REVIEW' && (
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Issue synthetic quote"
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                          action={(f) =>
                            action(`rfqs/${r.id}`, 'QUOTED', r.version, {
                              quoteTnd: text(f, 'quoteTnd'),
                              quoteExpiresAt: asDate(f, 'quoteExpiresAt'),
                            })
                          }
                        >
                          <Input name="quoteTnd" label="Exact buyer quote (TND)" required />
                          <Input
                            name="quoteExpiresAt"
                            label="Quote expiry"
                            type="datetime-local"
                            required
                          />
                        </ActionForm>
                      )}
                    {buyer(r.buyerOrganizationId) &&
                      data.buyerOrganizations
                        .find((o) => o.id === r.buyerOrganizationId)
                        ?.permissions?.includes('buyer.quotation.approve') &&
                      r.status === 'QUOTED' && (
                        <>
                          <ActionForm
                            label="Accept exact synthetic quote"
                            action={() => action(`rfqs/${r.id}`, 'ACCEPTED', r.version)}
                            onSuccess={resource.reload}
                          />
                          <ActionForm
                            label="Decline quote"
                            action={() => action(`rfqs/${r.id}`, 'DECLINED', r.version)}
                            onSuccess={resource.reload}
                          />
                        </>
                      )}
                  </Card>
                ))}
            </section>
          )}
          {mode !== 'artisan' && data.orders.length > 0 && (
            <section aria-labelledby="orders-heading">
              <h2 id="orders-heading">
                {mode === 'buyer' ? 'Your orders' : 'Production and fulfillment review'}
              </h2>
              {!data.orders.length && <p>No accepted orders yet.</p>}
              {data.orders
                .filter((o) =>
                  mode === 'buyer'
                    ? buyer(o.buyerOrganizationId)
                    : roles(o.operatorOrganizationId).length > 0,
                )
                .map(orderCard)}
            </section>
          )}
          {mode !== 'buyer' && (
            <section aria-labelledby="offers-heading">
              <h2 id="offers-heading">
                {mode === 'artisan' ? 'Voluntary offer decisions' : 'Offer review'}
              </h2>
              <p>
                Declining an offer or refusing a wearable carries no eligibility penalty. Only the
                named artisan may accept an offer.
              </p>
              {!data.offers.length && (
                <p>
                  No offers available. Artisans can{' '}
                  <Link href="/artisan/capacity">declare voluntary piece capacity</Link>.
                </p>
              )}
              {data.offers
                .filter((o) => mode === 'operator' || o.artisanProfileId === data.artisanProfileId)
                .map((o) => (
                  <Card
                    role="article"
                    className="panel commerce-card block gap-0 p-5"
                    key={o.id}
                    aria-label={`Artisan offer ${o.id}`}
                  >
                    <h3>Artisan offer · {humanize(o.status)}</h3>
                    <p className="hint">{o.id} · Synthetic</p>
                    <dl className="commerce-facts">
                      <dt>Quantity</dt>
                      <dd>{o.quantity} pieces</dd>
                      <dt>Estimated effort</dt>
                      <dd>{o.estimatedHours} hours</dd>
                      <dt>Agreed unit pay</dt>
                      <dd>{o.unitPayTnd ?? 'Restricted'} TND</dd>
                      <dt>Total agreed pay</dt>
                      <dd>{o.totalPayTnd ?? 'Restricted'} TND</dd>
                      <dt>Craft specification</dt>
                      <dd>{o.specification}</dd>
                      <dt>Material responsibility</dt>
                      <dd>{o.materials}</dd>
                      <dt>Quality/rework terms</dt>
                      <dd>{o.reworkTerms}</dd>
                      <dt>Payment conditions</dt>
                      <dd>{o.paymentConditions}</dd>
                      <dt>Offer expires</dt>
                      <dd>{new Date(o.expiresAt).toLocaleString()}</dd>
                      <dt>Delivery deadline</dt>
                      <dd>{new Date(o.deliveryAt).toLocaleString()}</dd>
                    </dl>
                    {o.artisanProfileId === data.artisanProfileId && o.status === 'OFFERED' && (
                      <>
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Accept this offer voluntarily"
                          action={() => action(`offers/${o.id}`, 'ACCEPTED', o.version)}
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Decline offer without penalty"
                          action={() => action(`offers/${o.id}`, 'DECLINED', o.version)}
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Card>
                ))}
            </section>
          )}
          {mode !== 'buyer' && (
            <section aria-labelledby="batches-heading">
              <h2 id="batches-heading">
                {mode === 'artisan' ? 'Your accepted production' : 'Batch and quality review'}
              </h2>
              {!data.batches.length && <p>No accepted production batches yet.</p>}
              {data.batches
                .filter((b) => mode === 'operator' || b.artisanProfileId === data.artisanProfileId)
                .map(batchCard)}
            </section>
          )}
          <section aria-labelledby="payments-heading" className="section-gap">
            <details open={data.payments.length > 0}>
              <summary id="payments-heading">Simulated payment records</summary>
              <p>
                Buyer receipts and individual artisan payouts use separate ledgers. “Settled” here
                always means simulated settlement, never an actual transfer.
              </p>
              {!data.payments.length && <p>No simulated payments in your permitted scope.</p>}
              {data.payments.map((p) => {
                const order = data.orders.find((o) => o.id === p.orderId);
                const finance =
                  order && roles(order.operatorOrganizationId).includes('FINANCE_MANAGER');
                const next: Record<string, string> = {
                  SCHEDULED: 'APPROVED',
                  APPROVED: 'INITIATED',
                  INITIATED: 'SETTLED',
                };
                return (
                  <Card
                    role="article"
                    className="panel commerce-card block gap-0 p-5"
                    key={p.id}
                    aria-label={`Simulated payment ${p.id}`}
                  >
                    <h3>
                      {humanize(p.kind)} · {p.amountTnd} TND
                    </h3>
                    <p>
                      {humanize(p.status)} ·{' '}
                      {p.evidenceType === 'SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT'
                        ? 'Simulated settlement recorded'
                        : 'Synthetic demonstration only'}
                    </p>
                    {finance && next[p.status] && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label={`Mark simulated payment ${humanize(next[p.status]).toLowerCase()}`}
                        action={() =>
                          action(
                            `payments/${p.id}`,
                            next[p.status],
                            p.version,
                            next[p.status] === 'SETTLED'
                              ? { evidenceType: 'SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT' }
                              : {},
                          )
                        }
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </details>
          </section>
          <p className="hint">
            Each list shows at most 100 records. This bounded prototype does not implement real
            contracts, banking, automatic matching or wearable ingestion.
          </p>
        </>
      )}
      <div className="panel section-gap">
        <details>
          <summary>Commerce notifications</summary>
          <button className="btn-secondary" type="button" onClick={inbox.reload}>
            Refresh notifications
          </button>
          <ResourceState {...inbox} retry={inbox.reload} />
          {inbox.data &&
            (inbox.data.length ? (
              <ul>
                {inbox.data.map((notice) => (
                  <li key={notice.id}>
                    {humanize(notice.code.replace('commerce.', '').replaceAll('.', ' '))} ·{' '}
                    <time dateTime={notice.createdAt}>
                      {new Date(notice.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                    </time>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <p>No processed commerce notifications yet.</p>
            ))}
          <p>Refresh to check for new commerce updates.</p>
        </details>
      </div>
    </Workspace>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\field.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Input } from './ui/input';
import { Label } from './ui/label';
export function Field({
  name,
  label,
  type = 'text',
  autoComplete,
  error,
  hint,
  defaultValue,
}: {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  type?: string;
  autoComplete?: string;
  error?: string[];
  hint?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
}) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const password = type === 'password';
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <Label htmlFor={name}>{label}</Label>
      <div className="input-wrap">
        <Input
          id={name}
          name={name}
          type={password && visible ? 'text' : type}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          defaultValue={defaultValue}
          required
          aria-invalid={Boolean(error?.length)}
          aria-describedby={
            [hint ? `${name}-hint` : '', error?.length ? `${name}-error` : '']
              .filter(Boolean)
              .join(' ') || undefined
          }
        />
        {password && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="reveal"
            aria-label={visible ? `Hide ${label.toLowerCase()}` : `Show ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
            onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
          >
            {visible ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {hint && (
        <span className="hint" id={`${name}-hint`}>
          {hint}
        </span>
      )}
      {error?.length ? (
        <span className="field-error" id={`${name}-error`}>
          {error.join(' ')}
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\foundation-admin.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { Page as PageData } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  Workspace,
  ResourceState,
  ActionForm,
  Input,
  Select,
  Checkboxes,
  useResource,
  text,
  humanize,
} from './workspace-ui';
import { EvidenceFields, evidence } from './foundation-workspace';
import { Card } from './ui/card';
import { Pagination } from './governance';
type Organization = { id: string; name: string; type: string; approvalStatus: string };
type Coordinator = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  organizationId: string;
  status: string;
  organization: { name: string };
  user: { name: string; email: string };
};
const post = (path: string, body: unknown) => apiFetch(`/api/v1/${path}`, { method: 'POST', body });
export function PersonnelAdmin({ coordinators = false }: { coordinators?: boolean }) {
  const organizations = useResource<PageData<Organization>>(
    '/api/v1/admin/organizations?pageSize=100',
  );
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const members = useResource<PageData<Coordinator>>(
    `/api/v1/admin/${coordinators ? 'coordinators' : 'operators'}?page=${page}`,
  );
  const approved =
    organizations.data?.items.filter(
      (o) =>
        o.approvalStatus === 'APPROVED' &&
        (coordinators
          ? ['ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE'].includes(o.type)
          : o.type === 'INTERNAL'),
    ) ?? [];
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={coordinators ? 'Coordinator access' : 'Internal operator access'}
      description="Privileged personnel require an administrator invitation and a verified account."
    >
      <ResourceState {...organizations} retry={organizations.reload} />
      <Card className="panel block p-5">
        <h2>Invite {coordinators ? 'a coordinator' : 'an operator'}</h2>
        <ActionForm
          label="Send personnel invitation"
          action={(d) =>
            post('admin/personnel/invite', {
              organizationId: text(d, 'organizationId'),
              email: text(d, 'email'),
              persona: coordinators ? 'ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR' : 'NASJ_OPERATOR',
              reason: text(d, 'reason'),
            })
          }
        >
          <Select
            name="organizationId"
            label="Approved organization"
            required
            options={[
              { value: '', label: 'Choose an approved organization' },
              ...approved.map((o) => ({ value: o.id, label: o.name })),
            ]}
          />
          <Input name="email" label="Personnel email" type="email" required />
          <Input name="reason" label="Invitation reason" required />
        </ActionForm>
      </Card>
      {coordinators ? (
        <>
          <ResourceState {...members} retry={members.reload} />
          {members.data?.items.map((m) => (
            <Card key={m.id} className="panel block p-5">
              <h2>{m.user.name}</h2>
              <p>
                {m.organization.name} · {humanize(m.status)}
              </p>
              <ActionForm
                label="Change coordinator affiliation status"
                action={(d) =>
                  apiFetch(`/api/v1/admin/coordinators/${m.userId}/status`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    body: {
                      organizationId: m.organizationId,
                      status: text(d, 'status'),
                      reason: text(d, 'reason'),
                    },
                  })
                }
                onSuccess={members.reload}
              >
                <Select
                  name="status"
                  label="Affiliation status"
                  options={['ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'REVOKED']}
                />
                <Input name="reason" label="Affiliation change reason" required />
              </ActionForm>
              <details>
                <summary>Transfer to another association</summary>
                <p>
                  Existing artisan assignments end and require explicit reassignment. History is
                  retained.
                </p>
                <ActionForm
                  label="Transfer coordinator"
                  action={(d) =>
                    post(`admin/coordinators/${m.userId}/transfer`, {
                      organizationId: text(d, 'organizationId'),
                      reason: text(d, 'reason'),
                    })
                  }
                  onSuccess={members.reload}
                >
                  <Select
                    name="organizationId"
                    label="Destination association"
                    required
                    options={[
                      { value: '', label: 'Choose destination' },
                      ...approved
                        .filter((o) => o.id !== m.organizationId)
                        .map((o) => ({ value: o.id, label: o.name })),
                    ]}
                  />
                  <Input name="reason" label="Transfer reason" required />
                </ActionForm>
              </details>
            </Card>
          ))}
          <Pagination data={members.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
          <ArtisanGovernance
            organizations={organizations.data?.items ?? []}
            coordinators={members.data?.items ?? []}
          />
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ResourceState {...members} retry={members.reload} />
          {members.data?.items.map((m) => (
            <Card key={m.id} className="panel block p-5">
              <h2>{m.user.name}</h2>
              <p>
                {m.organization.name} · {humanize(m.status)}
              </p>
              <p>
                User reference: {m.userId} · Membership reference: {m.id}
              </p>
              <ActionForm
                label="Change operator access"
                action={(d) =>
                  apiFetch(`/api/v1/organizations/${m.organizationId}/members/${m.id}`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    body: { status: text(d, 'status'), reason: text(d, 'reason') },
                  })
                }
                onSuccess={members.reload}
              >
                <Select
                  name="status"
                  label="Operator membership status"
                  options={['ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'REVOKED']}
                />
                <Input name="reason" label="Operator access change reason" required />
              </ActionForm>
            </Card>
          ))}
          <Pagination data={members.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
          <OperatorAssignments organizations={organizations.data?.items ?? []} />
        </>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}

function ArtisanGovernance({
  organizations,
  coordinators,
}: {
  organizations: Organization[];
  coordinators: Coordinator[];
}) {
  const policies = useResource<{ id: string; version: string; methods: string[] }[]>(
    '/api/v1/authorization-policies',
  );
  return (
    <Card className="panel block p-5">
      <h2>Participant access governance</h2>
      <p>
        Use a reviewed artisan reference. These actions do not expose private participant or
        financial records.
      </p>
      <ActionForm
        label="Reassign responsible coordinator"
        action={(d) =>
          post(`admin/artisans/${text(d, 'artisanId')}/assignment`, {
            coordinatorId: text(d, 'coordinatorId'),
            reason: text(d, 'reason'),
          })
        }
      >
        <Input name="artisanId" label="Artisan reference" required />
        <Select
          name="coordinatorId"
          label="Responsible coordinator"
          required
          options={[
            { value: '', label: 'Choose active coordinator' },
            ...coordinators
              .filter((c) => c.status === 'ACTIVE')
              .map((c) => ({ value: c.userId, label: `${c.user.name} — ${c.organization.name}` })),
          ]}
        />
        <Input name="reason" label="Reassignment reason" required />
      </ActionForm>
      <details>
        <summary>Link a verified participant account</summary>
        <ActionForm
          label="Link reviewed account"
          action={(d) =>
            post(`admin/artisans/${text(d, 'artisanId')}/link-account`, {
              userId: text(d, 'userId'),
              verificationReference: text(d, 'verificationReference'),
              reason: text(d, 'reason'),
            })
          }
        >
          <Input name="artisanId" label="Existing artisan reference" required />
          <Input name="userId" label="Verified user reference" required />
          <Input
            name="verificationReference"
            label="Reviewed identity verification evidence"
            required
          />
          <Input name="reason" label="Account-link review reason" required />
        </ActionForm>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Transfer artisan to another managing association</summary>
        {policies.data && (
          <ActionForm
            label="Transfer artisan with authorization"
            action={(d) =>
              post(`admin/artisans/${text(d, 'artisanId')}/transfer`, {
                organizationId: text(d, 'organizationId'),
                coordinatorId: text(d, 'coordinatorId'),
                authorization: evidence(d),
                reason: text(d, 'reason'),
              })
            }
          >
            <Input name="artisanId" label="Participant reference to transfer" required />
            <Select
              name="organizationId"
              label="New managing association"
              required
              options={[
                { value: '', label: 'Choose approved destination' },
                ...organizations
                  .filter(
                    (o) =>
                      ['ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE'].includes(o.type) &&
                      o.approvalStatus === 'APPROVED',
                  )
                  .map((o) => ({ value: o.id, label: o.name })),
              ]}
            />
            <Input
              name="coordinatorId"
              label="New responsible coordinator user reference"
              required
            />
            <EvidenceFields policies={policies.data} />
            <Input name="reason" label="Artisan transfer review reason" required />
          </ActionForm>
        )}
      </details>
      <p>
        Transfers between managing associations require new documented participation authorization.
        Approved destinations:{' '}
        {organizations
          .filter(
            (o) =>
              ['ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE'].includes(o.type) &&
              o.approvalStatus === 'APPROVED',
          )
          .map((o) => o.name)
          .join(', ') || 'none'}
        .
      </p>
    </Card>
  );
}
export function AuthorizationPolicies() {
  const policies = useResource<{ id: string; version: string; methods: string[] }[]>(
    '/api/v1/authorization-policies',
  );
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Assisted authorization policies"
      description="Record a legally reviewed policy reference before coordinators can onboard participants. Software does not replace legal review."
    >
      <ResourceState {...policies} retry={policies.reload} />
      <Card className="panel block p-5">
        <ActionForm
          label="Record reviewed authorization policy"
          action={(d) =>
            post('admin/authorization-policies', {
              version: text(d, 'version'),
              methods: d.getAll('methods'),
              reviewReference: text(d, 'reviewReference'),
            })
          }
          onSuccess={policies.reload}
        >
          <Input name="version" label="Policy version" required />
          <Input name="reviewReference" label="Legal review reference" required />
          <Checkboxes
            name="methods"
            options={['SIGNED', 'WITNESSED_VERBAL', 'SMS_CONFIRMATION', 'APPROVED_ACCESSIBLE']}
          />
        </ActionForm>
      </Card>
      {policies.data?.map((p) => (
        <Card className="panel block p-5" key={p.id}>
          <h2>{p.version}</h2>
          <p>{p.methods.map(humanize).join(', ')}</p>
          <ActionForm
            label="Withdraw authorization policy"
            action={(d) =>
              apiFetch(`/api/v1/admin/authorization-policies/${p.id}`, {
                method: 'PATCH',
                body: { active: false, reason: text(d, 'reason') },
              })
            }
            onSuccess={policies.reload}
          >
            <Input name="reason" label="Policy withdrawal reason" required />
          </ActionForm>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </Workspace>
  );
}

export function AccessReport() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const r = useResource<
    PageData<{
      id: string;
      user: { name: string; status: string };
      organization: { name: string; type: string; status: string };
      roles: string[];
      permissions: string[];
      status: string;
    }>
  >(`/api/v1/admin/access-report?page=${page}`);
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Access diagnostics"
      description="Effective account, organization, role and permission boundaries. No financial or wearable records appear here."
    >
      <ResourceState {...r} retry={r.reload} />
      {r.data?.items.map((m) => (
        <Card key={m.id} className="panel block p-5">
          <h2>
            {m.user.name} · {m.organization.name}
          </h2>
          <p>
            {humanize(m.status)} membership · {humanize(m.user.status)} account ·{' '}
            {humanize(m.organization.status)} organization
          </p>
          <p>Membership reference: {m.id}</p>
          <p>Roles: {m.roles.map(humanize).join(', ') || 'None'}</p>
          <details>
            <summary>Effective permissions</summary>
            <ul>
              {m.permissions.map((p) => (
                <li key={p}>{p}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            {!m.permissions.length && <p>No effective permissions.</p>}
          </details>
        </Card>
      ))}
      <Pagination data={r.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
    </Workspace>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\foundation-gate.tsx =====

import Link from 'next/link';
import { getIdentityContext } from '@/lib/server-api';
import type { OperationalPersona } from '@nasj/contracts';
export function DeniedWorkspace() {
  return (
    <>
      <h1>Access denied</h1>
      <p>This workspace requires an active approved affiliation and the appropriate permission.</p>
      <p>
        <Link href="/dashboard">Access overview</Link> ·{' '}
        <Link href="/settings/security">Security settings</Link>
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
export async function FoundationGate({
  persona,
  children,
}: {
  persona: OperationalPersona;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const context = await getIdentityContext();
  return context?.personas.includes(persona) ? children : <DeniedWorkspace />;
}
export async function CommerceGate({
  mode,
  children,
}: {
  mode: 'buyer' | 'artisan' | 'operator';
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const context = await getIdentityContext();
  const allowed =
    mode === 'buyer'
      ? context?.personas.includes('BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE')
      : mode === 'artisan'
        ? Boolean(context?.linkedArtisanProfileId)
        : context?.organizations.some(
            (o) =>
              o.type === 'INTERNAL' &&
              o.permissions.some((p) =>
                [
                  'production.manage',
                  'finance.payout.read',
                  'quality.inspection.create',
                  'inventory.manage',
                ].includes(p),
              ),
          );
  return allowed ? children : <DeniedWorkspace />;
}

} from './workspace-ui';

type Organization = { id: string; name: string; type: string; approvalStatus: string };
type Policy = { id: string; version: string; methods: string[] };
type Skill = { id: string; name: string };
type Participant = {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  region: string;
  participantStatus: string;
  availabilityStatus: string;
  userId: string | null;
};
type Detail = {
  profile: Participant & {
    contactPhone: string | null;
    preferredLanguage: string;
    equipment: string[];
    experienceDescription: string;
  };
  skills: { craftSkillId: string; craftSkill: Skill }[];
  capacity: {
    id: string;
    quantity: string;
    unitType: string;
    effectiveFrom: string;
    effectiveTo: string;
  }[];
  authorizations: {
    id: string;
    purpose: string;
    method: string;
    occurredAt: string;
    evidenceReference: string;
    withdrawnAt: string | null;
    policy: { version: string; active: boolean };
  }[];
  assignments: { id: string; coordinatorId: string; startedAt: string; endedAt: string | null }[];
};
const post = (path: string, data: unknown) =>
  apiFetch(`/api/v1/${path}`, { method: 'POST', body: data });
export function evidence(data: FormData) {
  return {
    policyId: text(data, 'policyId'),
    purpose: text(data, 'purpose') || 'PARTICIPATION',
    method: text(data, 'method'),
    occurredAt: new Date(text(data, 'occurredAt')).toISOString(),
    language: text(data, 'language'),
    evidenceReference: text(data, 'evidenceReference'),
    ...(text(data, 'witnessReference') ? { witnessReference: text(data, 'witnessReference') } : {}),
  };
}
function profile(data: FormData) {
  return {
    displayName: text(data, 'displayName'),
    region: text(data, 'region'),
    preferredLanguage: text(data, 'preferredLanguage'),
    contactPhone: text(data, 'contactPhone'),
    equipment: text(data, 'equipment')
      .split(',')
      .map((v) => v.trim())
      .filter(Boolean),
    experienceDescription: text(data, 'experienceDescription'),
    availabilityStatus: text(data, 'availabilityStatus'),
  };
}
function ProfileFields({ initial }: { initial?: Detail['profile'] }) {

      <Select
        name="preferredLanguage"
        label="Preferred language"
        value={initial?.preferredLanguage ?? 'fr'}
        options={['fr', 'ar', 'en']}
      />
      <Input name="contactPhone" label="Contact phone (optional)" value={initial?.contactPhone} />
      <Input
        name="equipment"
        label="Equipment (comma separated)"
        value={initial?.equipment.join(', ')}
      />
      <Input
        name="experienceDescription"
        label="Experience and capabilities"
        value={initial?.experienceDescription}
      />
      <Select
        name="availabilityStatus"
        label="Availability"
        value={initial?.availabilityStatus ?? 'AVAILABLE'}
        options={['AVAILABLE', 'PAUSED']}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export function AddArtisan() {
  const policies = useResource<Policy[]>('/api/v1/authorization-policies');
  const skills = useResource<PageData<Skill>>('/api/v1/craft-skills');
  const [created, setCreated] = useState('');
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Add artisan"
      description="Register an artisan without requiring an email, smartphone or account."
    >
      <ResourceState {...policies} retry={policies.reload} />
      <ResourceState {...skills} retry={skills.reload} />
      {policies.data?.length === 0 ? (
        <p>
          An administrator must record a reviewed authorization policy before onboarding can
          proceed.
        </p>
      ) : (
        policies.data &&
        skills.data && (
          <Card className="panel block p-5">
            <ActionForm
              label="Create authorized artisan"
              action={async (data) => {
                const result = (await post('associations/me/artisans', {
                  ...profile(data),
                  skills: data.getAll('skills'),
                  authorization: evidence(data),
                  ...(text(data, 'duplicateReviewId')
                    ? { duplicateReviewId: text(data, 'duplicateReviewId') }
                    : {}),
                })) as { id: string };
                setCreated(result.id);
              }}
            >
              <div className="settings-grid">
                <ProfileFields />
              </div>
              <h2>Craft skills</h2>
              <Checkboxes name="skills" options={skills.data.items.map((s) => s.id)} />
              <h2>Participation authorization</h2>
              <EvidenceFields policies={policies.data} />
              <Input
                name="duplicateReviewId"
                label="Operator duplicate review reference (if requested)"
              />
            </ActionForm>
          </Card>
        )
      )}
      {created && (
        <p role="status">
          Artisan created.{' '}
          <Link href={`/association/artisans/${created}`}>Open artisan record</Link>
        </p>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}
export function ArtisanRecord({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const resource = useResource<Detail>(`/api/v1/associations/me/artisans/${id}`);
  const policies = useResource<Policy[]>('/api/v1/authorization-policies');
  const value = resource.data;
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={value?.profile.displayName ?? 'Artisan record'}
      description="Profile, declared capacity and participation authorization."
    >
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {value && (
        <>
          <Card className="panel block p-5">
            <h2>Profile and availability</h2>
            <ActionForm
              label="Save artisan profile"
              action={(data) =>
                apiFetch(`/api/v1/associations/me/artisans/${id}`, {
                  method: 'PATCH',
                  body: { ...profile(data), reason: text(data, 'reason') },
                })
              }
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            >
              <div className="settings-grid">
                <ProfileFields initial={value.profile} />
              </div>
              <Input name="reason" label="Reason for profile change" required />
            </ActionForm>
            <h3>Craft skills</h3>
            <ul>
              {value.skills.map((s) => (
                <li key={s.craftSkillId}>{s.craftSkill.name}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <SkillEditor
              id={id}
              selected={value.skills.map((s) => s.craftSkillId)}
              reload={resource.reload}
            />
          </Card>
          <Card className="panel block p-5">
            <h2>Declared capacity</h2>
            <p>
              Record the artisan’s stated availability. Wearable data is never used. Existing
              accepted work is retained when a declaration changes.
            </p>
            <ActionForm
              label="Record declared capacity"
              action={(data) =>
                post(`associations/me/artisans/${id}/capacity`, {
                  craftSkillId: text(data, 'craftSkillId'),
                  quantity: text(data, 'quantity'),
                  unitType: text(data, 'unitType'),
                  effectiveFrom: new Date(text(data, 'effectiveFrom')).toISOString(),
                  effectiveTo: new Date(text(data, 'effectiveTo')).toISOString(),
                  authorizationId: text(data, 'authorizationId'),
                })
              }
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            >
              <Select
                name="craftSkillId"
                label="Craft"
                options={value.skills.map((s) => ({
                  value: s.craftSkillId,
                  label: s.craftSkill.name,
                }))}
              />
              <Input
                name="quantity"
                label="Weekly declared quantity"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="0.01"
                required
              />
              <Select name="unitType" label="Capacity unit" options={['HOURS', 'PIECES']} />
              <Input name="effectiveFrom" label="Effective from" type="datetime-local" required />
              <Input name="effectiveTo" label="Effective to" type="datetime-local" required />
              <Select
                name="authorizationId"
                label="Worker capacity authorization"
                required
                options={[
                  { value: '', label: 'Choose current worker authorization' },
                  ...value.authorizations
                    .filter((a) => !a.withdrawnAt && a.policy.active && a.purpose === 'CAPACITY')
                    .map((a) => ({
                      value: a.id,
                      label: `${humanize(a.purpose)} · ${a.policy.version}`,
                    })),
                ]}
              />
            </ActionForm>
            <ul>
              {value.capacity.map((c) => (
                <li key={c.id}>
                  {c.quantity} {c.unitType} · {new Date(c.effectiveFrom).toLocaleDateString()} –{' '}
                  {new Date(c.effectiveTo).toLocaleDateString()}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </Card>
          <Card className="panel block p-5">
            <h2>Authorization history</h2>
            <p>
              <Link href={`/association/artisans/${id}/history`}>
                Browse complete authorization, capacity and assignment history
              </Link>
            </p>
            {value.authorizations.map((a) => (
              <div key={a.id}>
                <p>
                  {humanize(a.purpose)} · {humanize(a.method)} · {a.policy.version} ·{' '}
                  {a.withdrawnAt ? 'Withdrawn' : a.policy.active ? 'Current' : 'Policy inactive'}
                </p>
                <p>Evidence reference: {a.evidenceReference}</p>
                {!a.withdrawnAt && (
                  <ActionForm
                    label="Record authorization withdrawal"
                    action={(data) =>
                      post(`associations/me/artisans/${id}/authorization/${a.id}/withdraw`, {
                        reason: text(data, 'withdrawalReason'),
                      })
                    }
                    onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  >
                    <Input name="withdrawalReason" label="Withdrawal reason" required />
                  </ActionForm>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
            <details>
              <summary>Record new worker authorization</summary>
              {policies.data && (
                <ActionForm
                  label="Record worker authorization"
                  action={(data) =>
                    post(`associations/me/artisans/${id}/authorization`, evidence(data))
                  }
                  onSuccess={resource.reload}
                >
                  <Select
                    name="purpose"
                    label="Authorization purpose"
                    options={['PARTICIPATION', 'CAPACITY', 'OFFER_DECISION']}
                  />
                  <EvidenceFields policies={policies.data} />
                </ActionForm>
              )}
            </details>
          </Card>
          <Card className="panel block p-5">
            <h2>Coordinator assignment history</h2>
            <ul>
              {value.assignments.map((a) => (
                <li key={a.id}>
                  {a.coordinatorId} · {new Date(a.startedAt).toLocaleDateString()} ·{' '}
                  {a.endedAt ? 'Ended' : 'Current'}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <p>Reassignment and association transfers require an administrator’s review.</p>
          </Card>
          <p>
            An incorrect participation or work-decision record can be disputed through the{' '}
            <Link href="/participant-support">independent NASJ support contact</Link>. An artisan
            without an account can contact NASJ directly; the coordinator should provide the contact
            details during onboarding.
          </p>
        </>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}

            options={skills.data.items.map((s) => s.id)}
          />
          <Input name="skillReason" label="Reason for skill change" required />
        </ActionForm>
      )}
    </details>
  );
}

export function PartnerReview({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const r = useResource<PageData<Pick<Participant, 'id' | 'displayName' | 'region'>>>(
    `/api/v1/operator/organizations/${id}/participants?page=${page}`,
  );
  const [review, setReview] = useState('');
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Participant duplicate review"
      description="Scoped participant references for an assigned partner. Contact and financial information are excluded."
    >
      <ResourceState {...r} retry={r.reload} />
      {r.data?.items.map((p) => (
        <Card key={p.id} className="panel block p-5">
          <h2>{p.displayName}</h2>
          <p>
            {p.region} · Reference: {p.id}
          </p>
          <ActionForm
            label="Record independent duplicate review"
            action={async (d) => {
              const result = (await post(`operator/organizations/${id}/duplicate-reviews`, {
                artisanId: p.id,
                reason: text(d, 'reason'),
              })) as { reviewId: string };
              setReview(result.reviewId);
            }}
          >
            <Input name="reason" label="Review findings and reason" required />
          </ActionForm>
        </Card>
      ))}
      {review && <p role="status">Duplicate review reference: {review}</p>}
      <Pagination data={r.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
    </Workspace>
  );
}

export function RegistryHistory({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<'authorization' | 'capacity' | 'assignments'>('authorization');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const r = useResource<
    PageData<{
      id: string;
      purpose?: string;
      method?: string;
      createdAt?: string;
      quantity?: string;
      unitType?: string;
      coordinatorId?: string;
      startedAt?: string;
      endedAt?: string | null;
      withdrawnAt?: string | null;
      policy?: { version: string };
    }>
  >(`/api/v1/associations/me/artisans/${id}/${kind}?page=${page}`);
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Participant history"
      description="Retained records for your assigned participant, with pagination."
    >
      <p>
        <Link href={`/association/artisans/${id}`}>Back to participant</Link>
      </p>
      <nav className="workspace-tabs" aria-label="History views">
        {(['authorization', 'capacity', 'assignments'] as const).map((k) => (
          <button
            className="button secondary"
            type="button"
            key={k}
            aria-pressed={kind === k}
            onClick={() => {
              setKind(k);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            {humanize(k)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <ResourceState {...r} retry={r.reload} />
      {r.data?.items.map((row) => (
        <Card key={row.id} className="panel block p-5">
          {kind === 'authorization' ? (
            <>
              <h2>{humanize(row.purpose ?? 'Authorization')}</h2>
              <p>
                {humanize(row.method ?? '')} · {row.policy?.version} ·{' '}
                {row.withdrawnAt ? 'Withdrawn' : 'Recorded'}
              </p>
            </>
          ) : kind === 'capacity' ? (
            <h2>
              {row.quantity} {row.unitType}
            </h2>
          ) : (
            <>
              <h2>Coordinator: {row.coordinatorId}</h2>
              <p>{row.endedAt ? 'Ended assignment' : 'Current assignment'}</p>
            </>
          )}
          <p>{new Date(row.createdAt ?? row.startedAt ?? '').toLocaleString()}</p>
        </Card>
      ))}
      <Pagination data={r.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
    </Workspace>
  );
}

export function OperatorActivity() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const r = useResource<
    PageData<{
      id: string;
      action: string;
      targetType: string;
      targetId: string;
      organizationId: string;
      timestamp: string;
    }>
  >(`/api/v1/operator/activity?page=${page}`);
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Assigned account activity"
      description="Scoped activity metadata for your currently assigned approved buyer and partner accounts. Private audit snapshots are excluded."
    >
      <ResourceState {...r} retry={r.reload} />
      {r.data?.items.map((e) => (
        <Card key={e.id} className="panel block p-5">
          <h2>{humanize(e.action.replaceAll('.', ' '))}</h2>
          <p>
            {e.targetType} · Reference: {e.targetId}
          </p>
          <p>{new Date(e.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</p>
        </Card>
      ))}
      {r.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No scoped activity yet.</p>}
      <Pagination data={r.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
    </Workspace>
  );
}
