'use client';
import { NativeSelect } from './ui/native-select';
import { Label } from './ui/label';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { Page, OrganizationView, MeView } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  Workspace,
  ResourceState,
  ActionForm,
  Input,
  Select,
  useResource,
  text,
  humanize,
} from './workspace-ui';
type PrivacyRequest = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  status: string;
  details: string;
  submittedAt: string;
  resolutionNotes: string | null;
  retentionExceptions: string | null;
};
type Audit = {
  id: string;
  action: string;
  actorId: string;
  targetType: string;
  targetId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  reason: string | null;
  organizationId: string | null;
  correlationId: string;
};
type SupportCase = {
  id: string;
  subject: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  organizationId: string | null;
  resolution: string | null;
  assignedToUserId: string | null;
  dueAt: string | null;
  canManage?: boolean;
};
type Consent = {
  id: string;
  purpose: string;
  policyVersion: string;
  decision: boolean;
  collectedAt: string;
  withdrawnAt: string | null;
};
type Preference = { category: string; channel: 'EMAIL'; language: string; optedIn: boolean };
export function Privacy({ admin = false }: { admin?: boolean }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const resource = useResource<Page<PrivacyRequest>>(
    `/api/v1/${admin ? 'admin/privacy-requests' : 'privacy/requests/me'}?page=${page}`,
  );
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={admin ? 'Privacy request review.' : 'Your data and privacy.'}
      description={
        admin
          ? 'Review requests and record outcomes and any retention exceptions.'
          : 'Request a correction, export or deletion and track its progress.'
      }
    >
      {!admin && (
        <div className="settings-grid">
          <section className="panel">
            <h2>Submit a request</h2>
            <ActionForm
              label="Submit privacy request"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(data) =>
                apiFetch('/api/v1/privacy/requests', {
                  method: 'POST',
                  body: { type: text(data, 'type'), details: text(data, 'details') },
                })
              }
            >
              <Select
                name="type"
                label="Request type"
                options={['EXPORT', 'CORRECTION', 'DELETION']}
              />
              <Input name="details" label="Request details" required />
            </ActionForm>
          </section>
          <section className="panel">
            <h2>Personal data export</h2>
            <p>
              Download your own account, membership, artisan and consent records. Required retained
              history is reviewed separately from account deactivation.
            </p>
            <ActionForm
              label="Download my data"
              action={async () => {
                const payload = await apiFetch('/api/v1/privacy/export');
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(
                  new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }),
                );
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = url;
                link.download = 'nasj-personal-data.json';
                link.click();
                setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
              }}
            />
          </section>
          <section className="panel wide">
            <Consents />
          </section>
        </div>
      )}
      <section className="panel section-gap">
        <h2>{admin ? 'Request queue' : 'Your requests'}</h2>
        <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
        <ul className="record-list">
          {resource.data?.items.map((request) => (
            <li key={request.id}>
              <h3>
                {humanize(request.type)} · {humanize(request.status)}
              </h3>
              <p>{request.details}</p>
              <p>Submitted {new Date(request.submittedAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
              {request.resolutionNotes && <p>Resolution: {request.resolutionNotes}</p>}
              {request.retentionExceptions && (
                <p>Retention exceptions: {request.retentionExceptions}</p>
              )}
              {admin && (
                <ActionForm
                  label="Save request review"
                  onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  action={(data) =>
                    apiFetch(`/api/v1/admin/privacy-requests/${request.id}`, {
                      method: 'PATCH',
                      body: {
                        status: text(data, 'status'),
                        resolutionNotes: text(data, 'resolutionNotes'),
                        retentionExceptions: text(data, 'retentionExceptions'),
                      },
                    })
                  }
                >
                  <Select
                    name="status"
                    label="Review status"
                    value={request.status === 'SUBMITTED' ? 'IN_REVIEW' : request.status}
                    options={['IN_REVIEW', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED']}
                  />
                  <Input
                    name="resolutionNotes"
                    label="Resolution notes"
                    value={request.resolutionNotes}
                    required
                  />
                  <Input
                    name="retentionExceptions"
                    label="Applicable retention exceptions"
                    value={request.retentionExceptions}
                  />
                </ActionForm>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No privacy requests.</p>}
        <Pagination data={resource.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
      </section>
    </Workspace>
  );
}
function Consents() {
  const resource = useResource<{ items: Consent[] }>('/api/v1/consents');
  return (
    <>
      <h2>Your consent history</h2>
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      <ul className="record-list">
        {resource.data?.items.map((consent) => (
          <li key={consent.id}>
            <strong>{consent.purpose}</strong>
            <p>
              Policy {consent.policyVersion} ·{' '}
              {consent.withdrawnAt ? 'Withdrawn' : consent.decision ? 'Granted' : 'Declined'}
            </p>
            {consent.decision && !consent.withdrawnAt && (
              <ActionForm
                label="Withdraw consent"
                confirm="Withdraw this consent? Related assistance permissions may be revoked."
                onSuccess={resource.reload}
                action={() => apiFetch(`/api/v1/consents/${consent.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })}
              />
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No consent records yet.</p>}
    </>
  );
}

              }
            >
              <Select
                name="preferredLanguage"
                label="Preferred communication language"

                  { value: 'ar', label: 'العربية' },
                ]}
              />
              <p className="hint">
                The interface currently uses English. French and Arabic interface translations are
                pending.
              </p>
            </ActionForm>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="panel">

              key={JSON.stringify(resource.data)}
              label="Save notification preferences"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(data) =>
                apiFetch('/api/v1/notifications/preferences', {
                  method: 'PUT',
                  body: {
                    items: categories.map((category) => ({
                      category,
                      channel: 'EMAIL',
                      language: language.data?.preferredLanguage ?? 'en',
                      optedIn: data.has(category),
                    })),
                  },
                })
              }
            >
              {categories.map((category) => (
                <label className="check-label" key={category}>
                  <input
                    name={category}
                    type="checkbox"
                    defaultChecked={
                      resource.data?.items.find((item) => item.category === category)?.optedIn ??
                      false
                    }
                  />
                  {humanize(category)}
                </label>
              ))}
              <p className="hint">
                Saving preferences does not indicate notification delivery. Security and
                verification messages follow account policy.
              </p>
            </ActionForm>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </Workspace>
  );
}
export function AuditLog({ organizationId }: { organizationId?: string }) {

export function SupportCases() {
  const [organizationId, setOrganizationId] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const me = useResource<MeView>('/api/v1/me');
  const memberships =
    useResource<Page<OrganizationView & { permissions?: string[] }>>('/api/v1/organizations');
  const resource = useResource<Page<SupportCase>>(
    organizationId === '__platform'
      ? `/api/v1/admin/support/cases?page=${page}`
      : `/api/v1/support/cases?page=${page}${organizationId ? `&organizationId=${encodeURIComponent(organizationId)}` : ''}`,
  );
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Support cases."
      description="Create a private support case and follow its resolution. Organization support staff can review cases within their assigned scope."
    >
      <div className="settings-grid">
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Create a case</h2>
          <ActionForm
            label="Create support case"
            onSuccess={resource.reload}
            action={(data) =>
              apiFetch('/api/v1/support/cases', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: {
                  subject: text(data, 'subject'),
                  description: text(data, 'description'),
                  ...(organizationId && organizationId !== '__platform' ? { organizationId } : {}),
                },
              })
            }
          >
            <Input name="subject" label="Subject" required />
            <Input name="description" label="What do you need help with?" required />
          </ActionForm>
          <p>
            <Link href="/support/privacy">Manage personal-data requests</Link>
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Case scope</h2>
          <label className="field">
            <span className="label">View cases for</span>
            <select
              aria-label="View cases for"
              value={organizationId}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setOrganizationId(event.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
            >
              <option value="">My personal cases</option>
              {me.data?.user.role === 'ADMIN' && (
                <option value="__platform">Platform account support</option>
              )}
              {memberships.data?.items.map((org) => (
                <option key={org.id} value={org.id}>
                  {org.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <p>The server checks your organization support permissions before returning cases.</p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel wide">
          <h2>Cases</h2>
          <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
          <ul className="record-list">
            {resource.data?.items.map((item) => (
              <li key={item.id}>
                <h3>{item.subject}</h3>
                <p>{item.description}</p>
                <p>{humanize(item.status)}</p>
                {item.resolution && <p>Resolution: {item.resolution}</p>}
                {item.canManage && (
                  <ActionForm
                    label="Update support case"
                    onSuccess={resource.reload}
                    action={(data) =>
                      apiFetch(`/api/v1/support/cases/${item.id}`, {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        body: {
                          status: text(data, 'status'),
                          resolution: text(data, 'resolution'),
                          ...(data.has('assignSelf') ? { assignedToUserId: me.data?.user.id } : {}),
                          ...(text(data, 'dueAt')
                            ? { dueAt: new Date(text(data, 'dueAt')).toISOString() }
                            : {}),
                        },
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    <Select
                      name="status"
                      label="Case status"
                      value={item.status}
                      options={['OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED']}
                    />
                    <Input name="resolution" label="Resolution notes" value={item.resolution} />
                    <Input name="dueAt" label="Response due" type="datetime-local" />
                    <label className="check-label">
                      <input type="checkbox" name="assignSelf" />
                      Assign this case to me
                    </label>
                  </ActionForm>
                )}
                {item.canManage && (
                  <ActionForm
                    label="Send case update email"
                    successMessage="Email accepted by the mail service. Delivery is not confirmed."
                    action={async () => {
                      const response = await apiFetch<{ status: string; delivered: boolean }>(
                        `/api/v1/support/cases/${item.id}/notify`,
                        { method: 'POST' },
                      );
                      if (response.status !== 'ACCEPTED_BY_SMTP')
                        throw new Error(
                          'Notification was not accepted for sending. Check recipient preferences and email service configuration.',
                        );
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No support cases found.</p>}
          <Pagination data={resource.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
        </section>
      </div>
    </Workspace>
  );
}
export function AdminOrganizations({ pending = false, id }: { pending?: boolean; id?: string }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [type, setType] = useState('');
  const resource = useResource<Page<OrganizationView> | OrganizationView>(
    id
      ? `/api/v1/admin/organizations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`
      : `/api/v1/admin/organizations${pending ? '/pending' : ''}?page=${page}${!pending && type ? `&type=${type}` : ''}`,
  );
  const items = resource.data
    ? 'items' in resource.data
      ? resource.data.items
      : [resource.data]
    : undefined;
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={pending ? 'Organization approvals.' : 'Organization administration.'}
      description="Review organization profiles and record approval decisions with a reason."
    >
      <nav className="workspace-tabs">
        <Link href="/admin/organizations">All organizations</Link>
        <Link href="/admin/approvals">Pending approval</Link>
        <Link href="/admin/users">User accounts</Link>
        <Link href="/admin/audit">Audit history</Link>
        <Link href="/admin/privacy-requests">Privacy requests</Link>
      </nav>
      {!id && !pending && (
        <div className="field">
          <Label htmlFor="organization-type-filter">Organization type</Label>
          <NativeSelect
            id="organization-type-filter"
            value={type}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setType(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            <option value="">All organization types</option>
            {['BUYER_BUSINESS', 'ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE', 'INTERNAL'].map((t) => (
              <option key={t} value={t}>
                {humanize(t)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </div>
      )}
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      <ul className="record-list">
        {items?.map((org) => (
          <li className="panel" key={org.id}>
            <h2>{org.name}</h2>
            <p>
              {humanize(org.type)} · {humanize(org.approvalStatus)}
            </p>
            <p>{org.description}</p>
            <p>
              {org.representativeName} · {org.contactEmail} · {org.region}
            </p>
            {org.approvalReason && <p>Latest review: {org.approvalReason}</p>}
            {['PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'SUSPENDED'].includes(org.approvalStatus) && (
              <ActionForm
                label="Record approval decision"
                confirm="Apply this organization approval decision?"
                onSuccess={resource.reload}
                action={(data) =>
                  apiFetch(`/api/v1/admin/organizations/${org.id}/${text(data, 'decision')}`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: { reason: text(data, 'reason') },
                  })
                }
              >
                <Select
                  name="decision"
                  label={`Decision for ${org.name}`}
                  options={
                    org.approvalStatus === 'PENDING_REVIEW'
                      ? ['approve', 'reject']
                      : org.approvalStatus === 'APPROVED'
                        ? ['suspend']
                        : ['approve']
                  }
                />
                <Input name="reason" label="Review reason" required />
              </ActionForm>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {items?.length === 0 && <p>No organizations found.</p>}
      <Pagination
        data={resource.data && 'items' in resource.data ? resource.data : null}
        page={page}
        change={setPage}
      />
    </Workspace>
  );
}
export function Pagination({
  data,
  page,
  change,
}: {
  data: { total: number; pageSize: number } | null;
  page: number;
  change: (page: number) => void;
}) {
  if (!data || data.total <= data.pageSize) return null;
  return (
    <nav className="pagination" aria-label="Results pages">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="button secondary"
        disabled={page === 1}
        onClick={() => change(page - 1)}
      >
        Previous
      </button>
      <span>
        Page {page} · {data.total} results
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="button secondary"
        disabled={page * data.pageSize >= data.total}
        onClick={() => change(page + 1)}
      >
        Next
      </button>
    </nav>
  );
}

===== apps\web\src\components\logout-button.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import { Button } from './ui/button';
import { LogOut } from 'lucide-react';
import { DropdownMenu } from 'radix-ui';
export function LogoutButton({ menuItem = false }: { menuItem?: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const button = (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant="ghost"
      className="w-full justify-start text-muted-foreground"
      disabled={pending}
      onClick={async () => {
        setPending(true);
        setError('');
        try {
          await apiFetch('/api/auth/sign-out', { method: 'POST' });
          router.replace('/auth/login');
          router.refresh();
        } catch {
          setError('Unable to sign out. Try again.');
          setPending(false);
        }
      }}
    >
      <LogOut size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
      {pending ? 'Signing out…' : 'Sign out'}
    </Button>
  );
  return (
    <span>
      {menuItem ? (
        <DropdownMenu.Item asChild onSelect={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
          {button}
        </DropdownMenu.Item>
      ) : (
        button
      )}
      {error && <span role="alert">{error}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\mfa-settings.tsx =====

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import { Workspace, ResourceState, ActionForm, Input, useResource, text } from './workspace-ui';
type Security = {
  sessionVerified: boolean;
  twoFactorEnabled: boolean;
  privilegedMfaRequired: boolean;
  hasPrivilegedAccess: boolean;
};
type Enrollment = { totpURI: string; backupCodes: string[] };
export function MfaSettings() {
  const resource = useResource<Security>('/api/v1/settings/security');
  const [enrollment, setEnrollment] = useState<Enrollment | null>(null);
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Account security."
      description="Protect your account with an authenticator app and recovery codes."
    >
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {resource.data && (
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Two-factor authentication</h2>
          <p>
            {resource.data.twoFactorEnabled
              ? 'Two-factor authentication is enabled.'
              : 'Two-factor authentication is not enabled.'}
          </p>
          {resource.data.privilegedMfaRequired && (
            <p className="notice">
              Two-factor authentication is required for privileged actions. Complete enrollment
              before managing organization access or administration.
            </p>
          )}
          {!resource.data.twoFactorEnabled && !enrollment && (
            <ActionForm
              label="Set up authenticator"
              action={async (data) =>
                setEnrollment(
                  await apiFetch<Enrollment>('/api/auth/two-factor/enable', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: { password: text(data, 'password') },
                  }),
                )
              }
            >
              <Input name="password" label="Current password" type="password" required />
            </ActionForm>
          )}
          {enrollment && (
            <>
              <h3>Add to your authenticator</h3>
              <p>Import this setup URI into your authenticator app. Keep it private.</p>
              <label className="field">
                <span className="label">Authenticator setup URI</span>
                <input readOnly value={enrollment.totpURI} autoComplete="off" />
              </label>
              <h3>Save your recovery codes</h3>
              <p>
                Store these codes somewhere private. Each code can be used once if you lose access
                to the authenticator.
              </p>
              <pre className="recovery-codes">{enrollment.backupCodes.join('\n')}</pre>
              <ActionForm
                label="Confirm authenticator code"
                action={async (data) => {
                  await apiFetch('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: { code: text(data, 'code') },
                  });
                  setEnrollment(null);
                  await resource.reload();
                }}
              >
                <Input name="code" label="Six-digit authenticator code" required />
              </ActionForm>
            </>
          )}
          {resource.data.twoFactorEnabled && !resource.data.sessionVerified && (
            <ActionForm
              label="Verify this session"
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
              action={(data) =>
                apiFetch('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp', {
                  method: 'POST',
                  body: { code: text(data, 'code') },
                })
              }
            >
              <Input name="code" label="Authenticator code for this session" required />
            </ActionForm>
          )}
          {resource.data.twoFactorEnabled &&
            resource.data.hasPrivilegedAccess &&
            resource.data.privilegedMfaRequired && (
              <p>Your privileged access requires two-factor authentication to remain enabled.</p>
            )}
          {resource.data.twoFactorEnabled &&
            !(resource.data.hasPrivilegedAccess && resource.data.privilegedMfaRequired) && (
              <ActionForm
                label="Disable two-factor authentication"
                confirm="Disable two-factor authentication? Privileged operations will require re-enrollment."
                onSuccess={resource.reload}
                action={(data) =>
                  apiFetch('/api/auth/two-factor/disable', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: { password: text(data, 'password') },
                  })
                }
              >
                <Input
                  name="password"
                  label="Password to disable two-factor authentication"
                  type="password"
                  required
                />
              </ActionForm>
            )}
        </section>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\components\organizations.tsx =====

'use client';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AuthForm } from './auth-form';
import type {
  OrganizationMembershipView,
  OrganizationListView,
  OrganizationMemberView,
  InvitationView,
  Page,
  BusinessRole,
  MeView,
} from '@nasj/contracts';
import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import { Pagination } from './governance';
import {
  Workspace,
  ResourceState,
  ActionForm,
  Input,
  Select,
  Checkboxes,
  useResource,
  humanize,
  text,
} from './workspace-ui';

type Detail = OrganizationMembershipView & {
  permissions: string[];
  assignableRoles: BusinessRole[];
};
const organizationFields = [
  'name',
  'representativeName',
  'country',
  'region',
  'description',
  'contactEmail',
  'contactPhone',
] as const;
const fieldLabels = {
  name: 'Organization name',
  representativeName: 'Authorized representative',
  country: 'Country',
  region: 'Region',
  description: 'Organization description',
  contactEmail: 'Contact email',
  contactPhone: 'Contact phone',
};
function OrganizationFields({ initial }: { initial?: OrganizationMembershipView }) {
  return (
    <>
      {organizationFields.map((field) => (
        <Input
          key={field}
          name={field}
          label={fieldLabels[field]}
          value={initial?.[field] ?? (field === 'country' ? 'Tunisia' : '')}
          required={field !== 'contactPhone'}
          type={field === 'contactEmail' ? 'email' : 'text'}
        />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
function organizationInput(data: FormData) {
  return Object.fromEntries(organizationFields.map((field) => [field, text(data, field)]));
}
export function Organizations() {
  const me = useResource<MeView>('/api/v1/me');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const resource = useResource<Page<OrganizationListView>>(`/api/v1/organizations?page=${page}`);
  const router = useRouter();
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Your organizations."
      description="Work with a buyer business or association. Each membership has its own access and roles."
    >
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      <div className="settings-grid">
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Your memberships</h2>
          {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>You have no organization memberships yet.</p>}

            {resource.data?.items.map((org) => (
              <li key={org.id}>
                <h3>{org.name}</h3>
                <p>
                  {humanize(org.approvalStatus)} · Membership {humanize(org.myMembership.status)}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {org.myMembership.roles.map(humanize).join(', ')}
                  {org.myMembership.isManager ? ' · Organization manager' : ''}
                </p>
                <Link className="button secondary" href={`/organizations/${org.id}/settings`}>
                  Open organization
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <Pagination data={resource.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
        </section>
        <section className="panel">

          <ActionForm
            label="Create organization"

                method: 'POST',

            }}
          >
            <Select
              name="type"
              label="Organization type"
              options={
                me.data?.user.role === 'ADMIN'
                  ? ['BUYER_BUSINESS', 'ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE', 'INTERNAL']
                  : ['BUYER_BUSINESS', 'ASSOCIATION', 'PARTNER_COOPERATIVE']
              }
            />
            <OrganizationFields />
          </ActionForm>
        </section>
      </div>
    </Workspace>
  );
}
export function OrganizationSettings({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const path = `/api/v1/organizations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
  const resource = useResource<Detail>(path);
  const org = resource.data;
  const permissions = org?.permissions ?? [];
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={org?.name ?? 'Organization.'}
      description="Manage organization details, access and approval."
    >
      <p>
        <Link href="/settings/organizations">All organizations</Link>
      </p>
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {org && (
        <>
          <p className="badge">
            Approval: {humanize(org.approvalStatus)} · Your membership:{' '}
            {humanize(org.myMembership.status)}
          </p>
          {org.approvalReason && <p>Latest review: {org.approvalReason}</p>}
          <div className="settings-grid">
            <section className="panel">
              <h2>Organization profile</h2>
              {permissions.includes('organization.update') &&
              ['DRAFT', 'REJECTED'].includes(org.approvalStatus) ? (
                <ActionForm
                  key={org.updatedAt}
                  label="Save organization"
                  onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  action={(data) =>
                    apiFetch(path, { method: 'PATCH', body: organizationInput(data) })
                  }
                >
                  <OrganizationFields initial={org} />
                </ActionForm>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <p>{org.description}</p>
                  <p>
                    {org.region}, {org.country}
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    {org.contactEmail}
                    {org.contactPhone ? ` · ${org.contactPhone}` : ''}
                  </p>
                  <p>Authorized representative: {org.representativeName}</p>
                  <p className="hint">
                    Organization details are locked during and after approval review. Contact
                    support if a correction is needed.
                  </p>
                </>
              )}
            </section>
            <section className="panel">
              <h2>Approval and membership</h2>
              {permissions.includes('audit.read') && (
                <p>
                  <Link href={`/organizations/${id}/audit`}>Organization audit history</Link>
                </p>
              )}
              <p>
                Approval is required before restricted organization operations become available.
              </p>
              {permissions.includes('organization.approval.request') &&
                ['DRAFT', 'REJECTED'].includes(org.approvalStatus) && (
                  <ActionForm
                    label="Request approval"
                    onSuccess={resource.reload}
                    action={() => apiFetch(`${path}/submit-approval`, { method: 'POST' })}
                  />
                )}
              {org.myMembership.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                <ActionForm
                  label="Leave organization"
                  confirm="Leave this organization? Its permissions will be removed immediately."
                  onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  action={() =>
                    apiFetch(`${path}/members/${org.myMembership.id}`, {
                      method: 'DELETE',
                      body: { reason: 'Member chose to leave organization.' },
                    })
                  }
                />
              )}
            </section>
            {permissions.includes('organization.members.read') && (
              <section className="panel wide">
                <Members
                  path={path}
                  canUpdate={permissions.includes('organization.members.update')}
                  canAssign={permissions.includes('organization.roles.assign')}
                  canRemove={permissions.includes('organization.members.remove')}
                  roles={org.assignableRoles}
                />
              </section>
            )}
            {permissions.includes('organization.members.invite') && (
              <section className="panel wide">
                <Invitations path={path} roles={org.assignableRoles} />
              </section>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}
function Members({
  path,
  canUpdate,
  canAssign,
  canRemove,
  roles,
}: {
  path: string;
  canUpdate: boolean;
  canAssign: boolean;
  canRemove: boolean;
  roles: BusinessRole[];
}) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const resource = useResource<Page<OrganizationMemberView>>(`${path}/members?page=${page}`);
  return (
    <>
      <h2>Members</h2>
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {resource.data?.items.length === 0 && <p>No members found.</p>}
      <ul className="record-list">
        {resource.data?.items.map((member) => (
          <li key={`${member.id}-${member.status}-${member.roles.join()}`}>
            <h3>{member.user.name}</h3>
            <p>
              {member.user.email} · {humanize(member.status)}
              {member.isManager ? ' · Organization manager' : ''}
            </p>
            <p>{member.roles.map(humanize).join(', ') || 'No business roles'}</p>
            {canUpdate && (
              <details>
                <summary>Change membership access</summary>
                <ActionForm
                  label="Update membership"
                  confirm="Apply this membership access change?"
                  onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  action={(data) =>
                    apiFetch(`${path}/members/${member.id}`, {
                      method: 'PATCH',
                      body: {
                        status: text(data, 'status'),
                        isManager: data.has('isManager'),
                        reason: text(data, 'reason'),
                      },
                    })
                  }
                >
                  <Select
                    name="status"
                    label={`Membership status for ${member.user.name}`}
                    value={member.status}
                    options={['ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'REVOKED', 'LEFT']}
                  />
                  <Checkboxes
                    name="isManager"
                    options={['Organization manager']}
                    selected={member.isManager ? ['Organization manager'] : []}
                  />
                  <Input name="reason" label="Reason for access change" required />
                </ActionForm>
              </details>
            )}
            {canAssign &&
              member.roles.some((r) => ['BUYER', 'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'].includes(r)) && (
                <details>
                  <summary>Quotation approval authority</summary>
                  <p>
                    Current authority:{' '}
                    {member.explicitPermissions?.includes('buyer.quotation.approve')
                      ? 'Authorized'
                      : 'Not authorized'}
                  </p>
                  <ActionForm
                    label="Save quotation approval authority"
                    action={(data) =>
                      apiFetch(`${path}/members/${member.id}/permissions`, {
                        method: 'PUT',
                        body: {
                          permission: 'buyer.quotation.approve',
                          enabled: text(data, 'enabled') === 'true',
                          reason: text(data, 'approvalReason'),
                        },
                      })
                    }
                    onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  >
                    <Select
                      name="enabled"
                      label="Quotation approval access"
                      options={[
                        { value: 'true', label: 'Authorize approval' },
                        { value: 'false', label: 'Revoke approval' },
                      ]}
                    />
                    <Input
                      name="approvalReason"
                      label="Approval authority review reason"
                      required
                    />
                  </ActionForm>
                </details>
              )}
            {canAssign &&
              member.roles.some((r) => ['BUYER', 'BUYER_REPRESENTATIVE'].includes(r)) && (
                <details>
                  <summary>Purchasing and negotiation authority</summary>
                  <ActionForm
                    label="Save purchasing authority"
                    action={(data) =>
                      apiFetch(`${path}/members/${member.id}/permissions`, {
                        method: 'PUT',
                        body: {
                          permission: text(data, 'purchasingPermission'),
                          enabled: text(data, 'purchasingEnabled') === 'true',
                          reason: text(data, 'purchasingReason'),
                        },
                      })
                    }
                    onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  >
                    <Select
                      name="purchasingPermission"
                      label="Purchasing permission"
                      options={[
                        { value: 'buyer.rfq.create', label: 'Prepare and submit RFQs' },
                        { value: 'buyer.quotation.negotiate', label: 'Negotiate quotations' },
                      ]}
                    />
                    <Select
                      name="purchasingEnabled"
                      label="Purchasing access"
                      options={[
                        { value: 'true', label: 'Authorize' },
                        { value: 'false', label: 'Remove authority' },
                      ]}
                    />
                    <Input
                      name="purchasingReason"
                      label="Purchasing authority review reason"
                      required
                    />
                  </ActionForm>
                </details>
              )}
            {canAssign && (
              <details>
                <summary>Manage business roles</summary>
                <ActionForm
                  label="Save roles"
                  confirm="Apply these role assignments?"
                  onSuccess={resource.reload}
                  action={(data) =>
                    apiFetch(`${path}/members/${member.id}/roles`, {
                      method: 'PUT',
                      body: { roles: data.getAll('roles'), reason: text(data, 'reason') },
                    })

                  <Input name="reason" label="Reason for role change" required />
                </ActionForm>
              </details>
            )}

              <ActionForm
                label="Remove membership"
                confirm={`Remove ${member.user.name} from this organization?`}
                onSuccess={resource.reload}
                action={() =>

                    method: 'DELETE',
                    body: { reason: 'Organization manager removed membership.' },
                  })
                }
              />
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <Pagination data={resource.data} page={page} change={setPage} />
    </>

export function AcceptInvitation() {
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<{ user: { email: string } } | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const [sessionError, setSessionError] = useState('');
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'login' | 'register'>('login');
  const [registrationMessage, setRegistrationMessage] = useState('');
  const initialized = useRef(false);
  const checkSession = useCallback(async () => {
    setSessionError('');
    try {
      setSession(await apiFetch<{ user: { email: string } } | null>('/api/auth/get-session'));
    } catch (failure) {
      setSessionError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Unable to check sign-in.');
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialized.current) return;
    initialized.current = true;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    const invitationToken = new URLSearchParams(url.hash.slice(1)).get('token') ?? '';
    url.hash = '';
    url.searchParams.delete('token');
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.pathname + url.search);
    setToken(invitationToken);
    void checkSession();
  }, [checkSession]);
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Join your organization."
      description="Accept your invitation using the verified account with the invited email address."
    >
      {done ? (
        <p className="notice success" role="status">
          Invitation accepted. <Link href="/settings/organizations">Open your organizations</Link>.
        </p>
      ) : !token ? (
        <p>Open the invitation link from your email to continue.</p>
      ) : sessionError ? (
        <ResourceState loading={false} error={sessionError} retry={checkSession} />
      ) : session === undefined ? (
        <p role="status">Checking sign-in…</p>
      ) : session ? (
        <section className="panel">
          <p>
            Signed in as <strong>{session.user.email}</strong>.
          </p>
          <ActionForm
            label="Accept invitation"
            successMessage=""
            action={async () => {
              await apiFetch('/api/v1/invitations/accept', { method: 'POST', body: { token } });
              setToken('');
              setDone(true);
            }}
          />
          <ActionForm
            label="Use a different account"
            successMessage=""
            action={async () => {
              await apiFetch('/api/auth/sign-out', { method: 'POST' });
              setSession(null);
              setMode('login');
            }}
          />
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section className="panel invitation-auth">
          <p>
            Keep this page open while you sign in. Your invitation stays here until you accept it.
          </p>
          {registrationMessage && (
            <p className="notice success" role="status">
              {registrationMessage}
            </p>
          )}
          <AuthForm
            key={mode}
            mode={mode}
            next="/invitations/accept"
            embedded
            onAuthenticated={checkSession}
            onRegistered={() => {
              setMode('login');
              setRegistrationMessage(
                'If this address is eligible, a verification email has been sent. Open it in another tab, complete verification, then sign in here to accept your invitation.',
              );
            }}
          />
          <nav className="auth-links" aria-label="Invitation account options">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="text-button"
              onClick={() => {
                setMode(mode === 'login' ? 'register' : 'login');
                setRegistrationMessage('');
              }}
            >
              {mode === 'login' ? 'Create an account here' : 'I already have an account'}
            </button>
            <Link href="/auth/verify-email" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
              Verify or resend email in another tab
            </Link>
            <Link href="/auth/forgot-password" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
              Reset your password in another tab
            </Link>
          </nav>
        </section>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

import { z } from 'zod';

import { apiFetch, ApiError } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  Workspace,
  ResourceState,
  ActionForm,
  Input,
  Select,
  useResource,
  text,
  humanize,
  useFieldError,
} from './workspace-ui';

import { Textarea } from './ui/textarea';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from './ui/tabs';
const root = '/api/v1/procurement';
function useCommand() {
  const keys = useRef(new Map<string, string>());
  return async <T = unknown>(path: string, body: unknown, schema?: z.ZodType): Promise<T> => {
    if (schema) {
      const parsed = schema.safeParse(body);
      if (!parsed.success)
        throw new ApiError(400, {
          code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Check the highlighted fields.',
          fieldErrors: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors as Record<string, string[]>,
        });
      body = parsed.data;
    }
    const signature = JSON.stringify({ path, body });
    const key = keys.current.get(signature) ?? crypto.randomUUID();
    keys.current.set(signature, key);
    const result = await apiFetch<T>(root + path, { method: 'POST', body, idempotencyKey: key });
    keys.current.delete(signature);
    return result;
  };
}
function LongText({

      />
      {errors.length > 0 && (

  );
}
