function Attachment({
  id,
  file,
  canRemove,
  version,
  reload,
}: {
  id: string;
  file: C.ProcurementDetail['attachments'][number];
  canRemove: boolean;
  version: number;
  reload: () => unknown;
}) {
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(''),
    [error, setError] = useState(''),
    send = useCommand();
  return (
    <li>
      <span>{file.filename}</span>
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        onClick={async () => {
          setError('');
          try {
            const { token } = await apiFetch<{ token: string }>(
              `${root}/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${file.id}/token`,
            );
            const image = await apiFetch<{ mime: string; base64: string }>(
              `${root}/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${file.id}/content?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`,
            );
            setPreview(`data:${image.mime};base64,${image.base64}`);
          } catch (e) {
            setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to load the image.');
          }
        }}
      >
        Preview {file.filename}
      </Button>
      {preview && (
        <Image
          unoptimized
          width={512}
          height={384}
          src={preview}
          alt={`Reference: ${file.filename}`}
          className="procurement-preview"
        />
      )}
      {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
      {canRemove && (
        <ActionForm
          label={`Remove ${file.filename}`}
          action={() => send(`/rfqs/${id}/attachments/${file.id}/remove`, { version })}
          onSuccess={reload}
        />
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
function Upload({ id, version, reload }: { id: string; version: number; reload: () => unknown }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState(0),
    [preview, setPreview] = useState(''),
    inputId = useId(),
    send = useCommand();
  return (
    <ActionForm
      label="Upload reference image"
      action={async () => {
        if (!file) throw new Error('Choose an image first.');
        if (!['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 262144)
          throw new Error('Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP under 256 KiB.');
        setProgress(0);
        const base64 = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onprogress = (e) => {
            if (e.lengthComputable) setProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 40));
          };
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Unable to read the image.'));
          reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result).split(',')[1]);
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
        setProgress(50);
        try {
          await send(
            `/rfqs/${id}/attachments`,
            { version, filename: file.name, mime: file.type, base64 },
            C.procurementAttachmentSchema,
          );
          setProgress(100);
          setFile(null);
          setPreview('');
          await reload();
        } catch (e) {
          setProgress(0);
          throw e;
        }
      }}
    >
      <p>
        Up to five PNG, JPEG or WebP images, 256 KiB each. Images are inspected, resized and stored
        privately.
      </p>
      <Label htmlFor={inputId}>Reference image</Label>
      <input
        id={inputId}
        type="file"
        accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const chosen = e.target.files?.[0] ?? null;
          setFile(chosen);
          setPreview('');
          setProgress(0);
          if (
            chosen &&
            chosen.size <= 262144 &&
            ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(chosen.type)
          ) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = () => setPreview(String(reader.result));
            reader.readAsDataURL(chosen);
          }
        }}
      />
      {preview && (
        <Image
          unoptimized
          width={512}
          height={384}
          src={preview}
          alt="Selected reference"
          className="procurement-preview"
        />
      )}
      <progress aria-label="Image upload progress" value={progress} max={100} />
      <p role="status">
        {progress === 100
          ? 'Uploaded'
          : progress > 0
            ? 'Uploading image…'
            : 'Choose an image to upload.'}
      </p>
    </ActionForm>
  );
}
export function ProcurementDetail({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const resource = useResource<C.ProcurementDetail>(`${root}/rfqs/${id}`),
    options = useResource<C.ProcurementList>(`${root}/rfqs`),
    send = useCommand(),
    data = resource.data;
  return (
    <Workspace
      title={data?.rfq.title ?? 'Request details'}
      description="The specification and every decision stay linked to this request."
    >
      <Nav />
      <Disclosure />
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {data &&
        (() => {
          const r = data.rfq,
            a = data.access,
            latest = data.samples[0];
          return (
            <>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <Badge variant="outline">{humanize(r.status)}</Badge>
                <span>Version {r.version}</span>
                {r.sourceProductId && <span>Reorder · new feasibility required</span>}
              </div>
              <Tabs defaultValue="details">
                <TabsList
                  className="procurement-tabs w-full flex-wrap justify-start gap-1 group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/tabs:h-auto"
                  aria-label="Request sections"
                >
                  {[
                    'details',
                    'references',
                    'activity',
                    'revisions',
                    'clarifications',
                    'samples',
                    'quotes',
                    'discussion',
                    'documents',
                  ].map((t) => (
                    <TabsTrigger key={t} value={t}>
                      {humanize(t)}
                    </TabsTrigger>
                  ))}
                </TabsList>
                <TabsContent value="details">
                  <Panel title="Specification">
                    <p>{r.specification}</p>
                    <p>{r.designRequirements}</p>
                    <dl>
                      <dt>Quantity</dt>
                      <dd>{r.quantity} pieces</dd>
                      <dt>Delivery deadline</dt>
                      <dd>{new Date(r.deliveryAt).toLocaleString()}</dd>
                      <dt>Destination</dt>
                      <dd>{r.deliveryLocation}</dd>
                    </dl>
                    {a.purchasing && r.status === 'DRAFT' && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Submit for review"
                        confirm="Submit this exact version? It will no longer be editable as a draft."
                        action={() => send(`/rfqs/${id}/submit`, { version: r.version })}
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      />
                    )}
                    {a.operator && r.status === 'SUBMITTED' && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Start review"
                        action={() => send(`/rfqs/${id}/review`, { version: r.version })}
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      />
                    )}
                    {a.purchasing &&
                      a.negotiating &&
                      !['ACCEPTED', 'DECLINED'].includes(r.status) && (
                        <details key={r.version}>
                          <summary>
                            {r.status === 'DRAFT'
                              ? 'Edit draft'
                              : 'Propose a revised specification'}
                          </summary>
                          <p>
                            A revision keeps previous terms and requires a fresh quote and sample
                            sign-off. Accepted obligations require a separate amendment.
                          </p>
                          <ActionForm
                            label="Save revision"
                            action={(f) =>
                              send(
                                `/rfqs/${id}/revisions`,
                                { ...fields(f), version: r.version, reason: text(f, 'reason') },
                                C.procurementReviseSchema,
                              )
                            }
                            onSuccess={resource.reload}
                          >
                            <RequestFields
                              row={r}
                              crafts={
                                options.data?.crafts ?? [
                                  { id: r.craftSkillId, name: r.craftSkillId },
                                ]
                              }
                            />
                            <LongText name="reason" label="Reason for revision" />
                          </ActionForm>
                        </details>
                      )}
                    {r.status === 'ACCEPTED' && (
                      <p>
                        Accepted terms are preserved. Changes require the contract amendment
                        workflow; create a separate request for a new obligation.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </Panel>
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="references">
                  <Panel title="Reference images">
                    <ul className="procurement-list">
                      {data.attachments.map((f) => (
                        <Attachment
                          key={f.id}
                          id={id}
                          file={f}
                          canRemove={a.purchasing && r.status === 'DRAFT'}
                          version={r.version}
                          reload={resource.reload}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                    {!data.attachments.length && <p>No reference images yet.</p>}
                    {a.purchasing && r.status === 'DRAFT' && data.attachments.length < 5 && (
                      <Upload id={id} version={r.version} reload={resource.reload} />
                    )}
                  </Panel>
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="activity">
                  <History id={id} kind="activity" />
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="revisions">
                  <History id={id} kind="revisions" />
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="clarifications">
                  <Panel title="Feasibility questions">
                    {a.operator && !['ACCEPTED', 'DECLINED'].includes(r.status) && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Ask a question"
                        action={(f) =>
                          send(
                            `/rfqs/${id}/questions`,
                            { question: text(f, 'question') },
                            C.procurementQuestionSchema,
                          )
                        }
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      >
                        <LongText name="question" label="Question" />
                      </ActionForm>
                    )}
                    {!data.questions.length && <p>No clarification questions.</p>}
                    {data.questions.map((q) => (
                      <article key={q.id}>
                        <h3>{q.question}</h3>
                        <p>{new Date(q.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
                        {q.answer ? (
                          <p>Buyer answer: {q.answer}</p>
                        ) : a.negotiating && !['ACCEPTED', 'DECLINED'].includes(r.status) ? (
                          <ActionForm
                            label="Send answer"
                            action={(f) =>
                              send(
                                `/rfqs/${id}/questions/${q.id}/answer`,
                                { answer: text(f, 'answer') },
                                C.procurementAnswerSchema,
                              )
                            }
                            onSuccess={resource.reload}
                          >
                            <LongText name="answer" label="Your answer" />
                          </ActionForm>
                        ) : (
                          <p>Awaiting buyer answer.</p>
                        )}
                      </article>
                    ))}
                  </Panel>
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="samples">
                  <Panel title="Sample review">
                    <p>
                      {data.currentSampleApproved
                        ? 'Latest sample and specification approved.'
                        : 'Full production requires approval of the latest sample and specification.'}
                    </p>
                    {a.operator && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Publish sample version"
                        action={(f) =>
                          send(
                            `/rfqs/${id}/samples`,
                            {
                              version: r.version,
                              evidenceReference: text(f, 'evidenceReference'),
                              criteria: text(f, 'criteria'),
                            },
                            C.procurementSampleSchema,
                          )
                        }
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      >
                        <LongText name="evidenceReference" label="Sample evidence reference" />
                        <LongText name="criteria" label="Sample acceptance criteria" />
                      </ActionForm>
                    )}
                    {!data.samples.length && <p>No sample evidence has been published.</p>}
                    {data.samples.map((s) => (
                      <article key={s.id}>
                        <h3>Sample v{s.version}</h3>
                        <p>Evidence: {s.evidenceReference}</p>
                        <p>Criteria: {s.criteria}</p>
                        <p>Specification: {String(s.snapshot.specification)}</p>
                        <p>Published {new Date(s.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
                        {s.decision ? (
                          <p>
                            {humanize(s.decision.decision)} · Signatory {s.decision.actorId} ·{' '}
                            {new Date(s.decision.createdAt).toLocaleString()} ·{' '}
                            {s.decision.comments}
                          </p>
                        ) : (
                          <p>Awaiting authorized buyer review.</p>
                        )}
                        {a.approving &&
                          s.id === latest?.id &&
                          !s.decision &&
                          s.revisionId === data.revisions[0]?.id && (
                            <ActionForm
                              label="Record sample decision"
                              action={(f) =>
                                send(
                                  `/rfqs/${id}/sample-decisions`,
                                  {
                                    version: r.version,
                                    sampleId: s.id,
                                    decision: text(f, 'decision'),
                                    comments: text(f, 'comments'),
                                  },
                                  C.procurementDecisionSchema,
                                )
                              }
                              onSuccess={resource.reload}
                            >
                              <Select
                                name="decision"
                                label="Sample decision"
                                options={['APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'REJECTED']}
                              />
                              <LongText name="comments" label="Decision comments" />
                            </ActionForm>
                          )}
                      </article>
                    ))}
                  </Panel>
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="quotes">
                  <Panel title="Quotation">
                    {a.negotiating && r.status === 'QUOTED' && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Decline quotation"
                        confirm="Decline this quotation?"
                        action={() =>
                          send(`/rfqs/${id}/close`, { version: r.version, next: 'DECLINED' })
                        }
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      />
                    )}
                    {a.operator &&
                      r.status === 'QUOTED' &&
                      data.quotes[0] &&
                      new Date(data.quotes[0].expiresAt) <= new Date() && (
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Record expired quotation"
                          action={() =>
                            send(`/rfqs/${id}/close`, { version: r.version, next: 'EXPIRED' })
                          }
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                      )}
                    {a.operator && ['UNDER_REVIEW', 'QUOTED'].includes(r.status) && (
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Issue quotation"
                        action={(f) =>
                          send(
                            `/rfqs/${id}/quotes`,
                            {
                              version: r.version,
                              totalTnd: text(f, 'totalTnd'),
                              expiresAt: dateValue(f, 'expiresAt'),
                              priceReview: text(f, 'priceReview'),
                              capacityReview: text(f, 'capacityReview'),
                              materialsReview: text(f, 'materialsReview'),
                              taxPolicyReference: text(f, 'taxPolicyReference'),
                              taxBasisPoints: Number(text(f, 'taxBasisPoints')),
                            },
                            C.procurementQuoteSchema,
                          )
                        }
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      >
                        <Input
                          name="totalTnd"
                          label="Total price including configured tax (TND)"
                          required
                        />
                        <Input
                          name="expiresAt"
                          label="Quote expires"
                          type="datetime-local"
                          required
                        />
                        <LongText name="priceReview" label="Current price review" />
                        <LongText name="capacityReview" label="Current capacity review" />
                        <LongText name="materialsReview" label="Current materials review" />
                        <Input
                          name="taxPolicyReference"
                          label="Reviewed synthetic tax policy reference"
                          required
                        />
                        <Input
                          name="taxBasisPoints"
                          label="Configured tax rate in basis points"
                          type="number"
                          min="0"
                          max="10000"
                          step="1"
                          value="0"
                          required
                        />
                      </ActionForm>
                    )}
                    {!data.quotes.length && <p>No quotation issued yet.</p>}
                    {data.quotes.map((q) => (
                      <article key={q.id}>
                        <h3>
                          Quotation v{q.version} · {q.totalTnd} TND
                        </h3>
                        <p>
                          {q.current
                            ? 'Current quotation'
                            : 'Historical, accepted or unavailable quotation'}
                          . Valid until {new Date(q.expiresAt).toLocaleString()}.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                          {String(q.snapshot.specification)} · {String(q.snapshot.quantity)} pieces
                          · {String(q.snapshot.deliveryLocation)}
                        </p>
                        <p>
                          Net {String(q.snapshot.netTnd)} TND · Tax {String(q.snapshot.taxTnd)} TND
                          · Policy {String(q.snapshot.taxPolicyReference)}
                        </p>
                        {a.approving && q.current && (
                          <ActionForm
                            label={`Accept quotation v${q.version}`}
                            confirm={`Accept quotation v${q.version} for ${q.totalTnd} TND?`}
                            action={(f) =>
                              send(
                                `/rfqs/${id}/accept`,
                                {
                                  version: r.version,
                                  quoteId: q.id,
                                  confirm: f.get('confirm') === 'on',
                                },
                                C.procurementAcceptSchema,
                              )
                            }
                            onSuccess={resource.reload}
                          >
                            <label>
                              <input type="checkbox" name="confirm" required /> I approve this exact
                              specification, quantity, total, deadline and quotation version.
                            </label>
                          </ActionForm>
                        )}
                      </article>
                    ))}
                  </Panel>
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="discussion">
                  <ProcurementDiscussion id={id} embedded />
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="documents">
                  <Panel title="Procurement records">
                    <DocumentList items={data.documents} />
                    {a.operator && data.orderId && (
                      <>
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Issue synthetic invoice"
                          action={() => send(`/rfqs/${id}/documents`, { kind: 'INVOICE' })}
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                        <ActionForm
                          label="Create delivery record from persisted shipment"
                          action={() => send(`/rfqs/${id}/documents`, { kind: 'DELIVERY' })}
                          onSuccess={resource.reload}
                        />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Panel>
                  {a.operator && data.orderId && (
                    <Panel title="Reusable approved product">
                      <ActionForm
                        label="Publish approved product version"
                        action={(f) =>
                          send(
                            `/rfqs/${id}/products`,
                            {
                              version: r.version,
                              productCode: text(f, 'productCode'),
                              materials: text(f, 'materials'),
                              leadTimeDays: Number(text(f, 'leadTimeDays')),
                              leadTimeSampleCount: Number(text(f, 'leadTimeSampleCount')),
                              leadTimeContext: text(f, 'leadTimeContext'),
                            },
                            C.procurementProductSchema,
                          )
                        }
                        onSuccess={resource.reload}
                      >
                        <Input name="productCode" label="Product code" required />
                        <LongText name="materials" label="Compatible materials" />
                        <Input
                          name="leadTimeDays"
                          label="Observed lead time in days"
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max="730"
                          step="1"
                          required
                        />
                        <Input
                          name="leadTimeSampleCount"
                          label="Number of lead-time samples"
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max="10000"
                          step="1"
                          required
                        />
                        <LongText name="leadTimeContext" label="Lead-time evidence and context" />
                      </ActionForm>
                      {data.products.map((p) => (
                        <div key={p.id}>
                          <p>
                            {p.productCode} v{p.version} · {humanize(p.status)}
                          </p>
                          {p.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                            <ActionForm
                              label={`Discontinue ${p.productCode} v${p.version}`}
                              action={(f) =>
                                send(
                                  `/products/${p.id}/status`,
                                  { status: 'DISCONTINUED', reason: text(f, 'reason') },
                                  C.procurementProductStatusSchema,
                                )
                              }
                              onSuccess={resource.reload}
                            >
                              <LongText name="reason" label="Reason for discontinuing" />
                            </ActionForm>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      <p>
                        Lead times remain estimates for future requests. Publication requires sample
                        approval and an accepted quotation.
                      </p>
                    </Panel>
                  )}
                </TabsContent>
              </Tabs>
            </>
          );
        })()}
    </Workspace>
  );
}
function History({ id, kind }: { id: string; kind: 'activity' | 'revisions' }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1),
    resource = useResource<{
      items: {
        id: string;
        actorLabel?: string;
        code?: string;
        version: number;
        createdAt: string;
        reason?: string;
        authorId?: string;
        predecessorId?: string | null;
        snapshot?: Record<string, unknown>;
      }[];
      hasMore: boolean;
    }>(`${root}/rfqs/${id}/${kind}?page=${page}`);
  return (
    <Panel title={kind === 'activity' ? 'Activity timeline' : 'Specification history'}>
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {resource.data && (
        <>
          {resource.data.items.length === 0 && <p>No records yet.</p>}
          <ol className="procurement-list">
            {resource.data.items.map((x) => (
              <li key={x.id}>
                <p>
                  <strong>{x.code ? humanize(x.code.replaceAll('.', '_')) : x.reason}</strong> · v
                  {x.version} · {x.actorLabel ?? x.authorId} ·{' '}
                  {new Date(x.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
                {x.snapshot && (
                  <p>
                    {String(x.snapshot.specification)} · {String(x.snapshot.quantity)} pieces ·{' '}
                    {String(x.snapshot.deliveryLocation)}
                  </p>
                )}
                {x.predecessorId && <small>Previous revision: {x.predecessorId}</small>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          <Pager page={page} hasMore={resource.data.hasMore} setPage={setPage} />
        </>
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
}
export function ProcurementDiscussion({
  id,
  embedded = false,
}: {
  id: string;
  embedded?: boolean;
}) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1),
    resource = useResource<C.ProcurementThread>(`${root}/rfqs/${id}/thread?page=${page}`),
    send = useCommand(),
    data = resource.data;
  const content = (
    <Panel title="Order discussion">
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {data && (
        <>
          {!data.items.length && <p>No messages yet.</p>}
          <ol className="procurement-list">
            {data.items.map((m) => (
              <li key={m.id}>
                <p>
                  <strong>{m.authorLabel}</strong> · {new Date(m.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                  {m.internal && ' · Internal note'}
                </p>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{m.body}</p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          <Pager page={page} hasMore={data.hasMore} setPage={setPage} />
          {data.canPost && (
            <ActionForm
              label="Send message"
              successMessage="Message delivered."
              action={(f) =>
                send(
                  `/rfqs/${id}/thread`,
                  { body: text(f, 'body'), internal: f.get('internal') === 'on' },
                  C.procurementMessageSchema,
                )
              }
              onSuccess={resource.reload}
            >
              <LongText name="body" label="Message" />
              {data.canPostInternal && (
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" name="internal" /> Internal note, hidden from buyers and
                  coordinators
                </label>
              )}
            </ActionForm>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
  return embedded ? (
    content
  ) : (
    <Workspace
      title="Order discussion"
      description="Messages for the permitted participants in this order."
    >
      <Disclosure />
      {content}
    </Workspace>
  );
}
async function download(id: string) {
  const result = await apiFetch<{ filename: string; document: unknown }>(
      `${root}/documents/${id}/download`,
    ),
    url = URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob([JSON.stringify(result.document, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }),
    );
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = result.filename;
  link.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}
function DocumentList({ items }: { items: C.ProcurementDocumentView[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {!items.length && <p>No documents are available yet.</p>}
      <ul className="procurement-list">
        {items.map((d) => (
          <li key={d.id}>
            <p>
              {humanize(d.kind)} #{d.number} · v{d.version} · {humanize(d.status)}
              {d.superseded ? ' · Superseded' : ''} · {new Date(d.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
            </p>
            <ActionForm
              label={`Download ${d.kind.toLowerCase()} ${d.number}`}
              action={() => download(d.id)}
            />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );
}
export function ProcurementDocuments() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1),
    resource = useResource<{ items: C.ProcurementDocumentView[]; hasMore: boolean }>(
      `${root}/documents?page=${page}`,
    );
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Company documents"
      description="Immutable versions of your company's procurement records."
    >
      <Nav />
      <Disclosure />
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {resource.data && (
        <Panel title="Documents">
          <DocumentList items={resource.data.items} />
          <Pager page={page} hasMore={resource.data.hasMore} setPage={setPage} />
        </Panel>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}
export function ProcurementProducts() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1),
    resource = useResource<C.ProcurementProducts>(`${root}/products?page=${page}`),
    router = useRouter(),
    send = useCommand();
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Approved products"
      description="Reuse a reviewed specification. Every reorder starts a new request."
    >
      <Nav />
      <Disclosure />
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {resource.data && (
        <>
          <div className="procurement-cards">
            {resource.data.items.map((p) => (
              <Panel key={p.id} title={`${p.productCode} · v${p.version}`}>
                <Badge variant="outline">{humanize(p.status)}</Badge>
                <p>{String(p.snapshot.specification)}</p>
                <p>Materials: {p.materials}</p>
                <p>
                  Indicative lead time: {p.leadTimeDays} days · {p.leadTimeSampleCount} samples ·{' '}
                  {p.leadTimeContext}
                </p>
                {p.status === 'ACTIVE' ? (
                  <details>
                    <summary>Reorder this product</summary>
                    <ActionForm
                      label="Create reorder draft"
                      action={async (f) => {
                        const r = await send<{ id: string }>(
                          `/products/${p.id}/reorder`,
                          {
                            quantity: Number(text(f, 'quantity')),
                            deliveryAt: dateValue(f, 'deliveryAt'),
                            deliveryLocation: text(f, 'deliveryLocation'),
                            confirm: f.get('confirm') === 'on',
                          },
                          C.procurementReorderSchema,
                        );
                        router.push(`/procurement/${r.id}`);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Input
                        name="quantity"
                        label="New quantity in pieces"
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        max="1000000"
                        step="1"
                        required
                      />
                      <Input
                        name="deliveryAt"
                        label="New delivery deadline"
                        type="datetime-local"
                        required
                      />
                      <Input name="deliveryLocation" label="New delivery destination" required />
                      <label>
                        <input name="confirm" type="checkbox" required /> Confirm quantity,
                        destination and deadline. Current price, capacity and materials must be
                        reviewed again.
                      </label>
                    </ActionForm>
                  </details>
                ) : (
                  <p>This specification needs a reviewed replacement before reordering.</p>
                )}
              </Panel>
            ))}
          </div>
          {resource.data.items.length === 0 && <p>No approved product versions are available.</p>}
          <Pager page={page} hasMore={resource.data.hasMore} setPage={setPage} />
        </>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}

export function ProcurementDiscussions() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1),
    resource = useResource<{ items: { id: string; title: string }[]; hasMore: boolean }>(
      `${root}/discussions?page=${page}`,
    );
  return (
    <Workspace
      title="Assigned order discussions"
      description="Only orders involving your currently assigned participants appear here."
    >
      <Disclosure />
      <ResourceState {...resource} retry={resource.reload} />
      {resource.data && (
        <Panel title="Conversations">
          {!resource.data.items.length && <p>No assigned order conversations.</p>}
          <ul className="procurement-list">
            {resource.data.items.map((r) => (
              <li key={r.id}>
                <Link href={`/procurement/${r.id}/discussion`}>{r.title}</Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <Pager page={page} hasMore={resource.data.hasMore} setPage={setPage} />
        </Panel>
      )}
    </Workspace>
  );
}

export function Profile({ initial }: { initial: MeView }) {
  const router = useRouter();

      });

      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  ) {

      action === 'profile'

            method: 'PATCH',
            body: result.data,

        } else if (action === 'password') {

          form.reset();
          setMessage('Password updated. Other sessions have been signed out.');
          const current = await apiFetch<{ items: SessionView[] }>('/api/v1/me/sessions');
          setSessions(current.items);
        } else {
          await apiFetch('/api/v1/me/deactivate', { method: 'POST', body: result.data });
          router.replace('/auth/login');
          router.refresh();
        }
      } catch (failure) {
        report(failure);
      }
    });
  }

===== apps\web\src\components\workspace-ui.tsx =====

'use client';
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  useTransition,
  useRef,
  useId,
} from 'react';
import type { ReactNode, FormEvent } from 'react';
import { apiFetch, ApiError } from '@/lib/api';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useHydrated } from '@/lib/use-hydrated';
import { Button } from './ui/button';
import { Input as ShadcnInput } from './ui/input';
import { Label } from './ui/label';
import { NativeSelect } from './ui/native-select';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from './ui/alert';
import { CircleCheck, LoaderCircle } from 'lucide-react';

const FieldErrors = createContext<Record<string, string[]>>({});
export function useFieldError(name: string) {
  return useContext(FieldErrors)[name] ?? [];
}

export function useResource<T>(path: string) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ path: string; value: T } | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [settledPath, setSettledPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [needsMfa, setNeedsMfa] = useState(false);
  const version = useRef(0);
  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestVersion = ++version.current;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setNeedsMfa(false);
    try {
      const value = await apiFetch<T>(path);
      if (requestVersion === version.current) setResult({ path, value });
    } catch (failure) {
      if (requestVersion === version.current) {
        setResult(null);
        setNeedsMfa(failure instanceof ApiError && failure.detail.code === 'MFA_REQUIRED');
        setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Unable to load this workspace.');
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestVersion === version.current) {
        setSettledPath(path);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [path]);
  useEffect(() => {
    void reload();
    return () => {
      ++version.current;
    };
  }, [reload]);
  return {
    data: result?.path === path ? result.value : null,
    error: settledPath === path ? error : '',
    loading: loading || settledPath !== path,
    reload,
    needsMfa: settledPath === path && needsMfa,
  };
}
const FeedbackContext = createContext<((message: string) => void) | null>(null);

export function Workspace({
  title,
  description,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState('');
  return (
    <FeedbackContext.Provider value={setFeedback}>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <h1>{title}</h1>
          <p className="lead">{description}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      {feedback && (
        <Alert className="notice success" role="status">
          <CircleCheck aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>{feedback}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      {children}
    </FeedbackContext.Provider>
  );
}
export function ResourceState({
  loading,
  error,
  retry,
  needsMfa = false,
}: {
  loading: boolean;
  error: string;
  retry: () => unknown;
  needsMfa?: boolean;
}) {
  return loading ? (
    <p className="resource-loading" role="status">
      <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
      Loading workspace…
    </p>
  ) : error ? (
    <div className="notice" role="alert">
      <p>{error}</p>
      {needsMfa && (
        <p>
          <Link href="/settings/security">Set up or verify two-factor authentication</Link>
        </p>
      )}
      <Button variant="outline" type="button" onClick={retry}>
        Try again
      </Button>
    </div>
  ) : null;
}
export function ActionForm({
  children,
  action,
  label,
  confirm,
  onSuccess,
  className,
  successMessage = 'Saved successfully.',
}: {
  children?: ReactNode;
  action: (data: FormData) => Promise<unknown>;
  label: string;
  confirm?: string;
  onSuccess?: () => unknown;
  className?: string;
  successMessage?: string;
}) {
  const ready = useHydrated();
  const feedback = useContext(FeedbackContext);
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [needsMfa, setNeedsMfa] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (confirm && !window.confirm(confirm)) return;
    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setError('');
    setFieldErrors({});
    setMessage('');
    setNeedsMfa(false);
    feedback?.('');
    start(async () => {
      try {
        await action(data);
        await onSuccess?.();
        if (feedback) feedback(successMessage);
        else setMessage(successMessage);
      } catch (failure) {
        setNeedsMfa(failure instanceof ApiError && failure.detail.code === 'MFA_REQUIRED');
        setFieldErrors(failure instanceof ApiError ? (failure.detail.fieldErrors ?? {}) : {});
        setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Unable to save. Please try again.');
      }
    });
  }
  return (
    <form method="post" onSubmit={submit} className={className}>
      <FieldErrors.Provider value={fieldErrors}>
        <fieldset disabled={pending || !ready} aria-busy={pending}>
          {children}
          <Button type="submit" className="action-submit">
            {pending ? 'Saving…' : label}
          </Button>
        </fieldset>
      </FieldErrors.Provider>
      {message && (
        <p className="notice success" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="notice" role="alert">
          {error}
          {needsMfa && (
            <>
              {' '}
              <Link href="/settings/security">Set up two-factor authentication</Link>.
            </>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
export function Input({
  name,
  label,
  value,
  type = 'text',
  required = false,
  min,
  max,
  step,
}: {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  value?: string | number | null;
  type?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  step?: string;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const errors = useFieldError(name);
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>{label}</Label>
      <ShadcnInput
        id={id}
        aria-invalid={errors.length ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={errors.length ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
        name={name}
        defaultValue={value ?? ''}
        type={type}
        required={required}
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={step}
      />
      {errors.length > 0 && (
        <p id={`${id}-error`} className="field-error">
          {errors.join(' ')}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function Select({
  name,
  label,
  value,
  options,
  required = false,
}: {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  value?: string;
  options: readonly string[] | readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
  required?: boolean;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const errors = useFieldError(name);
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>{label}</Label>
      <NativeSelect
        id={id}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-invalid={errors.length ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={errors.length ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
        name={name}
        defaultValue={value}
        required={required}
      >
        {options.map((item) =>
          typeof item === 'string' ? (
            <option key={item} value={item}>
              {humanize(item)}
            </option>
          ) : (
            <option key={item.value} value={item.value}>
              {item.label}
            </option>
          ),
        )}
      </NativeSelect>
      {errors.length > 0 && (
        <p id={`${id}-error`} className="field-error">
          {errors.join(' ')}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function humanize(value: string) {
  if (value === 'NASJ_OPERATOR') return 'NASJ operator';
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll('_', ' ')
    .replace(/^./, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase());
}
export function text(data: FormData, name: string) {
  return String(data.get(name) ?? '').trim();
}
export function Checkboxes({
  name,
  options,
  selected = [],
}: {
  name: string;
  options: readonly string[];
  selected?: string[];
}) {
  return (
    <div className="check-options">
      {options.map((option) => (
        <label key={option}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            name={name}
            value={option}
            defaultChecked={selected.includes(option)}
          />
          {humanize(option)}
        </label>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\lib\api.ts =====

import type { ApiFailure, MeView } from '@nasj/contracts';
import { safeApiPath } from './navigation';
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly detail: ApiFailure,
  ) {
    super(detail.message);
  }
}
export async function apiFetch<T>(
  path: string,
  options: {
    method?: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE';
    body?: unknown;
    idempotencyKey?: string;
  } = {},
): Promise<T> {
  if (!safeApiPath(path)) throw new Error('Invalid API destination.');
  const method = options.method ?? 'GET';
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: 'application/json' };
  if (method !== 'GET') {
    headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    if (options.idempotencyKey) headers['Idempotency-Key'] = options.idempotencyKey;
    if (path.startsWith('/api/v1/'))
      headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = (await apiFetch<MeView>('/api/v1/me')).csrfToken;
  }
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(path, {
      method,
      headers,
      body: method === 'GET' ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.body ?? {}),
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      cache: 'no-store',
      redirect: 'error',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
    });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(503, {
      code: 'API_UNAVAILABLE',
      message: 'The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.',
    });
  }
  const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new ApiError(
      response.status,
      body?.code && typeof body.message === 'string'
        ? body
        : { code: 'REQUEST_FAILED', message: 'Unable to complete this request.' },
    );
  return body as T;
}

// Single source of truth for signed-in navigation. Add a route here, not in the layout.
export type NavIcon =
  | 'organization'
  | 'artisan'
  | 'support'
  | 'approval'
  | 'users'
  | 'audit'
  | 'privacy';
export type NavItem = { href: string; label: string; icon: NavIcon; match?: string };
export type NavSection = { label: string; items: NavItem[]; adminOnly?: boolean };

export const sidebarSections: NavSection[] = [
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      {
        href: '/settings/organizations',
        label: 'Organizations',
        icon: 'organization',
        match: '/organizations',
      },
      { href: '/artisan/profile', label: 'Artisan workspace', icon: 'artisan', match: '/artisan' },
      { href: '/support/cases', label: 'Support', icon: 'support', match: '/support' },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Administration',
    adminOnly: true,
    items: [
      {
        href: '/admin/organizations',
        label: 'Organizations',
        icon: 'organization',
        match: '/admin/organizations',
      },
      { href: '/admin/approvals', label: 'Approvals', icon: 'approval' },
      { href: '/admin/users', label: 'User accounts', icon: 'users' },
      { href: '/admin/audit', label: 'Audit history', icon: 'audit' },
      { href: '/admin/privacy-requests', label: 'Privacy requests', icon: 'privacy' },
    ],
  },
];

export const profileMenuItems = [
  { href: '/settings/profile', label: 'Account and email' },
  { href: '/settings/security', label: 'Security and two-factor' },
  { href: '/settings/notifications', label: 'Language and notifications' },
  { href: '/support/privacy', label: 'Privacy and your data' },
];

export function isActive(pathname: string, item: NavItem) {
  if (pathname === item.href) return true;
  // Admin and member organization pages share a segment; keep them in their own sections.
  if (!item.match) return false;
  if (item.match === '/organizations')
    return pathname.startsWith('/organizations/') || pathname === '/settings/organizations';
  return pathname.startsWith(item.match);
}

export function initials(name: string) {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return (
    ((parts[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (parts.length > 1 ? (parts.at(-1)?.[0] ?? '') : '')).toUpperCase() ||
    '?'
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\lib\navigation.ts =====

export function safeNext(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const fallback = '/dashboard';
  if (!value?.startsWith('/') || value.startsWith('//') || /[\\\r\n]/.test(value)) return fallback;
  try {
    const decoded = decodeURIComponent(value);
    if (decoded.includes('\\') || decoded.startsWith('//') || /[\r\n]/.test(decoded))
      return fallback;
    const url = new URL(value, 'https://nasj.invalid');
    if (url.origin !== 'https://nasj.invalid' || !isWorkspacePath(url.pathname)) return fallback;
    return url.pathname + url.search;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
export function safeApiPath(path: string) {
  try {
    const decoded = decodeURIComponent(path);
    return (
      (path.startsWith('/api/v1/') || path.startsWith('/api/auth/')) &&
      !/[\\\r\n]/.test(decoded) &&
      !decoded.split('/').some((part) => part === '.' || part === '..')
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isWorkspacePath(path: string) {
  return (
    [
      '/dashboard',
      '/admin',
      '/operator',
      '/operator/activity',
      '/buyer',
      '/buyer/company',
      '/buyer/representatives',
      '/association',
      '/association/artisans',
      '/association/artisans/new',
      '/association/coordinators',
      '/admin/coordinators',
      '/admin/operators',
      '/admin/participant-concerns',
      '/admin/authorizations',
      '/admin/access',
      '/commerce/buyer',
      '/commerce/catalog',
      '/commerce/artisan',
      '/commerce/operator',
      '/settings/profile',
      '/settings/account',
      '/settings/security',
      '/settings/privacy',
      '/artisan/assisted',
      '/settings/organizations',
      '/settings/notifications',
      '/artisan/profile',
      '/artisan/skills',
      '/artisan/capacity',
      '/artisan/associations',
      '/artisan/delegations',
      '/invitations/accept',
      '/admin/users',
      '/admin/organizations',
      '/admin/approvals',
      '/admin/audit',
      '/admin/privacy-requests',
      '/support/cases',
      '/support/privacy',
    ].includes(path) ||
    /^\/procurement(?:\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+(?:\/discussion)?)?$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/association\/artisans\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+(?:\/history)?$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/operator\/partners\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/organizations\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\/settings$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/artisan\/assisted\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/organizations\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\/audit$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/admin\/organizations\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(path)
  );
}


===== apps\web\src\lib\server-api.ts =====

import 'server-only';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { cache } from 'react';
import type { IdentityContext, MeView } from '@nasj/contracts';
export async function serverApi<T>(path: string): Promise<T | null> {
  if (!path.startsWith('/api/v1/')) throw new Error('Invalid server API destination.');
  const incoming = await headers();
  const origin = process.env.API_INTERNAL_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';
  const response = await fetch(new URL(path, origin), {
    headers: { Cookie: incoming.get('cookie') ?? '', Accept: 'application/json' },
    cache: 'no-store',
    redirect: 'error',
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
  });
  if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) return null;
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('The account service is temporarily unavailable.');
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}
export const getMe = cache(() => serverApi<MeView>('/api/v1/me'));

export const getIdentityContext = cache(() => serverApi<IdentityContext>('/api/v1/me/context'));

===== apps\web\test\navigation.test.ts =====

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { safeNext, safeApiPath } from '../src/lib/navigation';
import { apiFetch, ApiError } from '../src/lib/api';
test('login redirect allowlist rejects external, encoded and unsupported destinations', () => {
  for (const value of [
    'https://evil.example',
    '//evil.example',
    '/\\evil.example',
    '/%5cevil.example',
    '/%2f%2fevil.example',
    '/auth/login',
    'javascript:alert(1)',
  ])
    assert.equal(safeNext(value), '/dashboard');
  assert.equal(safeNext('/admin/users?page=2'), '/admin/users?page=2');
  assert.equal(safeApiPath('/api/v1/../auth/sign-out'), false);
  assert.equal(safeApiPath('/api/v1/%ZZ'), false);
  assert.equal(safeApiPath('/api/v1/%5csecrets'), false);
});
test('browser mutations obtain a session-bound CSRF proof and never store session credentials', async () => {
  const original = globalThis.fetch;
  const calls: [string, RequestInit | undefined][] = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, options) => {
    calls.push([String(url), options]);
    return Response.json(calls.length === 1 ? { csrfToken: 'test-proof' } : { name: 'Updated' });
  };
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/v1/me', { method: 'PATCH', body: { name: 'Updated' } });
    assert.equal(calls[0][0], '/api/v1/me');
    assert.equal((calls[1][1]!.headers as Record<string, string>)['X-CSRF-Token'], 'test-proof');
    assert.equal(calls[1][1]?.credentials, 'same-origin');
    assert.equal(calls[1][1]?.cache, 'no-store');
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = original;
  }
});
test('API failures and network errors become safe user-facing errors', async () => {
  const original = globalThis.fetch;
  try {
    globalThis.fetch = async () =>
      Response.json({ code: 'CSRF_REJECTED', message: 'Refresh and try again.' }, { status: 403 });
    await assert.rejects(
      apiFetch('/api/v1/me'),
      (error) => error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 403,
    );
    globalThis.fetch = async () => {
      throw new Error('private upstream credentials');
    };
    await assert.rejects(
      apiFetch('/api/v1/me'),
      (error) => error instanceof ApiError && !error.message.includes('credentials'),
    );
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = original;
  }
});

test('workspace redirects allow scoped destinations and discard invitation secrets', () => {
  for (const path of [
    '/settings/organizations',
    '/settings/security',
    '/artisan/capacity',
    '/artisan/assisted/artisan_123',
    '/organizations/org-123/settings',
    '/organizations/org-123/audit',
    '/admin/approvals',
    '/support/privacy',
  ])
    assert.equal(safeNext(path), path);
  assert.equal(safeNext('/invitations/accept#token=private'), '/invitations/accept');
  for (const path of [
    '/organizations/id/private',
    '/admin/organizations/id/private',
    '/artisan/assisted/id/private',
  ])
    assert.equal(safeNext(path), '/dashboard');
});

test('PUT mutations use the same CSRF and credential protections as other writes', async () => {
  const original = globalThis.fetch;
  const calls: RequestInit[] = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (_url, options) => {
    calls.push(options ?? {});
    return Response.json(calls.length === 1 ? { csrfToken: 'put-proof' } : { items: [] });
  };
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/v1/artisans/me/skills', { method: 'PUT', body: { items: [] } });
    assert.equal(calls[1].method, 'PUT');
    assert.equal((calls[1].headers as Record<string, string>)['X-CSRF-Token'], 'put-proof');
    assert.equal(calls[1].credentials, 'same-origin');
    assert.equal(calls[1].redirect, 'error');
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = original;
  }
});

  !['http:', 'https:'].includes(api.protocol) ||
