===== scripts\seed-foundation.ts =====

import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, chmod, access } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { createApp } from '../apps/api/src/app.js';
import { validateEnvironment } from '../apps/api/src/config/env.js';
import { AuthService } from '../apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../apps/api/src/database/prisma.service.js';
import { logger } from '../apps/api/src/common/logging.js';
import type { BusinessRole } from '../packages/contracts/src/permissions.js';
import { assertLocalDevelopment } from './local-development.js';

const personas = [
  { key: 'buyer', name: 'Demo Business Buyer', email: 'buyer@nasj-demo.invalid' },
  { key: 'artisan', name: 'Demo Woman Artisan', email: 'artisan@nasj-demo.invalid' },
  {
    key: 'coordinator',
    name: 'Demo Association Coordinator',
    email: 'coordinator@nasj-demo.invalid',
  },
  {
    key: 'production',
    name: 'Demo Production Manager',
    email: 'production@nasj-demo.invalid',
  },
  { key: 'finance', name: 'Demo Finance Manager', email: 'finance@nasj-demo.invalid' },
  { key: 'admin', name: 'Demo Platform Reviewer', email: 'admin@nasj-demo.invalid' },
] as const;
type Credential = { persona: string; name: string; email: string; password: string };
export async function seedFoundation(mode: 'demo' | 'development') {
  const demo = mode === 'demo';
  const credentialsFile = new URL(
    demo ? '../.local/demo-credentials.json' : '../.local/dev-credentials.json',
    import.meta.url,
  );
  let app: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createApp>> | undefined;
  logger.level = 'silent';
  try {
    // These checks precede Nest/Prisma startup and every possible database write.
    if (!demo) assertLocalDevelopment(process.env);
    const database = new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL ?? '');
    if (
      demo &&
      (process.env.DEMO_MODE !== 'true' ||
        process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ||
        !['postgres:', 'postgresql:'].includes(database.protocol) ||
        database.pathname !== '/nasj_demo' ||
        database.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' ||
        database.port !== '5542' ||
        database.username !== 'nasj_demo' ||
        database.search ||
        database.hash ||
        process.env.PUBLIC_APP_URL !== 'http://127.0.0.1:3200')
    )
      throw new Error('Refusing to seed outside the isolated local demo database.');
    const config = validateEnvironment(process.env);
    await mkdir(new URL('../.local/', import.meta.url), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const generated = {
      version: 1,
      environment: demo ? 'isolated-local-demo' : 'local-development',
      appUrl: config.PUBLIC_APP_URL,
      personas: personas.map((persona) => ({
        persona: persona.key,
        name: persona.name,
        email: persona.email,
        password: randomBytes(24).toString('base64url'),
      })),
    };
    const credentialsExist = await access(credentialsFile).then(
      () => true,
      (error) => {
        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return false;
        throw error;
      },
    );
    if (!demo && !credentialsExist) {
      // Keep existing local reviewer credentials useful at the canonical development URL.
      // This copies only synthetic fixture passwords; no identities or application data cross databases.
      try {
        const previous = JSON.parse(
          await readFile(new URL('../.local/demo-credentials.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'),
        ) as { environment?: string; personas?: Credential[] };
        if (previous.environment !== 'isolated-local-demo' || !Array.isArray(previous.personas))
          throw new Error('Invalid synthetic credential manifest.');
        for (const entry of generated.personas) {
          const old = previous.personas.find(
            (item) => item.persona === entry.persona && item.email === entry.email,
          );
          if (!old || typeof old.password !== 'string' || old.password.length < 24)
            throw new Error('Invalid synthetic credential entry.');
          entry.password = old.password;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
      }
    }
    let newlyCreated = false;
    try {
      await writeFile(credentialsFile, `${JSON.stringify(generated, null, 2)}\n`, {
        flag: 'wx',
        mode: 0o600,
      });
      newlyCreated = true;
    } catch (error) {
      if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
    }
    await chmod(credentialsFile, 0o600);
    const saved: unknown = JSON.parse(await readFile(credentialsFile, 'utf8'));
    if (
      !saved ||
      typeof saved !== 'object' ||
      !('version' in saved) ||
      saved.version !== 1 ||
      !('environment' in saved) ||
      saved.environment !== (demo ? 'isolated-local-demo' : 'local-development') ||
      !('personas' in saved) ||
      !Array.isArray(saved.personas)
    )
      throw new Error('Invalid demo credential manifest; no credentials were changed.');
    const entries = saved.personas as Credential[];
    if (
      entries.length !== personas.length ||
      personas.some(
        (persona) =>
          entries.filter(
            (entry) =>
              entry.persona === persona.key &&
              entry.email === persona.email &&
              typeof entry.password === 'string' &&
              entry.password.length >= 24,
          ).length !== 1,
      )
    )
      throw new Error('Demo credential manifest does not match synthetic personas.');
    app = await createApp({ config });
    const db = app.get(PrismaService);
    const auth = app.get(AuthService);
    // A dedicated database can still have a wrong local fixture: fail closed rather than modify it.
    if (
      demo &&
      (await db.user.count({
        where: { email: { notIn: personas.map((persona) => persona.email) } },
      }))
    )
      throw new Error('Non-demo identities detected; refusing to seed this database.');
    const users = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const persona of personas) {
      const credential = entries.find((entry) => entry.persona === persona.key);
      if (!credential) throw new Error('Missing local demo credential.');
      const existing = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email: persona.email } });
      if (existing && newlyCreated)
        throw new Error(
          'Existing demo users have no preserved credential manifest; refusing to replace passwords.',
        );
      if (!existing)
        await auth.auth.api.signUpEmail({
          body: { name: persona.name, email: persona.email, password: credential.password },
        });
      const user =
        existing ??
        (await db.user.update({
          where: { email: persona.email },
          data: {
            emailVerified: true,
            role: persona.key === 'admin' ? 'ADMIN' : 'USER',
            status: 'ACTIVE',
          },
        }));
      users.set(persona.key, user.id);
    }
    const id = (key: string) => {
      const value = users.get(key);
      if (!value) throw new Error('Missing synthetic identity.');
      return value;
    };
    const admin = id('admin');
    const capacityStart = new Date();
    capacityStart.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    capacityStart.setUTCDate(
      capacityStart.getUTCDate() + ((8 - capacityStart.getUTCDay()) % 7 || 7),
    );
    const capacityEnd = new Date(capacityStart.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const organizationSpecs = [
      {
        slug: 'demo-buyer-business',
        name: 'DEMO — Jasmin Buyer Studio',
        type: 'BUYER_BUSINESS' as const,
        owner: 'buyer',
      },
      {
        slug: 'demo-artisan-association',
        name: 'DEMO — Noura Artisan Association',
        type: 'ASSOCIATION' as const,
        owner: 'coordinator',
      },
      {
        slug: 'demo-internal-operator',
        name: 'DEMO — NASJ Operations',
        type: 'INTERNAL' as const,
        owner: 'admin',
      },
    ];
    await db.$transaction(
      async (tx) => {
        await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631902)`;
        await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724631903)`;
        const organizations = new Map<string, string>();
        for (const spec of organizationSpecs) {
          const organization = await tx.organization.upsert({
            where: { slug: spec.slug },
            update: {},
            create: {
              slug: spec.slug,
              name: spec.name,
              type: spec.type,
              country: 'TN',
              region: 'Tunis',
              description:
                'Fictional demonstration organization. No real commercial activity or personal records.',
              contactEmail: `${spec.owner}@nasj-demo.invalid`,
              representativeName:
                personas.find((p) => p.key === spec.owner)?.name ?? 'Demo Representative',
              createdByUserId: id(spec.owner),
              approvalStatus: 'APPROVED',
              approvedByUserId: admin,
              approvedAt: new Date(),
              approvalReason: 'Synthetic isolated demonstration fixture',
            },
          });
          organizations.set(spec.slug, organization.id);
        }
        const orgId = (slug: string) => {
          const value = organizations.get(slug);
          if (!value) throw new Error('Missing synthetic organization.');
          return value;
        };
        const memberships: {
          persona: string;
          slug: string;
          manager: boolean;
          roles: BusinessRole[];
        }[] = [
          { persona: 'buyer', slug: 'demo-buyer-business', manager: true, roles: ['BUYER'] },
          {
            persona: 'coordinator',
            slug: 'demo-artisan-association',
            manager: true,
            roles: ['ASSOCIATION_COORDINATOR'],
          },
          {
            persona: 'artisan',
            slug: 'demo-artisan-association',
            manager: false,
            roles: ['ARTISAN'],
          },
          { persona: 'admin', slug: 'demo-internal-operator', manager: true, roles: [] },
          {
            persona: 'production',
            slug: 'demo-internal-operator',
            manager: false,
            roles: ['PRODUCTION_MANAGER'],
          },
          {
            persona: 'finance',
            slug: 'demo-internal-operator',
            manager: false,
            roles: ['FINANCE_MANAGER'],
          },
          {
            persona: 'coordinator',
            slug: 'demo-internal-operator',
            manager: false,
            roles: ['SUPPORT'],
          },
        ];
        for (const item of memberships) {
          const membership = await tx.organizationMember.upsert({
            where: {
              organizationId_userId: { organizationId: orgId(item.slug), userId: id(item.persona) },
            },
            update: {},
            create: {
              organizationId: orgId(item.slug),
              userId: id(item.persona),
              isManager: item.manager,
            },
          });
          for (const role of item.roles)
            await tx.membershipRole.upsert({
              where: { membershipId_role: { membershipId: membership.id, role } },
              update: {},
              create: { membershipId: membership.id, role, assignedByUserId: admin },
            });
        }
        const profile = await tx.artisanProfile.upsert({
          where: { userId: id('artisan') },
          update: {},
          create: {
            userId: id('artisan'),
            displayName: 'DEMO — Amel Artisan',
            region: 'Nabeul',
            preferredLanguage: 'fr',
            experienceDescription:
              'Fictional artisan demonstrating voluntary capacity and association relationships.',
            equipment: ['Hand loom', 'Embroidery tools'],
          },
        });
        if (
          !(await tx.consentRecord.findFirst({
            where: { userId: id('artisan'), purpose: 'artisan.profile' },
          }))
        )
          await tx.consentRecord.create({
            data: {
              userId: id('artisan'),
              purpose: 'artisan.profile',
              policyVersion: 'artisan-profile-v1',
              decision: true,
              collectionContext:
                'Synthetic isolated demonstration fixture; fictional profile consent.',
            },
          });
        const skill = await tx.craftSkill.upsert({
          where: { name: 'DEMO — Traditional embroidery' },
          update: {},
          create: {
            name: 'DEMO — Traditional embroidery',
            category: 'Textile',
            description: 'Synthetic craft for the isolated demonstration.',
          },
        });
        await tx.artisanSkill.upsert({
          where: {
            artisanProfileId_craftSkillId: { artisanProfileId: profile.id, craftSkillId: skill.id },
          },
          update: {},
          create: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            craftSkillId: skill.id,
            proficiency: 'ADVANCED',
          },
        });
        if (!(await tx.capacityDeclaration.findFirst({ where: { artisanProfileId: profile.id } })))
          await tx.capacityDeclaration.create({
            data: {
              artisanProfileId: profile.id,
              craftSkillId: skill.id,
              unitType: 'PIECES',
              quantity: '12.00',
              effectiveFrom: capacityStart,
              effectiveTo: capacityEnd,
              declaredByUserId: id('artisan'),
            },
          });
        // Normalize only known legacy synthetic fixture labels; preserve user edits/history.
        const repairedSkill = await tx.artisanSkill.updateMany({
          where: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            craftSkillId: skill.id,
            proficiency: 'Experienced',
          },
          data: { proficiency: 'ADVANCED' },
        });
        const repairedCapacity = await tx.capacityDeclaration.updateMany({
          where: {
            artisanProfileId: profile.id,
            craftSkillId: skill.id,
            unitType: 'PIECES_PER_WEEK',
          },
          data: { unitType: 'PIECES' },
        });
        const associationId = orgId('demo-artisan-association');
        const repairedConsent = await tx.consentRecord.updateMany({
          where: {
            userId: id('artisan'),
            purpose: 'association.link',
            collectionContext: 'Synthetic isolated demo seed; fictional consent, no real person.',
          },
          data: { purpose: `association:${associationId}` },
        });
        if (repairedSkill.count || repairedCapacity.count || repairedConsent.count)
          await tx.auditEvent.create({
            data: {
              actorId: admin,
              targetType: demo ? 'DemoEnvironment' : 'DevelopmentEnvironment',
              targetId: demo ? 'nasj_demo' : 'nasj',
              action: demo
                ? 'demo.fixture.labels.normalized'
                : 'development.fixture.labels.normalized',
              correlationId: crypto.randomUUID(),
              reason: 'Normalize legacy synthetic fixture labels to the validated API vocabulary.',
              after: {
                skills: repairedSkill.count,
                capacities: repairedCapacity.count,
                consents: repairedConsent.count,
              },
            },
          });

        if (
          !(await tx.associationMembership.findUnique({
            where: {
              artisanProfileId_organizationId: {
                artisanProfileId: profile.id,
                organizationId: associationId,
              },
            },
          }))
        ) {
          const consent = await tx.consentRecord.create({
            data: {
              userId: id('artisan'),
              purpose: `association:${associationId}`,
              policyVersion: 'association-v1',
              decision: true,
              collectionContext: 'Synthetic isolated demo seed; fictional consent, no real person.',
            },
          });
          await tx.associationMembership.create({
            data: {
              artisanProfileId: profile.id,
              organizationId: associationId,
              consentRecordId: consent.id,
            },
          });
        }
        if (
          !(await tx.auditEvent.findFirst({
            where: {
              action: demo ? 'demo.fixtures.created' : 'development.fixtures.created',
              actorId: admin,
            },
          }))
        )
          await tx.auditEvent.create({
            data: {
              actorId: admin,
              targetType: demo ? 'DemoEnvironment' : 'DevelopmentEnvironment',
              targetId: demo ? 'nasj_demo' : 'nasj',
              action: demo ? 'demo.fixtures.created' : 'development.fixtures.created',
              correlationId: demo ? 'isolated-demo-seed-v1' : 'local-development-seed-v1',
              reason: demo
                ? 'Synthetic fixtures in a dedicated database; no live data imported.'
                : 'Synthetic fixtures in the local development database; no real data imported.',
            },
          });
      },
      { maxWait: 15000, timeout: 30000 },
    );
    console.log(
      `Six local fixture accounts are ready at ${config.PUBLIC_APP_URL}. Credentials: .local/${demo ? 'demo' : 'dev'}-credentials.json. Existing passwords and records were preserved.`,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      `Local fixture seed refused or failed (${error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'UnknownError'}). Check the intended local environment and preserved credential manifest. No passwords were reset.`,
    );
    process.exitCode = 1;
  } finally {
    await app?.close();
  }
}

===== scripts\setup-demo.ts =====

import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, chmod } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify, parseEnv } from 'node:util';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
const exec = promisify(execFile);
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const local = new URL('../.local/', import.meta.url);
const environmentFile = new URL('demo.env', local);
try {
  await mkdir(local, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const password = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  const content = [
    'NODE_ENV=development',
    'DEMO_MODE=true',
    'PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3200',
    'API_HOST=127.0.0.1',
    'API_PORT=3201',
    'API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3201',
    'NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-demo',
    `POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${password}`,
    `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nasj_demo:${password}@127.0.0.1:5542/nasj_demo`,
    `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nasj_demo:${password}@127.0.0.1:5542/nasj_demo`,
    `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${randomBytes(48).toString('hex')}`,
    'REQUIRE_PRIVILEGED_MFA=false',
    'ARCJET_ENABLED=false',
    'ARCJET_MODE=DRY_RUN',
    'ARCJET_FAILURE_MODE=closed',
    'TRUST_PROXY=',
    'SMTP_HOST=127.0.0.1',
    'SMTP_PORT=1126',
    'SMTP_SECURE=false',
    'SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS=false',
    'SMTP_USER=',
    'SMTP_PASSWORD=',
    'EMAIL_FROM=NASJ Demo <noreply@nasj-demo.invalid>',
    'LOG_LEVEL=silent',
    '',
  ].join('\n');
  try {
    await writeFile(environmentFile, content, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
    console.log('Created dedicated .local/demo.env with separate random secrets.');
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
    console.log('Preserved existing .local/demo.env and its secrets.');
  }
  await chmod(environmentFile, 0o600);
  const values = parseEnv(await readFile(environmentFile, 'utf8'));
  const database = new URL(values.DATABASE_URL ?? '');
  if (
    values.DEMO_MODE !== 'true' ||
    values.NODE_ENV === 'production' ||
    database.pathname !== '/nasj_demo' ||
    database.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' ||
    database.port !== '5542' ||
    database.username !== 'nasj_demo' ||
    values.PUBLIC_APP_URL !== 'http://127.0.0.1:3200' ||
    values.API_PORT !== '3201' ||
    values.SMTP_PORT !== '1126' ||
    values.NEXT_DIST_DIR !== '.next-demo'
  )
    throw new Error('Dedicated demo environment does not match isolation requirements.');
  // Prevent inherited migration credentials or deployment variables choosing another database.
  const env = { ...process.env, ...values, MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: values.DATABASE_URL };
  await exec(
    'docker',
    [
      '--context',
      'default',
      'compose',
      '--env-file',
      fileURLToPath(environmentFile),
      '-f',
      'docker-compose.demo.yml',
      '-p',
      'nasj-demo',
      'up',
      '-d',
      '--wait',
    ],
    { cwd: root, env, maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 },
  );
  console.log('Separate demo PostgreSQL and mail capture are ready.');
  await exec('pnpm', ['--filter', '@nasj/contracts', 'build'], { cwd: root, env });
  await exec('pnpm', ['--filter', '@nasj/api', 'db:generate'], { cwd: root, env });
  await exec('pnpm', ['exec', 'prisma', 'migrate', 'deploy'], {
    cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL('../apps/api/', import.meta.url)),
    env,
    maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,
  });
  console.log('Applied additive migrations to the dedicated demo database.');
  await exec(
    'pnpm',
    ['exec', 'tsx', '--tsconfig', 'apps/api/tsconfig.json', 'scripts/seed-demo.ts'],
    {
      cwd: root,
      env,
      maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,
    },
  );
  console.log(
    'Demo identities are ready. Credentials remain in .local/demo-credentials.json (mode 0600).',
  );
  console.log('Start the dedicated API and web commands documented in ../docs/demo-identity.md.');
} catch (error) {
  console.error(
    `Demo setup failed (${error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'UnknownError'}). Existing environment and database records were preserved; inspect dedicated service health and ../docs/demo-identity.md.`,
  );
  process.exitCode = 1;
}


===== scripts\setup-local-operations.ts =====

import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, lstat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { parseEnv } from 'node:util';
import { assertLocalDevelopment } from './local-development.js';
import { userUnits } from '../apps/api/src/operations/local-runner.js';
import { readBackupKey } from '../apps/api/src/operations/backup.js';
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)).replace(/\/$/, '');
const mode = process.argv[2] ?? '--prepare';
if (!['--prepare', '--enable', '--disable'].includes(mode) || process.argv.length > 3)
  throw Error('Use --prepare, --enable or --disable.');
const exec = promisify(execFile);
const timers = ['nasj-local-backup.timer', 'nasj-local-health.timer'];
if (mode === '--disable') {
  await exec('systemctl', ['--user', 'disable', '--now', ...timers]);
  console.log('Local NASJ timers disabled; backups and keys preserved.');
} else {
  assertLocalDevelopment(parseEnv(await readFile(join(root, '.env'), 'utf8')));
  const operations = join(root, '.local', 'operations');
  const backups = join(root, '.local', 'backups');
  const keys = join(root, '.local', 'backup-keys');
  for (const path of [operations, backups, keys]) {
    await mkdir(path, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const info = await lstat(path);
    if (
      !info.isDirectory() ||
      info.isSymbolicLink() ||
      info.uid !== process.getuid?.() ||
      (info.mode & 0o077) !== 0
    )
      throw Error('Private owned operations/backup/key directories required.');
  }
  const key = join(keys, 'demo.key');
  try {
    await writeFile(key, randomBytes(32), { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' });
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
  }
  (await readBackupKey(key)).fill(0);
  const env = join(operations, 'schedule.env');
  const config = `BACKUP_CONTAINER=nasj-postgres-1\nBACKUP_DIRECTORY=${backups}\nBACKUP_KEY_FILE=${key}\nBACKUP_DATABASE_USER=nasj\nBACKUP_DATABASE_NAME=nasj\nBACKUP_CONFIG_FILE=${root}/.env\n`;
  const units = userUnits(root, process.execPath, env);
  // Keep preparation in the private project directory for review before host installation.
  const prepared = join(operations, 'units');
  await mkdir(prepared, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  try {
    await writeFile(env, config, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
    const info = await lstat(env);
    if (
      !info.isFile() ||
      info.isSymbolicLink() ||
      info.uid !== process.getuid?.() ||
      (info.mode & 0o077) !== 0
    )
      throw Error('Private owned operations configuration required.');
    const existing = await readFile(env, 'utf8');
    if (existing !== config) {
      if (existing !== config.replace(`BACKUP_CONFIG_FILE=${root}/.env\n`, ''))
        throw Error(
          'Existing customized operations configuration requires review; it was preserved.',
        );
      await writeFile(env, config, { mode: 0o600 }); // Exact managed v1 configuration migration only.
    }
  }
  for (const [name, contents] of Object.entries(units))
    await writeFile(join(prepared, name), contents, { mode: 0o600 });
  await exec('systemd-analyze', [
    '--user',
    'verify',
    ...Object.keys(units).map((name) => join(prepared, name)),
  ]);
  if (mode === '--enable') {
    const destination = join(homedir(), '.config', 'systemd', 'user');
    await mkdir(destination, { recursive: true });
    for (const [name, contents] of Object.entries(units)) {
      const path = join(destination, name);
      try {
        const info = await lstat(path);
        if (!info.isFile() || info.isSymbolicLink() || info.uid !== process.getuid?.())
          throw Error('Owned regular user units required.');
        const existing = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
        if (!existing.startsWith('# NASJ managed local-demo unit v1\n'))
          throw Error('Refusing to replace an unmanaged user unit.');
      } catch (error) {
        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
      }
      await writeFile(path, contents, { mode: 0o644 });
    }
    await exec('systemctl', ['--user', 'daemon-reload']);
    await exec('systemctl', ['--user', 'enable', '--now', ...timers]);
    console.log('Local backup and health timers enabled. Status and alerts: .local/operations/.');
  } else
    console.log(
      'Prepared validated local user units in .local/operations/units; use --enable to install.',
    );
}


===== scripts\setup-local.ts =====

import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
const target = new URL('../.env', import.meta.url);
const template = await readFile(new URL('../.env.example', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const password = randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
try {
  await writeFile(
    target,
    template
      .replaceAll('replace_with_random_hex', password)
      .replace('generate_48_or_more_random_characters', randomBytes(48).toString('hex')),
    { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 },
  );
  console.log('Created .env with random local secrets. Existing databases were not accessed.');
} catch (error) {
  if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
  console.log('Existing .env preserved.');
}


===== scripts\verify-clean.ts =====

import { execFile, spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { cp, mkdir, mkdtemp, lstat, rm, writeFile, open } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { join, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const output = join(root, '.local', 'clean-verification');
await mkdir(output, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
const cache = join(homedir(), '.cache');
await mkdir(cache, { recursive: true });
const source = await mkdtemp(join(cache, 'nasj-clean-'));
const commands = [
  ['install', '--frozen-lockfile'],
  ['setup:local'],
  ['db:generate'],
  ['lint'],
  ['typecheck'],
  ['test'],
  ['test:integration'],
  ['test:e2e'],
  ['audit', '--audit-level=high'],
  ['build'],
];
const results: { command: string; exitCode: number; durationMs: number; log: string }[] = [];
await writeFile(
  join(output, 'summary.json'),
  `${JSON.stringify({ status: 'RUNNING', passed: false, results }, null, 2)}\n`,
  { mode: 0o600 },
);
let child: ReturnType<typeof spawn> | undefined;
let interrupted = false;
for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM'] as const)
  process.once(signal, () => {
    interrupted = true;
    // Let the real test harness clean up its own disposable services before removing source files.
    if (child?.pid) {
      try {
        process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGTERM');
      } catch {
        child.kill('SIGTERM');
      }
    }
  });
try {
  const { stdout } = await promisify(execFile)(
    'git',
    ['ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z'],
    { cwd: root, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024 },
  );
  for (const name of stdout.split('\0').filter(Boolean)) {
    if (isAbsolute(name) || name.split('/').includes('..')) throw Error('Invalid source path.');
    const path = join(root, name);
    const info = await lstat(path);
    if (!info.isFile()) throw Error('Clean verification requires regular source files.');
    await mkdir(join(source, name, '..'), { recursive: true });
    await cp(path, join(source, name));
  }
  for (const [index, args] of commands.entries()) {
    if (interrupted) throw Error('Clean verification interrupted.');
    const log = `${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${args[0]}.log`;
    const handle = await open(join(output, log), 'w', 0o600);
    const started = performance.now();
    // Do not inherit the earlier installed-workspace verification workaround or a database URL.
    const environment: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = { ...process.env, NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1' };
    for (const key of [
      'pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run',
      'DATABASE_URL',
      'MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL',
      'NEXT_DIST_DIR',
      'API_INTERNAL_URL',
      'NODE_ENV',
      'TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH',
      'INIT_CWD',
      'PNPM_SCRIPT_SRC_DIR',
    ])
      delete environment[key];
    let exitCode: number;
    try {
      child = spawn('pnpm', args, {
        cwd: source,
        env: environment,
        detached: true,
        stdio: ['ignore', handle.fd, handle.fd],
      });
      exitCode = await new Promise<number>((resolve, reject) => {
        child!.once('error', reject);
        child!.once('close', (code) => resolve(code ?? 1));
      });
    } finally {
      child = undefined;
      await handle.close();
    }
    const result = {
      command: `pnpm ${args.join(' ')}`,
      exitCode,
      durationMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
      log,
    };
    results.push(result);
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
    if (exitCode !== 0)
      throw Error(`Clean verification failed at ${args[0]}. See .local/clean-verification/${log}.`);
  }
} catch (failure) {
  console.error(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Clean verification failed.');
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  await writeFile(
    join(output, 'summary.json'),
    `${JSON.stringify(
      {
        source: 'CURRENT_WORKTREE_WITHOUT_IGNORED_FILES',
        ordinaryFrozenInstall: true,
        disposableDatabase: true,
        results,
        passed: results.length === commands.length && results.every((r) => r.exitCode === 0),
      },
      null,
      2,
    )}\n`,
    { mode: 0o600 },
  );
  await rm(source, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

import { test, expect, type Page, type APIRequestContext } from '@playwright/test';
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
import type { BuyerCatalog, CommerceWorkspaceView } from '@nasj/contracts';

const password = 'Synthetic-commerce-browser-password-2026!';
const origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100';
async function register(request: APIRequestContext, email: string) {
  expect(
    (
      await request.post('/api/auth/sign-up/email', {
        headers: { Origin: origin },
        data: { email, name: 'Synthetic Catalog Persona', password },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(202);
  const token = await (
    await request.get(`${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/token?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`)
  ).json();

    (await request.get(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(token.token)}`)).status(),
  ).toBe(200);
}
async function login(page: Page, email: string) {
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');

  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);

async function accessible(page: Page, label: string) {
  const result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
    .include('main')
    .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'])
    .analyze();
  await test.info().attach(label, {
    body: JSON.stringify({ violations: result.violations }),
    contentType: 'application/json',
  });
  expect(result.violations).toEqual([]);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
}

test('catalog loading, retry, empty and broken-image states remain usable', async ({
  page,
  request,
}) => {
  await register(request, 'catalog-states@example.com');
  await login(page, 'catalog-states@example.com');
  const url = '**/api/v1/commerce/catalog';
  let release: (() => void) | undefined;
  const hold = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    release = resolve;
  });
  await page.route(url, async (route) => {
    await hold;
    await route.fulfill({
      status: 503,
      contentType: 'application/json',
      body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Catalog temporarily unavailable.' }),
    });
  });
  await page.goto('/commerce/catalog');
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Loading workspace');
  release!();
  await expect(page.getByRole('main').getByRole('alert')).toContainText(
    'Catalog temporarily unavailable',
  );
  await page.unroute(url);
  await page.route(url, (route) =>
    route.fulfill({
      json: { version: 1, provenance: 'SYNTHETIC', categories: [] } satisfies BuyerCatalog,
    }),
  );
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try again', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByText('No craft categories are available. Please check again later.'),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.unroute(url);
  await page.route('**/catalog/woven-runner.svg', (route) => route.abort());
  await page.reload();
  const runner = page.getByRole('article', { name: 'Woven table runner', exact: true });
  await runner.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect(runner.getByText(/No example image available/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(runner.getByRole('link')).toBeVisible();
  await accessible(page, 'catalog-image-fallback');
});

import { test, expect, type Page, type APIRequestContext } from '@playwright/test';

async function login(page: Page, email: string) {
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);

async function workspace(page: Page) {
  return (await (
    await page.request.get('/api/v1/commerce/workspace')
  ).json()) as CommerceWorkspaceView;
}
async function a11y(page: Page, label: string) {
  const result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
    .include('main')
    .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'])
    .analyze();
  await test.info().attach(`axe-${label}`, {
    body: JSON.stringify(
      { url: page.url(), violations: result.violations, passes: result.passes.map((p) => p.id) },
      null,
      2,
    ),
    contentType: 'application/json',
  });
  expect(
    result.violations,
    JSON.stringify(
      result.violations.map((v) => ({ id: v.id, nodes: v.nodes.map((n) => n.target) })),
    ),
  ).toEqual([]);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
}
async function keyboardButton(page: Page, name: string) {
  const button = page.getByRole('button', { name, exact: true });
  await expect(button).toBeEnabled();
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await button.focus();
  await expect(button).toBeFocused();
  expect(await button.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).outlineStyle)).not.toBe('none');
  const request = page.waitForRequest(
    (req) => req.url().includes('/api/v1/commerce/') && ['POST', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method()),
  );
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  const response = await (await request).response();
  if (response) await response.finished();
  await expect(page.locator('fieldset[aria-busy="true"]')).toHaveCount(0);
}

===== tests\e2e\foundation.spec.ts =====

import { test, expect, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
const password = 'Browser-test-password-2026!';
const resetPassword = 'Browser-reset-password-2026!';
async function token(request: APIRequestContext, email: string, kind = 'verify') {
  const response = await request.get(
    `${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/token?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}&kind=${kind}`,
  );
  expect(response.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  return (await response.json()).token as string;
}
async function register(request: APIRequestContext, email: string, name: string) {
  expect(
    (
      await request.post('/api/auth/sign-up/email', {
        data: { email, name, password },
        headers: { Origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100' },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(202);
  const value = await token(request, email);
  expect(
    (await request.get(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`)).status(),
  ).toBe(200);
}
async function login(page: Page, email: string, pw = password, next = '/settings/profile') {
  await page.goto(`/auth/login${next ? `?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}` : ''}`);
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(pw);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings\/profile|\/admin\/users/);
}

test('protected routes redirect and authentication errors are accessible', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/settings/profile');
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/auth\/login/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText('Welcome back.');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill('nobody@example.com');
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('main').getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Sign-in unsuccessful');
});
test('signup, email verification, profile, sessions and password changes work in the browser', async ({
  page,
  request,
  browser,
}) => {
  const email = 'ui-maker@example.com';
  await page.goto('/auth/register');
  await page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true }).fill('UI Maker');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show password' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true })).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Hide password' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create account', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('check your inbox');
  const verification = await token(request, email);
  await page.goto(`/auth/verify-email#token=${encodeURIComponent(verification)}`);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify email address' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('email is verified');
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => location.hash)).toBe('');
  await login(page, email);
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('UI Maker');
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('UI Maker');
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.cookie.includes('nasj.session_token'))).toBe(
    false,
  );
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.length)).toBe(0);
  await page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true }).fill('UI Maker Updated');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save profile' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('profile has been saved');
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('UI Maker Updated');
  const other = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: new URL(page.url()).origin });
  const otherPage = await other.newPage();
  await login(otherPage, email);
  await page.reload();
  await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Password & sessions', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText('Another session', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign out session', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText('Another session', { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
  await otherPage.reload();
  await expect(otherPage).toHaveURL(/\/auth\/login/);
  await other.close();
  expect((await page.request.get('/api/v1/admin/users')).status()).toBe(403);
  await page.goto('/admin/users');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Access denied', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/admin\/users/);
  await page.goto('/settings/profile');
  await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Password & sessions', exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Current password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByLabel('New password', { exact: true }).fill(resetPassword);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Update password', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Password updated');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Account menu' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign out', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/auth\/login/);
  await login(page, email, resetPassword);
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('UI Maker Updated');
});
test('password recovery token stays out of URLs after hydration and revokes sessions', async ({
  page,
  request,
}) => {
  const email = 'ui-recovery@example.com';
  await register(request, email, 'UI Recovery');
  await login(page, email);
  await page.goto('/auth/forgot-password');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send recovery link' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('check your inbox');
  const value = await token(request, email, 'reset');
  await page.goto(`/auth/reset-password#token=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`);
  await page.getByLabel('New password', { exact: true }).fill(resetPassword);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => location.hash)).toBe('');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Update password', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('password has been updated');
  expect((await page.request.get('/api/v1/me')).status()).toBe(401);
  await login(page, email, resetPassword);
});
test('admin user search and status controls work; last admin cannot be removed', async ({
  page,
  request,
}) => {
  const email = 'ui-admin@example.com';
  await register(request, email, 'UI Admin');
  expect(
    (
      await request.post(
        `${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/promote?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
      )
    ).ok(),
  ).toBeTruthy();
  await login(page, email, password, '/admin/users');
  await expect(page.getByRole('table', { name: 'User administration' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel('Search by name or email').fill('ui-maker@example.com');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Search', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText('UI Maker Updated', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page
    .getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Status for UI Maker Updated' })
    .selectOption('SUSPENDED');
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Account access updated');
  const denied = await request.post('/api/auth/sign-in/email', {
    data: { email: 'ui-maker@example.com', password: resetPassword },
    headers: { Origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100' },
  });
  expect(denied.status()).toBe(401);
  await page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Status for UI Maker Updated' }).selectOption('ACTIVE');
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Account access updated');
  await page.getByLabel('Search by name or email').fill('ui-admin@example.com');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Search', exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Role for UI Admin' }).selectOption('USER');
  await expect(page.locator('main').getByRole('alert')).toContainText(
    'at least one active verified administrator',
  );
});

test('network failures show a recoverable message without exposing upstream details', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
  await page.route('**/api/auth/sign-in/email', (route) => route.abort('failed'));
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill('error@example.com');
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('main').getByRole('alert')).toContainText('temporarily unavailable');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();
});

test('forms remain disabled without JavaScript and cannot fall back to credential-bearing GET requests', async ({
  browser,
}) => {
  const context = await browser.newContext({
    baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100',
    javaScriptEnabled: false,
  });
  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    await page.goto('/auth/login');
    await expect(page.locator('form')).toHaveAttribute('method', 'post');
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(new URL(page.url()).search).toBe('');
  } finally {
    await context.close();
  }
});
test('pending authentication disables duplicate submissions and recovers after a failed response', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  let release!: () => void;
  const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    release = resolve;
  });
  let received!: () => void;
  const started = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    received = resolve;
  });
  await page.route('**/api/auth/sign-in/email', async (route) => {
    received();
    await held;
    await route.fulfill({
      status: 401,
      contentType: 'application/json',
      body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'SIGN_IN_FAILED', message: 'Sign-in unsuccessful. Try again.' }),
    });
  });
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill('pending@example.com');
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await started;
  try {
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Please wait…', exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.locator('fieldset')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
  } finally {
    release();
  }
  await expect(page.locator('main').getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Sign-in unsuccessful');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();
});

test('small-screen login supports keyboard focus, associated labels and direct API denials through the proxy', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Skip to content' })).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  const email = page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true });
  await email.focus();
  await page.keyboard.type('keyboard@example.com');
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  const passwordInput = page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true });
  await expect(passwordInput).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.type(password);
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show password', exact: true })).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'password');
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true })).toBeFocused();
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
  for (const field of await page.locator('input:not([type="hidden"])').all()) {
    const id = await field.getAttribute('id');
    expect(id).toBeTruthy();
    await expect(page.locator(`label[for="${id}"]`)).not.toBeEmpty();
  }
  const denied = await page.request.get('/api/v1/me');
  expect(denied.status()).toBe(401);
  expect((await denied.json()).requestId).toBe(denied.headers()['x-request-id']);
  const malformed = await page.request.post('/api/auth/sign-in/email', {
    headers: { Origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100' },
    data: { email: 'bad', password: 'bad', wearableSummary: {} },
  });
  expect(malformed.status()).toBe(400);
});


===== tests\e2e\identity.spec.ts =====

import { test, expect, type APIRequestContext, type Page, type Browser } from '@playwright/test';
import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
const password = 'Identity-browser-password-2026!';
const origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100';
test.use({ actionTimeout: 15000 });
async function mailToken(request: APIRequestContext, email: string, kind = 'verify') {
  const response = await request.get(
    `${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/token?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}&kind=${kind}`,
  );
  expect(response.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  return (await response.json()).token as string;
}
async function register(request: APIRequestContext, email: string, name: string) {
  expect(
    (
      await request.post('/api/auth/sign-up/email', {
        data: { email, name, password },
        headers: { Origin: origin },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(202);
  expect(
    (
      await request.get(
        `/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(await mailToken(request, email))}`,
      )
    ).ok(),
  ).toBeTruthy();
}
async function login(page: Page, email: string) {
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings\/profile/);
}
async function administrator(browser: Browser, request: APIRequestContext, suffix: string) {
  const email = `identity-admin-${suffix}@example.com`;
  await register(request, email, `Identity Admin ${suffix}`);
  expect(
    (
      await request.post(
        `${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/promote?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
      )
    ).ok(),
  ).toBeTruthy();
  const context = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: origin });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await login(page, email);
  return { context, page };
}
async function createOrganization(page: Page, name: string, type = 'BUYER_BUSINESS') {
  await page.goto('/settings/organizations');
  await page.getByLabel('Organization type', { exact: true }).selectOption(type);
  await page.getByLabel('Organization name', { exact: true }).fill(name);
  await page
    .getByLabel('Authorized representative', { exact: true })
    .fill('Synthetic Representative');
  await page.getByLabel('Region', { exact: true }).fill('Tunis');
  await page
    .getByLabel('Organization description', { exact: true })
    .fill('Synthetic identity foundation browser test organization.');
  await page
    .getByLabel('Contact email', { exact: true })
    .fill('synthetic-organization@example.com');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create organization', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/organizations\/[^/]+\/settings/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText(name);
  const id = new URL(page.url()).pathname.split('/')[2];
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Request approval', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText('Approval: Pending review', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
  return id;
}
// Approval dialogs must be accepted before the triggering click resolves.
async function approveOrganization(page: Page, name: string) {
  await page.goto('/admin/approvals');
  const card = page
    .locator('li.panel')
    .filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name, exact: true }) });
  await card
    .getByLabel('Review reason', { exact: true })
    .fill('Synthetic organization reviewed and approved.');
  page.once('dialog', (dialog) => dialog.accept());
  await card.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record approval decision', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(card).toHaveCount(0);
}

test('buyer onboarding, approval, invitation and scoped membership revocation work across organizations', async ({
  page,
  request,
  browser,
}) => {
  test.setTimeout(120000);
  const buyerEmail = 'identity-buyer@example.com';
  await page.goto('/auth/register');
  await page.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true }).fill('Identity Buyer');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(buyerEmail);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create account', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('check your inbox');
  await page.goto(
    `/auth/verify-email#token=${encodeURIComponent(await mailToken(request, buyerEmail))}`,
  );
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify email address' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('email is verified');
  await login(page, buyerEmail);
  const orgId = await createOrganization(page, 'Identity Buyer Organization');
  const admin = await administrator(browser, request, 'buyer');
  await approveOrganization(admin.page, 'Identity Buyer Organization');
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByText('Approval: Approved', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
  const staffEmail = 'identity-staff@example.com';
  await page.getByLabel('Invitee email', { exact: true }).fill(staffEmail);
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Buyer representative', exact: true }).check();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Invite member', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(staffEmail, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  const invitation = await mailToken(request, staffEmail, 'invitation');
  await register(request, staffEmail, 'Identity Staff');
  const staffContext = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: origin });
  const staff = await staffContext.newPage();
  await login(staff, staffEmail);
  const enrollmentResponse = await staff.request.post('/api/auth/two-factor/enable', {
    data: { password },
    headers: { Origin: origin },
  });
  expect(enrollmentResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  const enrollment = (await enrollmentResponse.json()) as { totpURI: string };
  expect(
    (
      await staff.request.post('/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp', {
        data: { code: totp(enrollment.totpURI) },
        headers: { Origin: origin },
      })
    ).ok(),
  ).toBeTruthy();
  await staff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Account menu' }).click();
  await staff.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign out', exact: true }).click();
  await staff.goto(`/invitations/accept#token=${invitation}`);
  await staff.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(staffEmail);
  expect(await staff.evaluate(() => location.hash)).toBe('');
  expect(await staff.evaluate(() => localStorage.length + sessionStorage.length)).toBe(0);
  await staff.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await staff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await staff.getByLabel('Authenticator code', { exact: true }).fill(totp(enrollment.totpURI));
  await staff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify sign-in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(staff).toHaveURL(/\/invitations\/accept$/);
  await expect(staff.getByText(staffEmail, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await staff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept invitation', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(staff.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Invitation accepted');
  expect(await staff.evaluate(() => location.hash)).toBe('');
  const newStaffEmail = 'identity-new-staff@example.com';
  await page.getByLabel('Invitee email', { exact: true }).fill(newStaffEmail);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Invite member', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(newStaffEmail, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  const newInvitation = await mailToken(request, newStaffEmail, 'invitation');
  const newStaffContext = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: origin });
  const newStaff = await newStaffContext.newPage();
  await newStaff.goto(`/invitations/accept#token=${newInvitation}`);
  await newStaff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create an account here', exact: true }).click();
  await newStaff.getByLabel('Your name', { exact: true }).fill('Identity New Staff');
  await newStaff.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(newStaffEmail);
  await newStaff.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await newStaff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create account', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(newStaff.getByRole('status')).toContainText('verification email has been sent');
  const verifyTab = await newStaffContext.newPage();
  await verifyTab.goto(
    `/auth/verify-email#token=${encodeURIComponent(await mailToken(request, newStaffEmail))}`,
  );
  await verifyTab.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify email address', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(verifyTab.getByRole('status')).toContainText('email is verified');
  await verifyTab.close();
  await newStaff.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(newStaffEmail);
  await newStaff.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await newStaff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await newStaff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept invitation', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(newStaff.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Invitation accepted');
  expect(await newStaff.evaluate(() => location.hash + location.search)).toBe('');
  expect(await newStaff.evaluate(() => localStorage.length + sessionStorage.length)).toBe(0);
  await newStaffContext.close();
  await staff.goto(`/organizations/${orgId}/settings`);
  await expect(staff.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText('Identity Buyer Organization');
  await expect(staff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Invite member', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(staff.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save organization', exact: true })).toHaveCount(
    0,
  );
  const separateId = await createOrganization(staff, 'Identity Staff Separate Organization');
  await expect((await page.request.get(`/api/v1/organizations/${separateId}`)).status()).toBe(403);
  await page.reload();
  const member = page
    .locator('#main-content li')
    .filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Identity Staff', exact: true }) });
  await member.getByText('Change membership access', { exact: true }).click();
  await member
    .getByLabel('Membership status for Identity Staff', { exact: true })
    .selectOption('SUSPENDED');
  await member
    .getByLabel('Reason for access change', { exact: true })
    .fill('Synthetic scoped suspension verification.');
  page.once('dialog', (dialog) => dialog.accept());
  await member.getByRole('button', { name: 'Update membership', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    member.getByText('identity-staff@example.com · Suspended', { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  expect((await staff.request.get(`/api/v1/organizations/${orgId}`)).status()).toBe(403);
  expect((await staff.request.get(`/api/v1/organizations/${separateId}`)).status()).toBe(200);

    await route.continue();
  });

  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke delegation', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
  expect((await coordinator.request.get(`/api/v1/artisans/${artisanId}`)).status()).toBe(403);
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Display name', { exact: true })).toHaveValue(
    'Assisted Test Artisan',
  );
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 800 });
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(

  );

  await admin.context.close();

function totp(uri: string) {
  const secret = new URL(uri).searchParams.get('secret')!;
  let bits = '';
  for (const character of secret.toUpperCase().replaceAll('=', ''))
    bits += 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567'.indexOf(character).toString(2).padStart(5, '0');
  const key = Buffer.from((bits.match(/.{8}/g) ?? []).map((byte) => Number.parseInt(byte, 2)));
  const counter = Buffer.alloc(8);
  counter.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 30000)));
  const hash = createHmac('sha1', key).update(counter).digest();
  const offset = hash[hash.length - 1] & 15;
  return ((hash.readUInt32BE(offset) & 0x7fffffff) % 1000000).toString().padStart(6, '0');
}
test('authenticator enrollment and recovery-code sign-in work without persisting secrets', async ({
  page,
  request,
}) => {
  const email = 'identity-mfa@example.com';
  await register(request, email, 'Identity MFA');
  await login(page, email);
  await page.goto('/settings/security');
  await page.getByLabel('Current password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Set up authenticator', exact: true }).click();
  const uri = await page.getByLabel('Authenticator setup URI', { exact: true }).inputValue();
  const backup = (await page.locator('.recovery-codes').textContent())!.split('\n')[0];
  await page.getByLabel('Six-digit authenticator code', { exact: true }).fill(totp(uri));
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm authenticator code', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByText('Two-factor authentication is enabled.', { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('.recovery-codes')).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.length)).toBe(0);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Account menu' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign out', exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Authenticator code', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Use recovery code', exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Recovery code', { exact: true }).fill(backup);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify sign-in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
for (const viewport of [
  { label: 'mobile', width: 360, height: 800 },
  { label: 'desktop', width: 1280, height: 900 },
]) {
  test(`NASJ landing, branding and account menu work on ${viewport.label}`, async ({
    page,
    request,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize(viewport);
    await page.goto('/');
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText('Meaningful gifts.');
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'NASJ | نسج', exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
    let result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'])
      .analyze();
    await test.info().attach(`nasj-landing-${viewport.label}`, {
      body: JSON.stringify({ violations: result.violations }),
      contentType: 'application/json',
    });
    expect(result.violations).toEqual([]);
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(
      true,
    );
    await page.screenshot({ path: `.local/nasj-landing-${viewport.label}.png`, fullPage: true });
    const email = `nasj-menu-${viewport.label}@example.com`,
      password = 'Synthetic-commerce-browser-password-2026!';
    expect(
      (
        await request.post('/api/auth/sign-up/email', {
          headers: { Origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100' },
          data: { email, name: 'NASJ menu persona', password },
        })
      ).status(),
    ).toBe(202);
    const { token } = await (
      await request.get(`${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/token?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`)
    ).json();
    expect(
      (await request.get(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`)).status(),
    ).toBe(200);
    await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
    await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
    await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/settings\/profile/);
    const trigger = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Account menu', exact: true });
    await trigger.focus();
    await trigger.press('ArrowDown');
    await expect(page.getByRole('menu', { name: 'Account menu', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(
      page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Account and email', exact: true }),
    ).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    await expect(
      page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Security and two-factor', exact: true }),
    ).toBeFocused();
    result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'])
      .analyze();
    await test.info().attach(`nasj-menu-${viewport.label}`, {
      body: JSON.stringify({ violations: result.violations }),
      contentType: 'application/json',
    });
    expect(result.violations).toEqual([]);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(trigger).toBeFocused();
    await trigger.click();
    await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Privacy and your data', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/support\/privacy/);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Account menu', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign out', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/auth\/login/);
    await page.screenshot({ path: `.local/nasj-account-${viewport.label}.png`, fullPage: true });
  });
}

    contentType: 'application/json',
  });

  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
}

===== tests\e2e\revised-foundation.spec.ts =====

import { test, expect, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
const origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100';
const password = 'Synthetic-foundation-browser-password-2026!';
const reason = 'Synthetic independently reviewed fixture authorization';
async function register(request: APIRequestContext, email: string) {
  expect(
    (
      await request.post('/api/auth/sign-up/email', {
        headers: { Origin: origin },
        data: { email, name: 'Synthetic Foundation Person', password },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(202);
  const { token } = await (
    await request.get(`${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/token?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`)
  ).json();
  expect(
    (await request.get(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`)).status(),
  ).toBe(200);
}
async function loginApi(request: APIRequestContext, email: string) {
  expect(
    (
      await request.post('/api/auth/sign-in/email', {
        headers: { Origin: origin },
        data: { email, password },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(200);
  return (await (await request.get('/api/v1/me')).json()).user.id as string;
}
async function mutate(
  request: APIRequestContext,
  path: string,
  data: unknown,
  method: 'POST' | 'PATCH' = 'POST',
) {
  const { csrfToken } = await (await request.get('/api/v1/me')).json();
  const r = await request.fetch(`/api/v1/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: { Origin: origin, 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
    data,
  });
  expect(r.ok(), await r.text()).toBeTruthy();
  return r.json();
}
async function signIn(page: Page, email: string, path: string) {
  await page.goto('/auth/login');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(`${origin}${path}`);
}
async function axe(page: Page, label: string) {
  const result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
    .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'])
    .analyze();
  await test.info().attach(label, {
    body: JSON.stringify({ violations: result.violations }),
    contentType: 'application/json',
  });
  expect(result.violations).toEqual([]);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
}
async function fillEvidence(page: Page) {
  await page.getByLabel('Authorization method', { exact: true }).selectOption('WITNESSED_VERBAL');
  await page
    .getByLabel('Reviewed authorization policy', { exact: true })
    .selectOption({ label: 'Synthetic browser policy v1' });
  await page
    .getByLabel('Authorization date and time', { exact: true })
    .fill(new Date(Date.now() - 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16));
  await page
    .getByLabel('Authorization evidence reference', { exact: true })
    .fill('synthetic-confirmation-document');
  await page
    .getByLabel('Separate witness reference (required for verbal authorization)', { exact: true })
    .fill('separate-synthetic-witness');
}

===== tests\e2e\setup.ts =====

import { seedBrowserCommerceFixture } from '../../apps/api/test/commerce.fixture';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { spawn, execFile, type ChildProcess } from 'node:child_process';
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { createServer as netServer } from 'node:net';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import {
  captureMail,
  disposableDatabase,
  promoteDisposableAdmin,
  testConfig,
} from '../../apps/api/test/support';
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url));
async function free(port: number) {
  const server = netServer();
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    server.once('error', reject);
    server.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => server.close(() => resolve()));
  });
}
export default async function setup() {
  await free(3100);
  await free(3101);
  const database = await disposableDatabase();
  const mail = await captureMail();
  const children: ChildProcess[] = [];
  let log = '';
  const nonce = randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
  const control = createServer(async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://127.0.0.1');
      if (!url.pathname.startsWith(`/${nonce}/`)) {
        res.writeHead(404).end();
        return;
      }
      const email = url.searchParams.get('email') ?? '';
      if (url.pathname.endsWith('/token')) {
        const token = await mail.token(
          email,
          url.searchParams.get('kind') === 'reset'
            ? '/auth/reset-password'
            : url.searchParams.get('kind') === 'invitation'
              ? '/invitations/accept'
              : '/auth/verify-email',
        );
        res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ token }));
      } else if (url.pathname.endsWith('/promote') && req.method === 'POST') {
        await promoteDisposableAdmin(database.url, email);
        res.end('{}');
      } else if (url.pathname.endsWith('/commerce-fixture') && req.method === 'POST') {
        const fixture = await seedBrowserCommerceFixture(
          database.url,
          url.searchParams.get('suffix') ?? '',
        );
        res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        res.end(JSON.stringify(fixture));
      } else if (url.pathname.endsWith('/run-worker') && req.method === 'POST') {
        // Loopback nonce test control only; not registered in the production app.
        await promisify(execFile)(
          process.execPath,
          [
            `${root}node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs`,
            '--tsconfig',
            `${root}apps/api/tsconfig.json`,
            'apps/api/src/jobs/main.ts',
            '--once',
          ],
          { cwd: root, env: { ...process.env, ...environment } },
        );
        res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        res.end('{}');
      } else res.writeHead(404).end();
    } catch {
      res.writeHead(500).end('Test fixture failed.');
    }
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => control.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL = `http://127.0.0.1:${(control.address() as { port: number }).port}/${nonce}`;
  const config = testConfig(database.url, mail.port, {
    PUBLIC_APP_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100',
    API_PORT: 3101,
    LOG_LEVEL: 'silent',
  });
  const environment = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(config).map(([key, value]) => [
      key,
      Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(',') : String(value ?? ''),
    ]),
  );
  function start(command: string, args: string[], cwd: string, extra: Record<string, string> = {}) {
    const child = spawn(command, args, {
      cwd,
      env: { ...process.env, ...environment, ...extra },
      detached: process.platform !== 'win32',
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
    });
    for (const stream of [child.stdout, child.stderr])
      stream?.on('data', (chunk) => {
        log = (log + chunk.toString()).slice(-12000);
      });
    children.push(child);
    return child;
  }
  async function wait(url: string, child: ChildProcess) {
    for (let n = 0; n < 120; n++) {
      if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Test service exited. ${log}`);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1000) });
        if (response.ok) return;
      } catch {}
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
    }
    throw new Error(`Test service did not start. ${log}`);
  }
  async function cleanup() {
    for (const child of children.reverse()) {
      if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid) {
        try {
          if (process.platform !== 'win32') process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGTERM');
          else child.kill('SIGTERM');
        } catch {}
      }
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 700));
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => control.close(() => resolve()));
    await mail.stop();
    await database.stop();
  }
  try {
    const api = start(
      process.execPath,
      [
        `${root}node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs`,
        '--tsconfig',
        `${root}apps/api/tsconfig.json`,
        'apps/api/src/main.ts',
      ],
      root,
    );
    await wait('http://127.0.0.1:3101/api/health/ready', api);
    const webEnv = {
      NODE_ENV: 'production',
      API_INTERNAL_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:3101',
      NEXT_DIST_DIR: '.next-e2e',
    };
    const build = start(
      process.execPath,
      ['node_modules/next/dist/bin/next', 'build'],
      `${root}apps/web`,
      webEnv,
    );
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      build.once('error', reject);
      build.once('exit', (code) =>
        code === 0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error(`Browser build failed. ${log}`)),
      );
    });
    const web = start(
      process.execPath,
      ['node_modules/next/dist/bin/next', 'start', '--port', '3100'],
      `${root}apps/web`,
      webEnv,
    );
    await wait('http://127.0.0.1:3100', web);
    return cleanup;
  } catch (error) {
    await cleanup();
    throw error;
  }
}


===== tests\e2e\workspace-ui.spec.ts =====

import { test, expect, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
const origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100';
const password = 'Synthetic-commerce-browser-password-2026!';
async function register(request: APIRequestContext, email: string) {
  expect(
    (
      await request.post('/api/auth/sign-up/email', {
        headers: { Origin: origin },
        data: { email, name: 'Workspace Buyer', password },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(202);
  const { token } = await (
    await request.get(`${process.env.E2E_CONTROL_URL}/token?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`)
  ).json();
  expect(
    (await request.get(`/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`)).status(),
  ).toBe(200);
}
async function login(page: Page, email: string) {
  await page.goto('/auth/login?next=%2Fsettings%2Fprofile');
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/settings\/profile/);
}
async function a11y(page: Page, label: string) {
  const result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
    .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'])
    .analyze();
  await test.info().attach(label, {
    body: JSON.stringify({ violations: result.violations }),
    contentType: 'application/json',
  });
  expect(result.violations).toEqual([]);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
}
